# COUNTRY NAM. The native balance is sampled once before wartime rewards or losses.
# The stored value determines the mandate even if the live ladder later moves.
NAM_freeze_prewar_mandate = {
	clear_variable = NAM_ai_prewar_course
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_prewar_balance } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_prewar_balance value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_power_balance = { id = NAM_ladder_bop } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_prewar_balance value = power_balance_value }
			# The scalar may expose magnitude; the named BOP trigger supplies its direction.
			if = {
				limit = {
					power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value < 0 }
					check_variable = { NAM_prewar_balance > 0 }
				}
				multiply_variable = { var = NAM_prewar_balance value = -1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value > 0 }
					check_variable = { NAM_prewar_balance < 0 }
				}
				multiply_variable = { var = NAM_prewar_balance value = -1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_leader = { character = NAM_Egor_Rom ruling_only = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_prewar_district_mandate = yes }
				NAM_rom_take_humanism = yes
				set_portraits = {
					character = NAM_Egor_Rom
					civilian = { large = GFX_portrait_NAM_Egor_Rom_republic }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NAM_prewar_service_mandate = yes }
				NAM_rom_take_etatism = yes
				set_portraits = {
					character = NAM_Egor_Rom
					civilian = { large = GFX_portrait_NAM_Egor_Rom_state }
				}
			}
			else = {
				NAM_rom_take_pragmatism = yes
				set_portraits = {
					character = NAM_Egor_Rom
					civilian = { large = GFX_portrait_NAM_Egor_Rom_republic }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. District authority gives Rom the humanist leadership during the war.
NAM_rom_take_humanism = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_leader = { character = NAM_Egor_Rom ruling_only = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_leader_ideology = humanism_ideology }
		}
		NAM_rom_step_down = yes
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = humanism
			elections_allowed = no
		}
		add_country_leader_role = {
			character = NAM_Egor_Rom
			promote_leader = yes
			country_leader = {
				desc = NAM_Egor_Rom_desc
				ideology = humanism_ideology
				traits = {
					NAM_trait_keeper_of_seals
					NAM_trait_oil_ledger
				}
				expire = "2200.1.1.1"
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. A balanced mandate keeps Rom as a pragmatic arbiter.
NAM_rom_take_pragmatism = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_leader = { character = NAM_Egor_Rom ruling_only = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_leader_ideology = pragmatism_ideology }
		}
		NAM_rom_step_down = yes
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = pragmatism
			elections_allowed = no
		}
		add_country_leader_role = {
			character = NAM_Egor_Rom
			promote_leader = yes
			country_leader = {
				desc = NAM_Egor_Rom_desc
				ideology = pragmatism_ideology
				traits = {
					NAM_trait_keeper_of_seals
					NAM_trait_oil_ledger
				}
				expire = "2200.1.1.1"
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY scope. Repeated confederation teardown must preserve the current leader.
NAM_adopt_service_etatism = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = NAM_prewar_balance }
			has_country_leader = {
				character = NAM_Egor_Rom
				ruling_only = yes
			}
			has_country_leader_ideology = etatism_ideology
		}
		NAM_Egor_Rom = {
			remove_country_leader_role = { ideology = etatism_ideology }
		}
		add_country_leader_role = {
			character = NAM_Egor_Rom
			promote_leader = yes
			country_leader = {
				desc = NAM_Egor_Rom_desc
				ideology = service_etatism
				traits = {
					NAM_trait_keeper_of_seals
					NAM_trait_oil_ledger
				}
				expire = "2200.1.1.1"
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. An explicit constitutional choice may restore the service course.
NAM_rom_take_service_etatism = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_leader = {
				character = NAM_Egor_Rom
				ruling_only = yes
			}
			OR = {
				has_country_leader_ideology = etatism_ideology
				has_country_leader_ideology = humanism_ideology
				has_country_leader_ideology = pragmatism_ideology
			}
		}
		NAM_rom_step_down = yes
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = etatism
			elections_allowed = no
		}
		add_country_leader_role = {
			character = NAM_Egor_Rom
			promote_leader = yes
			country_leader = {
				desc = NAM_Egor_Rom_desc
				ideology = service_etatism
				traits = {
					NAM_trait_keeper_of_seals
					NAM_trait_oil_ledger
				}
				expire = "2200.1.1.1"
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every ending of the depot dispute and the island exile pass here;
# a seeded post-war board closes with it.
NAM_end_depot_concessions = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_case
	set_country_flag = NAM_depot_concessions_settled
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_private_tank_farms }
		remove_ideas = NAM_private_tank_farms
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_depot_board_seeded }
		NAM_depot_board_close = yes
	}
}

# ----- Post-war depot board -----
# COUNTRY NAM unless stated. The post-war tree replaces NAM_private_tank_farms
# with a board of five sites (700, 67, 689, 690, 225); each carries the private
# share in the state variable NAM_depot_hold (0-100). Sites NAM does not own and
# control are dormant and leave the total. Pending: seeded, not opened. Open:
# NAM_depot_board_open. Ended: NAM_depot_settlement_variant stored (1 revocation,
# 2 reserve buy-out, 3 cooperative revocation, 4 settlement, 5 owners' win).
# Every helper acts only while the board is pending or open.

# Called from NAM_open_postwar_future once per campaign; an island exile
# settled earlier keeps the old route.
NAM_depot_board_seed = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_depot_board_seeded }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_depot_concessions_settled }
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_depot_board_seeded
		# The decision ladder of the other routes stops here.
		if = {
			limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_depot_public_hearing }
			remove_mission = NAM_depot_public_hearing
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_case
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_private_tank_farms }
			remove_ideas = NAM_private_tank_farms
		}
		700 = { set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold value = 80 } }
		67 = { set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold value = 60 } }
		689 = { set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold value = 60 } }
		690 = { set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold value = 50 } }
		225 = { set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold value = 70 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_owner_funds value = 60 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_court value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_street value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_buyback value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_evidence value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyback_price value = 40 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_sold_count value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_seed_day value = global.num_days }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_depot_board_dynamic }
		NAM_depot_recompute = yes
	}
}

# Head card: the owners answer every 56 days from now on.
NAM_depot_board_open_case = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_pending = yes }
		set_country_flag = NAM_depot_board_open
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_round_delay value = 56 }
		NAM_depot_schedule_round = yes
	}
}

# The only scheduler of ADISCORD_nam_story.395. Input: temp NAM_depot_round_delay
# (56 for a round, 28 for a wartime pause).
NAM_depot_schedule_round = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_next_round_day value = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_next_round_day value = NAM_depot_round_delay }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_days_left value = NAM_depot_round_delay }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_round_delay < 56 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.395 days = 28 }
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.395 days = 56 }
	}
}

# Event-driven: every helper that changes a share or a rule calls it; nothing polls.
# Buy-out price: 2 x the private total, at most 200.
NAM_depot_recompute = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold_total value = 0 }
		700 = { NAM_depot_read_site = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_frame_700 value = NAM_depot_site_frame }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold_total value = NAM_depot_site_share }
		67 = { NAM_depot_read_site = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_frame_67 value = NAM_depot_site_frame }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold_total value = NAM_depot_site_share }
		689 = { NAM_depot_read_site = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_frame_689 value = NAM_depot_site_frame }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold_total value = NAM_depot_site_share }
		690 = { NAM_depot_read_site = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_frame_690 value = NAM_depot_site_frame }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold_total value = NAM_depot_site_share }
		225 = { NAM_depot_read_site = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_frame_225 value = NAM_depot_site_frame }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold_total value = NAM_depot_site_share }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_daily_drain value = NAM_depot_hold_total }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_depot_daily_drain value = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_depot_lockout_round }
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_depot_daily_drain value = 1.5 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_max_fuel_mod value = NAM_depot_hold_total }
		divide_variable = { var = NAM_depot_max_fuel_mod value = -2000 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyout_price value = NAM_depot_hold_total }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_depot_buyout_price
			min = 0
			max = 100
		}
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyout_price value = 2 }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

# STATE site. Output: temp NAM_depot_site_share (0 when dormant) and
# NAM_depot_site_frame for the basin gauge (0 dormant, 1-11 tenths, 12 sold).
NAM_depot_read_site = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_site_share value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_site_frame value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = NAM_depot_hold
			NAM_depot_site_counted = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_site_share value = NAM_depot_hold }
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_site_frame value = 12 }
		}
		else = {
			# floor(share / 10) + 1 on whole shares.
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_site_frame value = NAM_depot_hold }
			divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_site_frame value = 10 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_site_frame value = 0.45 }
			round_temp_variable = NAM_depot_site_frame
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_site_frame value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# STATE site. Input: temp NAM_depot_push_delta. A sold site moves only under the
# buy-back front (temp NAM_depot_buyback_push = 1) and is unsold again below 70.
NAM_depot_push_site = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = NAM_depot_hold
			NAM = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold }
				check_variable = { NAM_depot_push_delta > 0 }
				check_variable = { NAM_depot_buyback_push > 0 }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_hold value = NAM_depot_push_delta }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_depot_hold
			min = 0
			max = 100
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold
				check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold < 70 }
			}
			clr_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold
			NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_sold_count value = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold > 20 } } }
			set_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_public
		}
		else = {
			clr_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_public
		}
		NAM = { NAM_depot_recompute = yes }
	}
}

# Input: temp NAM_depot_push_site_id (state id or 0) and NAM_depot_push_delta.
NAM_depot_push_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_push_site_id = 700 } }
		700 = { NAM_depot_push_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_push_site_id = 67 } }
		67 = { NAM_depot_push_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_push_site_id = 689 } }
		689 = { NAM_depot_push_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_push_site_id = 690 } }
		690 = { NAM_depot_push_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_push_site_id = 225 } }
		225 = { NAM_depot_push_site = yes }
	}
}

# Inputs: temp NAM_depot_pick_floor (the share must exceed it) and
# NAM_depot_pick_exclude (state id or 0). Output: temp NAM_depot_pick_site, the
# unsold counted site with the highest share (0 when none); fixed order breaks ties.
NAM_depot_pick_highest = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_site value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_hold value = NAM_depot_pick_floor }
	700 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_depot_site_unsold = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_pick_exclude = 700 } }
				check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold > NAM_depot_pick_hold }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_site value = 700 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_hold value = NAM_depot_hold }
		}
	}
	67 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_depot_site_unsold = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_pick_exclude = 67 } }
				check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold > NAM_depot_pick_hold }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_site value = 67 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_hold value = NAM_depot_hold }
		}
	}
	689 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_depot_site_unsold = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_pick_exclude = 689 } }
				check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold > NAM_depot_pick_hold }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_site value = 689 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_hold value = NAM_depot_hold }
		}
	}
	690 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_depot_site_unsold = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_pick_exclude = 690 } }
				check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold > NAM_depot_pick_hold }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_site value = 690 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_hold value = NAM_depot_hold }
		}
	}
	225 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_depot_site_unsold = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_pick_exclude = 225 } }
				check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold > NAM_depot_pick_hold }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_site value = 225 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_hold value = NAM_depot_hold }
		}
	}
}

# Output: temp NAM_depot_target_site. The site marked on the basin map while it
# is counted, unsold and above 0; otherwise the highest unsold share.
NAM_depot_resolve_target = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_target_site value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_depot_target = 700 }
			700 = { NAM_depot_site_targetable = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_target_site value = 700 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_depot_target = 67 }
			67 = { NAM_depot_site_targetable = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_target_site value = 67 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_depot_target = 689 }
			689 = { NAM_depot_site_targetable = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_target_site value = 689 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_depot_target = 690 }
			690 = { NAM_depot_site_targetable = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_target_site value = 690 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_depot_target = 225 }
			225 = { NAM_depot_site_targetable = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_target_site value = 225 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_target_site = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_floor value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_exclude value = 0 }
		NAM_depot_pick_highest = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_target_site value = NAM_depot_pick_site }
	}
}

# Input: temp NAM_depot_push_delta.
NAM_depot_push_target = {
	NAM_depot_resolve_target = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = NAM_depot_target_site }
	NAM_depot_push_state = yes
}

# Input: temp NAM_depot_push_delta. Two fixed passes; the second skips the first pick.
NAM_depot_push_two_highest = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_floor value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_exclude value = 0 }
	NAM_depot_pick_highest = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = NAM_depot_pick_site }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_exclude value = NAM_depot_pick_site }
	NAM_depot_push_state = yes
	NAM_depot_pick_highest = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = NAM_depot_pick_site }
	NAM_depot_push_state = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_exclude value = 0 }
}

# Fronts raised before the head card are stored and act from the first round.
# A front already at level 3 pays its substitute instead.
NAM_depot_raise_front_court = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_front_court < 3 } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_court value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_evidence_delta value = 3 }
			NAM_depot_add_evidence = yes
		}
	}
}

NAM_depot_raise_front_street = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_front_street < 3 } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_street value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = -10 }
			NAM_depot_push_target = yes
		}
	}
}

NAM_depot_raise_front_buyback = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_front_buyback < 3 } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_buyback value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = -10 }
			NAM_depot_change_owner_funds = yes
		}
	}
}

# Input: temp NAM_depot_evidence_delta.
NAM_depot_add_evidence = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_evidence value = NAM_depot_evidence_delta }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_depot_evidence
			min = 0
			max = 12
		}
	}
}

# Input: temp NAM_depot_funds_delta.
NAM_depot_change_owner_funds = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_owner_funds value = NAM_depot_funds_delta }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_depot_owner_funds
			min = 0
			max = 100
		}
	}
}

# Pragmatic hook: the buy-back front pays half per level.
NAM_depot_set_buyback_discount = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyback_price value = 20 }
	}
}

# The first sold site in fixed order returns to share 60 and to the dispute.
NAM_depot_annul_one_sale = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes
			check_variable = { NAM_depot_sold_count > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyback_push value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { 700 = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold } }
			700 = { NAM_depot_return_sold_site = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { 67 = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold } }
			67 = { NAM_depot_return_sold_site = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { 689 = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold } }
			689 = { NAM_depot_return_sold_site = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { 690 = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold } }
			690 = { NAM_depot_return_sold_site = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { 225 = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold } }
			225 = { NAM_depot_return_sold_site = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyback_push value = 0 }
	}
}

# STATE sold site. Input: temp NAM_depot_buyback_push = 1.
NAM_depot_return_sold_site = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = 60 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = NAM_depot_hold }
	NAM_depot_push_site = yes
}

# The press move of the basin map; the AI branch of the round calls it at 150
# political power. The next round doubles every active front and its price.
NAM_depot_press_target = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_depot_press_available = yes
			NOT = { has_political_power < 50 }
		}
		add_political_power = -50
		set_country_flag = NAM_depot_press_next_round
	}
}

# Body of ADISCORD_nam_story.395. A copy arriving before the stored round day does
# nothing and does not reschedule, so the chain stays single. A war pauses the
# round; the end of the war for the South, or 900 days for the AI, decides the
# dispute by its total.
NAM_depot_round = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_depot_board_open
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_next_round_day > global.num_days } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_board_age value = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_board_age value = NAM_depot_seed_day }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_global_flag = ADISCORD_south_final_resolved
					AND = {
						is_ai = yes
						check_variable = { NAM_depot_board_age > 899 }
					}
				}
			}
			NAM_depot_board_resolve_by_total = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_war = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_round_delay value = 28 }
			NAM_depot_schedule_round = yes
		}
		else = {
			clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_lockout_round
			NAM_depot_recompute = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					NOT = { has_political_power < 150 }
				}
				NAM_depot_press_target = yes
			}
			NAM_depot_round_fronts = yes
			NAM_depot_round_drift = yes
			NAM_depot_check_loss = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_depot_board_open }
				NAM_depot_round_owner_move = yes
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_round_delay value = 56 }
				NAM_depot_schedule_round = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Court, street, buy-back in fixed order, each on the target resolved at its turn.
NAM_depot_round_fronts = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_press_factor value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_depot_press_next_round }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_press_factor value = 2 }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_press_next_round
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyback_push value = 0 }
	# Court: one piece of evidence per strength step; idle without evidence and
	# frozen for one round after the owners' lawsuit.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_front_court > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_depot_court_frozen }
			clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_court_frozen
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_evidence > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_factor value = NAM_depot_press_factor }
			clamp_temp_variable = {
				var = NAM_depot_front_factor
				min = 1
				max = NAM_depot_evidence
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = NAM_depot_front_court }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = -6 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = NAM_depot_front_factor }
			NAM_depot_push_target = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_evidence_delta value = NAM_depot_front_factor }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_evidence_delta value = -1 }
			NAM_depot_add_evidence = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = NAM_depot_front_court }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = -3 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = NAM_depot_front_factor }
			NAM_depot_change_owner_funds = yes
		}
	}
	# Street: paid in fuel (1500 per strength step) and in the export houses'
	# support, skipped for the round when the stock is short. fuel_k counts
	# thousands, so the price is compared in thousands.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_front_street > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_strength value = NAM_depot_front_street }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_strength value = NAM_depot_press_factor }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_street_fuel_k value = NAM_depot_front_strength }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_street_fuel_k value = 1.5 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fuel_k < NAM_depot_street_fuel_k } } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_street_fuel value = NAM_depot_front_strength }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_street_fuel value = -1500 }
			add_fuel = NAM_depot_street_fuel
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = NAM_depot_front_strength }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = -5 }
			NAM_depot_push_target = yes
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = NAM_depot_front_strength }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = NAM_depot_front_strength }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = NAM_depot_front_strength }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = -2 }
			NAM_depot_change_owner_funds = yes
		}
	}
	# Buy-back: paid from the treasury per strength step, skipped when short. A
	# sold share is bought back first, at half strength.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_front_buyback > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_strength value = NAM_depot_front_buyback }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_front_strength value = NAM_depot_press_factor }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = NAM_depot_front_strength }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = NAM_depot_buyback_price }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ADISCORD_economy_treasury < NAM_treasury_amount } } }
			NAM_spend_treasury = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = NAM_depot_front_strength }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = 2 }
			NAM_depot_change_owner_funds = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { 700 = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = 700 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { 67 = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = 67 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { 689 = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = 689 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { 690 = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = 690 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { 225 = { has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = 225 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_push_site_id > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = NAM_depot_front_strength }
				multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = -4 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyback_push value = 1 }
				NAM_depot_push_state = yes
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyback_push value = 0 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = NAM_depot_front_strength }
				multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = -8 }
				NAM_depot_push_target = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NAM_groups_refresh = yes
}

# Owners' income, the group drift of a high or low total and the local yield of
# sites back in public hands (share 20 or less).
NAM_depot_round_drift = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = NAM_depot_hold_total }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = 64 }
	NAM_depot_change_owner_funds = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold_total < 250 } } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = -1 }
		NAM_groups_refresh = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold_total > 150 } } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = -1 }
		NAM_groups_refresh = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 700 = { NAM_depot_site_yields = yes } }
		add_fuel = 4000
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 225 = { NAM_depot_site_yields = yes } }
		add_fuel = 3000
	}
	67 = {
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_depot_site_yields = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_repair_amount value = 5 }
			NAM_field_apply_repair = yes
		}
	}
	689 = {
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_depot_site_yields = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_repair_amount value = 5 }
			NAM_field_apply_repair = yes
		}
	}
	690 = {
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_depot_site_yields = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_repair_amount value = 5 }
			NAM_field_apply_repair = yes
		}
	}
}

# Called after the fronts and in the answers of 396-400: the owners win at a
# private total of 450 or with three shares sold.
NAM_depot_check_loss = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_depot_board_open
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold_total < 450 } }
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_sold_count < 3 } }
			}
		}
		NAM_depot_board_lose = yes
	}
}

# Weights come from the board; five fixed branches, no scans. Below 10 funds the
# owners make no move.
NAM_depot_round_owner_move = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_owner_funds < 10 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_floor value = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_pick_exclude value = 0 }
		NAM_depot_pick_highest = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_move_site value = NAM_depot_pick_site }
		# Lockout of the highest unsold site.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_lockout value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_move_site > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_lockout value = NAM_depot_front_street }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_lockout value = 10 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_lockout value = 30 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_depot_rail_crews_ready }
				multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_lockout value = 0.5 }
			}
		}
		# Lawsuit against an active court front.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_lawsuit value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_depot_front_court > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_owner_funds < 15 } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_lawsuit value = NAM_depot_front_court }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_lawsuit value = 10 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_lawsuit value = 25 }
		}
		# Sale of the highest unsold share to a Shahrabad house.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_sale value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_depot_sale_possible = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_sale value = NAM_depot_owner_funds }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_sale value = 50 }
			divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_sale value = 2 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_sale value = 15 }
		}
		# Sabotage of the most private field while a front is active.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_field_site value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_field_hold value = 29.9 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_depot_front_active = yes }
			67 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NAM_depot_site_counted = yes
						check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold > NAM_depot_field_hold }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_field_site value = 67 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_field_hold value = NAM_depot_hold }
				}
			}
			689 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NAM_depot_site_counted = yes
						check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold > NAM_depot_field_hold }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_field_site value = 689 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_field_hold value = NAM_depot_hold }
				}
			}
			690 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NAM_depot_site_counted = yes
						check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold > NAM_depot_field_hold }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_field_site value = 690 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_field_hold value = NAM_depot_hold }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_sabotage value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_field_site > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_sabotage value = 20 }
		}
		# Press bribes against the target, or the lockout site when every share is at 0.
		NAM_depot_resolve_target = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_target_site = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_target_site value = NAM_depot_move_site }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_bribe value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_target_site > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_w_bribe value = 20 }
		}
		# Cumulative thresholds of one roll.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_c_lawsuit value = NAM_depot_w_lockout }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_c_lawsuit value = NAM_depot_w_lawsuit }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_c_sale value = NAM_depot_c_lawsuit }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_c_sale value = NAM_depot_w_sale }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_c_sabotage value = NAM_depot_c_sale }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_c_sabotage value = NAM_depot_w_sabotage }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_c_bribe value = NAM_depot_c_sabotage }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_c_bribe value = NAM_depot_w_bribe }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_c_bribe > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_roll value = random }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_roll value = NAM_depot_c_bribe }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_roll < NAM_depot_w_lockout } }
				NAM_depot_owner_move_lockout = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_roll < NAM_depot_c_lawsuit } }
				NAM_depot_owner_move_lawsuit = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_roll < NAM_depot_c_sale } }
				NAM_depot_owner_move_sale = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_roll < NAM_depot_c_sabotage } }
				NAM_depot_owner_move_sabotage = yes
			}
			else = {
				NAM_depot_owner_move_bribe = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Input: temp NAM_depot_move_site. With the town boiler houses supplied directly
# the lockout raises the site by 5 and adds no drain surcharge.
NAM_depot_owner_move_lockout = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_event_site value = NAM_depot_move_site }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_depot_towns_direct }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_event_amount value = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_event_amount value = 10 }
		set_country_flag = NAM_depot_lockout_round
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = NAM_depot_move_site }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = NAM_depot_event_amount }
	NAM_depot_push_state = yes
	NAM_depot_recompute = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = -10 }
	NAM_depot_change_owner_funds = yes
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.396 hours = 6 }
}

NAM_depot_owner_move_lawsuit = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_event_site value = 0 }
	set_country_flag = NAM_depot_court_frozen
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = -15 }
	NAM_depot_change_owner_funds = yes
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.397 hours = 6 }
}

# Input: temp NAM_depot_move_site (an unsold site at 70 or more). Shahrabad's
# influence power is paid by the answers of .398 that let the sale stand.
NAM_depot_owner_move_sale = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_event_site value = NAM_depot_move_site }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_move_site = 700 } }
		700 = { NAM_depot_sell_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_move_site = 67 } }
		67 = { NAM_depot_sell_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_move_site = 689 } }
		689 = { NAM_depot_sell_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_move_site = 690 } }
		690 = { NAM_depot_sell_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_move_site = 225 } }
		225 = { NAM_depot_sell_site = yes }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = 20 }
	NAM_depot_change_owner_funds = yes
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.398 hours = 6 }
}

# STATE site. The previous share is kept for answer b of .398.
NAM_depot_sell_site = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_sale_prev value = NAM_depot_hold }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = 100 }
	NAM_depot_push_site = yes
	set_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold
	NAM = {
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_sale_prev_hold value = NAM_depot_sale_prev }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_sold_count value = 1 }
		NAM_depot_recompute = yes
	}
}

# Answer b of .398: the stored site returns to its share before the sale.
NAM_depot_undo_sale = {

		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_event_site = 700 } }
		700 = { NAM_depot_unsell_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_event_site = 67 } }
		67 = { NAM_depot_unsell_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_event_site = 689 } }
		689 = { NAM_depot_unsell_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_event_site = 690 } }
		690 = { NAM_depot_unsell_site = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_event_site = 225 } }
		225 = { NAM_depot_unsell_site = yes }
	}
}

# STATE sold site.
NAM_depot_unsell_site = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold
			NAM = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		}
		clr_state_flag = NAM_depot_site_sold
		NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_depot_sold_count value = -1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = NAM.NAM_depot_sale_prev_hold }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = NAM_depot_hold }
		NAM_depot_push_site = yes
	}
}

# Input: temp NAM_depot_field_site. The damage actually done is kept for the answers of .399.
NAM_depot_owner_move_sabotage = {

	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_effective_damage value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_field_site = 67 } }
		67 = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_damage_amount value = 20 }
			NAM_field_apply_damage = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_field_site = 689 } }
		689 = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_damage_amount value = 20 }
			NAM_field_apply_damage = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_field_site = 690 } }
		690 = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_damage_amount value = 20 }
			NAM_field_apply_damage = yes
		}
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_event_amount value = NAM_field_effective_damage }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_site_id value = NAM_depot_field_site }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = 5 }
	NAM_depot_push_state = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_funds_delta value = -10 }
	NAM_depot_change_owner_funds = yes
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.399 hours = 6 }
}

# Answers of .396: the drain surcharge of the lockout round ends.
NAM_depot_lift_lockout = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes
			has_country_flag = NAM_depot_lockout_round
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_lockout_round
		NAM_depot_recompute = yes
	}
}

# Endings 1-4. Input: temp NAM_depot_variant (1 revocation, 2 reserve buy-out,
# 3 cooperative revocation, 4 settlement with the owners).
NAM_depot_board_settle_variant = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_variant < 4 } }
			# Every share returns to the state, sold shares included.
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = -100 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyback_push value = 1 }
			700 = { NAM_depot_push_site = yes }
			67 = { NAM_depot_push_site = yes }
			689 = { NAM_depot_push_site = yes }
			690 = { NAM_depot_push_site = yes }
			225 = { NAM_depot_push_site = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_buyback_push value = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_settlement_variant value = NAM_depot_variant }
		NAM_end_depot_concessions = yes
	}
}

# Ending 5: the owners keep their shares; the close freezes the drain at half
# rate and the storage penalty at 10 %.
NAM_depot_board_concede = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_settlement_variant value = 5 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 10 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = -15 }
		NAM_groups_refresh = yes
		NAM_end_depot_concessions = yes
	}
}

NAM_depot_board_lose = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_depot_board_open }
		NAM_depot_board_concede = yes
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.394 days = 1 }
	}
}

# Ending 6: a private total of 200 or less ends as a revocation, a higher one as
# the owners' win without event 394. The stored variant is 1 or 5. Acts on a
# pending board too: the end of the war for the South closes a dispute the
# player never opened, so its drain cannot outlive the post-war tree.
NAM_depot_board_resolve_by_total = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_depot_board_not_ended = yes }
		NAM_depot_recompute = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_hold_total > 200 } } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_variant value = 1 }
			NAM_depot_board_settle_variant = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM_depot_board_concede = yes
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.401 days = 1 }
	}
}

# Called only by NAM_end_depot_concessions. Clears the round rules; the stored
# variant and the evidence stay. Variants 4 and 5 keep the modifier with frozen
# values, every other close (and the island exile) removes it.
NAM_depot_board_close = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_board_open
	clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_sale_banned
	clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_rail_crews_ready
	clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_court_frozen
	clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_lockout_round
	clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_cooperative_route
	clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_towns_direct
	clr_country_flag = NAM_depot_press_next_round
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_depot_board_conceded = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_island_exile }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_daily_drain value = NAM_depot_hold_total }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_depot_daily_drain value = 2.5 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_depot_settlement_variant = 5 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_max_fuel_mod value = -0.10 }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_daily_drain value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_depot_max_fuel_mod value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_depot_board_dynamic } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_depot_board_dynamic }
		}
	}
}

# Shared core of the three lane ends at 31,8 (NAM_depot_state_fuel_service,
# NAM_depot_fuel_service_shares, NAM_depot_cooperative_fuel_service). Each calls

				type = fuel_silo
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
	}
	690 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = ROOT
				is_controlled_by = ROOT
			}
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			add_building_construction = {
				type = fuel_silo
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_grp_depot_fuel_service_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		# A silo whose district is not held at delivery is paid to the treasury.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					67 = {
						is_owned_by = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 450 }
			NAM_add_treasury = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					690 = {
						is_owned_by = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 450 }
			NAM_add_treasury = yes
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_adm_fuel_gain_factor value = 0.08 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_adm_stability_factor value = 0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_adm_admin_expense value = 0.03 }
		NAM_refresh_administration = yes
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 12 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = -6 }
		NAM_groups_refresh = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL/AZH. The own-country callback is independent of NAM's focus tree.
# A single bounded muster counts ordinary recruitment and consumes real recruits.
NAM_rw_coalition_muster = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = EFL
				tag = AZH
			}
			exists = yes
			has_capitulated = no
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_rw_coalition_mobilised }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolved }
			capital_scope = {
				is_owned_by = PREV
				is_controlled_by = PREV
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_rw_coalition_mobilised
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_muster_target value = 10 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_rifle_reserve value = 12000 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_squad_reserve value = 200 }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = EFL }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_muster_target value = 15 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_rifle_reserve value = 20000 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_squad_reserve value = 300 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_muster_count value = num_divisions }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_muster_missing value = NAM_rw_muster_target }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_muster_missing value = NAM_rw_muster_count }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_muster_missing min = 0 max = 15 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_rifle_need value = NAM_rw_muster_missing }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_rifle_need value = 3600 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_rifle_need value = NAM_rw_rifle_reserve }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_rifle_need value = num_equipment@infantry_equipment }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rw_rifle_need > 0 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment_0 amount = NAM_rw_rifle_need producer = THIS }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_squad_need value = NAM_rw_muster_missing }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_squad_need value = 32 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_squad_need value = NAM_rw_squad_reserve }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_squad_need value = num_equipment@ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rw_squad_need > 0 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment_0 amount = NAM_rw_squad_need producer = THIS }
		}
		NAM_rw_coalition_transport_reserve = yes
		division_template = {
			name = "Restitution Regiment"
			template_counter = 3
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = 15
			value = NAM_rw_muster_index
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_rw_muster_count value = NAM_rw_muster_target compare = less_than }
					NOT = { has_manpower < 4000 }
					NOT = { has_equipment = { infantry_equipment < 3600 } }
					NOT = { has_equipment = { ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment < 32 } }
				}
				add_manpower = -4000
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = -3600 producer = THIS }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment amount = -32 producer = THIS }
				capital_scope = {
					create_unit = {
						division = "division_template = \"Restitution Regiment\" start_experience_factor = 0.20 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
						owner = PREV
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_muster_count value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL/AZH. Top up reserves once; ordinary supply use and losses continue.
NAM_rw_coalition_transport_reserve = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_fuel < 20000 }
		set_fuel = 20000
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_transport_need value = 20 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_transport_need value = num_equipment@train_equipment }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rw_transport_need > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = NAM_rw_transport_need producer = THIS }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_transport_need value = 150 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_transport_need value = num_equipment@motorized_equipment }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rw_transport_need > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = motorized_equipment_1 amount = NAM_rw_transport_need producer = THIS }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_transport_need value = 150 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_transport_need value = num_equipment@support_equipment }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rw_transport_need > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment_1 amount = NAM_rw_transport_need producer = THIS }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		end = 40
		value = NAM_rw_convoy_index
		if = {
			limit = { has_navy_size = { size < 40 type = convoy } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = convoy_1 amount = 1 producer = THIS }
		}
	}
}
