# Country event in the recipient's scope. Both templates are created at delivery
# so edits to the peacetime army cannot change the composition or the price.
NAM_rw_coalition_second_wave = {
	random_owned_controlled_state = {
		prioritize = { 69 701 }
		save_event_target_as = NAM_rw_second_wave_state
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_second_wave_regiments value = 4 }
	if = {
		limit = { difficulty > 2 }
		add_manpower = 100000
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_second_wave_regiments value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { difficulty > 1 }
		add_manpower = 30000
	}
	division_template = {
		name = "Coalition Reserve Regiment"
		template_counter = 3
		division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
		regiments = {
			infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
			infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
			infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
			infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		end = NAM_rw_second_wave_regiments
		value = NAM_rw_second_wave_index
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_manpower < 4000 }
				NOT = { has_equipment = { infantry_equipment < 3600 } }
				NOT = { has_equipment = { ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment < 32 } }
			}
			add_manpower = -4000
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = -3600 }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment amount = -32 }
			event_target:NAM_rw_second_wave_state = {
				create_unit = {
					division = "division_template = \"Coalition Reserve Regiment\" start_experience_factor = 0.20 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
					owner = PREV
					allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
				}
			}
		}
	}
	division_template = {
		name = "Coalition Reserve Militia"
		template_counter = 7
		division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
		regiments = {
			ADISCORD_militia = { x = 0 y = 0 }
			ADISCORD_militia = { x = 0 y = 1 }
			ADISCORD_militia = { x = 1 y = 0 }
		}
	}
	event_target:NAM_rw_second_wave_state = {
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = 10
			value = NAM_rw_second_wave_militia_index
			create_unit = {
				division = "division_template = \"Coalition Reserve Militia\" start_experience_factor = 0.10 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
				owner = PREV
				allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
			}
		}
	}
}

# Every queued ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.1 is counted. A dispatch that fails
# readiness may stop the entry only when no other dispatch is still queued, so
# a pending retry always owns the final decision and no war follows a refund.
NAM_rw_count_entry_dispatch = {
	add_to_variable = { var = global.NAM_rw_entry_dispatches value = 1 }
}

ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_ready = yes }
		NAM = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_subject = yes }
				overlord = { set_autonomy = { target = NAM autonomy_state = autonomy_free } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
				leave_faction = yes
			}
		}
		clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_scheduled
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_begin_hostilities = yes
	}
}

ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_begin_hostilities = {
	set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_started
	VAL = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_focus_tree = VAL_focus
			}
			mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.3 hours = 1 }
		}
	}
	clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_scheduled
	clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_EFL_defeated
	clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_AZH_defeated
	clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_SLF_defeated

	NAM = {
		NAM_agreement_cancel = yes
		NAM_freeze_prewar_mandate = yes
		remove_mission = NAM_resource_war_deadline
		clr_country_flag = NAM_rw_war_dispatched
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_rw_first_strike }
			add_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_first_strike_corps
		}
		else = {
			add_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_extraction_defence_corps
		}
		add_war_support = 0.20
		# Reserve for the three baseline formations only. Paid orders took
		# their recruits when they were placed and are delivered from escrow.
		add_manpower = 8000
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 20000 producer = NAM }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment_0 amount = 80 producer = NAM }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment amount = 300 producer = NAM }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = artillery_equipment amount = 250 producer = NAM }
		# The templates exist before any unit refers to them: the baseline OOB
		# carries units only and shares the fixed mobilisation templates with orders.
		NAM_order_ensure_templates = yes
		load_oob = "NAM_resource_war"
		NAM_deliver_mobilisation_orders = yes
		NAM_seal_discipline_begin = yes
	}
	EFL = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			leave_faction = yes
		}
		add_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_restitution_coalition
		add_war_support = 0.18
		NAM_rw_coalition_muster = yes
		NAM_rw_grant_wartime_rifle_stockpile = yes
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.119 days = 45 } }
	}
	AZH = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			leave_faction = yes
		}
		add_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_restitution_coalition
		add_war_support = 0.22
		NAM_rw_coalition_muster = yes
		NAM_rw_grant_wartime_rifle_stockpile = yes
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.119 days = 45 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_rw_first_strike } }
		EFL = { add_war_support = 0.10 }
		AZH = { add_war_support = 0.10 }
	}

	# Only states with a direct material interest mobilise expeditionary corps:
	# Rahma wants capped fuel prices; Mazar wants priority access for water convoys.
	# A buyer already holding a Svetlogorsk fuel contract has nothing to win.
	if = {
		limit = {
			RHM = {
				exists = yes
				is_subject = no
				has_war = no
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_oil_client }
			}
		}
		RHM = { add_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_profitable_volunteer_contracts }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			MZR = {
				exists = yes
				is_subject = no
				has_war = no
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_oil_client }
			}
		}
		MZR = { add_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_profitable_volunteer_contracts }
	}

	EFL = {
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = faction_eflor_azhar_restitution_alliance
		}
		add_to_faction = AZH
	}

	67 = {
		add_claim_by = EFL
		add_claim_by = AZH
	}
	# Every principal must fall before native faction peace can end the campaign.
	NAM = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_reserve_major = yes }
	EFL = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_reserve_major = yes }
	AZH = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_reserve_major = yes }
	# A first strike makes Svetlogorye the declarer of the same single war.
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_rw_first_strike } }
		NAM = { declare_war_on = { target = EFL type = annex_everything } }
	}
	else = {
		EFL = { declare_war_on = { target = NAM type = annex_everything } }
	}
	AZH = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = NAM } }
			add_to_war = {
				targeted_alliance = EFL
				enemy = NAM
				hostility_reason = asked_to_join
				single_target_only = yes
			}
		}
	}

	NAM = {
		if = {
			limit = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes }
			load_focus_tree = {
				tree = NAM_resource_war_focus
				keep_completed = yes
			}
		}
		# The declarations above end the contracts of every belligerent buyer.
		NAM_oil_validate_clients = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_compact_effective = yes }
			set_country_flag = NAM_compact_ratified
			set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_SLF_defeated
		}
		# The underground's strength decides the uprising; a missing value reads 0.
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_underground value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.2 days = 45 random_days = 30 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_underground value = 30 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			random_list = {
				50 = { country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.2 days = 45 random_days = 30 } }
				50 = { set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_SLF_defeated }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_SLF_defeated
		}
		activate_mission = NAM_defend_fields
		NAM_activate_field_missions = yes
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.11 hours = 1 }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.50 days = 420 }
		news_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_news.1 hours = 1 }
		ADISCORD_nam_show_resource_war_superevent = yes
	}
}

# Timeout settlement for an oil score of 36-99. Svetlogorye survives as a rump:
# it keeps every field it still controls and its islands, cedes the fields held
# by the coalition and owes a year of fuel tribute.
ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_compromise = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes }
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolved
		NAM = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
		VAL = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					has_focus_tree = VAL_focus
				}
				mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_compromise
		VAL = { VAL_cancel_nam_concession = yes }
		clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_started

		# Ownership follows wartime control before white peace returns occupations.
		67 = { NAM_rw_compromise_cede_field = yes }
		689 = { NAM_rw_compromise_cede_field = yes }
		690 = { NAM_rw_compromise_cede_field = yes }
		719 = { NAM_rw_compromise_cede_field = yes }
		688 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_controlled_by = NAM }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM } }
					NAM = { transfer_state = 688 }
				}
				remove_core_of = SLF
			}
			else = {
				EFL = { transfer_state = 688 }
				remove_core_of = SLF
				remove_core_of = NAM
				add_core_of = EFL
				add_claim_by = NAM
				set_state_controller_to = EFL
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { SLF = { exists = yes } }
			688 = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { tag = SLF } }
						annex_country = { target = SLF transfer_troops = no }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_end_all_wars = yes
		NAM = {
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM } }
				set_state_controller_to = NAM
			}
		}

		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_clear_temporary_support = yes
		VAL = { VAL_settle_resource_aid = yes }
		NAM = {
			NAM_rw_start_tribute = yes
			load_focus_tree = {
				tree = NAM_defeated_focus
				keep_completed = no
			}
		}
		EFL = { news_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_news.7 hours = 1 } }
		ADISCORD_south_begin_preparation = yes
	}
}

# STATE field owned by NAM. Cede it to the coalition member that controls it;
# a field Svetlogorye still holds stays with it. Another occupier counts as Eflor.
NAM_rw_compromise_cede_field = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_owned_by = NAM
			is_controlled_by = AZH
		}
		AZH = { transfer_state = PREV }
		remove_core_of = NAM
		add_core_of = AZH
		add_claim_by = NAM
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_owned_by = NAM
			NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM }
		}
		EFL = { transfer_state = PREV }
		remove_core_of = NAM
		add_core_of = EFL
		add_claim_by = NAM
		set_state_controller_to = EFL
	}
}

ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_start_mainland_rebellion = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			688 = { is_owned_by = NAM }
			NAM = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_compact_ratified }
				# Yaroslav Weber accepted the amnesty: there is no uprising to lead.
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_weber_amnesty }
			}
		}
		SLF = {
			transfer_state = 688
			set_capital = { state = 688 }
			add_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_insurgent_columns
			add_war_support = 0.20
			load_oob = "SLF_nam_resource_war"
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 18000 producer = SLF }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment_0 amount = 20 producer = SLF }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment amount = 220 producer = SLF }
			declare_war_on = { target = NAM type = annex_everything }
		}
		688 = {
			add_core_of = SLF
			set_state_controller_to = SLF
		}
		SLF = { news_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_news.5 hours = 1 } }
	}
	else = {
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_SLF_defeated
	}
}

ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_clear_temporary_support = {
	NAM = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes }
	EFL = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes }
	AZH = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes }
	NAM = {
		NAM_close_war_programmes = yes
		NAM_underground_close_campaign = yes
		remove_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_extraction_defence_corps
		remove_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_first_strike_corps
		remove_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_last_line_administration
	}
	EFL = { remove_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_restitution_coalition }
	AZH = { remove_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_restitution_coalition }
	RHM = { remove_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_profitable_volunteer_contracts }
	MZR = { remove_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_profitable_volunteer_contracts }
	if = {
		limit = { SLF = { exists = yes } }
		SLF = { remove_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_insurgent_columns }
	}
}

ADISCORD_nam_refresh_emergency_defence = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = ADISCORD_nam_last_line_administration
			OR = {
				is_ai = no
				NOT = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes }
				surrender_progress < 0.45
			}
		}
		remove_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_last_line_administration
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			surrender_progress > 0.60
			NOT = { has_idea = ADISCORD_nam_last_line_administration }
		}
		add_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_last_line_administration
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			surrender_progress > 0.40
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ADISCORD_nam_emergency_reserve_called }
		}
		set_country_flag = ADISCORD_nam_emergency_reserve_called
		add_manpower = 7000
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 15000 producer = NAM }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment amount = 300 producer = NAM }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = artillery_equipment amount = 150 producer = NAM }
		capital_scope = {
			create_unit = {
				division = "name = \"Last Line Guard\" division_template = \"Capital Guard\" start_experience_factor = 0.20 start_equipment_factor = 1.00"
				owner = NAM
			}
			create_unit = {
				division = "name = \"Last Line Infantry\" division_template = \"Line Infantry Brigade\" start_experience_factor = 0.15 start_equipment_factor = 1.00"
				owner = NAM
			}
		}
	}
}

ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_end_all_wars = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { has_war_with = EFL } }
		NAM = { white_peace = EFL }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { has_war_with = AZH } }
		NAM = { white_peace = AZH }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			SLF = {
				exists = yes
				has_war_with = NAM
			}
		}
		SLF = { white_peace = NAM }
	}
}

# Capitulation, a lost front, a lost timeout and a lost war of return share this
# treaty. Svetlogorye loses the whole mainland; while it owns an overseas
# district it survives there in exile, otherwise it is annexed.
ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_coalition_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
				NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_war_of_return_active = yes }
			NAM_war_of_return_close = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolved
		# Settle paid domestic work before a possible annexation removes NAM.
		NAM = { NAM_underground_close_campaign = yes }
		NAM = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
		VAL = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					has_focus_tree = VAL_focus
				}
				mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_coalition_victory
		VAL = { VAL_cancel_nam_concession = yes }
		clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_started
		# The flight to the islands is decided while the mainland is still
		# Svetlogorsk and its divisions still stand there, before the peace
		# moves any unit.
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_rw_can_go_into_exile = yes }
			NAM = { NAM_rw_exile_evacuate = yes }
		}
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_end_all_wars = yes

		EFL = {
			if = {
				limit = { SLF = { exists = yes } }
				annex_country = { target = SLF transfer_troops = no }
			}
		}
		# Eflor inherits the uprising district together with the uprising.
		688 = {
			remove_core_of = SLF
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				remove_core_of = NAM
				add_core_of = EFL
				add_claim_by = NAM
				set_state_controller_to = EFL
			}
		}
		# The mainland goes to the victors in both outcomes: Eflor takes the
		# Northern Deposits and Svetlogorsk, Azhar the southern fields and the
		# harbour, Eflor any other mainland district Svetlogorye still owns.
		67 = { NAM_rw_cede_mainland_state = yes }
		688 = { NAM_rw_cede_mainland_state = yes }
		689 = { NAM_rw_cede_mainland_state = yes }
		690 = { NAM_rw_cede_mainland_state = yes }
		700 = { NAM_rw_cede_mainland_state = yes }
		719 = { NAM_rw_cede_mainland_state = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_rw_can_go_into_exile = yes }
			NAM = {
				every_owned_state = {
					limit = { NOT = { NAM_rw_island_state = yes } }
					NAM_rw_cede_mainland_state = yes
				}
			}
			NAM_rw_settle_island_exile = yes
		}
		else = {
			# Without an overseas district nothing is left to govern: the
			# original partition annexes the remainder to Eflor.
			clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_island_exile
			if = {
				limit = { NAM = { exists = yes } }
				NAM = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_focus_tree = NAM_resource_war_focus }
						load_focus_tree = {
							tree = NAM_focus
							keep_completed = yes
						}
					}
				}
				EFL = { annex_country = { target = NAM transfer_troops = no } }
			}
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_clear_temporary_support = yes
			VAL = { VAL_settle_resource_aid = yes }
			NAM_oil_close_all = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_debug_corporate_start }
						has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
					}
				}
			}
			EFL = { news_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_news.2 hours = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

# STATE owned by NAM on the mainland. Azhar takes the southern fields and the
# harbour while it exists, Eflor everything else. Svetlogorye keeps a claim on
# the fields for a later war of return.
NAM_rw_cede_mainland_state = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_owned_by = NAM
			OR = {
				state = 689
				state = 690
				state = 700
				state = 719
			}
			country_exists = AZH
		}
		AZH = { transfer_state = PREV }
		remove_core_of = NAM
		add_core_of = AZH
		add_claim_by = NAM
		set_state_controller_to = AZH
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
		EFL = { transfer_state = PREV }
		remove_core_of = NAM
		add_core_of = EFL
		add_claim_by = NAM
		set_state_controller_to = EFL
	}
}

# GLOBAL. The coalition holds the whole mainland; Svetlogorye survives on its
# overseas districts. NAM_rw_exile_evacuate has already moved the capital and
# the army to the islands; the islands return to Svetlogorsk control. The
# evacuation starts the island succession outside the debug route.
# The defeat tree belongs to the compromise only.
NAM_rw_settle_island_exile = {
	ADISCORD_south_suspend_preparation = yes
	# A new story campaign: the war for the South gets a new calendar.
	ADISCORD_south_clear_deadline = yes
	# The country's institutions stay on the mainland. Only the first settlement
	# finds the island flag unset, so the reset runs once per campaign.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_island_exile } }
		NAM = { ADISCORD_reset_country_development = yes }
	}
	set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_island_exile
	NAM = {
		# The pillars stay on the mainland: a running agreement or offer ends here.
		NAM_agreement_cancel = yes
		clr_country_flag = NAM_crisis_open
		clr_country_flag = NAM_coup_pending
		if = {
			limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_incident_countdown }
			remove_mission = NAM_incident_countdown
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_incident_response }
			remove_mission = NAM_incident_response
		}
		# The depot case and the private tank farms belong to the mainland.
		if = {
			limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_depot_public_hearing }
			remove_mission = NAM_depot_public_hearing
		}
		NAM_end_depot_concessions = yes
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM } }
			set_state_controller_to = NAM
		}
	}
	ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_clear_temporary_support = yes
	VAL = { VAL_settle_resource_aid = yes }
	# Contracts end with the fields; the island steel concession continues.
	NAM_oil_release_all_buyers = yes
	# Scorched earth: the victors receive burnt fields and a wrecked harbour.
	67 = { NAM_rw_exile_scorch_state = yes }
	688 = { NAM_rw_exile_scorch_state = yes }
	689 = { NAM_rw_exile_scorch_state = yes }
	690 = { NAM_rw_exile_scorch_state = yes }
	719 = { NAM_rw_exile_scorch_state = yes }
	700 = { NAM_rw_exile_scorch_state = yes }
	NAM = {
		NAM_exile_prepare_landing = yes
		NAM_oil_refresh = yes
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_debug_corporate_start }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
				NOT = { has_idea = NAM_interregnum_power_vacuum }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_execution_pending }
			}
			set_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_execution_pending
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.81 hours = 2 }
		}
	}
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][PEACE] Island exile: capital [NAM.Capital.GetName]."
}

# ----- Flight to the islands -----
# COUNTRY NAM, inside the coalition treaty before any state changes hands.
# The transports carry the real divisions, with their own templates: 35% of
# the army that stood at the end of the war, rounded, and at least one. The
# rest is left behind division by division in a fixed order: columns cut off
# in mainland states Svetlogorye no longer controls, the front (719, 690, 688,
# 67, 689), the principals' ground and regional districts,
# any other mainland state and the South Harbour, where the transports load,
# last. Divisions already on the islands or at sea are never left behind.
# The survivors move to the island capital, and the whole army in exile loses
# 45% strength and half its organisation for want of weapons; the stocks lose
# 65% over the side.
NAM_rw_exile_evacuate = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_exile_divisions_before value = num_divisions }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_exile_divisions_keep value = num_divisions }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_exile_divisions_keep value = 0.35 }
	round_variable = NAM_exile_divisions_keep
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_exile_divisions_keep
		min = 1
		max = 1000
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_to_cut value = NAM_exile_divisions_before }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_to_cut value = NAM_exile_divisions_keep }
	NAM_rw_exile_move_capital = yes
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rw_island_state = yes
			NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM }
		}
		set_state_controller_to = NAM
	}
	# No division-scope delete exists: the abandoned divisions switch to a
	# temporary template, and deleting that template removes exactly them.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_exile_to_cut > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Abandoned Columns" } }
			division_template = {
				name = "Abandoned Columns"
				template_counter = 6
				division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
				regiments = {
					infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
					infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
					infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				}
				support = {
					artillery = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_exile_to_cut > 0 }
				NOT = { NAM_rw_island_state = yes }
				NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM }
				any_state_division = { OWNER = { tag = NAM } }
			}
			NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes
		}
		719 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		690 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		688 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		67 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		689 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		720 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		721 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		722 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		701 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		68 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		725 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		70 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		723 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		724 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		691 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		726 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		69 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		727 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		728 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		692 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		729 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_exile_to_cut > 0 } }
			every_state = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_exile_to_cut > 0 }
					NOT = { NAM_rw_island_state = yes }
					NOT = { state = 700 }
					any_state_division = { OWNER = { tag = NAM } }
				}
				NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes
			}
		}
		700 = { NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_template = "Abandoned Columns" }
			delete_unit = {
				division_template = "Abandoned Columns"
				disband = no
			}
			delete_unit_template_and_units = {
				division_template = "Abandoned Columns"
				disband = no
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_exile_divisions_after value = num_divisions }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_exile_divisions_lost value = NAM_exile_divisions_before }
	subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_exile_divisions_lost value = NAM_exile_divisions_after }
	# The survivors embark before the peace moves any unit or state.
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { NAM_rw_island_state = yes }
			any_state_division = { OWNER = { tag = NAM } }
		}
		NAM_rw_exile_embark_state = yes
	}
	NAM_rw_exile_damage_army = yes
	# Equipment that the transports cannot take goes over the side.
	set_variable = { var = NAM_exile_rifles_dumped value = num_equipment@infantry_equipment }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_dump value = num_equipment@infantry_equipment }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_dump value = -0.65 }
	round_temp_variable = NAM_exile_dump
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = NAM_exile_dump producer = NAM }
	subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_exile_rifles_dumped value = num_equipment@infantry_equipment }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_exile_heavy_dumped value = num_equipment@support_equipment }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_exile_heavy_dumped value = num_equipment@artillery_equipment }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_dump value = num_equipment@support_equipment }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_dump value = -0.65 }
	round_temp_variable = NAM_exile_dump
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment amount = NAM_exile_dump producer = NAM }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_dump value = num_equipment@artillery_equipment }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_dump value = -0.65 }
	round_temp_variable = NAM_exile_dump
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = artillery_equipment amount = NAM_exile_dump producer = NAM }
	subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_exile_heavy_dumped value = num_equipment@support_equipment }
	subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_exile_heavy_dumped value = num_equipment@artillery_equipment }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_dump value = num_equipment@ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_dump value = -0.65 }
	round_temp_variable = NAM_exile_dump
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment amount = NAM_exile_dump producer = NAM }
	# The remaining-mainland count is diagnostic only; it needs a separate world scan.
	if = {
		limit = { is_debug = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_mainland_left value = 0 }
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { NAM_rw_island_state = yes }
				any_state_division = { OWNER = { tag = NAM } }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_mainland_left value = 1 }
		}
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][EXILE] Evacuation: divisions [?NAM_exile_divisions_before] before, [?NAM_exile_divisions_keep] carried by plan, [?NAM_exile_divisions_after] left, [?NAM_exile_divisions_lost] abandoned, [?NAM_exile_to_cut] still to abandon; mainland states still holding NAM divisions [?NAM_exile_mainland_left]; capital [NAM.Capital.GetName]; rifles dumped [?NAM_exile_rifles_dumped], heavy equipment dumped [?NAM_exile_heavy_dumped]."
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The government in exile sits on the largest island still owned.
NAM_rw_exile_move_capital = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns_state = 228 }
		set_capital = { state = 228 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns_state = 225 }
		set_capital = { state = 225 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns_state = 227 }
		set_capital = { state = 227 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns_state = 231 }
		set_capital = { state = 231 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns_state = 226 }
		set_capital = { state = 226 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns_state = 229 }
		set_capital = { state = 229 }
	}
	else = {
		set_capital = { state = 230 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Founding of the exile capital, called by the exile focuses.
# The Great Island (228) becomes Neo-Svetlogorye and its harbour city (6893)
# Neo-Svetlogorsk. If 228 is lost, the island that holds the capital takes
# the same names, given to its principal victory point. The city gains 2
# victory points, the island one infrastructure level and one building slot.
# Once per campaign (NAM_new_capital_founded); the names stay when a won war
# of return moves the capital back to the mainland. Without 228 or an island
# capital nothing happens and the founding stays available.
NAM_exile_found_new_capital = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_new_capital_founded_focus_condition_tt
					has_country_flag = NAM_new_capital_founded
				}
			}
			OR = {
				AND = {
					owns_state = 228
					controls_state = 228
				}
				capital_scope = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = NAM_rw_island_state_focus_condition_tt
						NAM_rw_island_state = yes
					}
					is_owned_by = NAM
					is_controlled_by = NAM
				}
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_exile_found_new_capital_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = NAM_new_capital_founded }
		if = {
			limit = {
				owns_state = 228
				controls_state = 228
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				set_province_name = {
					id = 6893
					name = NAM_neo_svetlogorsk
				}
			}
			add_victory_points = {
				province = 6893
				value = 2
			}
			228 = { NAM_exile_new_capital_state_reward = yes }
		}
		else = {
			NAM_exile_name_island_capital_city = yes
			capital_scope = { NAM_exile_new_capital_state_reward = yes }
		}
	}
}

# STATE island of the new exile capital: its name, infrastructure and slot.
NAM_exile_new_capital_state_reward = {
	hidden_effect = { set_state_name = NAM_neo_svetlogorye }
	if = {
		limit = { infrastructure < 5 }
		add_building_construction = {
			type = infrastructure
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
	}
	add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
}

# STATE on the mainland. While the temp NAM_exile_to_cut count lasts, NAM
# divisions here are left behind under the temporary template. The count is
# read inside the loop body, so it falls with every division it marks.
NAM_rw_exile_abandon_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_exile_to_cut > 0 } }
		every_state_division = {
			limit = { OWNER = { tag = NAM } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_exile_to_cut > 0 } }
				change_division_template = { division_template = "Abandoned Columns" }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_exile_to_cut value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# STATE on the mainland. NAM armies here move to the island capital chosen by
# NAM_rw_exile_move_capital; other countries' armies stay.
NAM_rw_exile_embark_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { capital_scope = { state = 228 } } }
		teleport_armies = {
			to_state = 228
			limit = { tag = NAM }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM = { capital_scope = { state = 225 } } }
		teleport_armies = {
			to_state = 225
			limit = { tag = NAM }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM = { capital_scope = { state = 227 } } }
		teleport_armies = {
			to_state = 227
			limit = { tag = NAM }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM = { capital_scope = { state = 231 } } }
		teleport_armies = {
			to_state = 231
			limit = { tag = NAM }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM = { capital_scope = { state = 226 } } }
		teleport_armies = {
			to_state = 226
			limit = { tag = NAM }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM = { capital_scope = { state = 229 } } }
		teleport_armies = {
			to_state = 229
			limit = { tag = NAM }
		}
	}
	else = {
		teleport_armies = {
			to_state = 230
			limit = { tag = NAM }
		}
	}
}

# STATE of the ceded mainland. Svetlogorye burns what it cannot keep: a field
# drops 70 condition and yields nothing for 180 days, roads and plants are
# wrecked and the South Harbour loses its piers.
NAM_rw_exile_scorch_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_field_condition }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_damage_amount value = 70 }
			NAM_field_apply_damage = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_scorched_wells_modifier } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_scorched_wells_modifier }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = {
				modifier = NAM_scorched_wells_modifier
				days = 180
			}
			set_state_flag = {
				flag = NAM_wells_scorched
				value = 1
				days = 180
			}
		}
		damage_building = {
			type = infrastructure
			damage = 2
		}
		damage_building = {
			type = industrial_complex
			damage = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { state = 700 }
			damage_building = {
				type = naval_base
				damage = 3
			}
			damage_building = {
				type = dockyard
				damage = 1
			}
		}
	}
}

ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_nam_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes }
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolved
		NAM = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
		VAL = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					has_focus_tree = VAL_focus
				}
				mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_nam_victory
		clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_started
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_end_all_wars = yes
		NAM = {
			if = {
				limit = { SLF = { exists = yes } }
				annex_country = { target = SLF transfer_troops = no }
			}
			transfer_state = 688
		}
		688 = {
			remove_core_of = SLF
			add_core_of = NAM
			set_state_controller_to = NAM
		}

		# ----- Border award of the victory treaty -----
		# Each defeated principal cedes its border sliver: Eflor the Moren district
		# (720), the Loren borderland (721) and the Middle Loren city (701), which
		# touches Svetlogorye only through 720; Azhar cedes its seaboard (722).
		# Only land still owned by a defeated principal changes hands. The frozen
		# governor mandate adds 727 and 723. Original cores remain for occupation;
		# citizenship is settled separately by regional programmes.
		720 = { NAM_rw_award_border_state = yes }
		721 = { NAM_rw_award_border_state = yes }
		701 = { NAM_rw_award_border_state = yes }
		722 = { NAM_rw_award_border_state = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM = { NAM_prewar_service_mandate = yes } }
			727 = { NAM_rw_award_border_state = yes }
			723 = { NAM_rw_award_border_state = yes }
		}
		69 = { add_claim_by = NAM }
		727 = { add_claim_by = NAM }
		728 = { add_claim_by = NAM }
		# ----- End of the border award -----
		NAM_rw_punish_defeated_coalition = yes
		NAM = {
			set_country_flag = NAM_treaty_independence_recognised
			add_ideas = ADISCORD_nam_treaty_independence
			add_stability = 0.15
		}
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_clear_temporary_support = yes
		VAL = {
			VAL_deliver_nam_concession = yes
			VAL_settle_resource_aid = yes
		}
		# The post-war chapter keeps every completed focus of the main tree.
		NAM = {
			NAM_oil_refresh = yes
			NAM_reset_campaign_cooldowns = yes
			NAM_open_postwar_future = yes
			load_focus_tree = {
				tree = NAM_postwar_focus
				keep_completed = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				scoped_play_song = "ADISCORD_3teeth_dissolve"
			}
			news_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_news.3 hours = 1 }
		}
		# The war for the South is timed from this victory.
		set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_deadline_window value = 1095 }
		ADISCORD_south_set_deadline = yes
		ADISCORD_south_begin_preparation = yes
	}
}

# Timeout settlement for a held basin without a captured border district.
# The fighting ends on the pre-war border: Svetlogorye keeps its independence
# and loads the post-war chapter, but signs no recognition treaty, wins no
# border award and imposes no punishment. ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_nam_victory
# marks every outcome in which Svetlogorye held: Kefreyt's concession and aid,
# the post-war tree and the South read it. The standoff flag distinguishes the
# texts and the missing recognition treaty.
ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_standoff = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes }
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolved
		NAM = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
		VAL = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					has_focus_tree = VAL_focus
				}
				mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_nam_victory
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_standoff
		clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_started
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_end_all_wars = yes
		# The uprising is an internal front: its district returns to Svetlogorye.
		NAM = {
			if = {
				limit = { SLF = { exists = yes } }
				annex_country = { target = SLF transfer_troops = no }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { 688 = { is_owned_by = SLF } }
				transfer_state = 688
			}
		}
		688 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
				remove_core_of = SLF
				set_state_controller_to = NAM
			}
		}
		NAM = {
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM } }
				set_state_controller_to = NAM
			}
		}
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_clear_temporary_support = yes
		VAL = {
			VAL_deliver_nam_concession = yes
			VAL_settle_resource_aid = yes
		}
		NAM = {
			NAM_oil_refresh = yes
			NAM_open_postwar_future = yes
			load_focus_tree = {
				tree = NAM_postwar_focus
				keep_completed = yes
			}
			news_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_news.3 hours = 1 }
		}
		# The standoff is timed like the victory.
		set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_deadline_window value = 1095 }
		ADISCORD_south_set_deadline = yes
		ADISCORD_south_begin_preparation = yes
	}
}

ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_check_nam_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			ADISCORD_nam_victory_record_complete = yes
		}
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_nam_victory = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY native ROOT. Keep the receipt through both capitulation callbacks:
# the final opponent may not expose has_capitulated before the treaty runs.
ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_record_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_defender_capitulation = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ADISCORD_nam_capitulation_reserved }
		}
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = ADISCORD_nam_capitulation_reserved
			value = 1
			days = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { tag = EFL }
			NAM = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_mark_eflor_defeated = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tag = AZH }
			NAM = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_mark_azhar_defeated = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tag = SLF }
			NAM = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_mark_rebels_defeated = yes }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY native ROOT of on_uncapitulation. A liberated principal is no longer
# defeated and blocks the victory treaty again until it falls once more.
ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_record_uncapitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = EFL }
			clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_EFL_defeated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tag = AZH }
			clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_AZH_defeated
		}
	}
}

ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_mark_eflor_defeated = {
	set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_EFL_defeated
	ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_check_nam_victory = yes
}

ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_mark_azhar_defeated = {
	set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_AZH_defeated
	ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_check_nam_victory = yes
}

ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_mark_rebels_defeated = {
	set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_SLF_defeated
	NAM = { news_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_news.6 hours = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { has_war_with = SLF } }
		NAM = { white_peace = SLF }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 688 = { is_owned_by = SLF } }
		NAM = { transfer_state = 688 }
		688 = {
			remove_core_of = SLF
			set_state_controller_to = NAM
		}
	}
	ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_check_nam_victory = yes
}

# Settlement by oil score: the fields Svetlogorye still controls count
# 67 = 80, 688 = 12, 689 = 36, 690 = 24, 719 = 12. 100 or more keeps
# independence, 36-99 is the compromise peace, less than 36 is the partition.
# A held basin wins the border treaty only when Svetlogorye has also taken a
# border district of a principal; holding its own fields alone is a standoff.
ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_timeout_resolution = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes }
		NAM_rw_compute_oil_score = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM = { exists = yes }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_rw_oil_score value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NAM_rw_holds_border_belt = yes
			}
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_nam_victory = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM = { exists = yes }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_rw_oil_score value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_standoff = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM = { exists = yes }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_rw_oil_score value = 36 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_compromise = yes
		}
		else = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_coalition_victory = yes
		}
	}
}

# ----- Front settlement -----
# The decisive ground ends the war before its deadline, for either side:
# Svetlogorye holding every border belt and all its own fields wins the
# border treaty; the coalition holding the Northern Deposits and one more
# field imposes its own. A control change that reaches either state queues
# one check after 7 days, so a province that changes hands for a day does
# not end the war. The check reads the front again.

# COUNTRY NAM. Called by on_state_control_changed for the war's states.
NAM_rw_queue_front_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_rw_front_check_pending }
			OR = {
				NAM_rw_territorial_victory = yes
				NAM_rw_coalition_territorial_victory = yes
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = NAM_rw_front_check_pending
			value = 1
			days = 8
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.51 days = 7 }
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Event .51: the front still decides the war after the delay.
ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_front_resolution = {
	NAM = { clr_country_flag = NAM_rw_front_check_pending }
	if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			NAM_rw_territorial_victory = yes
		}
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][PEACE] Front settlement: Svetlogorye holds the border belts and its fields."
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_nam_victory = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			NAM_rw_coalition_territorial_victory = yes
		}
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][PEACE] Front settlement: the coalition holds the Northern Deposits and another field."
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_coalition_victory = yes
	}
}

# Writes temp NAM_rw_oil_score in the caller's scope.
NAM_rw_compute_oil_score = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_oil_score value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { controls_state = 67 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_oil_score value = 80 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { controls_state = 688 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_oil_score value = 12 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { controls_state = 689 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_oil_score value = 36 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { controls_state = 690 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_oil_score value = 24 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { controls_state = 719 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_oil_score value = 12 }
	}
}

# Compact entry points for the shared debug category. They deliberately call
# the production effects instead of duplicating any resource-war mechanics.
# The political ratings are the displayed totals, including diplomacy and world tension.
# The idea reset also strips the two Judas camps that NAM_corp_takeover has just
# installed; their meeting clocks and operations need them back.
NAM_debug_prepare_corporate_start = {
	set_country_flag = NAM_board_silence_seats
	ADISCORD_debug_clear_country_ideas = yes
	add_ideas = NAM_judas_weber_committees
	add_ideas = NAM_judas_karamyshev_watch
	if = {
		limit = { has_active_mission = ADISCORD_economy_demobilization_deadline }
		remove_mission = ADISCORD_economy_demobilization_deadline
	}
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_was_at_war value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_demobilization_phase value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_postwar_demobilization_months value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_last_idea_signature value = -1 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_last_loan_visible_idea_signature value = -1 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_last_debt_state_idea value = -1 }
	clr_country_flag = ADISCORD_economy_overflow_investment_active
	NAM_board_appoint_cabinet = yes
	clr_country_flag = NAM_board_silence_seats
	NAM_board_recount = yes
	NAM_board_install_spirits = yes
	set_stability = 0
	set_war_support = 0
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_debug_stability_target value = -0.50 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_debug_stability_target value = has_stability }
	add_stability = var:NAM_debug_stability_target
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_debug_war_support_target value = -0.10 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_debug_war_support_target value = has_war_support }
	add_war_support = var:NAM_debug_war_support_target
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Shared opening of both debug defeats: reach the treaty directly so
# starting before the imperial collapse does not declare wars or schedule the war's
# introductory events. The caller resolves the war itself.

		overlord = { set_autonomy = { target = NAM autonomy_state = autonomy_free } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
		leave_faction = yes
	}
	NAM_colony_close = yes
	set_country_flag = NAM_independence_declared
	NAM_agreement_cancel = yes
	NAM_freeze_prewar_mandate = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_started } }
		NAM_rw_close_preparation = yes
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_started
	}
	clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_scheduled
}

# External annexation or subjugation invalidates the authored contest. A war
# that a native peace ended while both governments remain independent still
# receives its treaty: the oil-score settlement reads the front it left.
ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_close_external = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			NAM = {
				exists = yes
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { has_war_with = EFL }
				NOT = { has_war_with = AZH }
			}
			EFL = {
				exists = yes
				is_subject = no
			}
			AZH = {
				OR = {
					exists = no
					is_subject = no
				}
			}
		}
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][PEACE] The resource war ended outside its treaty; settling by the oil score."
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_timeout_resolution = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			OR = {
				NAM = {
					OR = {
						exists = no
						is_subject = yes
					}
				}
				EFL = {
					OR = {
						exists = no
						is_subject = yes
					}
				}
				AZH = {
					OR = {
						exists = no
						is_subject = yes
					}
				}
				NAM = {
					NOT = { has_war_with = EFL }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AZH }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolved
		NAM = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_focus_tree = NAM_resource_war_focus }
				load_focus_tree = {
					tree = NAM_focus
					keep_completed = yes
				}
			}
		}
		clr_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_started
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_end_all_wars = yes
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_clear_temporary_support = yes
		VAL = {
			VAL_cancel_nam_concession = yes
			VAL_settle_resource_aid = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { country_exists = NAM } }
			NAM_oil_close_all = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM = { NAM_oil_validate_clients = yes }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, on every terminal path of the war for the South. The exchanges
# collect the war loans once. A repelled campaign keeps the war results for
# the next campaign over the same completed tree; a settled South ends them.
NAM_sw_close_war = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_sw_war_loans_debt }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_sw_war_loans_debt
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 250 }
		NAM_spend_treasury = yes
	}
	# Inspections belong to one campaign: the furnace districts may change hands again.
	287 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	288 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	289 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	290 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	291 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	292 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	293 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	294 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	295 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	699 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	707 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_sw_furnace_inspected }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_south_final_resolved }
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_south_war_dynamic } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_south_war_dynamic }
		}
		clear_variable = NAM_sw_war_support
		clear_variable = NAM_sw_stability
		clear_variable = NAM_sw_army_attack

# ----- Pillars of power -----
# Five groups hold Svetlogorye together. Support (0-100) times influence (sums to
# 100) gives loyalty; NAM_loyalty_dynamic reads values derived only here.

# COUNTRY NAM. One-time setup from the fresh-campaign startup.
NAM_groups_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_groups_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = NAM_groups_initialized
		every_subject_country = { NAM_sync_subject_resource_tariff = yes }
		NAM_sync_etatist_party_name = yes
		EFL = { NAM_board_sync_district_status = yes }
		AZH = { NAM_board_sync_district_status = yes }
		RHM = { NAM_board_sync_district_status = yes }
		SDR = { NAM_board_sync_district_status = yes }
		KDR = { NAM_board_sync_district_status = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_hidden_fuel value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_open_fuel_reserve value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_gar_army_speed value = -0.10 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_gar_supply_consumption value = 0.08 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_gar_army_defence value = -0.04 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_gar_army_attack value = -0.04 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_gar_max_dig_in value = -2 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_repair_speed value = -0.25 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_landing_speed value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_organisation value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_dockyard_output value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_spotting value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_screen_defence value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_sub_detection value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_convoy_raiding value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_sub_attack value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_coordination value = -0.15 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_positioning value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_mine_planting value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_mine_damage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_navy_mine_sweeping value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_air_accidents value = 0.20 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_air_mission_efficiency value = -0.15 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_air_intercept_efficiency value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_air_cas_efficiency value = 0 }
		NAM_refresh_garrison = yes
		NAM_refresh_navy = yes
		NAM_refresh_air = yes
		set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 55 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_influence value = 30 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 40 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_influence value = 20 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 40 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_influence value = 20 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 50 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_influence value = 20 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 45 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_influence value = 10 }
		NAM_groups_refresh = yes
		# The shared startup has a single NAM entry; it also seeds the
		# preparation capacities that focus rewards raise.
		set_variable = { var = NAM_order_cap value = 4 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_line_slots value = 2 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_project_slots value = 1 }
		NAM_oil_initialize = yes
		NAM_crisis_draw = yes
		# The AI's prewar ladder course for this campaign: 1 districts, 2 vertical,
		# 3 compromise. Its strategy plans, the declaration answer and the ladder
		# decisions read it; NAM_freeze_prewar_mandate clears it at the first shot.
		random_list = {
			40 = { set_variable = { var = NAM_ai_prewar_course value = 1 } }
			35 = { set_variable = { var = NAM_ai_prewar_course value = 2 } }
			25 = { set_variable = { var = NAM_ai_prewar_course value = 3 } }
		}
		# Weber's network works from the first day of the colony; focuses may
		# already have changed it, so only a missing value is seeded.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_underground } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_underground value = 25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_wrk_trade_level } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_trade_level value = 0 }
		}
		NAM_wrk_trade_refresh = yes
		# Rom's notes reach a human player every 90 days from the fourth day while Rom lives.
		set_variable = { var = NAM_memoir_next value = 1 }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_memoir.99 days = 4 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Called after every support or influence change and by the monthly drift.
NAM_groups_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_groups_initialized
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_loyalty value = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support min = 0 max = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = NAM_grp_nam_support }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = NAM_grp_nam_influence }
		divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = 100 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loyalty value = NAM_grp_weighted }
		clamp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support min = 0 max = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = NAM_grp_oil_support }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = NAM_grp_oil_influence }
		divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = 100 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loyalty value = NAM_grp_weighted }
		clamp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support min = 0 max = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = NAM_grp_dist_support }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = NAM_grp_dist_influence }
		divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = 100 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loyalty value = NAM_grp_weighted }
		clamp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support min = 0 max = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = NAM_grp_garr_support }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = NAM_grp_garr_influence }
		divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = 100 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loyalty value = NAM_grp_weighted }
		clamp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support min = 0 max = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = NAM_grp_trade_support }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = NAM_grp_trade_influence }
		divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_grp_weighted value = 100 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loyalty value = NAM_grp_weighted }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_loy_political_power_gain value = NAM_loyalty }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_loy_political_power_gain value = 50 }
		divide_variable = { var = NAM_loy_political_power_gain value = 250 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_loy_stability_factor value = NAM_loyalty }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_loy_stability_factor value = 50 }
		divide_variable = { var = NAM_loy_stability_factor value = 500 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_loy_tax_collection value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_loy_fuel_gain_factor value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_loy_building_speed value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_loy_army_org value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_loy_trade_income value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loy_tax_collection value = 0.05 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 25 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loy_political_power_gain value = -0.1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loy_fuel_gain_factor value = 0.1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 25 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loy_fuel_gain_factor value = -0.15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loy_building_speed value = 0.05 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 25 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loy_stability_factor value = -0.05 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loy_army_org value = 0.05 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 25 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loy_army_org value = -0.05 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loy_trade_income value = 0.05 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 25 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_loy_trade_income value = -0.05 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_loyalty_dynamic } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_loyalty_dynamic }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. on_monthly_NAM: every group drifts half a point towards 50,
# so a favour, a concession or a refusal outlasts several months.
NAM_groups_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_groups_initialized
			NAM_mainland_programmes_active = yes
		}
		# The monthly drift has no new modifier inputs when every group is at rest.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 50 compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 50 compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 50 compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 50 compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 50 compare = equals } }
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_loyalty_dynamic } }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 50.5 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 49.5 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 0.5 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 50 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 50.5 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 49.5 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 0.5 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 50 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 50.5 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 49.5 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 0.5 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 50 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 50.5 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 49.5 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 0.5 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 50 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 50.5 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 49.5 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 0.5 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 50 }
			}
			NAM_groups_refresh = yes
		}
	}
}

# A specialisation can complete while its last countdown day is being settled.
NAM_crisis_apply_interval_bonus = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_active_mission = NAM_incident_countdown
			check_variable = { days_mission_timeout@NAM_incident_countdown > 0 }
		}
		add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_incident_countdown days = 15 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. A random incident at most once per draw; the cooldown and the
# open-crisis flag keep incidents from piling up.
NAM_crisis_draw = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_country_operable = yes
			NAM_mainland_programmes_active = yes
			NOT = { has_active_mission = NAM_incident_countdown }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_crisis_open }
		}
		activate_mission = NAM_incident_countdown
		random_list = {
			1 = { }
			1 = { add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_incident_countdown days = 30 } }
			1 = { add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_incident_countdown days = 60 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_crisis_office }
			add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_incident_countdown days = 60 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_pw_power_grid }
			add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_incident_countdown days = 15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_pw_operable = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_crisis_flood_mitigated = yes }
				add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_incident_countdown days = 15 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_crisis_dam_commissioned } }
					set_country_flag = NAM_crisis_dam_commissioned
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_crisis_delivery_disruption_mitigated = yes }
				add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_incident_countdown days = 15 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Only the selected case reserves the incident receipt. The event
# still opens after a context change so its safe closing answer can release it.
NAM_crisis_select = {
	random_list = {
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NAM_crisis_fire_operable = no
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_crisis_open value = 1 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_crisis.1 hours = 1 }
		}
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NAM_fuel_embargo_source = no
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_crisis_open value = 2 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_crisis.2 hours = 1 }
		}
		20 = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_crisis_open value = 3 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_crisis.3 hours = 1 }
		}
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NAM_fuel_embargo_source = no
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_crisis_open value = 4 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_crisis.4 hours = 1 }
		}
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_crisis_open value = 5 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_crisis.5 hours = 1 }
		}
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NAM_crisis_drought_possible = no
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_crisis_open value = 6 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_crisis.6 hours = 1 }
		}
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NAM_crisis_blackout_possible = no
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_crisis_open value = 7 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_crisis.7 hours = 1 }
		}
		12 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NAM_crisis_flood_possible = no
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_crisis_open value = 8 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_crisis.8 hours = 1 }
		}
		12 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NAM_crisis_delivery_disruption_possible = no
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_crisis_open value = 9 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_crisis.9 hours = 1 }
		}
	}
	activate_mission = NAM_incident_response
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_crisis_office }
		add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_incident_response days = 7 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Unpaid first answers fall back to the same guarded outcome
# as an explicit refusal, or consume a reserved fund, so timeout cannot lock a case.
NAM_crisis_default_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NAM_crisis_case_1 = yes
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_crisis_1_b_tt
		add_fuel = -8000
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = -8 }
			NAM_groups_refresh = yes
			# The fire burns out in the Northern Deposits.
			67 = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_controlled_by = NAM }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_damage_amount value = 20 }
					NAM_field_apply_damage = yes
				}
			}
			NAM_crisis_close = yes
		}
	}
}

# ----- Treasury helpers -----
# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_treasury_amount (positive). Both record the
# transaction for the monthly budget and invalidate the economy cache.
NAM_spend_treasury = {
	ADISCORD_economy_initialize_country = yes
	subtract_from_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_treasury value = NAM_treasury_amount }
	add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_current_month_action_costs value = NAM_treasury_amount }
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

NAM_add_treasury = {
	ADISCORD_economy_initialize_country = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_treasury value = NAM_treasury_amount }
	add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_current_month_action_income value = NAM_treasury_amount }
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# ----- Colony phase -----
# Until the Vorkerland collapse Svetlogorye is the metropole's oil colony.
# NAM_wrk_trade_level (0-3) is the standing of its trade houses in the
# metropole; focuses add to it and call NAM_wrk_trade_refresh. The level sets
# the price of a fuel shipment and the monthly income of the trade concession.

# COUNTRY NAM. Shipment 180 + 40 per level; concession 40 + 20 per level a month.
NAM_wrk_trade_refresh = {
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_wrk_trade_level
		min = 0
		max = 3
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_shipment_income value = NAM_wrk_trade_level }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_shipment_income value = 40 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_shipment_income value = 180 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_trade_income value = NAM_wrk_trade_level }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_trade_income value = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_trade_income value = 40 }
	# The economy settles weekly: twelve monthly payments equal fifty-two weeks.
	set_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_trade_weekly_income value = NAM_wrk_trade_income }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_trade_weekly_income value = 3 }
	divide_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_trade_weekly_income value = 13 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_wrk_concession_active }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_wrk_concession_income } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_wrk_concession_income }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. on_monthly_NAM: only the concealed reserve uses a monthly payment.
NAM_colony_monthly = {
	# The second ledger hides the metropole's share, not the colony's own income.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = NAM_hidden_reserve
			NAM_colony_phase = yes
			event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation = { exists = yes }
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_hidden_reserve value = 45 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The commissioner's echelon arrives: the escrowed fuel goes to
# the metropole and its depots send rifles back.
NAM_wrk_echelon_deliver = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_wrk_echelon_deposit > 0 }
			NAM_colony_phase = yes
			event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation = { exists = yes }
		}
		clear_variable = NAM_wrk_echelon_deposit
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_wrk_echelons_delivered value = 1 }
		event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation = { add_fuel = 90000 }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = infantry_equipment
			amount = 6000
			producer = NAM
		}
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = support_equipment
			amount = 60
			producer = NAM
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 2 }
		NAM_groups_refresh = yes
	}
	else = {
		NAM_wrk_echelon_refund = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. An echelon that never left returns its fuel; political power stays spent.

}

# Native fuel variables use thousands; reserve ledgers use individual fuel units.
# Only available storage is filled. The remaining stock stays in its original ledger.
NAM_hidden_fuel_release = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hidden_fuel > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_fuel_room value = max_fuel_k }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_fuel_room value = fuel_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_fuel_room value = 1000 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_fuel_room min = 0 max = NAM_hidden_fuel }
		add_fuel = NAM_fuel_room
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_hidden_fuel value = NAM_fuel_room }
	}
}

NAM_open_fuel_release = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_open_fuel_reserve > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_fuel_room value = max_fuel_k }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_fuel_room value = fuel_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_fuel_room value = 1000 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_fuel_room min = 0 max = NAM_open_fuel_reserve }
		add_fuel = NAM_fuel_room
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_open_fuel_reserve value = NAM_fuel_room }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, after the central successor exists. Clear colonial receipts before
# seizing open assets, then release completed shelters. Repeated teardown calls are inert.
NAM_metropolitan_flight = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			WKR = { exists = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_metropolitan_evacuated }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_debug_corporate_start }
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_metropolitan_evacuated
		NAM_colonial_artillery_contract_refund = yes
		NAM_colonial_local_register_refund = yes
		NAM_colonial_emergency_stocks_refund = yes
		NAM_colonial_reserve_fund_refund = yes
		NAM_wrk_concession_refund = yes
		67 = { NAM_sweep_release = yes }
		688 = { NAM_sweep_release = yes }
		689 = { NAM_sweep_release = yes }
		690 = { NAM_sweep_release = yes }
		719 = { NAM_sweep_release = yes }
		700 = { NAM_sweep_release = yes }
		ADISCORD_economy_initialize_country = yes
		set_variable = { var = NAM_evacuated_treasury value = ADISCORD_economy_treasury }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_evacuated_treasury < 0 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_evacuated_treasury value = 0 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_treasury value = NAM_evacuated_treasury }
		add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_current_month_action_costs value = NAM_evacuated_treasury }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_evacuated_fuel value = fuel_k }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_evacuated_fuel value = 1000 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_evacuated_fuel value = NAM_open_fuel_reserve }
		clear_variable = NAM_open_fuel_reserve
		# In-transit fuel is seized directly so refunding cannot overflow the depots.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_wrk_echelon_deposit > 0 } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_evacuated_fuel value = 90000 }
			clear_variable = NAM_wrk_echelon_deposit
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_paid }
			clr_country_flag = NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_paid
			add_political_power = 25
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_evacuated_fuel value = 40000 }
		}
		set_fuel = 0
		WKR = {
			ADISCORD_economy_initialize_country = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_treasury value = NAM.NAM_evacuated_treasury }
			add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_current_month_action_income value = NAM.NAM_evacuated_treasury }
			add_to_variable = { var = WKR_evacuated_fuel_reserve value = NAM.NAM_evacuated_fuel }
			ADISCORD_vorkerland_release_evacuated_fuel = yes
			ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_sheltered_treasury value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_hidden_reserve }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_sheltered_treasury value = NAM_hidden_reserve }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_sheltered_fuel value = NAM_hidden_fuel }
		NAM_colony_hourglass_payout = yes
		NAM_hidden_fuel_release = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.88 hours = 1 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; PREV is the district searched by the gendarmerie.
NAM_sweep_excesses = {
	add_stability = -0.02
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = -4 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_change value = 3 }
	NAM_underground_add = yes
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][UNDERGROUND] Sweep excesses in [PREV.GetName]."
}

# STATE target. Settlement consumes the district's receipt before applying
# national consequences; cancellation returns only the treasury deposit.
NAM_sweep_complete = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = NAM_sweep_in_progress
			NAM = { NAM_colonial_programme_operable = yes }
			is_owned_by = NAM
			is_controlled_by = NAM
		}
		clr_state_flag = NAM_sweep_in_progress
		clear_variable = NAM_sweep_deposit
		set_state_flag = {
			flag = NAM_swept
			value = 1
			days = 120
		}
		NAM = {
			clr_country_flag = NAM_sweep_running
			if = {
				limit = { PREV = { state = 688 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_change value = -12 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_change value = -8 }
			}
			NAM_underground_add = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = -4 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				random = {
					chance = 15
					NAM_sweep_excesses = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				random = {
					chance = 30
					NAM_sweep_excesses = yes
				}
			}
			NAM_groups_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		NAM_sweep_release = yes
	}
}

# STATE target. An interrupted sweep returns its treasury deposit and frees
# the single sweep slot; political power stays spent.
NAM_sweep_release = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_sweep_in_progress }
		clr_state_flag = NAM_sweep_in_progress
		NAM = {
			clr_country_flag = NAM_sweep_running
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = PREV.NAM_sweep_deposit }
			NAM_add_treasury = yes
		}
		clear_variable = NAM_sweep_deposit
	}
}
