NAM_rw_fill_tribute_tanks = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rw_tribute_fuel_reserve > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_tribute_room value = max_fuel_k }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_tribute_room value = fuel_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_tribute_room value = 1000 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rw_tribute_room min = 0 max = NAM_rw_tribute_fuel_reserve }
		add_fuel = NAM_rw_tribute_room
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_rw_tribute_fuel_reserve value = NAM_rw_tribute_room }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Monthly deliveries come only from fuel actually in stock; a
# recipient at war with Svetlogorye receives nothing.
NAM_rw_deliveries_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_rw_tribute }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_fuel < 15000 }
				EFL = { NAM_rw_tribute_creditor = yes }
			}
			add_fuel = -15000
			EFL = {
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_rw_tribute_fuel_reserve value = 15000 }
				NAM_rw_fill_tribute_tanks = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_fuel < 15000 }
				AZH = { NAM_rw_tribute_creditor = yes }
			}
			add_fuel = -15000
			AZH = {
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_rw_tribute_fuel_reserve value = 15000 }
				NAM_rw_fill_tribute_tanks = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every recurring part guards itself and reads fixed tags only.
NAM_rw_monthly = {
	NAM_rw_deadline_monthly = yes
	NAM_rw_deliveries_monthly = yes
	NAM_seal_discipline_monthly = yes
	NAM_oil_monthly = yes
}

# ----- Mobilisation orders -----
# An order debits political power, treasury and recruits once; the treasury
# price pays for the formation's equipment. The per-type counters are the
# escrow: each owes one fixed-price formation at hostilities, or its material
# price on release before the war. Prices: guard 200/9600, field infantry
# 100/6300, motorised division 250/4600 and 3000 fuel, coastal battalion 50/3300.

# COUNTRY NAM. All capacity rewards share the six-order ceiling. Additional
# training supplies replacements once no further paid formation can be opened.
NAM_expand_mobilisation_capacity = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NAM_rw_clock_running = yes
				check_variable = { var = NAM_order_cap value = 6 compare = less_than }
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_mobilisation_capacity_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_order_cap value = 1 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_mobilisation_reinforcements_tt
		add_manpower = 2000
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Called after the debit of one order.
NAM_order_register = {
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_orders_paid value = 1 }
	NAM_order_ensure_templates = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The motorised division rides armoured carriers; its order
# brings the carrier programme to a Svetlogorye that has not researched it.
NAM_order_grant_motor_technology = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_tech = ADISCORD_tech_armored_carrier_program } }
		set_technology = {
			ADISCORD_tech_armored_carrier_program = 1
			popup = no
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Fixed mobilisation templates are independent of editable starting templates.
# Only paid coastal and mechanised orders create their distinct templates.
# The motorised template needs the carrier programme first.
NAM_order_ensure_templates = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Mobilisation Guard" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Mobilisation Guard"
			is_locked = yes
			force_allow_recruiting = yes
			template_counter = 78
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 }
				infantry = { x = 2 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 2 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 2 y = 2 }
			}
			support = {
				engineer = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				artillery = { x = 0 y = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Mobilisation Infantry Brigade" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Mobilisation Infantry Brigade"
			is_locked = yes
			force_allow_recruiting = yes
			template_counter = 3
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 }
			}
			support = {
				engineer = { x = 0 y = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_template = "Coastal Battalion" }
			check_variable = { NAM_order_coastal_paid > 0 }
		}
		division_template = {
			name = "Coastal Battalion"
			template_counter = 6
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			is_locked = yes
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
			}
			support = {
				artillery = { x = 0 y = 0 }
			}
		}
		set_division_force_allow_recruiting = {
			division_template = "Coastal Battalion"
			force_allow_recruiting = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_template = "Motor Column" }
			check_variable = { NAM_order_motor_paid > 0 }
			has_tech = ADISCORD_tech_armored_carrier_program
		}
		division_template = {
			name = "Motor Column"
			template_counter = 5
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			is_locked = yes
			regiments = {
				ADISCORD_mechanized_infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				ADISCORD_mechanized_infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				ADISCORD_mechanized_infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				ADISCORD_mechanized_infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
			}
			support = {
				engineer = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				artillery = { x = 0 y = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_division_force_allow_recruiting = {
			division_template = "Motor Column"
			force_allow_recruiting = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. No order remains open: delivery at hostilities or a stopped
# entry. The templates stay as ordinary, editable templates.
NAM_order_unlock_templates = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_template = "Mobilisation Guard" }
		set_division_template_lock = {
			division_template = "Mobilisation Guard"
			is_locked = no
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_template = "Mobilisation Infantry Brigade" }
		set_division_template_lock = {
			division_template = "Mobilisation Infantry Brigade"
			is_locked = no
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_template = "Coastal Battalion" }
		set_division_template_lock = {
			division_template = "Coastal Battalion"
			is_locked = no
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_template = "Motor Column" }
		set_division_template_lock = {
			division_template = "Motor Column"
			is_locked = no
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Hostilities. NAM_order_ensure_templates has run in the same
# effect, so every template exists before the first create_unit. Each paid
# order spawns exactly one formation through NAM_order_spawn_one. The per-type
# delivery counters keep the report for event .11 and the category text.
NAM_deliver_mobilisation_orders = {
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][ORDERS] Delivery: guard [?NAM_order_guard_paid], infantry [?NAM_order_infantry_paid], motorised [?NAM_order_motor_paid], coastal [?NAM_order_coastal_paid]."
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_order_motor_paid value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			NOT = { has_template = "Motor Column" }
		}
		NAM_order_grant_motor_technology = yes
		NAM_order_ensure_templates = yes
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_orders_delivered_guard value = NAM_order_guard_paid }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_orders_delivered_infantry value = NAM_order_infantry_paid }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_orders_delivered_motor value = NAM_order_motor_paid }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_orders_delivered_coastal value = NAM_order_coastal_paid }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_orders_delivered value = NAM_order_guard_paid }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_orders_delivered value = NAM_order_infantry_paid }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_orders_delivered value = NAM_order_motor_paid }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_orders_delivered value = NAM_order_coastal_paid }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_kind value = 1 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_order_guard_paid value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_order_guard_paid value = 1 }
		NAM_order_spawn_one = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_kind value = 2 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_order_infantry_paid value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_order_infantry_paid value = 1 }
		NAM_order_spawn_one = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_kind value = 3 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_order_motor_paid value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_order_motor_paid value = 1 }
		NAM_order_spawn_one = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_kind value = 4 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_order_coastal_paid value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_order_coastal_paid value = 1 }
		NAM_order_spawn_one = yes
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_orders_paid value = 0 }
	NAM_order_unlock_templates = yes
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][ORDERS] Delivered [?NAM_orders_delivered] paid formations."
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_order_kind (1 guard, 2 infantry, 3 motorised,
# 4 coastal). The formation takes the first fully held state of its own list:
# guard 67; infantry 690, 719, 689; motorised 67, 688; coastal 700, 689.
# Otherwise any fully held mainland state takes it, with the harbour, the port
# city and Svetlogorsk first, then any state Svetlogorye still holds, so a lost
# field or an occupied capital never swallows a paid formation.
NAM_order_spawn_one = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 1 }
			has_full_control_of_state = 67
		}
		67 = { NAM_create_order_by_kind = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 2 }
			has_full_control_of_state = 690
		}
		690 = { NAM_create_order_by_kind = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 2 }
			has_full_control_of_state = 719
		}
		719 = { NAM_create_order_by_kind = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 2 }
			has_full_control_of_state = 689
		}
		689 = { NAM_create_order_by_kind = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 3 }
			has_full_control_of_state = 67
		}
		67 = { NAM_create_order_by_kind = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 3 }
			has_full_control_of_state = 688
		}
		688 = { NAM_create_order_by_kind = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 4 }
			has_full_control_of_state = 700
		}
		700 = { NAM_create_order_by_kind = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 4 }
			has_full_control_of_state = 689
		}
		689 = { NAM_create_order_by_kind = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_order_route = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_owned_state = {
					is_fully_controlled_by = NAM
					NOT = { NAM_rw_island_state = yes }
				}
			}
			random_owned_controlled_state = {
				limit = {
					is_fully_controlled_by = NAM
					NOT = { NAM_rw_island_state = yes }
				}
				prioritize = { 700 689 688 }
				NAM_create_order_by_kind = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_owned_state = { is_controlled_by = NAM } }
			random_owned_controlled_state = {
				prioritize = { 700 689 688 }
				NAM_create_order_by_kind = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_order_route value = 3 }
		}
	}
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][ORDERS] Formation kind [?NAM_order_kind]: placement route [?NAM_order_route] (1 own state, 2 mainland, 3 any held state, 0 none)."
}

# STATE. Reads temp NAM_order_kind set by the caller.
NAM_create_order_by_kind = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 1 } }
		NAM_create_order_guard = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 2 } }
		NAM_create_order_infantry = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_order_kind = 3 } }
		NAM_create_order_motor = yes
	}
	else = {
		NAM_create_order_coastal = yes
	}
}

# STATE. Spawn one paid formation for NAM at full strength.
NAM_create_order_guard = {
	create_unit = {
		division = "division_template = \"Mobilisation Guard\" start_experience_factor = 0.25 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
		owner = NAM
		allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
	}
}

NAM_create_order_infantry = {
	create_unit = {
		division = "division_template = \"Mobilisation Infantry Brigade\" start_experience_factor = 0.20 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
		owner = NAM
		allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
	}
}

NAM_create_order_motor = {
	create_unit = {
		division = "division_template = \"Motor Column\" start_experience_factor = 0.20 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
		owner = NAM
		allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
	}
}

NAM_create_order_coastal = {
	create_unit = {
		division = "division_template = \"Coastal Battalion\" start_experience_factor = 0.15 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
		owner = NAM
		allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Release before the war: recruits, fuel and treasury return at
# the fixed prices; political power stays spent.
NAM_refund_mobilisation_orders = {
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][ORDERS] Refund: guard [?NAM_order_guard_paid], infantry [?NAM_order_infantry_paid], motorised [?NAM_order_motor_paid], coastal [?NAM_order_coastal_paid]."
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_order_guard_paid value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_order_guard_paid value = 1 }
		add_manpower = 9600
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 200 }
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
	}
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_order_infantry_paid value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_order_infantry_paid value = 1 }
		add_manpower = 6300
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 100 }
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
	}
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_order_motor_paid value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_order_motor_paid value = 1 }
		add_manpower = 4600
		add_fuel = 3000
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 250 }
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
	}
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_order_coastal_paid value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_order_coastal_paid value = 1 }
		add_manpower = 3300
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 50 }
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_orders_paid value = 0 }
}

# ----- Defence lines -----
# A line under construction holds the state flag NAM_line_in_progress: it is
# the escrow for the 100 treasury deposit and occupies one of NAM_line_slots.

# STATE target. Payment side; the decision has already debited the price.
NAM_line_begin = {
	set_state_flag = NAM_line_in_progress
	NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_lines_in_progress value = 1 } }
}

# STATE target. A supply project refunds its full receipt; an ordinary line
# returns its 100 treasury deposit. Both release the same preparation slot.
NAM_line_release = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_line_in_progress }
		clr_state_flag = NAM_line_in_progress
		NAM = { subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_lines_in_progress value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_line_supply_deposit }
			NAM = {
				add_political_power = 25
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = support_equipment
					amount = 60
					producer = NAM
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = PREV.NAM_line_supply_deposit }
				NAM_add_treasury = yes
			}
			clear_variable = NAM_line_supply_deposit
		}
		else = {
			NAM = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 100 }
				NAM_add_treasury = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# STATE target. Paid permanent fortifications may finish after peace.
# A later supply project owns a different receipt and must not be settled here.
NAM_line_complete = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = NAM_line_in_progress
			NOT = { has_variable = NAM_line_supply_deposit }
			NAM = { NAM_country_operable = yes }
			is_owned_by = NAM
			is_controlled_by = NAM
			any_neighbor_state = { NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM } }
		}
		clr_state_flag = NAM_line_in_progress
		set_state_flag = NAM_line_prepared
		NAM = { subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_lines_in_progress value = 1 } }
		# Every province bordering another country gets level 1; border towns
		# with a victory point are the main approaches and get a second level.
		add_building_construction = {
			type = bunker
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
			province = {
				all_provinces = yes
				limit_to_border = yes
			}
		}
		add_building_construction = {
			type = bunker
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
			province = {
				all_provinces = yes
				limit_to_border = yes
				limit_to_victory_point > 0
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_line_supply_deposit } }
		NAM_line_release = yes
	}
}

# ----- Seal discipline -----
# NAM_seal_discipline (0-100) starts at hostilities at 70 plus any prewar focus
# bonus. NAM_seal_discipline_dynamic exists from then on and reads
# NAM_seal_org_factor = (discipline - 50) / 1000; it persists after the war.

# COUNTRY NAM. Snapshot casualties so earlier wars do not count.
NAM_seal_discipline_begin = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_last_change value = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_seal_discipline value = 70 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_casualties_seen_k value = casualties_k }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_surrender_seen value = surrender_progress }
	every_enemy_country = { set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_enemy_seen_k value = casualties_k } }
	clr_country_flag = NAM_seal_warned_50
	clr_country_flag = NAM_seal_warned_25
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_seal_discipline_dynamic } }
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_seal_discipline_dynamic }
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
	NAM_seal_discipline_clamp = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Clamp, refresh the modifier and open the threshold events once.
NAM_seal_discipline_clamp = {
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_seal_discipline
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_seal_discipline_dynamic } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_org_next value = NAM_seal_discipline }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_org_next value = 50 }
		divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_org_next value = 1000 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = NAM_seal_org_factor }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_seal_org_factor value = NAM_seal_org_next compare = equals } }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_org_factor value = NAM_seal_org_next }
			force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		}
		# A newly reached event threshold still matters when the modifier is unchanged.
		if = {
			limit = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_seal_night }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_seal_discipline value = 0 compare = less_than_or_equals }
				}
				set_country_flag = NAM_seal_night
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.32 hours = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_seal_warned_25 }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_seal_discipline value = 25 compare = less_than }
				}
				set_country_flag = NAM_seal_warned_25
				set_country_flag = NAM_seal_warned_50
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.31 hours = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_seal_warned_50 }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_seal_discipline value = 50 compare = less_than }
				}
				set_country_flag = NAM_seal_warned_50
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.30 hours = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

NAM_seal_record_war_entry = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_enemy_seen_k value = casualties_k }
	save_event_target_as = NAM_seal_new_opponent
	NAM = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_enemy_country = { NOT = { tag = event_target:NAM_seal_new_opponent } }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_casualties_seen_k value = casualties_k }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_surrender_seen value = surrender_progress }
		}
	}
}

# Casualty counters cover all current wars of a country. Sample each active opponent separately
# so that joining the war never credits NAM with losses incurred before the encounter.
NAM_seal_discipline_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_seal_discipline_dynamic } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_delta value = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_war = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_losses_k value = casualties_k }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_losses_k value = NAM_seal_casualties_seen_k }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_losses_k min = 0 max = 100000 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_enemy_k value = 0 }
			every_enemy_country = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = NAM_seal_enemy_seen_k }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_opponent_k value = casualties_k }
					subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_opponent_k value = NAM_seal_enemy_seen_k }
					clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_opponent_k min = 0 max = 100000 }
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_enemy_k value = NAM_seal_opponent_k }
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_enemy_seen_k value = casualties_k }
			}
			NAM_seal_score_front = yes
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_casualties_seen_k value = casualties_k }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_surrender_seen value = surrender_progress }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_seal_last_change value = NAM_seal_delta }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_seal_discipline value = NAM_seal_delta }
		NAM_seal_discipline_clamp = yes
	}
}

NAM_seal_score_front = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_delta value = NAM_seal_losses_k }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_delta value = -5 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_delta min = -50 max = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_double_own value = NAM_seal_losses_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_double_own value = 2 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_double_enemy value = NAM_seal_enemy_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_double_enemy value = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_seal_enemy_k value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_seal_enemy_k value = NAM_seal_double_own compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_delta value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_seal_losses_k value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_seal_losses_k value = NAM_seal_double_enemy compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_delta value = 2 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_front_change value = surrender_progress }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_front_change value = NAM_seal_surrender_seen }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_front_change value = 20 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_seal_delta value = NAM_seal_front_change }
}

# STATE field. The finite burn remains after peace; only its military penalties change.
NAM_scorched_field_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_scorched_wells_modifier } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_enemy_speed_next value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = NAM_wells_scorched
				ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
				controller = { has_war_with = NAM }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_enemy_speed_next value = -0.20 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = NAM_scorched_enemy_speed }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_scorched_enemy_speed value = NAM_enemy_speed_next compare = equals } }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_scorched_enemy_speed value = NAM_enemy_speed_next }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_scorched_enemy_attrition value = NAM_enemy_speed_next }
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_scorched_enemy_attrition value = -0.75 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_scorched_enemy_supply value = NAM_enemy_speed_next }
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_scorched_enemy_supply value = 5 }
			force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		}
	}
}

# STATE field. The focus calls this directly before its completion is committed.
NAM_guarded_field_apply = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			is_owned_by = NAM
			is_controlled_by = NAM
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_guarded_wells_modifier } }
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_guarded_wells_modifier }
	}
}

# STATE field. Controller changes and peace use the same current-state predicate.
NAM_guarded_field_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			is_owned_by = NAM
			is_controlled_by = NAM
			NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_wells_under_guard }
		}
		NAM_guarded_field_apply = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_guarded_wells_modifier } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_guarded_wells_modifier }
	}
}

# STATE field. Capacity remains in the denominator even after damage or occupation.
# Only working, unburnt wells in enemy hands contribute to the numerator.
NAM_count_captured_field = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_field_capacity }
		NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_basin_capacity value = PREV.NAM_field_capacity } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
				controller = { has_war_with = NAM }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_wells_scorched }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_captured_working_capacity value = NAM_field_capacity }
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_captured_working_capacity value = NAM_field_condition }
			divide_variable = { var = NAM_captured_working_capacity value = 100 }
			NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_captured_capacity value = PREV.NAM_captured_working_capacity } }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Recompute current losses; repeated captures never accumulate a penalty.
NAM_captured_fields_refresh = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_basin_capacity value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_captured_capacity value = 0 }
	67 = { NAM_count_captured_field = yes }
	688 = { NAM_count_captured_field = yes }
	689 = { NAM_count_captured_field = yes }
	690 = { NAM_count_captured_field = yes }
	719 = { NAM_count_captured_field = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_captured_share_next value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes
			exists = yes
			check_variable = { NAM_basin_capacity > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_captured_share_next value = NAM_captured_capacity }
		divide_temp_variable = { var = NAM_captured_share_next value = NAM_basin_capacity }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_captured_share_next min = 0 max = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = NAM_captured_share }
				NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_captured_share value = NAM_captured_share_next compare = equals } }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_captured_share value = NAM_captured_share_next }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_captured_war_support value = NAM_captured_share }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_captured_war_support value = -0.30 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_captured_factory_output value = NAM_captured_share }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_captured_factory_output value = -0.20 }
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_captured_share > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_captured_wells_shock } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_captured_wells_shock }
			ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_captured_wells_shock } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_captured_wells_shock }
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

NAM_port_refresh_capacity = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_port_contract_capacity value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_oil_terminal_units value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_oil_trade_authorized = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_port_contract_capacity value = NAM_port_general_slots }
		if = {
			limit = { 700 = { has_state_flag = NAM_sea_terminal_built } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_oil_terminal_units value = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_port_contract_capacity value = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_oil_contracts value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_oil_overseas_committed value = 0 }
	NAM_oil_count_clients = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_port_free_berths value = NAM_port_contract_capacity }
	subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_port_free_berths value = NAM_oil_contracts }
	clamp_variable = { var = NAM_port_free_berths min = 0 max = NAM_port_contract_capacity }
}

NAM_oil_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_fuel_embargo_source = no }
		EFL = { NAM_oil_lift_embargo = yes }
		AZH = { NAM_oil_lift_embargo = yes }
		SHL = { NAM_oil_lift_embargo = yes }
	}
	67 = { NAM_field_update_units = yes }
	688 = { NAM_field_update_units = yes }
	689 = { NAM_field_update_units = yes }
	690 = { NAM_field_update_units = yes }
	719 = { NAM_field_update_units = yes }
	NAM_port_refresh_capacity = yes
	NAM_captured_fields_refresh = yes
}

NAM_field_update_units = {
	NAM_scorched_field_refresh = yes
	NAM_guarded_field_refresh = yes
	# Physical extraction follows the field even when NAM loses control. Apply only
	# its delta so unrelated resource rewards in this state remain intact.
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pumping_capacity value = NAM_field_capacity }
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_grid_operating_field = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM = { NAM_grid_has_power = yes } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pumping_capacity value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_grid_mobile_generator }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pumping_capacity value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_controlled_by = NAM
			NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_wells_scorched }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_refinery_built }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pumping_capacity value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = NAM_pipeline_built
				700 = { is_controlled_by = NAM }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pumping_capacity value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = NAM_loren_lease
				is_owned_by = NAM
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pumping_capacity value = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_field_oil value = NAM_pumping_capacity }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_field_oil value = NAM_field_condition }
	divide_variable = { var = NAM_field_oil value = 10 }
	subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_field_oil value = 0.499 }
	round_variable = NAM_field_oil
	clamp_variable = { var = NAM_field_oil min = 0 max = 200 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_oil_delta value = NAM_field_oil }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_oil_delta value = NAM_field_applied_oil }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_field_oil_delta value = 0 compare = equals } } }
		add_resource = { type = oil amount = NAM_field_oil_delta }
		owner = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
		controller = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_field_applied_oil value = NAM_field_oil }
	}

	NAM_export_office_refresh = yes
}

# STATE field. A later hit may damage an improved field or deepen an existing loss.
NAM_field_record_condition = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = NAM_field_condition_before_damage }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_field_condition value = NAM_field_condition_before_damage compare = greater_than }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_field_condition_before_damage value = NAM_field_condition }
	}
}

# STATE field. Input: temp NAM_field_damage_amount set in this state scope.
# Fires, raids and sabotage lower the condition; production follows at once.
NAM_field_apply_damage = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_field_condition }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_effective_damage value = NAM_field_damage_amount }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = NAM
				is_controlled_by = NAM
				OR = {
					NAM = {
						NAM_independent_programmes_operable = yes
						has_decision = NAM_mil_field_security
					}
					AND = {
						state = 67
						has_state_flag = NAM_board_guard_post
						NAM = { NAM_board_operable = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_effective_damage value = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				state = 689
				is_owned_by = NAM
				is_controlled_by = NAM
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_south_coast_irrigation }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_effective_damage value = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = NAM
				is_controlled_by = NAM
				has_state_flag = NAM_field_spare_pump
				check_variable = { NAM_field_effective_damage > 0 }
			}
			clr_state_flag = NAM_field_spare_pump
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_effective_damage value = 25 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_field_effective_damage < 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_field_effective_damage value = 0 }
			}
		}
		NAM_field_record_condition = yes
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_field_condition value = NAM_field_effective_damage }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_field_condition
			min = 0
			max = 100
		}
		NAM = { NAM_oil_refresh = yes }
	}
}

# STATE field. Input: temp NAM_field_repair_amount set in this state scope.
NAM_field_apply_repair = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_field_condition }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_field_condition value = NAM_field_repair_amount }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_field_condition
			min = 0
			max = 100
		}

	}
}

# ----- Fuel contracts -----
# Each signed buyer occupies one berth. Only a delivered shipment earns revenue.

# COUNTRY buyer (decision FROM). The buyer answers in ADISCORD_nam_oil.1.
NAM_oil_offer_contract = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_oil_buyer_eligible = yes
			NAM_port_berth_free_for_buyer = yes
		}
		ADISCORD_release_non_participating_minor_optimization = yes
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = NAM_oil_offer_pending
			value = 1
			days = 40
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_oil.1 hours = 6 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY buyer, ROOT of ADISCORD_nam_oil.1. Capacity is rechecked at the answer.
NAM_oil_sign_contract = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_oil_offer_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_oil_offer_declined }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_oil_client }
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_oil_offer_pending
		NAM = { NAM_port_refresh_capacity = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_oil_buyer_eligible = yes
				NAM_port_berth_free_for_buyer = yes
			}
			ADISCORD_release_non_participating_minor_optimization = yes
			set_country_flag = NAM_oil_client
			hidden_effect = { SHL_refresh_oil_supply_quote = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = NAM_fuel_shortage }
				remove_ideas = NAM_fuel_shortage
			}
			NAM = {
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 5 }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 5 }
				NAM_groups_refresh = yes
				NAM_port_refresh_capacity = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = {
				flag = NAM_oil_offer_lapsed
				value = 1
				days = 7
			}
		}
		NAM = { country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_oil.2 hours = 6 } }
	}
}

	}

# COUNTRY buyer. A war with Svetlogorye or the buyer's end voids its contract;
# a surviving buyer loses its supply abruptly.
NAM_oil_validate_client = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_oil_client
			OR = {
				exists = no
				has_war_with = NAM
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_oil_client
		hidden_effect = { SHL_refresh_oil_supply_quote = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_fuel_shortage days = 90 }
		}
		NAM = { set_country_flag = NAM_oil_clients_changed }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The exporter supplies the gross sale price in NAM_treasury_amount.
# Warehouse receipts confer a buyback right. A customs stamp backs one bond issue.
NAM_settle_harbour_sale = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				OR = {
					has_completed_focus = NAM_municipal_bonds
					has_completed_focus = NAM_prag_ending_directorate
				}
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_bond_stamp_tt
		hidden_effect = { NAM_certify_shipping_manifest = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { hidden_trigger = { check_variable = { NAM_bond_balance > 0 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { hidden_trigger = { check_variable = { NAM_bond_balance < 200 } } }
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_bond_final_payment_tt
			}
			else = { custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_bond_payment_tt }
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_bond_payment value = NAM_bond_balance }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_bond_payment min = 0 max = 200 }
				subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_bond_balance value = NAM_bond_payment }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = NAM_bond_payment }
			}
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = { NAM_add_treasury = yes }
}

# COUNTRY client. Only a completed shipment earns the dispatch-office margin.
# It uses the existing monthly client pass and never charges the buyer again.
NAM_oil_settle_client = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_oil_client
			NAM = { NOT = { has_fuel < 15000 } }
			OR = {
				NAM = { check_variable = { var = NAM_port_month_general value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
				AND = {
					NAM_oil_overseas_buyer = yes
					NAM = { check_variable = { var = NAM_port_month_sea value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_oil_overseas_buyer = yes
				NAM = { check_variable = { var = NAM_port_month_sea value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
			}
			NAM = { subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_port_month_sea value = 1 } }
		}
		else = { NAM = { subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_port_month_general value = 1 } } }
		add_fuel = 15000
		NAM = {
			add_fuel = -15000
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_oil_month_revenue value = 40 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_decision = NAM_econ_export_dispatch
					has_country_flag = NAM_econ_dispatch_paid
					NAM_independent_programmes_operable = yes
					owns_state = 700
					controls_state = 700
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_oil_month_revenue value = 30 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Revenue of all deliveries enters the treasury in one transaction.
NAM_oil_settle_clients = {

	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_port_month_sea value = 0 }

		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_port_month_sea value = NAM_oil_terminal_units }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_oil_month_revenue value = 0 }
	EFL = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	AZH = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	VAL = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	STP = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	STS = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	RHM = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	MZR = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	SHL = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	RUS = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	WEF = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	KDR = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	SDR = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	GLP = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	KYZ = { NAM_oil_settle_client = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_oil_month_revenue value = 0 compare = greater_than } }

	}

# Bondholders keep their claim on the treasury if the port or the export market closes.
NAM_pay_municipal_instalment = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_bond_balance > 0 }
			check_variable = { ADISCORD_economy_treasury > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = ADISCORD_economy_treasury }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount min = 0 max = 60 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount min = 0 max = NAM_bond_balance }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_bond_balance value = NAM_treasury_amount }
		NAM_spend_treasury = yes
	}
}

# ----- Fuel embargo -----
# The dynamic modifier on the target is the embargo's only marker.

# COUNTRY target.
NAM_oil_impose_embargo = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NAM_fuel_embargo_target_valid = yes
				NAM = {
					NAM_independent_programmes_operable = yes
					NAM_fuel_embargo_source = yes
					has_completed_focus = NAM_fuel_leverage
				}
			}
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_fuel_embargo_modifier }
		hidden_effect = { SHL_refresh_oil_supply_quote = yes }
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = NAM
			modifier = embargoed_us
		}
		NAM = { custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_fuel_embargo_trade_tt }

		hidden_effect = {
			ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
			NAM = {
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = -10 }
				NAM_groups_refresh = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY target.
NAM_oil_lift_embargo = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_fuel_embargo_modifier } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_fuel_embargo_modifier }
		hidden_effect = { SHL_refresh_oil_supply_quote = yes }
		remove_opinion_modifier = {
			target = NAM
			modifier = embargoed_us
		}
		hidden_effect = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
	}
}

# ----- Field projects -----
# A project in progress holds the state flag NAM_project_in_progress and the
# state variable NAM_project_deposit: the escrow for its treasury price. It
# occupies one of NAM_project_slots (never more than two). Completion rechecks
# ownership and control; a lost state returns the deposit.

# STATE target. The decision has debited the price and stored the local deposit.
NAM_project_begin = {
	set_state_flag = NAM_project_in_progress
	NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_projects_in_progress value = 1 } }
}

NAM_labour_shift_release = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_labour_shift_workers > 0 } }
		add_manpower = NAM_labour_shift_workers
		clear_variable = NAM_labour_shift_workers
	}
}

# STATE target. Unfinished project: slot and deposit return.
NAM_project_release = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_project_in_progress }
		clr_state_flag = NAM_project_in_progress
		NAM = {
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_projects_in_progress value = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = PREV.NAM_project_deposit }
			NAM_add_treasury = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_project_pp_deposit }
			NAM = { add_political_power = PREV.NAM_project_pp_deposit }
		}
		clear_variable = NAM_export_office_order
		clear_variable = NAM_project_pp_deposit
		clear_variable = NAM_project_deposit
	}
}

# STATE target. Finished project: the deposit is spent and the slot frees.
NAM_project_close = {
	clear_variable = NAM_export_office_order
	clr_state_flag = NAM_project_in_progress
	clear_variable = NAM_project_pp_deposit
	clear_variable = NAM_project_deposit
	NAM = { subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_projects_in_progress value = 1 } }
}

	}
}

			}

			NAM_project_close = yes
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			if = {
				limit = { state = 700 }

					type = industrial_complex
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_building_construction = {
					type = dockyard
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
			NAM = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
		}
		else = { NAM_cabinet_return_tools = yes }
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = NAM_project_in_progress
			check_variable = { var = NAM_project_deposit value = 150 compare = equals }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_field_repair_possible = yes }
			NAM_project_close = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_field_condition value = 30 }
			if = {
				limit = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_field_firefighters } }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_field_condition value = 15 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NAM = {
						has_country_flag = NAM_harbour_repair_service
						owns_state = 700
						controls_state = 700
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_field_condition value = 15 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_south_fenn_guarantee }
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_field_condition value = 100 }
			}
			clamp_variable = {
				var = NAM_field_condition
				min = 0
				max = 100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_south_fenn_guarantee } }
				if = {
					limit = { state = 67 }
					690 = { NAM_water_board_dispatch = yes }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { state = 690 }
					67 = { NAM_water_board_dispatch = yes }
				}
			}
			NAM = { NAM_oil_refresh = yes }
		}
		else = { NAM_project_release = yes }
	}
}

# COUNTRY VAL or GLP, ROOT of ADISCORD_nam_oil.4. The buyer pays 300 treasury
# for the extraction rights of the Middle Island; the state stays Svetlogorsk.
NAM_steel_concession_grant = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_steel_concession_can_accept = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 300 }
		NAM_spend_treasury = yes
		set_country_flag = NAM_steel_concession_231
		ADISCORD_release_non_participating_minor_optimization = yes
		if = {
			limit = { tag = VAL }
			NAM = {
				give_resource_rights = {
					receiver = VAL
					state = 231
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			NAM = {
				give_resource_rights = {
					receiver = GLP
					state = 231
				}
			}
		}
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		NAM = {
			clr_country_flag = NAM_concession_231_pending
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 300 }
			NAM_add_treasury = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 6 }
			NAM_groups_refresh = yes
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_oil.5 hours = 6 }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY VAL or GLP, ROOT of ADISCORD_nam_oil.4.

		set_country_flag = NAM_steel_concession_declined
		NAM = {
			clr_country_flag = NAM_concession_231_pending
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_oil.5 hours = 6 }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY holder. The extraction rights return to the state's owner.
NAM_steel_concession_end = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_steel_concession_holder = yes }
		remove_resource_rights = 231
		clr_country_flag = NAM_steel_concession_231
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = NAM }
			NAM = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY holder. War with Svetlogorye or the loss of the island ends the rights.
NAM_steel_concession_validate = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_steel_concession_holder = yes
			OR = {
				exists = no
				has_war_with = NAM
				231 = { NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM } }
				231 = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM } }
			}
		}
		NAM_steel_concession_end = yes
	}
}

# ----- Ladder of seals -----
# NAM_ladder_bop runs from the namestnik vertical (-1) to the districts (+1).
# The collapse edge proclaims independence once; the ladder is created only
# when it does not exist, so a repeated call never resets accumulated balance.

# COUNTRY NAM. Called by ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_schedule at the collapse.
NAM_ladder_declare_independence = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = ADISCORD_fresh_campaign_contract_v1
			exists = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_independence_declared }
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_independence_declared
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = NAM_letters_to_the_centre } }
			complete_national_focus = NAM_letters_to_the_centre
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_leader = { character = NAM_Egor_Rom ruling_only = yes } }
			set_portraits = {
				character = NAM_Egor_Rom
				civilian = { large = GFX_portrait_NAM_Egor_Rom_independent }
			}
		}
		NAM_reset_campaign_cooldowns = yes
		set_popularities = {
			etatism = 45
			humanism = 20
			pragmatism = 15
			anarchism = 7
			technocracy = 5
			chauvinism = 4
			utilitarism = 2
			hedonism = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_power_balance = { id = NAM_ladder_bop } } }
			set_power_balance = { id = NAM_ladder_bop set_value = 0 }
			# A course chosen before the ladder existed applies its shift now;
			# the course focuses push the balance themselves once it exists.
			if = {
				limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_vertical }
				add_power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value = -0.25 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_districts }
				add_power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value = 0.25 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = NAM_colony_ladder_lean }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ladder_shift value = NAM_colony_ladder_lean }
				NAM_ladder_shift = yes
				clear_variable = NAM_colony_ladder_lean
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_underground } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_underground value = 20 }
		}
		# Civil agreements open after the first three months of independence.
		set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_agreement_cooldown value = 1 days = 90 }
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		# Event .80 announces the vanished centre and then opens the
		# declaration event ADISCORD_nam_groups.12.
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.80 hours = 6 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every ladder shift outside focuses uses this guard.
# Input: temp NAM_ladder_shift (negative toward the vertical), one of the
# listed steps: add_power_balance_value rejects a variable value.
NAM_ladder_shift = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_power_balance = { id = NAM_ladder_bop } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ladder_shift = -0.20 } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value = -0.20 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ladder_shift = -0.15 } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value = -0.15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ladder_shift = -0.10 } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value = -0.10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ladder_shift = -0.05 } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value = -0.05 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ladder_shift = 0.05 } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value = 0.05 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ladder_shift = 0.10 } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value = 0.10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ladder_shift = 0.15 } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value = 0.15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ladder_shift = 0.20 } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NAM_ladder_bop value = 0.20 }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. on_monthly_NAM after the declaration. Fixed scopes only.
NAM_ladder_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_agreement_peace = no }
		NAM_agreement_cancel = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_independence_declared
			NAM_country_operable = yes
			NAM_mainland_programmes_active = yes
		}
		NAM_rivals_monthly = yes
	}
}

# ----- Pillar favours -----
# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_favour_group (1 namestniks, 2 oil, 3 districts,
# 4 garrisons, 5 export houses). The favour costs that pillar 15 support.
NAM_favour_pay_support = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_favour_group value = 1 compare = equals } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = -15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_favour_group value = 2 compare = equals } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = -15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_favour_group value = 3 compare = equals } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = -15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_favour_group value = 4 compare = equals } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = -15 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = -15 }
	}
	NAM_groups_refresh = yes
}

# ----- Rivals of the ladder -----
# Rival numbers: 1 Vera Pechat (namestniks), 2 Arseny Klyuch (oil),
# 3 Taras Shtyk (garrisons), 4 Lev Gavanov (export houses). The districts have
# no rival: their discontent feeds the underground instead.

# COUNTRY NAM. Writes NAM_rival_current: the free rival of the weakest pillar,
# or 0 when every rival is gone.
NAM_rival_pick_weakest = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_rival_current value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rival_low value = 101 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rival_pechat_free = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = NAM_rival_low compare = less_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rival_low value = NAM_grp_nam_support }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rival_current value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rival_klyuch_free = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = NAM_rival_low compare = less_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rival_low value = NAM_grp_oil_support }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rival_current value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rival_shtyk_free = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = NAM_rival_low compare = less_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rival_low value = NAM_grp_garr_support }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rival_current value = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rival_gavanov_free = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = NAM_rival_low compare = less_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rival_low value = NAM_grp_trade_support }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rival_current value = 4 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Story coups take priority over civilian agreements.
NAM_rivals_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_coup_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_coup_succeeded }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ladder_settled }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_rival_event_pending }
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_coup_pending
		NAM_agreement_cancel = yes
		NAM_rival_pick_weakest = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current > 0 } }
			NAM_rival_open_coup = yes
		}
	}
	else = { NAM_agreements_monthly = yes }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_rival_delta. Changes the current rival's pillar.
NAM_rival_pillar_add = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = NAM_rival_delta }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = NAM_rival_delta }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = NAM_rival_delta }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = NAM_rival_delta }
	}
	NAM_groups_refresh = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The demand is accepted: the rival waits 60 days for its terms.


# COUNTRY NAM. Refusal or a broken promise. A pillar already below 25 lets an
# unheard rival stake the seals; a heard rival only loses face.


# COUNTRY NAM. Mission success: the promised term is collected once.


# COUNTRY NAM. Opens the coup event for NAM_rival_current.
NAM_rival_open_coup = {
	set_country_flag = NAM_rival_event_pending
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.21 hours = 12 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The current rival leaves politics for good.
NAM_rival_remove_current = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = NAM_rival_1_removed
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_Vera_Pechat = { is_hired_as_advisor = yes } }
			deactivate_advisor = NAM_Vera_Pechat_advisor
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 2 } }
		set_country_flag = NAM_rival_2_removed
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_Arseny_Klyuch = { is_hired_as_advisor = yes } }
			deactivate_advisor = NAM_Arseny_Klyuch_advisor
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 3 } }
		set_country_flag = NAM_rival_3_removed
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_Taras_Shtyk = { is_hired_as_advisor = yes } }
			deactivate_advisor = NAM_Taras_Shtyk_advisor
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 4 } }
		set_country_flag = NAM_rival_4_removed
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_Lev_Gavanov = { is_hired_as_advisor = yes } }
			deactivate_advisor = NAM_Lev_Gavanov_advisor
		}
	}
	NAM_agreement_cancel = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Remove the active role before installing a successor of either party.
NAM_rom_step_down = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_leader = {
				character = NAM_Egor_Rom
				ruling_only = yes
			}
			has_country_leader_ideology = service_etatism
		}
		NAM_Egor_Rom = { remove_country_leader_role = { ideology = service_etatism } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_leader = {
				character = NAM_Egor_Rom
				ruling_only = yes
			}
			has_country_leader_ideology = etatism_ideology
		}
		NAM_Egor_Rom = { remove_country_leader_role = { ideology = etatism_ideology } }
	}

	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_leader = { character = NAM_Egor_Rom ruling_only = yes }
			has_country_leader_ideology = humanism_ideology
		}
		NAM_Egor_Rom = { remove_country_leader_role = { ideology = humanism_ideology } }
	}

	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_leader = { character = NAM_Egor_Rom ruling_only = yes }
			has_country_leader_ideology = pragmatism_ideology
		}
		NAM_Egor_Rom = { remove_country_leader_role = { ideology = pragmatism_ideology } }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The rival takes the seals for the rest of Svetlogorye's route.
# The coup leader stays an etatist ruler; later endings keep him in power.
NAM_coup_install = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rival_event_pending
	set_country_flag = NAM_coup_succeeded
	NAM_agreement_cancel = yes
	NAM_rom_step_down = yes
	set_politics = {
		ruling_party = etatism
		elections_allowed = no
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_Vera_Pechat = { is_hired_as_advisor = yes } }
			deactivate_advisor = NAM_Vera_Pechat_advisor
		}
		add_country_leader_role = {
			character = NAM_Vera_Pechat
			promote_leader = yes
			country_leader = {
				desc = NAM_Vera_Pechat_leader_desc
				ideology = etatism_ideology
				traits = {
					NAM_trait_usurper_of_seals
					NAM_trait_registrar_of_seals
				}
				expire = "2200.1.1.1"
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_Arseny_Klyuch = { is_hired_as_advisor = yes } }
			deactivate_advisor = NAM_Arseny_Klyuch_advisor
		}
		add_country_leader_role = {
			character = NAM_Arseny_Klyuch
			promote_leader = yes
			country_leader = {
				desc = NAM_Arseny_Klyuch_leader_desc
				ideology = etatism_ideology
				traits = {
					NAM_trait_usurper_of_seals
					NAM_trait_klyuchevsk_magnate
				}
				expire = "2200.1.1.1"
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_Taras_Shtyk = { is_hired_as_advisor = yes } }
			deactivate_advisor = NAM_Taras_Shtyk_advisor
		}
		add_country_leader_role = {
			character = NAM_Taras_Shtyk
			promote_leader = yes
			country_leader = {
				desc = NAM_Taras_Shtyk_leader_desc
				ideology = etatism_ideology
				traits = {
					NAM_trait_usurper_of_seals
					NAM_trait_garrison_commandant
				}
				expire = "2200.1.1.1"
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_Lev_Gavanov = { is_hired_as_advisor = yes } }
			deactivate_advisor = NAM_Lev_Gavanov_advisor
		}
		add_country_leader_role = {
			character = NAM_Lev_Gavanov
			promote_leader = yes
			country_leader = {
				desc = NAM_Lev_Gavanov_leader_desc
				ideology = etatism_ideology
				traits = {
					NAM_trait_usurper_of_seals
					NAM_trait_harbour_master
				}
				expire = "2200.1.1.1"
			}
		}
	}
	add_timed_idea = {
		idea = NAM_seal_junta
		days = 365
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rival_delta value = 15 }
	NAM_rival_pillar_add = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = -10 }
	NAM_groups_refresh = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ladder_shift value = -0.15 }
	NAM_ladder_shift = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_underground value = 10 }
	NAM_underground_clamp = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_south_hegemon_NAM }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}

# ----- Underground -----
# NAM_underground (0-100) is Yaroslav Weber's network. It works from the first
# day of the colony, strikes at the fields, the depots and the namestniks, and
# at hostilities decides the Svetlogorsk uprising; the amnesty ends it for good.
# Growth, thresholds and sabotage stop once the resource war has opened.

# COUNTRY NAM. Every writer calls this clamp; it also opens the threshold events.
NAM_underground_clamp = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolved }
		clear_variable = NAM_underground
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_weber_amnesty }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_underground value = 0 }
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_underground
			min = 0
			max = 100
		}
		NAM_underground_check_thresholds = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Crossing 40, 60 or 80 opens its event once; a threshold arms
# again after the network falls 15 points below it. A jump across several
# thresholds opens only the highest one.
NAM_underground_check_thresholds = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_underground_active = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_40
				check_variable = { NAM_underground < 25 }
			}
			clr_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_40
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_60
				check_variable = { NAM_underground < 45 }
			}
			clr_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_60
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_80
				check_variable = { NAM_underground < 65 }
			}
			clr_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_80
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_country_operable = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ug_event_pending }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_80 }
					check_variable = { NAM_underground > 79 }
				}
				set_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_80
				set_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_60
				set_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_40
				NAM_underground_open_event = yes
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.84 hours = 6 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_60 }
					check_variable = { NAM_underground > 59 }
				}
				set_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_60
				set_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_40
				NAM_underground_open_event = yes
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.83 hours = 6 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_40 }
					check_variable = { NAM_underground > 39 }
				}
				set_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_40
				NAM_underground_open_event = yes
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.82 hours = 6 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. At most one underground event is open. The marker expires by
# itself, so an event that never fires cannot block the network for good.
NAM_underground_open_event = {
	set_country_flag = {
		flag = NAM_ug_event_pending
		value = 1
		days = 30
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every option of an underground event ends with this call.
NAM_underground_close_event = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_ug_event_pending
	clear_variable = NAM_ug_rifles_stolen
	clear_variable = NAM_ug_strike_damage
	clear_variable = NAM_ug_strike_fuel
	clear_variable = NAM_ug_strike_stability
	clear_variable = NAM_ug_strike_power
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = NAM_ug_field }
		event_target:NAM_ug_field = { clear_variable = NAM_ug_damage_receipt }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. on_monthly_NAM from the first day of the colony: base +3, +2
# while the districts' support is below 40 and +1 more below 25, +2 while the
# vertical holds the ladder, -1 while the districts' support is 60 or more,
# -3 while the Svetlogorsk compact is paid and -3 during print-supply control.
# Pipeline guards and counter-leaflet campaigns each subtract another 2.
# The month's change is kept for the category text, then the network may strike.
NAM_underground_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_underground_active = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_delta value = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_grp_dist_support < 40 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_delta value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_grp_dist_support < 25 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_delta value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_grp_dist_support > 59 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_delta value = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_underground_vertical_pressure = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_delta value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_district_compact }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_delta value = -3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_decision = NAM_disrupt_print_supply }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_delta value = -3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_decision = NAM_colonial_pipeline_guard }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_delta value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_decision = NAM_campaign_answer_leaflets }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_underground_delta value = -2 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_underground_growth value = NAM_underground_delta }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_underground value = NAM_underground_delta }
		NAM_underground_clamp = yes
		NAM_underground_sabotage_roll = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. A network of 30 or more may strike once a month before the
# resource war. The chance follows the strike tier: 20% at 30-49, 35% at 50-69,
# 50% at 70-89 and 65% from 90; both weights of each tier add up to 100. A
# strike rests the network for 200, 120, 60 or 30 days by the tier it struck
# at; the roll waits for the next monthly pulse after the rest. A field strike
# needs a field in Svetlogorsk hands, a
# depot raid rifles, a pipeline blast fuel and an unguarded line from tier 2;
# the bombing of Svetlogorsk opens from tier 3.
NAM_underground_sabotage_roll = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_country_operable = yes
			NAM_underground_active = yes
			check_variable = { NAM_underground > 29 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ug_sabotage_cooldown }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ug_event_pending }
		}
		random_list = {
			80 = {
				modifier = {
					factor = 0.8125
					NAM_underground_strike_tier_2 = yes
					NAM_underground_strike_tier_3 = no
				}
				modifier = {
					factor = 0.625
					NAM_underground_strike_tier_3 = yes
					NAM_underground_strike_tier_4 = no
				}
				modifier = {
					factor = 0.4375
					NAM_underground_strike_tier_4 = yes
				}
			}
			20 = {
				modifier = {
					factor = 1.75
					NAM_underground_strike_tier_2 = yes
					NAM_underground_strike_tier_3 = no
				}
				modifier = {
					factor = 2.5
					NAM_underground_strike_tier_3 = yes
					NAM_underground_strike_tier_4 = no
				}
				modifier = {
					factor = 3.25
					NAM_underground_strike_tier_4 = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NAM_underground_strike_tier_4 = yes }
					set_country_flag = {
						flag = NAM_ug_sabotage_cooldown
						value = 1
						days = 30
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NAM_underground_strike_tier_3 = yes }
					set_country_flag = {
						flag = NAM_ug_sabotage_cooldown
						value = 1
						days = 60
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NAM_underground_strike_tier_2 = yes }
					set_country_flag = {
						flag = NAM_ug_sabotage_cooldown
						value = 1
						days = 120
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_country_flag = {
						flag = NAM_ug_sabotage_cooldown
						value = 1
						days = 200
					}
				}
				NAM_underground_open_event = yes
				# Every answer names the strength the network struck with.
				set_variable = { var = NAM_ug_strike_power value = NAM_underground }
				random_list = {
					40 = {
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							NOT = {
								any_owned_state = {
									NAM_field_state = yes
									is_controlled_by = NAM
								}
							}
						}
						country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.85 hours = 6 }
					}
					30 = {
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							has_equipment = { infantry_equipment < 1500 }
						}
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							has_country_flag = NAM_depots_guarded
						}
						country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.86 hours = 6 }
					}
					30 = {
						country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.87 hours = 6 }
					}
					25 = {
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							NAM_underground_strike_tier_2 = no
						}
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							has_fuel < 5000
						}
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							OR = {
								has_decision = NAM_colonial_pipeline_guard
								has_country_flag = NAM_pipeline_watched
							}
						}
						country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.116 hours = 6 }
					}
					25 = {
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							NAM_underground_strike_tier_3 = no
						}
						country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.117 hours = 6 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_underground_change (negative weakens the
# network). Event options and decisions change the network through this call.
NAM_underground_add = {
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_underground value = NAM_underground_change }
	NAM_underground_clamp = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Event .86: the network carries off up to 2000, 3500, 5000 or
# 7500 rifles of Svetlogorsk make by strike tier; the exact loss is kept for
# the event text.
NAM_underground_steal_rifles = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ug_rifles_taken value = -2000 }
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_underground_strike_tier_4 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ug_rifles_taken value = -7500 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_underground_strike_tier_3 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ug_rifles_taken value = -5000 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_underground_strike_tier_2 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ug_rifles_taken value = -3500 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ug_rifles_stolen value = num_equipment@infantry_equipment }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = NAM_ug_rifles_taken producer = NAM }
	subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_ug_rifles_stolen value = num_equipment@infantry_equipment }
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][UNDERGROUND] Depot raid: [?NAM_ug_rifles_stolen] rifles taken."
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Event .116: the blast burns up to 30000, 50000 or 75000 fuel by
# strike tier. Native fuel_k counts thousands; the exact loss is kept for the
# event text and never exceeds the stock.
NAM_underground_burn_fuel = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ug_fuel_cap value = 30000 }
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_underground_strike_tier_4 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ug_fuel_cap value = 75000 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_underground_strike_tier_3 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ug_fuel_cap value = 50000 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ug_strike_fuel value = fuel_k }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_ug_strike_fuel value = 1000 }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_ug_strike_fuel
		min = 0
		max = NAM_ug_fuel_cap
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ug_fuel_burnt value = NAM_ug_strike_fuel }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ug_fuel_burnt value = -1 }
	add_fuel = NAM_ug_fuel_burnt
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][UNDERGROUND] Pipeline blast: [?NAM_ug_strike_fuel] fuel burnt."
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Broken-off talks return the treasury deposit of the paid round;
# political power, like a released mobilisation order's, stays spent.
NAM_weber_talks_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_weber_talks_deposit value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = NAM_weber_talks_deposit }
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_weber_talks_deposit
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The council and the signed amnesty may complete in either order.
NAM_deliver_amnesty_recruits = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				has_country_flag = NAM_weber_amnesty
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_amnesty_recruits_delivered }
			}
		}
		add_manpower = 2000
		set_country_flag = NAM_amnesty_recruits_delivered
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The third round of talks ends in the amnesty: the underground
# dissolves, Weber serves Svetlogorye and the uprising can no longer happen.
NAM_weber_amnesty = {
	set_country_flag = NAM_weber_amnesty
	set_temp_variable = { ADISCORD_party = token:humanism }
	ADISCORD_legalise_party = yes
	NAM_underground_clamp = yes
	NAM_activate_weber_commander = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 10 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = -5 }
	NAM_groups_refresh = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ladder_shift value = 0.10 }
	NAM_ladder_shift = yes
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes }
		set_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_SLF_defeated
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_mine_councils }
		NAM_deliver_amnesty_recruits = yes
	}
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.30 hours = 1 }
}

# ----- Endings of the ladder and the charter -----
# Each ending settles the order: the rival cycle stops, a coup leader stays in
# power and keeps his etatist course, otherwise the ending installs its own
# leader. The South-war settlement still follows NAM_service_state or
# NAM_federal_charter, which precede these endings.

# COUNTRY NAM. Egor Rom rules as an etatist of the iron ladder.
NAM_rom_take_etatism = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_leader = {
				character = NAM_Egor_Rom
				ruling_only = yes
			}
			OR = {
				has_country_leader_ideology = service_etatism
				has_country_leader_ideology = humanism_ideology
				has_country_leader_ideology = pragmatism_ideology
			}
		}
		NAM_rom_step_down = yes
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = etatism
			elections_allowed = no
		}
		add_country_leader_role = {
			character = NAM_Egor_Rom
			promote_leader = yes
			country_leader = {
				desc = NAM_Egor_Rom_desc
				ideology = etatism_ideology
				traits = {
					NAM_trait_keeper_of_seals
					NAM_trait_oil_ledger
				}
				expire = "2200.1.1.1"
			}
		}
	}
}
