# ----- Victory treaty: border award and punishment -----
# STATE border sliver. Ownership, cores and control move from a defeated
# principal under the native validity gate.
NAM_rw_award_border_state = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_owned_by = EFL
			country_exists = OWNER
			country_exists = CONTROLLER
		}
		NAM = { transfer_state = PREV }
		set_state_controller_to = NAM
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_owned_by = AZH
			country_exists = OWNER
			country_exists = CONTROLLER
		}
		NAM = { transfer_state = PREV }
		set_state_controller_to = NAM
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Defeated principals carry punishment and factory reparations for two years.
NAM_rw_punish_defeated_coalition = {
	EFL = { NAM_rw_apply_punishment = yes }
	AZH = { NAM_rw_apply_punishment = yes }
}

# COUNTRY defeated principal. A new treaty replaces the existing obligations.
NAM_rw_apply_punishment = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		NAM_rw_clear_punishment = yes
		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = NAM_reparations_to_svetlogorye
			days = 730
		}
		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = NAM_ruined_economy
			days = 730
		}
		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = NAM_army_of_shame
			days = 730
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY. Annexation ends the punishment so a later revival starts clean.
NAM_rw_clear_punishment = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_ruined_economy }
		remove_ideas = NAM_ruined_economy
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_army_of_shame }
		remove_ideas = NAM_army_of_shame
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_reparations_to_svetlogorye }
		remove_ideas = NAM_reparations_to_svetlogorye
	}
}

# ----- War of return -----
# The defeat tree's revenge. After the compromise peace it is one war against
# the current owners of the lost fields and the South Harbour (67, 688, 689,
# 690, 719, 700): NAM capitulation is the coalition treaty and capitulation of
# every owner returns the states.
# From the island exile, once the namestnik has fallen, the same entry opens
# the exile war (global flag NAM_wor_exile_war) against Eflor and Azhar: the
# two fight in one temporary coalition and the marines land at the South
# Harbour. Their capitulation returns the homeland, applies the course's
# settlement to both (annexation and exploitation under the junta, federal
# districts under the humanists) and opens the consolidation; NAM
# capitulation annexes Svetlogorye with its islands.
# These wars have no deadline: they end only when one side has capitulated
# completely, or outside the treaty through NAM_war_of_return_close_external.
# The later great war (NAM_great_war_*) reuses the participant array, the
# coalition, the capitulation receipts and the settlements of this section.
# Every terminal path runs NAM_war_of_return_close or NAM_great_war_close.

# STATE field. The same army may hold several lost regions.
NAM_return_record_contact = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_wor_field_held_by_rival = yes }
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = NAM_return_contacts value = THIS } } }
				add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_return_contacts value = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
}

NAM_return_survey_field_owners = {
	clear_temp_array = NAM_return_contacts
	67 = { NAM_return_record_contact = yes }
	688 = { NAM_return_record_contact = yes }
	689 = { NAM_return_record_contact = yes }
	690 = { NAM_return_record_contact = yes }
	719 = { NAM_return_record_contact = yes }
	700 = { NAM_return_record_contact = yes }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_return_contacts
		NAM = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 20 } }
	}
}

# STATE field. Registers its foreign owner once and claims the field.
NAM_wor_register_owner = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_wor_field_held_by_rival = yes }
		add_claim_by = NAM
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant } }
				set_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
				add_to_array = { array = global.NAM_wor_participants value = THIS }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved } }
					set_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved
					save_global_event_target_as = NAM_wor_primary
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY target of the exile war or the great war. Woken from minor
# suppression before any alliance or war and registered once; the first
# independent target becomes the coalition's primary.
NAM_wor_register_target = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_wor_target_valid = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant }
		}
		ADISCORD_release_non_participating_minor_optimization = yes
		set_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
		add_to_array = { array = global.NAM_wor_participants value = THIS }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { has_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved }
			}
			set_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved
			save_global_event_target_as = NAM_wor_primary
		}
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Each independent target leaves its own alliance, so no outside ally
# is drawn into the war, and the primary founds a temporary coalition from the
# shared template. NAM_wor_release_participants dismantles it on every
# terminal path.
NAM_wor_form_coalition = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.NAM_wor_participants
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = no
				is_in_faction = yes
			}
			leave_faction = yes
		}
	}
	event_target:NAM_wor_primary = {
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = NAM_wor_coalition_faction
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_wor_coalition_founder
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.NAM_wor_participants
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = no
				is_in_faction = no
			}
			event_target:NAM_wor_primary = { add_to_faction = PREV }
		}
	}
}

# GLOBAL. The participants not yet at war join the primary's side; each
# learns of the declaration through the given event.
NAM_wor_call_participants = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.NAM_wor_participants
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_war_with = NAM }
				NOT = { tag = event_target:NAM_wor_primary }
			}
			add_to_war = {
				targeted_alliance = event_target:NAM_wor_primary
				enemy = NAM
				hostility_reason = asked_to_join
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Called by the focuses NAM_defeat_war_of_return (compromise),
# NAM_rad_war_of_return, NAM_hum_war_of_return and NAM_board_operation_poseidon
# (exile, through NAM_board_poseidon_launch) and by the renewal decision
# NAM_exile_renew_war_of_return after an exile war closed outside the treaty
# or by the council's armistice.
NAM_war_of_return_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_war_of_return_can_start = yes }
		ADISCORD_south_suspend_preparation = yes
		ADISCORD_south_clear_deadline = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_wor_start_exile value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_wor_exile_war_ready = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_wor_start_exile value = 1 }
			set_global_flag = NAM_wor_exile_war
			# A war of return lost after the compromise may have preceded the exile.
			clr_global_flag = NAM_war_of_return_resolved
			clr_global_flag = NAM_war_of_return_won
		}
		set_global_flag = NAM_war_of_return_started
		clear_array = global.NAM_wor_participants
		clr_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved
		clear_global_event_target = NAM_wor_primary
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_wor_start_exile = 1 } }
			EFL = { NAM_wor_register_target = yes }
			AZH = { NAM_wor_register_target = yes }
			# Svetlogorye claims its homeland again for the war goal.
			67 = { add_claim_by = NAM }
			688 = { add_claim_by = NAM }
			689 = { add_claim_by = NAM }
			690 = { add_claim_by = NAM }
			719 = { add_claim_by = NAM }
			700 = { add_claim_by = NAM }
		}
		else = {
			67 = { NAM_wor_register_owner = yes }
			688 = { NAM_wor_register_owner = yes }
			689 = { NAM_wor_register_owner = yes }
			690 = { NAM_wor_register_owner = yes }
			719 = { NAM_wor_register_owner = yes }
			700 = { NAM_wor_register_owner = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			leave_faction = yes
		}
		# Every owner must fall before the fields return, so the campaign
		# temporarily owns mandatory major status on both sides.
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_reserve_major = yes
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.NAM_wor_participants
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_reserve_major = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_wor_start_exile = 1 } }
			NAM_wor_form_coalition = yes
			declare_war_on = {
				target = event_target:NAM_wor_primary
				type = annex_everything
			}
		}
		else = {
			declare_war_on = {
				target = event_target:NAM_wor_primary
				type = take_claimed_state
			}
		}
		# The other owners join the same war on the primary owner's side.
		NAM_wor_call_participants = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_wor_start_exile = 0 }
				has_completed_focus = NAM_defeat_officer_cadres
			}
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.NAM_wor_participants
				NAM = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 20 } }
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.NAM_wor_participants
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.60 hours = 1 }
		}
		# From the islands the return begins with a landing at the old capital.
		NAM_wor_revenge_landing = yes
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.60 hours = 1 }
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Ends the war with every participant, releases campaign-added major
# status, dismantles the temporary coalition and clears the membership.
NAM_wor_release_participants = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.NAM_wor_participants
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_war_with = NAM
			}
			white_peace = NAM
		}
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes
		clr_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_wor_coalition_founder }
			clr_country_flag = NAM_wor_coalition_founder
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					is_faction_leader = yes
				}
				dismantle_faction = yes
			}
		}
	}
	clear_array = global.NAM_wor_participants
	clr_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved
	clear_global_event_target = NAM_wor_primary
}

# GLOBAL. Shared terminal cleanup of the war of return. The resolved flag
# comes first, so the peace callbacks this causes find no open campaign.
# Two-day capitulation receipts stay until the late callback consumes them.
NAM_war_of_return_close = {
	set_global_flag = NAM_war_of_return_resolved
	NAM_wor_release_participants = yes
	67 = { NAM_board_rising_sabotage_clear = yes }
	688 = { NAM_board_rising_sabotage_clear = yes }
	689 = { NAM_board_rising_sabotage_clear = yes }
	690 = { NAM_board_rising_sabotage_clear = yes }
	700 = { NAM_board_rising_sabotage_clear = yes }
	719 = { NAM_board_rising_sabotage_clear = yes }
	NAM = {
		clr_country_flag = NAM_return_yard_warrant
		# An armistice offer still out is withdrawn by any ending, also one
		# reached without the war tree.
		clear_variable = NAM_board_armistice_terms
		clr_country_flag = NAM_board_armistice_sent
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_board_poseidon_beachhead }
			remove_mission = NAM_board_poseidon_beachhead
		}
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM = {
				exists = yes
				has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_at_war
			}
		}
		NAM = { NAM_rtw_close = yes }
	}
}

# STATE field. Victory: a field owned by a participant returns to Svetlogorye.
NAM_wor_return_field = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM }
			owner = { has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant }
		}
		owner = { save_event_target_as = NAM_wor_old_owner }
		NAM = { transfer_state = PREV }
		remove_core_of = event_target:NAM_wor_old_owner
		add_core_of = NAM
		set_state_controller_to = NAM
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Capitulation of every owner: the fields come home. After the exile
# war Eflor and Azhar also receive the course's settlement and the
# consolidation of the returned south begins.
NAM_war_of_return_resolve_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_war_of_return_active = yes }
		set_global_flag = NAM_war_of_return_won
		NAM = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_loren_debt value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_board_loren_lien days = 540 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_loren_debt value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_board_loren_lien days = 360 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_loren_debt value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_board_loren_lien days = 180 }
			}
			clear_variable = NAM_board_loren_debt
			# Eflor mortgages bought by the council pay out once: 100 capital and
			# Reidbank +5 trust for each package.
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_eflor_mortgages value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_board_eflor_mortgages }
				multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 100 }
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 6 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_board_eflor_mortgages }
				multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 5 }
				NAM_board_support_change = yes
				NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
			}
			clear_variable = NAM_board_eflor_mortgages
			# The lawsuit closed before the return keeps the districts free of claims
			# for the first year.
			if = {
				limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_close_the_lawsuit }
				set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_corp_dispute_cooldown value = 1 days = 360 }
			}
		}
		67 = { NAM_wor_return_field = yes }
		688 = { NAM_wor_return_field = yes }
		689 = { NAM_wor_return_field = yes }
		690 = { NAM_wor_return_field = yes }
		719 = { NAM_wor_return_field = yes }
		700 = { NAM_wor_return_field = yes }
		# The partition belt passes while its owners are still participants.
		NAM_board_partition_take_belt = yes
		# Islands ceded by a dictated peace return from Eflor or Azhar.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_cede_from value = 0 }
		NAM = { NAM_rtw_return_ceded_states = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = NAM_wor_exile_war }
			# The council's victory settles every remaining principal by the
			# form of rule chosen in the war tree (NAM_rtw_settle_country).
			if = {
				limit = { NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_settling_return value = 1 }
			}
			NAM_wor_copy_participants = yes
			NAM_war_of_return_close = yes
			EFL = { NAM_sub_clear_target = yes }
			AZH = { NAM_sub_clear_target = yes }
			NAM = { NAM_sub_close = yes }
			NAM_wor_settle_list_by_route = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_settling_return value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover } }
				NAM = { NAM_rtw_settle_victory = yes }
				NAM = { NAM_mdr_begin = yes }
			}
			NAM = {
				# A won return ends the council's mainland cells; an armistice keeps them.
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
					NAM_board_cells_close = yes
				}
				NAM_consolidation_begin = yes
				news_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_news.9 hours = 1 }
			}
			log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][PEACE] Exile war of return won; Eflor and Azhar receive the course's settlement."
		}
		else = {
			NAM_war_of_return_close = yes
		}
		NAM = {
			add_stability = 0.10
			NAM_wor_restore_mainland_capital = yes
			NAM_oil_refresh = yes
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.62 hours = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
				set_temp_variable = { ADISCORD_superevent_request = 78 }
				ADISCORD_superevent_enqueue = yes
			}
		}
		ADISCORD_south_begin_preparation = yes
	}
}

# GLOBAL. NAM capitulation: the exile war annexes Svetlogorye with its islands;
# the war of return after the compromise falls to the coalition treaty.
NAM_war_of_return_resolve_defeat = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
			has_global_flag = NAM_wor_exile_war
		}
		NAM = { clear_variable = NAM_board_loren_debt }
		NAM_wor_pick_annexer = yes
		NAM_war_of_return_close = yes
		EFL = { NAM_sub_clear_target = yes }
		AZH = { NAM_sub_clear_target = yes }
		NAM_wor_annex_svetlogorye = yes
	}
	else = {
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_resolve_coalition_victory = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. A government in exile returns to the South Harbour once the war
# of return has brought it back under Svetlogorsk ownership.
NAM_wor_restore_mainland_capital = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_island_exile
			owns_state = 700
			capital_scope = { NAM_rw_island_state = yes }
		}
		set_capital = { state = 700 }
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Native peace, annexation or subjugation outside the treaty closes
# the campaign without awards. This is the only ending that can leave an
# independent exile without a won war: when its principals were removed or
# made peace by another hand. NAM_exile_renew_war_of_return then reopens the
# exile war while Eflor or Azhar still stands.
NAM_war_of_return_close_external = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
			NAM_wor_campaign_lost_outside_treaty = yes
			# Eflor's surrender routes the campaign itself once it has settled.
			NOT = { has_global_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_settling }
		}
		NAM = { clear_variable = NAM_board_loren_debt }
		NAM_war_of_return_close = yes
		# A provisional subject of direct rule waits for the victory. When no
		# principal is left to renew the war, no victory can follow: it is
		# annexed now. While one stands, the pause keeps it for the renewal.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_annex_pending
				}
				NOT = { NAM_wor_principal_standing = yes }
			}
			NAM = { NAM_rtw_annex_surrendered = yes }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY native ROOT of a capitulation. A participant of the war of return or
# the great war defeated by NAM or its subject keeps a two-day receipt through
# both callbacks.
NAM_wor_record_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_wor_campaign_active = yes
			NAM_wor_participant = yes
			OR = {
				FROM = {
					OR = {
						tag = NAM
						is_subject_of = NAM
					}
				}
				capital_scope = {
					controller = {
						OR = {
							tag = NAM
							is_subject_of = NAM
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = NAM_wor_capitulation_reserved
			value = 1
			days = 2
		}
	}
}

# ----- Settlements of the exile war and the great war -----
# GLOBAL. The participants are copied to a temporary list before the shared
# cleanup ends the war and dismantles the coalition.
NAM_wor_copy_participants = {
	clear_temp_array = NAM_wor_settle_list
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.NAM_wor_participants
		add_to_temp_array = { NAM_wor_settle_list = THIS }
	}
}

# GLOBAL, after the cleanup. Each surviving participant receives the course's
# settlement: the pillars annex and strip the conquered; Veter's humanists,
# and the corporate state that may have replaced them, make it a federal
# district.
NAM_wor_settle_list_by_route = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_wor_settle_list
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			# Only the council's won return sets the temp; the great war never does.
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_settling_return > 0 } }
				NAM_rtw_settle_country = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_exile_radical } }
				NAM_wor_radical_annex = yes
			}
			# "Материковые акции": the council's joint-stock state annexes the desert.
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NAM = {
						has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
						has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_mainland_shares
					}
				}
				NAM_wor_radical_annex = yes
			}
			else = {
				NAM_wor_federal_district_join = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY defeated participant, radical route. Its states are recorded before
# the annexation and marked once Svetlogorye owns them.
NAM_wor_radical_annex = {
	clear_temp_array = NAM_wor_annexed_states
	every_owned_state = {
		add_to_temp_array = { NAM_wor_annexed_states = THIS }
	}
	NAM_rw_clear_punishment = yes
	NAM = {
		annex_country = {
			target = PREV
			transfer_troops = no
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_wor_annexed_states
		if = {
			limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
			NAM_wor_take_state = yes
		}
	}
}

# STATE now owned by Svetlogorye after the exile war or the great war. The
# homeland regains its cores; any other state is conquered land: the state
# flag NAM_conquered_state, NAM's array NAM_conquered_states and, under the
# pillars, the modifier that blocks its development.
NAM_wor_take_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_wor_homeland_state = yes }
		add_core_of = NAM
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_conquered_state } }
			set_state_flag = NAM_conquered_state
			NAM = {
				add_to_array = { array = NAM_conquered_states value = PREV }
				set_country_flag = NAM_southern_lands_open
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_exile_radical }
				NAM_rad_direct_rule = yes
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_conquered_state_modifier } }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_conquered_state_modifier }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH. Appointment follows the subject's current ruling party.
NAM_sync_neighbor_governor = {
	if = {
		limit = { tag = EFL }
		EFL_NAM_governor = { NAM_sync_governor_roles = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = AZH }
		AZH_NAM_governor = { NAM_sync_governor_roles = yes }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM or a member district. Issuing a standard preserves any locally edited copy.
NAM_hum_issue_federal_regiment = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Federal Rifle Regiment" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Federal Rifle Regiment"
			template_counter = 3
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

NAM_hum_issue_union_brigade = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Union Combined Arms Brigade" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Union Combined Arms Brigade"
			template_counter = 3
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 }
				ADISCORD_line_artillery = { x = 2 y = 0 }
			}
			support = { engineer = { x = 0 y = 0 } }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY defeated participant. The autonomy level pools resources, factories
# and recruits. A corporate government assigns the district to an operator.
NAM_wor_federal_district_join = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_hum_federal_treaty_signed
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject = no
			is_in_faction = yes
		}
		leave_faction = yes
	}
	NAM_rw_clear_punishment = yes
	NAM = { puppet = PREV }
	NAM = {
		set_autonomy = {
			target = PREV
			autonomy_state = autonomy_NAM_federal_district
			end_wars = no
			end_civil_wars = no
		}
	}
	set_country_flag = NAM_federal_district
	NAM = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = NAM_federal_districts value = PREV } } }
			add_to_array = { array = NAM_federal_districts value = PREV }
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_southern_lands_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover } }
		NAM_corp_assign_district = yes
		# On the mainland tree the council tenders the new district (event 212);
		# a treaty district has its own tender and skips the queue.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_mdr_started }
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_skip_tender_queue = 1 } }
			}
			NAM_mdr_queue_district_tender = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		NAM_federal_district_set_name = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hum_federal_army } }
			NAM_hum_issue_federal_regiment = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hum_union_army } }
			NAM_hum_issue_union_brigade = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY recipient. The original mandate and the active southern balance are rechecked on signature.
NAM_hum_sign_southern_mandate = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_hum_southern_letter_live = yes }
		NAM = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 300 }
			NAM_spend_treasury = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = { flag = NAM_hum_southern_letter value < 2 } }
			NAM_wor_federal_district_join = yes
			set_country_flag = NAM_hum_federal_treaty_signed
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 300 }
			NAM_add_treasury = yes
		}
		else = {
			capital_scope = {
				add_building_construction = {
					type = industrial_complex
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_hum_southern_letter
		NAM = { country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.114 hours = 1 } }
	}
}

			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_subject_name_style value = 5 compare = equals } }
			set_cosmetic_tag = KDR_NAM_subject_treaty_republic
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_subject_name_style value = 6 compare = equals } }
			set_cosmetic_tag = KDR_NAM_subject_directorate
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_subject_name_style value = 7 compare = equals } }
			set_cosmetic_tag = KDR_NAM_subject_imperial_governorate
		}
		else = { set_cosmetic_tag = KDR_NAM_subject_governorate }
	}
}

# GLOBAL, before the cleanup. The participant holding the island capital,
# otherwise the coalition's first surviving independent member, will annex
# Svetlogorye; the temp NAM_wor_annexer_found reports the choice.
NAM_wor_pick_annexer = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_wor_annexer_found value = 0 }
	NAM = {
		capital_scope = {
			controller = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
						is_subject = no
					}
					save_event_target_as = NAM_wor_annexer
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_wor_annexer_found value = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.NAM_wor_participants
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_wor_annexer_found = 0 }
				exists = yes
				is_subject = no
			}
			save_event_target_as = NAM_wor_annexer
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_wor_annexer_found value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# GLOBAL, after the cleanup. NAM capitulation from the islands: the annexer
# takes Svetlogorye with every island.
NAM_wor_annex_svetlogorye = {
	NAM = { NAM_agreement_cancel = yes }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_wor_annexer_found = 1 }
			NAM = { exists = yes }
		}
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][PEACE] Svetlogorye capitulated from the islands: [NAM_wor_annexer.GetTag] annexes it."
		event_target:NAM_wor_annexer = {
			news_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_news.8 hours = 1 }
			annex_country = {
				target = NAM
				transfer_troops = no
			}
		}
	}
}

# ----- Consolidation of the returned south -----
# NAM_consolidation (0-100) is Svetlogorye's hold on the regions taken back in
# the exile war. It starts at 10 with the victory and grows by 2 a month; the
# junta adds terror and garrison orders and pays garrison upkeep of 3
# treasury per held district with a posted division, the humanists add federal treaties and
# reconstruction funds, the corporate board the same funds. Below 70 the regions may revolt or strike (event
# .104). From 70 the great war against the rest of the south may begin
# (NAM_great_war_can_start). NAM_consolidation_dynamic turns the hold into
# stability and compliance.

# COUNTRY NAM. Focuses completed before the victory may already have written
# consolidation; the base 10 is added to that value once.
NAM_consolidation_begin = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_consolidation_started } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_consolidation value = 10 }
	}
	set_country_flag = NAM_consolidation_started
	NAM_consolidation_clamp = yes
	mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every writer of the consolidation calls this clamp.
NAM_consolidation_clamp = {
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_consolidation
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_consolidation_started }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_cons_mod_stability value = NAM_consolidation }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_cons_mod_stability value = 50 }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_cons_mod_stability value = 0.002 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_cons_mod_compliance value = NAM_consolidation }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_cons_mod_compliance value = 0.0005 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_consolidation_dynamic } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_consolidation_dynamic }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# Kadir's market can trade locally even if traffic to Basiran is interrupted.

		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				controls_province = 16747
				controls_province = 16752
				controls_province = 16725
				249 = { NAM_rad_caravan_market = yes }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 30 }
		}
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, on_monthly_NAM. Growth, garrison upkeep and the incident roll;
# the incident reads only NAM's own arrays of conquered states and districts.
NAM_consolidation_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_consolidation_started
			NAM_country_operable = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_cons_delta value = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_posted_garrisons value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = NAM_exile_radical
				OR = {
					check_variable = { NAM_consolidation < 100 }
					has_country_flag = NAM_rad_garrison_order_active
				}
			}
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = NAM_conquered_states
				if = {
					limit = {
						NAM_rad_direct_rule = yes
						NAM_rad_command_post_staffed = yes
					}
					NAM = { add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_posted_garrisons value = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = NAM_rad_garrison_order_active
				OR = {
					check_variable = { NAM_posted_garrisons > 0 }
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = NAM_rad_garrison_rule
						capital_scope = {
							NAM_rad_command_post_site = yes
							NAM_rad_command_post_staffed = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_cons_delta value = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 20 }
			NAM_spend_treasury = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_stability < 0.40 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_cons_delta value = -2 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_consolidation_growth value = NAM_cons_delta }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_consolidation value = NAM_cons_delta }
		NAM_consolidation_clamp = yes
		# The junta's garrisons in the conquered states.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = NAM_exile_radical
				check_variable = { NAM_consolidation < 100 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = NAM_posted_garrisons }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 3 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_treasury_amount > 0 } }
				NAM_spend_treasury = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_consolidation < 70 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_cons_incident_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_cons_event_pending }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = NAM_exile_radical
						check_variable = { var = NAM_conquered_states^num value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
						check_variable = { var = NAM_federal_districts^num value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					# The council's direct rule holds Eflor and Azhar as conquered land.
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
						NAM_rtw_direct_rule = yes
						check_variable = { var = NAM_conquered_states^num value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
				}
			}
			random_list = {
				70 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0.7
						check_variable = { NAM_consolidation < 30 }
					}
				}
				30 = {
					NAM_consolidation_open_incident = yes
				}
			}
		}
		NAM_mdr_desert_lapse_check = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Store the incident target before scheduling the council's response.
NAM_consolidation_open_incident = {
	set_country_flag = {
		flag = NAM_cons_incident_cooldown
		value = 1
		days = 60
	}
	set_country_flag = {
		flag = NAM_cons_event_pending
		value = 1
		days = 30
	}
	clear_global_event_target = NAM_cons_place
	clear_global_event_target = NAM_cons_district
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_exile_radical }
		random_scope_in_array = {
			array = NAM_conquered_states
			limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
			save_global_event_target_as = NAM_cons_place
		}
	}
	else = {
		random_scope_in_array = {
			array = NAM_federal_districts
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				is_subject_of = NAM
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = NAM_cons_district
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
				NAM_rtw_direct_rule = yes
			}
			random_scope_in_array = {
				array = NAM_conquered_states
				limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
				save_global_event_target_as = NAM_cons_place
			}
		}
	}
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.104 hours = 6 }
}

# STATE South Harbour. An existing basin project keeps its paid terminal commission.

# ----- Great war -----
# After the consolidation Svetlogorye fights the rest of the south in one war:
# Rahma, Sardan and Kadir, and Eflor or Azhar if either still stands
# independent. The focus that opens it calls NAM_great_war_start behind
# NAM_great_war_can_start. The suppressed minors wake before any alliance,
# the targets fight in one temporary coalition, every participant holds
# mandatory major status only for this war. Capitulation of all of them
# applies the course's settlement to the new conquests; NAM capitulation
# annexes Svetlogorye. The war has no deadline. Every terminal path runs
# NAM_great_war_close.

# COUNTRY NAM. Only districts at peace before the declaration can enter the federal muster.
NAM_hum_register_federal_army = {
	clear_array = global.NAM_hum_federal_army
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_hum_government_operable = yes
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hum_union_call
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_federal_districts
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_hum_federal_muster_eligible = yes }
				add_to_array = { array = global.NAM_hum_federal_army value = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Each district joins Svetlogorye against the existing southern coalition.
NAM_hum_call_federal_army = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.NAM_hum_federal_army
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:NAM_wor_primary } }
			add_to_war = {
				targeted_alliance = NAM
				enemy = event_target:NAM_wor_primary
				hostility_reason = asked_to_join
			}
		}
	}
}

NAM_hum_demobilise_federal_army = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.NAM_hum_federal_army
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			save_event_target_as = NAM_hum_mustered_district
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.NAM_wor_participants
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = yes
						has_war_with = event_target:NAM_hum_mustered_district
					}
					white_peace = event_target:NAM_hum_mustered_district
				}
			}
		}
	}
	clear_array = global.NAM_hum_federal_army
}

# A war ended outside the treaty may resume with a fresh list of participants.
NAM_great_war_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_great_war_can_start = yes }
		ADISCORD_south_suspend_preparation = yes
		ADISCORD_south_clear_deadline = yes
		set_global_flag = NAM_great_war_started
		clr_global_flag = NAM_great_war_resolved
		clear_array = global.NAM_wor_participants
		clr_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved
		clear_global_event_target = NAM_wor_primary
		EFL = { NAM_wor_register_target = yes }
		AZH = { NAM_wor_register_target = yes }
		RHM = { NAM_wor_register_target = yes }
		SDR = { NAM_wor_register_target = yes }
		KDR = { NAM_wor_register_target = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			leave_faction = yes
		}
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_reserve_major = yes
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.NAM_wor_participants
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_reserve_major = yes
		}
		NAM_wor_form_coalition = yes
		NAM_hum_register_federal_army = yes
		declare_war_on = {
			target = event_target:NAM_wor_primary
			type = annex_everything
		}
		NAM_wor_call_participants = yes
		NAM_hum_call_federal_army = yes
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.NAM_wor_participants
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.105 hours = 1 }
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.105 hours = 1 }
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][GREAT_WAR] Svetlogorye opens the great war against the south."
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Shared terminal cleanup of the great war; the resolved flag comes
# first.
NAM_great_war_close = {
	set_global_flag = NAM_great_war_resolved
	NAM_hum_demobilise_federal_army = yes
	NAM_wor_release_participants = yes
	NAM = {
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Capitulation of every participant: the course's settlement.
NAM_great_war_resolve_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_great_war_active = yes }
		set_global_flag = NAM_great_war_won
		NAM_wor_copy_participants = yes
		NAM_great_war_close = yes
		NAM_wor_settle_list_by_route = yes
		NAM = {
			add_stability = 0.10
			NAM_oil_refresh = yes
			news_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_news.9 hours = 1 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.107 hours = 1 }
		}
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][GREAT_WAR] Great war won; the southern settlement applies to every participant."
		ADISCORD_south_begin_preparation = yes
	}
}

# GLOBAL. NAM capitulation in the great war.
NAM_great_war_resolve_defeat = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_great_war_active = yes }
		NAM_wor_pick_annexer = yes
		NAM_great_war_close = yes
		NAM_wor_annex_svetlogorye = yes
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Native peace, annexation or subjugation outside the treaty closes
# the great war without awards. An independent Svetlogorye left without a
# won war may open it again through NAM_renew_great_war.
NAM_great_war_close_external = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_great_war_active = yes
			NAM_wor_campaign_lost_outside_treaty = yes
		}
		NAM_great_war_close = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. An amnesty can promote the dormant startup character.
# An earlier amnesty preserves his accumulated commander experience.
NAM_activate_weber_commander = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_Yaroslav_Weber = { is_unit_leader = no } }
		add_corps_commander_role = {
			character = NAM_Yaroslav_Weber
			traits = {
				guerilla_fighter
				ambusher
				hill_fighter
			}
			skill = 3
			attack_skill = 3
			defense_skill = 2
			planning_skill = 3
			logistics_skill = 3
		}
	}
}

# ----- Corporate exile: capital, island concessions and the boards -----
NAM_corp_seed_capital = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_corp_capital } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 50 }
	}
}

# Liquidate the stocks rescued in the evacuation before the first orders are paid.
NAM_corp_initialize = {
	NAM_corp_seed_capital = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_free_zone_slots } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_free_zone_slots value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_free_zones_pending } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_free_zones_pending value = 0 }
	}
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_free_zone_slots
		min = 1
		max = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_loot value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_pirate_loot }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_loot value = 0 }
	}
	NAM_corp_count_zones = yes
	NAM_corp_influence_clamp = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_corp_capital_change (negative spends).
NAM_corp_capital_add = {
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = NAM_corp_capital_change }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_corp_capital
		min = 0
		max = 100000
	}
}

NAM_corp_influence_clamp = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_influence value = 100 }
	NAM_corp_refresh = yes
}

	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_loyalty_dynamic } }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_south_war_dynamic } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_south_war_dynamic }
	}
	if = {

# COUNTRY NAM. Each additional free zone exempts a further 3% of tax collection.
NAM_corp_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_mod_tax value = NAM_free_zones_active }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_corp_mod_tax value = -0.03 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_mod_research value = NAM_board_focus_research }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_mod_trade value = 0.25 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_mod_stability value = -0.05 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_mod_pp value = -0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_corp_mod_pp value = NAM_board_majority_pp }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_corp_mod_stability value = NAM_board_majority_stab }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_corp_mod_pp value = NAM_board_focus_pp }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_corp_mod_stability value = NAM_board_focus_stab }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Update income from the currently held free zones.
NAM_corp_count_zones = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_free_zones_active value = 0 }
	225 = { NAM_corp_count_zone = yes }
	226 = { NAM_corp_count_zone = yes }
	227 = { NAM_corp_count_zone = yes }
	228 = { NAM_corp_count_zone = yes }
	229 = { NAM_corp_count_zone = yes }
	230 = { NAM_corp_count_zone = yes }
	231 = { NAM_corp_count_zone = yes }
}

# STATE island.
NAM_corp_count_zone = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_free_zone }
		if = {
			limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
			NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_free_zones_active value = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			clr_state_flag = NAM_free_zone
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_free_zone_state } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_free_zone_state }
			}
		}
	}
}

# STATE island. Its pending receipt settles once, even if cancellation and
# completion both run. Delivery requires NAM's ownership and control.
NAM_corp_zone_establish = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_free_zone_pending }
		NAM_corp_zone_release = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = NAM
				is_controlled_by = NAM
				NAM = { NAM_corp_zone_operable = yes }
			}
			set_state_flag = NAM_free_zone
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_free_zone_state } } }
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_free_zone_state }
			}
			NAM = {
				NAM_corp_count_zones = yes
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 20 }
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_corp_influence value = 5 }
				NAM_corp_influence_clamp = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# STATE island. Interrupted negotiations free the slot; political power stays
# spent.
NAM_corp_zone_release = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_free_zone_pending }
		clr_state_flag = NAM_free_zone_pending
		NAM = {
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_free_zones_pending value = 1 }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = NAM_free_zones_pending
				min = 0
				max = 3
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The 3000 leased workers come home; the escrow marks a contract
# whose recruits have not yet returned.
NAM_corp_labour_return = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_labour_escrow value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		add_manpower = 3000
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_corp_labour_escrow
	clr_country_flag = NAM_corp_labour_leased
}

# STATE. The board develops the selected plot only if the national limit permits it.
# Caller: NAM_mdr_owners_register on the harbour (700), behind NAM_board_office_site.
NAM_board_build_company_offices = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { free_building_slots = { building = ADISCORD_business_center size > 0 include_locked = no } } }
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
	}
	add_building_construction = {
		type = ADISCORD_business_center
		level = 1
		instant_build = yes
	}
}

NAM_board_build_company_housing = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no } } }
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
	}
	add_building_construction = {
		type = industrial_complex
		level = 1
		instant_build = yes
	}
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_board_company_quarters_state }
}

# STATE scope. The dockyard brings its own shared slot, so it never takes a slot
# already in use in the port.
NAM_board_build_company_docks = {
	if = {
		limit = { dockyard < 20 }
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = {
			type = dockyard
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
	}
}

NAM_board_expand_company_airport = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_base < 9 }
		add_building_construction = {
			type = air_base
			level = 2
			instant_build = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_base < 10 }
		add_building_construction = {
			type = air_base
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. An interrupted capital-paid programme returns its deposit.
NAM_corp_park_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_park_deposit value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_corp_park_deposit }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_corp_park_deposit
}

# Each active island free zone pays the boards monthly.
NAM_corp_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
			NAM_country_operable = yes
		}
		NAM_corp_count_zones = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_corp_influence }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 0.3 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = NAM_board_harbour_exchange
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 10 }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_free_zones_active }
		# A lot still held by the treasury pays the council directly.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_lot_rail = 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 10 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_quay_chain }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 5 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_lot_yards = 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 10 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_quay_chain }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 5 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_lot_depots = 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 10 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_quay_chain }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 5 }
			}
		}
		# A mainland lot kept by the treasury (event 215 c, value -1) pays the council.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lot_wells = -1 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lot_smelters = -1 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lot_yards = -1 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = NAM_board_private_gospel
				NOT = { has_global_flag = NAM_war_of_return_won }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = NAM_welfare_society_99_1
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_board_society_dues }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = NAM_board_port_rights_monopoly
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = NAM_board_reidbank_clearing
			}
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 10 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change min = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = NAM_board_sanction_reidbank
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = NAM_judas_general_strike
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = NAM_judas_dock_strike
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = NAM_judas_weber_committees
				NAM_board_operable = yes
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 30 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = NAM_board_loan_service
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_loan_balance value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 20 }
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_board_loan_balance value = 20 }
		}
		round_temp_variable = NAM_corp_capital_change
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_last_income value = NAM_corp_capital_change }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		NAM_rtw_dictate_check = yes
		NAM_isl_monthly = yes
		NAM_board_cells_monthly = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_board_operable = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_pirate_commissioned = yes }
				NAM_pirate_monthly = yes
			}
			NAM_board_deliver_bid_cargo = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = NAM_judas_karamyshev_watch
					check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 30 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = 60 compare = less_than }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_watch_readiness value = NAM_revenge_readiness }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_watch_readiness value = 1 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_watch_readiness max = 60 }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = NAM_judas_watch_readiness }
				NAM_revenge_readiness_clamp = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_bank_payments value = 0 compare = greater_than }
						NAM_board_product_blocked_6 = no
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 15 }
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_bank_payments value = -1 }
			}
			NAM_corp_districts_monthly = yes
			NAM_mdr_conquered_monthly = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_hgm_started }
				NAM_ptn_deadline_check = yes
				NAM_ptn_monthly = yes
				NAM_hgm_loans_monthly = yes
			}
			# Board loops count companies themselves; see NAM_board_recount.
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_drift_company value = 0 }
			for_loop_effect = {
				start = 1
				end = 7
				value = NAM_board_loop_step
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_drift_company value = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_drift_company }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_drift_company value = NAM_board_rest^NAM_board_drift_company compare = less_than } }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_drift_company value = NAM_board_rest^NAM_board_drift_company compare = greater_than } }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -1 }
				}
				NAM_board_support_change = yes
			}
			NAM_board_recount = yes
			NAM_board_check_no_confidence = yes
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				NAM_board_ai_monthly = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_last_dividend value = 0 }
			NAM_corp_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = NAM_judas_weber_committees
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_growth value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair value = 5 compare = equals }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_growth value = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_camp_input value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_delta_input value = NAM_judas_growth }
		NAM_judas_support_change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = NAM_judas_karamyshev_watch
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_camp_input value = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_delta_input value = 2 }
		NAM_judas_support_change = yes
	}
}

# ----- Island interregnum -----
NAM_interregnum_begin = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_execution_pending
	kill_country_leader = yes
	ADISCORD_end_party_coalition = yes
	clear_array = ADISCORD_banned_parties
	set_party_name = {
		ideology = anarchism
		name = NAM_interregnum_party
		long_name = NAM_interregnum_party
	}
	set_politics = {
		ruling_party = anarchism
		elections_allowed = no
	}
	promote_character = {
		character = NAM_Absent_Government
		ideology = anarchism_ideology
	}
	add_ideas = NAM_interregnum_power_vacuum
	activate_mission = NAM_interregnum_islands
	load_focus_tree = {
		tree = NAM_exile_interregnum_focus
		keep_completed = yes
	}
}

NAM_interregnum_close = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_execution_pending }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_execution_pending
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_interregnum_islands }
		remove_mission = NAM_interregnum_islands
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_interregnum_power_vacuum }
		remove_ideas = NAM_interregnum_power_vacuum
	}
}

	set_party_name = {

	}

# COUNTRY NAM. Called once by NAM_corp_takeover after the opening trust is written and
# before NAM_board_opened: the interregnum lanes and the answer of event 82 move the
# opening values of the council and both camps. The event 82 flags are consumed here.
# Trust goes through NAM_board_support_change, which clamps to 0-100 and does not recount;
# the caller recounts once after the opening block.
NAM_interregnum_apply_pledges = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_interregnum_guarantors }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 4 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_interregnum_underwrite_freight }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 4 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_interregnum_roll_call }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 3 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_interregnum_second_shift }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_interregnum_coast_watch }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 3 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_interregnum_chart_soundings }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_first_boards }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 3 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 3 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		clr_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_first_boards
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_first_committees }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 3 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		clr_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_first_committees
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_first_officers }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 3 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		clr_country_flag = NAM_interregnum_first_officers
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Both deaths leave the sitting chairman and his cabinet in office.

			elections_allowed = no
		}
		promote_character = { character = NAM_Yaroslav_Weber ideology = humanism_ideology }
		drop_cosmetic_tag = yes
		ADISCORD_refresh_party_coalition = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_board_chairman_rules = yes
			has_completed_focus = NAM_board_last_debtor
			has_completed_focus = NAM_board_escheated_throne
			has_character = NAM_Rostislav_Karamyshev
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ADISCORD_party = token:etatism }
		ADISCORD_legalise_party = yes
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = etatism
			elections_allowed = no
		}
		set_party_name = {
			ideology = etatism
			name = NAM_island_imperial_party
			long_name = NAM_island_imperial_party
		}
		promote_character = { character = NAM_Rostislav_Karamyshev ideology = etatism_ideology }
		drop_cosmetic_tag = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# ----- Corporate state: the districts of the corporations -----
# After the takeover every federal district belongs to one of six
# corporations; the district's variable NAM_corp_district_owner (1-6) names
# it: 1 Loren, 2 Ferrant, 3 Navis, 4 Arktur, 5 Smenkom, 6 Reidbank.
# The owner gives its district a profile
# modifier and pays the board a monthly dividend; rival corporations dispute
# districts (event .108); the board auctions districts, arbitrates disputes
# and renews charters through decisions. The board leader rules the
# metropole.

NAM_sync_etatist_party_name = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover } }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_is_vorkerland_dependency = yes }
			set_party_name = {
				ideology = etatism
				name = NAM_etatism_party
				long_name = NAM_etatism_party_long
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_party_name = {
				ideology = etatism
				name = NAM_independent_etatists
				long_name = NAM_independent_etatists_long
			}
		}
	}
}

NAM_board_subject_change = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = NAM
				NAM_subject_identity_participant = yes
				is_subject_of = NAM
				FROM = { tag = NAM }
				NAM_has_subject_resource_tariff = yes
			}
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.112 hours = 1 }
		NAM = { NAM_board_queue_recount = yes }
	}
}

# NAM is the exporter. The relation's target buys its resources.
NAM_sync_subject_resource_tariff = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject_of = NAM
			NAM_has_subject_resource_tariff = no
		}
		NAM = {
			add_relation_modifier = {
				target = PREV
				modifier = NAM_subject_resource_tariff
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { is_subject_of = NAM }
			NAM_has_subject_resource_tariff = yes
		}
		NAM = {
			remove_relation_modifier = {
				target = PREV
				modifier = NAM_subject_resource_tariff
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_qualifies_for_governorate_tariff = yes
			NAM_has_governorate_resource_tariff = no
		}
		NAM = {
			add_relation_modifier = {
				target = PREV
				modifier = NAM_governorate_resource_tariff
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_qualifies_for_governorate_tariff = no
			NAM_has_governorate_resource_tariff = yes
		}
		NAM = {
			remove_relation_modifier = {
				target = PREV
				modifier = NAM_governorate_resource_tariff
			}
		}
	}
}

# Diplomatic callbacks can fire before the native overlord has changed.
# Subject identity does not grant a federal charter or its economic benefits.
# Liberation removes only NAM's own cosmetics, preserving other countries' titles.
NAM_board_sync_district_status = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_corp_disputed
			NAM_board_federal_subject = no
		}
		NAM_corp_dispute_clear = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_neighbour_is_command = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = EFL }
			set_cosmetic_tag = EFL_NAM_subject_governorate
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tag = AZH }
			set_cosmetic_tag = AZH_NAM_subject_governorate
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_board_federal_subject = yes
			NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
		}
		NAM_corp_district_set_name = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_subject_of = NAM }
		NAM_federal_district_set_name = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NAM_board_has_charter_cosmetic = yes
				NAM_has_federal_district_cosmetic = yes
			}
		}
		drop_cosmetic_tag = yes
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# Slot and diplomatic callbacks may precede the native change of office or overlord.
NAM_board_queue_recount = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_ended = 1 } }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_recount_queued }
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_board_recount_queued
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.111 hours = 1 }
	}
}

NAM_board_arm_no_confidence = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_no_confidence_day value = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_no_confidence_day value = 45 }
	activate_mission = NAM_board_no_confidence
}

NAM_board_check_no_confidence = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_board_operable = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_against value = NAM_board_votes_for compare = greater_than }
			check_variable = { NAM_board_no_confidence_day < 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_no_confidence_immunity }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_meeting_open }
			# Emergency powers of the war tree hold while a war of return runs, renewals included.
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_completed_focus = NAM_rtw_chairmans_war
					NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
				}
			}
		}
		NAM_board_arm_no_confidence = yes
	}
}

NAM_board_settle_no_confidence = {
	NAM_board_recount = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_no_confidence_day value = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_against value = NAM_board_votes_for compare = greater_than }
			check_variable = { NAM_board_challenger > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_winner value = NAM_board_challenger }
		# Board loops count companies themselves; see NAM_board_recount.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_voter value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 7
			value = NAM_board_loop_step
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_voter value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_board_voter value = -1 compare = equals } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_voter }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_board_set_input value = 55 }
				NAM_board_support_change = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_voter value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 7
			value = NAM_board_loop_step
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_voter value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_board_voter value = 1 compare = equals } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_voter }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -10 }
				NAM_board_support_change = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_winner }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_no_bonus_input value = 1 }
		NAM_board_install_chairman = yes
		add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_board_no_confidence_spirit days = 120 }
		country_event = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.420
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_voter value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 7
			value = NAM_board_loop_step
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_voter value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_board_voter value = -1 compare = equals } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_voter }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -5 }
				NAM_board_support_change = yes
			}
		}
		add_stability = 0.05
		NAM_board_recount = yes
		country_event = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.421
	}
	# "Устав правлений" adds 90 days to every route: 180, 270 with one of the two
	# focuses, 360 with both. "Вечный совет шести" always grants 360.
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_perpetual_council }
		set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_board_no_confidence_immunity days = 360 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_board_original_stays_home
			has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_boards_constitution
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_board_no_confidence_immunity days = 360 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_completed_focus = NAM_board_original_stays_home
				has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_boards_constitution
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_board_no_confidence_immunity days = 270 }
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_board_no_confidence_immunity days = 180 }
	}
}

# Callers supply a company and either an absolute value or a signed delta.
NAM_board_support_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_company value = NAM_board_company_input }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_board_set_input }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_value value = NAM_board_set_input }
		clear_variable = NAM_board_set_input
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_value value = NAM_board_delta_input }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_value value = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_trust_company }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_value min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_trust_company value = NAM_board_trust_value }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Inputs: temp NAM_board_trust_input_1 .. NAM_board_trust_input_6, signed
# trust deltas; an unset input reads as 0. Applies each non-zero delta through
# NAM_board_support_change, resets the six inputs to 0 and recounts once.
NAM_board_trust_package = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_package_1 value = NAM_board_trust_input_1 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_package_2 value = NAM_board_trust_input_2 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_package_3 value = NAM_board_trust_input_3 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_package_4 value = NAM_board_trust_input_4 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_package_5 value = NAM_board_trust_input_5 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_package_6 value = NAM_board_trust_input_6 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_2 value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_package_1 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_board_package_1 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_package_2 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_board_package_2 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_package_3 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_board_package_3 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_package_4 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_board_package_4 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_package_5 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_board_package_5 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_package_6 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_board_package_6 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	NAM_board_recount = yes
}

NAM_board_minister_seated = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_seated_company value = NAM_board_company_input }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_board_opened
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_silence_seats }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_fulfilled value = 1 compare = equals }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_seated_company }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 10 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_fulfilled value = 0 }
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	}
}

NAM_board_minister_unseated = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_unseated_company value = NAM_board_company_input }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_board_opened
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_silence_seats }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_unseated_company }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -15 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_dismissal_prepared^NAM_board_unseated_company value = global.num_days compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -5 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_dismissal_prepared^NAM_board_unseated_company value = -1 }
		}
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	}
}

NAM_board_install_chairman = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_incoming_chair value = NAM_board_company_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_suppress_bonus value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_no_bonus_input = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_suppress_bonus value = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_no_bonus_input value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_outgoing_chair value = NAM_board_chair }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_incoming_chair value = NAM_board_outgoing_chair compare = equals } }
			check_variable = { NAM_board_incoming_chair > -1 }
			check_variable = { NAM_board_incoming_chair < 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_incoming_chair = 0 } }
			promote_character = {
				character = NAM_Mark_Olshansky
				ideology = techno_corporatism
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_incoming_chair = 1 } }
			promote_character = {
				character = NAM_Aristarkh_Vyazemtsev
				ideology = techno_corporatism
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_incoming_chair = 2 } }
			promote_character = {
				character = NAM_Taisiya_Valts
				ideology = techno_corporatism
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_incoming_chair = 3 } }
			promote_character = {
				character = NAM_Saveliy_Kruze
				ideology = techno_corporatism
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_incoming_chair = 4 } }
			promote_character = {
				character = NAM_Rodion_Kalyonov
				ideology = techno_corporatism
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_incoming_chair = 5 } }
			promote_character = {
				character = NAM_Nazar_Guryev
				ideology = techno_corporatism
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_incoming_chair = 6 } }
			promote_character = {
				character = NAM_Lidiya_Velyaminova
				ideology = techno_corporatism
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair value = NAM_board_incoming_chair }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_sig_trust_plan_uses value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_sig_out_of_turn_uses value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_sig_contract_recruitment_uses value = 0 }
		NAM_hgm_sync_chair_traits = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_board_incoming_chair > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_suppress_bonus = 1 } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_incoming_chair }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 15 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_outgoing_chair > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_outgoing_chair }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -20 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
		}
		NAM_board_recount = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

NAM_judas_refresh_targets = {

			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_reason value = NAM_judas_favour_reason }
