		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_favoured value = 4 compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_sectors_4 value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_target value = 4 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_reason value = NAM_judas_favour_reason }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_favoured value = 5 compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_sectors_5 value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_target value = 5 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_reason value = NAM_judas_favour_reason }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_favoured value = 6 compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_sectors_6 value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_target value = 6 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_reason value = NAM_judas_favour_reason }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_judas_karamyshev_unlocked_target = yes
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_target value = NAM_judas_preparation }
	}
}

NAM_judas_space_clock = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spaced_day value = NAM_judas_day_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spacing_previous value = -1 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spaced_day value = NAM_judas_spacing_previous compare = equals } } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spacing_previous value = NAM_judas_spaced_day }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = NAM_board_session_day
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = NAM_judas_spaced_day }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = NAM_board_session_day }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = -7 compare = greater_than }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = 7 compare = less_than }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spaced_day value = NAM_board_session_day }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spaced_day value = 7 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = NAM_board_meeting_day
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = NAM_judas_spaced_day }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = NAM_board_meeting_day }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = -7 compare = greater_than }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = 7 compare = less_than }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spaced_day value = NAM_board_meeting_day }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spaced_day value = 7 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = NAM_board_previous_session_day
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = NAM_judas_spaced_day }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = NAM_board_previous_session_day }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = -7 compare = greater_than }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = 7 compare = less_than }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spaced_day value = NAM_board_previous_session_day }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spaced_day value = 7 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = NAM_board_previous_meeting_day
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = NAM_judas_spaced_day }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = NAM_board_previous_meeting_day }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = -7 compare = greater_than }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_gap value = 7 compare = less_than }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spaced_day value = NAM_board_previous_meeting_day }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spaced_day value = 7 }
			}
		}
	}
}

NAM_judas_weber_space_clock = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_day_input value = NAM_judas_weber_day }
	NAM_judas_space_clock = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_day value = NAM_judas_spaced_day }
}

NAM_judas_weber_adjust_clock = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_old_day value = NAM_judas_weber_day }
	NAM_judas_weber_space_clock = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_adjust value = NAM_judas_weber_day }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_adjust value = NAM_judas_old_day }
	add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_judas_weber_meeting days = NAM_judas_adjust }
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_judas_weber_unlocked_target = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_lock value = NAM_judas_weber_day }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_lock value = -14 }
	}
}

NAM_judas_weber_arm = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = NAM_judas_weber_committees
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 20 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_active_mission = NAM_judas_weber_meeting }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_day value = global.num_days }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = NAM_judas_weber_remaining
			}
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_day value = NAM_judas_weber_remaining }
			clear_variable = NAM_judas_weber_remaining
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_day value = 39 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_day value = 49 }
		}
		NAM_judas_weber_space_clock = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_judas_weber_unlocked_target = yes }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_lock value = NAM_judas_weber_day }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_lock value = -14 }
		}
		activate_mission = NAM_judas_weber_meeting
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_adjust value = NAM_judas_weber_day }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_adjust value = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_adjust value = -50 }
		add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_judas_weber_meeting days = NAM_judas_adjust }
		NAM_judas_refresh_targets = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = NAM_judas_weber_committees
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 20 compare = less_than }
			NOT = { has_variable = NAM_judas_weber_remaining }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_remaining value = 50 }
	}
}

NAM_judas_weber_due = {
	clear_variable = NAM_judas_weber_day
	clear_variable = NAM_judas_weber_lock
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = NAM_judas_weber_committees
			NAM_board_operable = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 20 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_variable = NAM_judas_weber_pending }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_pending value = NAM_judas_weber_target }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.450 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = NAM_judas_weber_committees
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 20 compare = less_than }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_remaining value = 50 }
	}
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.452 days = 1 }
}

	NAM_judas_karamyshev_space_clock = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_adjust value = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day }

	add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_judas_karamyshev_meeting days = NAM_judas_adjust }
	if = {

		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_lock value = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_lock value = -14 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Inputs: temp NAM_judas_camp_input (1 committees, 2 officers) and
# NAM_judas_delay_input (signed days). A running meeting is moved and respaced against
# the council session; a paused clock keeps the days for its next arm. No effect once
# the camp is closed.
NAM_judas_delay_meeting = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_delay_camp value = NAM_judas_camp_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_delay value = NAM_judas_delay_input }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_delay_camp value = 1 compare = equals }
			has_idea = NAM_judas_weber_committees
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_judas_weber_meeting }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_day value = NAM_judas_delay }
			add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_judas_weber_meeting days = NAM_judas_delay }
			NAM_judas_weber_adjust_clock = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_judas_weber_remaining }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_remaining value = NAM_judas_delay }
			clamp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_remaining min = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_delay_camp value = 2 compare = equals }
			has_idea = NAM_judas_karamyshev_watch
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_judas_karamyshev_meeting }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day value = NAM_judas_delay }
			add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_judas_karamyshev_meeting days = NAM_judas_delay }
			NAM_judas_karamyshev_adjust_clock = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining value = NAM_judas_delay }
			clamp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining min = 1 }
		}
	}
}

NAM_judas_karamyshev_arm = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = NAM_judas_karamyshev_watch
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 20 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_active_mission = NAM_judas_karamyshev_meeting }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day value = global.num_days }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining
			}
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day value = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining }
			clear_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day value = 44 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day value = 59 }
		}
		NAM_judas_karamyshev_space_clock = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_judas_karamyshev_unlocked_target = yes }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_lock value = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_lock value = -14 }
		}
		activate_mission = NAM_judas_karamyshev_meeting
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_adjust value = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_adjust value = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_adjust value = -60 }
		add_days_mission_timeout = { mission = NAM_judas_karamyshev_meeting days = NAM_judas_adjust }
		NAM_judas_refresh_targets = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = NAM_judas_karamyshev_watch
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 20 compare = less_than }
			NOT = { has_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining value = 60 }
	}
}

NAM_judas_karamyshev_due = {
	clear_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day
	clear_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_lock
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = NAM_judas_karamyshev_watch
			NAM_board_operable = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 20 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_pending }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_pending value = NAM_judas_karamyshev_target }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.451 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = NAM_judas_karamyshev_watch
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 20 compare = less_than }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining value = 60 }
	}
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.453 days = 1 }
}

NAM_judas_support_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_camp value = NAM_judas_camp_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_delta value = NAM_judas_delta_input }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_camp value = 1 compare = equals }
			has_idea = NAM_judas_weber_committees
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = NAM_judas_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 20 compare = less_than }
				has_active_mission = NAM_judas_weber_meeting
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_remaining value = NAM_judas_weber_day }
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_remaining value = global.num_days }
			clamp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_remaining min = 1 }
			remove_mission = NAM_judas_weber_meeting
			clear_variable = NAM_judas_weber_day
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_judas_weber_unlocked_target = yes }
				clear_variable = NAM_judas_weber_lock
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber value = 20 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				has_variable = NAM_judas_weber_remaining
			}
			NAM_judas_weber_arm = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_camp value = 2 compare = equals }
			has_idea = NAM_judas_karamyshev_watch
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = NAM_judas_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 20 compare = less_than }
				has_active_mission = NAM_judas_karamyshev_meeting
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining value = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day }
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining value = global.num_days }
			clamp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining min = 1 }
			remove_mission = NAM_judas_karamyshev_meeting
			clear_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_day
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_judas_karamyshev_unlocked_target = yes }
				clear_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_lock
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev value = 20 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				has_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_remaining
			}
			NAM_judas_karamyshev_arm = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Inputs: temp NAM_judas_camp_input (1 committees, 2 officers) and
# NAM_corp_capital_change (the full replacement of a dead camp's operation). Pays it by
# the band stored at the kill: band 1 or no band in full, band 2 half, band 3 nothing.
NAM_judas_pay_spoils = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils_camp value = NAM_judas_camp_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils value = NAM_corp_capital_change }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils_band value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils_camp value = 1 compare = equals }
			has_variable = NAM_judas_weber_end
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils_band value = NAM_judas_weber_end }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils_camp value = 2 compare = equals }
			has_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_end
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils_band value = NAM_judas_karamyshev_end }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils_band value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils_band value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_spoils value = 0.5 }
	}
	round_temp_variable = NAM_judas_spoils
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_judas_spoils }
	NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
}

	}
}

NAM_judas_buy_notes_finish = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = NAM_judas_buy_notes_receipt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_board_operable = yes
				has_idea = NAM_judas_weber_committees
			}
			clear_variable = NAM_judas_buy_notes_receipt
			set_country_flag = NAM_judas_buy_notes_done
			NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
			NAM_judas_weber_record_operation = yes

			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -4 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes

				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_minimum_day value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = {

					}
					set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_weber_day value = NAM_judas_minimum_day }

				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_loan value = 3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_navy_size = { size > 1 type = convoy }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_loan value = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_navy_size = { size > 0 type = convoy }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_loan value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_loan value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
				add_to_array = { array = NAM_judas_convoy_receipts value = NAM_judas_loan }
				multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_loan value = -1 }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = convoy_1 amount = NAM_judas_loan producer = NAM }
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.454 days = 90 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -8 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_karamyshev_pending value = 3 compare = equals }
			}
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_judas_drill_boycott days = 60 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -8 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = -10 }
			NAM_revenge_readiness_clamp = yes
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_judas_drill_block days = 60 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_camp_input value = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_delta_input value = 5 }
		NAM_judas_support_change = yes
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_pending
}

NAM_judas_karamyshev_force = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_board_operable = yes
			has_idea = NAM_judas_karamyshev_watch
			has_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_pending
			NAM_judas_karamyshev_can_force = yes
		}
		# The old settlers bring the men: Smenkom is credited, the readiness cost halves,
		# and published receipts (event 65) waive it once.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = NAM_board_old_settlers_oath
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 5 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = NAM_judas_receipts_published
				}
				clr_country_flag = NAM_judas_receipts_published
			}
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = -4 }
				NAM_revenge_readiness_clamp = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_willing_navis = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 5 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = -8 }
			NAM_revenge_readiness_clamp = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 5 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = -8 }
			NAM_revenge_readiness_clamp = yes
		}
		NAM_judas_karamyshev_record_operation = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_camp_input value = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_judas_delta_input value = -8 }
		NAM_judas_support_change = yes
		clear_variable = NAM_judas_karamyshev_pending
	}
}

NAM_board_close_tender = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_bid_lot value = NAM_board_lot_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_bid_winner value = NAM_board_company_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_bid_public_delta value = NAM_board_delta_input }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_bid_lot value = 1 compare = equals }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_bid_winner value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_lot_rail value = NAM_board_bid_winner }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_bid_loser value = 7 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_bid_loser value = NAM_board_bid_winner }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_bid_winner }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 15 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_bid_loser }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -15 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_loss_until^NAM_board_bid_loser value = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_loss_until^NAM_board_bid_loser value = 180 }
			# Only the first award of a lot opens a charter line; a retender does not.
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_lot_awarded^NAM_board_bid_lot value = 0 compare = equals } }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_board_lot_awarded^NAM_board_bid_lot value = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_bid_winner }
				NAM_board_grant_charter = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_bid_winner value = 5 compare = equals }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 80 }
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 40 }
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
				set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rail_cargo value = 1 }
			}
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.28 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_board_bid_public_delta }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes

# An empty agenda is the last resort; among usable agendas a tender loss overrides both speaker exclusions.
NAM_board_pick_speaker = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_excluded value = NAM_board_company_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_best value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_best_priority value = -100 }
	# Board loops count companies themselves; see NAM_board_recount.
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_candidate value = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 1
		end = 7
		value = NAM_board_loop_step
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_candidate value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_candidate value = NAM_board_excluded compare = equals }
					}
					OR = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_loss_until^NAM_board_candidate value = global.num_days compare = greater_than }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_candidate value = 0 compare = greater_than }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^NAM_board_candidate value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_priority value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_candidate value = NAM_board_last_1 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_candidate value = NAM_board_last_2 compare = equals }
					}
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_priority value = -2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^NAM_board_candidate value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_priority value = -4 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_loss_until^NAM_board_candidate value = global.num_days compare = greater_than }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_priority value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_agenda^NAM_board_candidate value = 0 compare = equals } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_priority value = -10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_best value = 0 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_priority value = NAM_board_best_priority compare = greater_than }
						AND = {
							check_variable = { var = NAM_board_priority value = NAM_board_best_priority compare = equals }
							OR = {
								check_variable = { var = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_candidate value = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_best compare = less_than }
								AND = {
									check_variable = { var = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_candidate value = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_best compare = equals }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_candidate value = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_best compare = greater_than }
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_best value = NAM_board_candidate }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_best_priority value = NAM_board_priority }
			}
		}
	}
}

NAM_board_ai_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			NAM_board_operable = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^1 value = 4 compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_1
		}
		else = { clr_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^6 value = 3 compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_6
		}
		else = { clr_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_6 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^4 value = 2 compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_4
		}
		else = { clr_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_4 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^2 value = 4 compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_2
		}
		else = { clr_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^5 value = 3 compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_5
		}
		else = { clr_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_5 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^3 value = 4 compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_3
		}
		else = { clr_country_flag = NAM_board_ai_seat_3 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_ai_target value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_ai_trust value = 101 }
		# Board loops count companies themselves; see NAM_board_recount.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_ai_company value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 7
			value = NAM_board_loop_step
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_ai_company value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_ai_company value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_ai_company value = NAM_board_ai_trust compare = less_than }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_ai_target value = NAM_board_ai_company }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_ai_trust value = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_ai_company }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_ai_target value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_ai_trust value = 65 compare = less_than }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_action_used value = NAM_board_action_slots compare = less_than }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_target value = 0 compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_day^NAM_board_ai_target value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_political_power < 30 }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 25 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_selected value = NAM_board_ai_target }
			activate_decision = NAM_board_lobby_company
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_disperse_mourners_eligible = yes
				NOT = { has_political_power < 20 }
			}
			activate_decision = NAM_judas_disperse_mourners
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_disarm_cutters_eligible = yes
				NOT = { has_political_power < 20 }
			}
			activate_decision = NAM_judas_disarm_cutters
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_exchange_hiring_eligible = yes
				NOT = { has_political_power < 20 }
				NOT = { has_manpower < 1500 }
			}
			activate_decision = NAM_judas_exchange_hiring
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_unseat_proxies_eligible = yes
				NOT = { has_political_power < 25 }
			}
			activate_decision = NAM_judas_unseat_proxies
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_pay_captains_eligible = yes
				NOT = { has_political_power < 25 }
				NOT = { command_power < 30 }
			}
			activate_decision = NAM_judas_pay_captains
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_register_patents_eligible = yes
				NOT = { has_political_power < 30 }
			}
			activate_decision = NAM_judas_register_patents
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_buy_mortgages_eligible = yes
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 45 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			activate_decision = NAM_judas_buy_mortgages
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_pay_moderates_eligible = yes
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			activate_decision = NAM_judas_pay_moderates
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_buy_notes_eligible = yes
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_political_power < 15 }
			}
			activate_decision = NAM_judas_buy_notes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_judas_appoint_masters_eligible = yes
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 30 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { has_political_power < 25 }
			}
			activate_decision = NAM_judas_appoint_masters
		}
	}
}

NAM_board_meeting_due = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_previous_meeting_day value = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_board_operable = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_meeting_open }
		}
		NAM_board_recount = yes
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_meeting_winner value = NAM_board_rank_1 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_dividend_quote value = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_dividend_quote value = NAM_board_sectors_1 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_meeting_sectors_1 value = NAM_board_sectors_1 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_dividend_quote value = NAM_board_sectors_2 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_meeting_sectors_2 value = NAM_board_sectors_2 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_dividend_quote value = NAM_board_sectors_3 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_meeting_sectors_3 value = NAM_board_sectors_3 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_dividend_quote value = NAM_board_sectors_4 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_meeting_sectors_4 value = NAM_board_sectors_4 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_dividend_quote value = NAM_board_sectors_5 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_meeting_sectors_5 value = NAM_board_sectors_5 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_dividend_quote value = NAM_board_sectors_6 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_meeting_sectors_6 value = NAM_board_sectors_6 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = NAM_board_double_lock_warehouse
			}
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_board_dividend_quote value = 30 }
		}
		else = {
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_board_dividend_quote value = 40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_judas_dividend_surcharge }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_dividend_quote value = NAM_judas_dividend_surcharge }
			clear_variable = NAM_judas_dividend_surcharge
		}
		# Bought proxies expire at the meeting that counted them; the story votes stay.
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^1 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^2 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^3 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^4 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^5 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^6 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_bought value = 0 }
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_meeting_winner value = NAM_board_chair compare = equals } }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.472 }
		}
		else = { country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.471 } }
	}
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.470 days = 1 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The fixed template of the old settlers' militia. Its price in the
# militia decision is four infantry battalions: 4000 manpower and 3600 rifles.
NAM_board_militia_ensure_template = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Old Settlers Militia" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Old Settlers Militia"
			is_locked = yes
			force_allow_recruiting = yes
			template_counter = 7
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

NAM_board_reward_navis = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^3 value = 1 compare = equals }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_fulfilled^11 value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^3 value = 2 compare = equals }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_fulfilled^12 value = 1 }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_board_navis_free_fairway days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^3 value = 3 compare = equals }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_fulfilled^13 value = 1 }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = convoy_1 amount = 10 producer = NAM }
		create_ship = { type = ADISCORD_coastal_patrol_ship_1 amount = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^3 value = 4 compare = equals }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_fulfilled^14 value = 1 }
		NAM_board_build_capital_naval_base = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_site_built value = 0 compare = equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 60 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^3 value = 5 compare = equals }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_fulfilled^15 value = 1 }

NAM_board_settle_resolution = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = NAM_board_company_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_settled_result value = NAM_board_result_input }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^NAM_board_settler value = 0 compare = greater_than }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settled_result value = 1 compare = equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_settler }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 15 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = 1 compare = equals }
				}
				NAM_board_reward_loren = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = 2 compare = equals }
				}
				NAM_board_reward_ferrant = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = 3 compare = equals }
				}
				NAM_board_reward_navis = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = 4 compare = equals }
				}
				NAM_board_reward_arktur = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = 5 compare = equals }
				}
				NAM_board_reward_smenkom = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = 6 compare = equals }
				}
				NAM_board_reward_reidbank = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settled_result value = 0 compare = less_than }
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_board_settler value = -1 compare = equals }
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_board_deposit^NAM_board_settler }
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = 2 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^2 value = 2 compare = equals }
						has_idea = NAM_board_ferrant_steel_monopoly
					}
				}
				remove_ideas = NAM_board_ferrant_steel_monopoly
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = 4 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^4 value = 4 compare = equals }
						has_idea = NAM_board_arktur_arms_monopoly
					}
				}
				remove_ideas = NAM_board_arktur_arms_monopoly
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = 5 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^5 value = 4 compare = equals }
						has_idea = NAM_board_smenkom_closed_shop
					}
				}
				remove_ideas = NAM_board_smenkom_closed_shop
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settler value = 6 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^6 value = 2 compare = equals }
						has_idea = NAM_board_reidbank_clearing
					}
				}
				remove_ideas = NAM_board_reidbank_clearing
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settled_result value = -1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_settler }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -20 }
				NAM_board_support_change = yes
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_settler }
				NAM_board_sanction_company = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = NAM_judas_weber_committees
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_settled_result value = 1 compare = equals }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_favoured value = NAM_board_settler }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_judas_favour_reason value = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_motion^NAM_board_settler value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_deposit^NAM_board_settler value = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_resolution_count value = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		}
	}
}

NAM_board_refund_lobby = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_target value = 0 compare = greater_than }
		}
		add_political_power = 30
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 25 }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_target value = 0 }
		NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
	}
}

NAM_board_finish_lobby = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_target value = 0 compare = greater_than }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_board_operable = yes
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_lobby_target value = 65 compare = less_than }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_gain value = 65 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_gain value = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_lobby_target }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_gain min = 0 max = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_lobby_target }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_board_lobby_gain }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_rival value = 7 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_rival value = NAM_board_lobby_target }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_lobby_rival }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -5 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_day^NAM_board_lobby_target value = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_day^NAM_board_lobby_target value = 120 }
			NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_lobby_target value = 0 }
			NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM_board_refund_lobby = yes
		}
	}
}

NAM_board_refund_dismissal = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_dismissal_target value = 0 compare = greater_than }
		}
		add_political_power = 20

		NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
	}

NAM_board_finish_dismissal = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_dismissal_target value = 0 compare = greater_than }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_dismissal_prepared^NAM_board_dismissal_target value = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_dismissal_prepared^NAM_board_dismissal_target value = 120 }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.437 days = 120 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_dismissal_target value = 0 }
			NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM_board_refund_dismissal = yes
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: laws -----
# COUNTRY NAM. One enactment per council law, called once by its focus. The law the slot
# holds is swapped out visibly, whichever law the player kept from the mainland, so the
# native line shows what the council gives up; the else branch covers an empty slot.
# A slot holds one law: the later enactment replaces whatever is there. A war law left by an
# armistice is swapped out first and is not restored when the council law is repealed.
NAM_board_enact_property_census = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_light_dues }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_light_dues
			add_idea = NAM_board_law_property_census
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_balanced_register }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_balanced_register
			add_idea = NAM_board_law_property_census
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_progressive_brackets }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_progressive_brackets
			add_idea = NAM_board_law_property_census
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_industrial_tariffs }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_industrial_tariffs
			add_idea = NAM_board_law_property_census
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_extraction_quotas }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_extraction_quotas
			add_idea = NAM_board_law_property_census
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_corporate_assessment }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = ADISCORD_taxation_corporate_assessment
			add_idea = NAM_board_law_property_census
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_ideas = NAM_board_law_property_census
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_law_lock_tt
}

# ----- Council of boards: development trades -----
# COUNTRY NAM. A trade moves 100 progress from a social track to another track. The
# raised track checks its level at once (economic through the shared economy upgrade gate);
# at level 5 the council takes 100 capital instead. The social track drops one level and
# keeps its progress; at level 1 it loses its progress and, once per campaign and track,
# one point of monthly growth. The level setters do not invalidate the economy.
NAM_board_trade_social_system_for_economic = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_economic_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_social_system_for_economic_capped_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 100 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_social_system_for_economic_tt
		hidden_effect = { NAM_board_dev_raise_economic = yes }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		NAM_board_dev_lower_social_system = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

NAM_board_trade_society_for_economic = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_economic_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_society_for_economic_capped_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 100 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_society_for_economic_tt
		hidden_effect = { NAM_board_dev_raise_economic = yes }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		NAM_board_dev_lower_society = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

NAM_board_trade_society_for_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_state_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_society_for_state_capped_tt

	}

		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The war trade of the centre pair of the return: it lowers whichever social
# track is above level 1 (society first), so it always costs a real level when one exists;
# with both at level 1 the home front pays through NAM_rtw_home_front_strain instead.
NAM_board_trade_war_lower_social = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_society_development_at_least_2 = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_war_lower_society_tt
		hidden_effect = { NAM_board_dev_lower_society = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_social_system_development_at_least_2 = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_war_lower_social_system_tt
		hidden_effect = { NAM_board_dev_lower_social_system = yes }
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_war_strain_tt
		add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_rtw_home_front_strain days = 180 }
	}
}

NAM_board_trade_war_for_army = {
	NAM_board_trade_war_lower_social = yes
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_army_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_war_for_army_capped_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 100 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_war_for_army_tt
		hidden_effect = { NAM_board_dev_raise_army = yes }
	}
	hidden_effect = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
}

NAM_board_trade_war_for_state = {

# The economic raise passes the shared economy upgrade gate; banked progress
# waits for the monthly tick.
NAM_board_trade_war_for_economic = {
	NAM_board_trade_war_lower_social = yes
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_economic_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_war_for_economic_capped_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 100 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_trade_war_for_economic_tt
		hidden_effect = { NAM_board_dev_raise_economic = yes }
	}
	hidden_effect = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
}

# The level waits for the economic gate; banked progress is retried by the monthly tick.
NAM_board_dev_raise_economic = {
	ADISCORD_initialize_society_development_variables = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economic_development_progress value = 100 }
	ADISCORD_economy_check_economic_development_upgrade = yes
}

NAM_board_dev_raise_state = {
	ADISCORD_initialize_society_development_variables = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_state_development_progress value = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_state_development_progress value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { ADISCORD_state_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_development_remainder value = ADISCORD_state_development_progress }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_development_remainder value = -100 }
		ADISCORD_increase_state_development = yes
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_state_development_progress value = ADISCORD_development_remainder }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_state_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_state_development_progress value = 0 }
	}
}

NAM_board_dev_raise_army = {
	ADISCORD_initialize_society_development_variables = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_army_development_progress value = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_army_development_progress value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { ADISCORD_army_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_development_remainder value = ADISCORD_army_development_progress }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_development_remainder value = -100 }
		ADISCORD_increase_army_development = yes
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_army_development_progress value = ADISCORD_development_remainder }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_army_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_army_development_progress value = 0 }
	}
}

# The level setter clears progress, so the kept progress is restored after the drop.
NAM_board_dev_lower_society = {
	ADISCORD_initialize_society_development_variables = yes
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_society_development_at_least_2 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_dev_kept value = ADISCORD_society_development_progress }
		ADISCORD_decrease_society_development = yes
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_society_development_progress value = NAM_board_dev_kept }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_society_development_progress value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_dev_cut_society }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_society_development_monthly_growth value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_society_development_monthly_growth value = -1 }
			set_country_flag = NAM_board_dev_cut_society
		}
	}
}

NAM_board_dev_lower_social_system = {
	ADISCORD_initialize_society_development_variables = yes
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_social_system_development_at_least_2 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_dev_kept value = ADISCORD_social_system_development_progress }
		ADISCORD_decrease_social_system_development = yes
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_social_system_development_progress value = NAM_board_dev_kept }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_social_system_development_progress value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_dev_cut_social_system }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_social_system_development_monthly_growth value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_social_system_development_monthly_growth value = -1 }
			set_country_flag = NAM_board_dev_cut_social_system
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Temp array of industries per company; index zero collects the
# public lots. Temp arrays do not outlive the effect that built them, so the
# recount and every direct call of NAM_board_update_industrial_policy build it.
NAM_board_count_industries = {
	clear_temp_array = NAM_board_industries
	resize_temp_array = {
		array = NAM_board_industries
		size = 7
		value = 0
	}
	add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^1 value = 1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^3 value = 1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^5 value = 1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^NAM_board_lot_rail value = 1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^NAM_board_lot_yards value = 1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^NAM_board_lot_depots value = 1 }
	# Mainland lots count once awarded; one kept by the treasury (-1) counts nowhere.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lot_wells > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^NAM_mdr_lot_wells value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lot_smelters > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^NAM_mdr_lot_smelters value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lot_yards > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^NAM_mdr_lot_yards value = 1 }
	}
}

# One-based company IDs match district concessions. Public holdings accrue at index zero.
# Seniority is the last digit of the ballot, so equal votes have a stable order.
# Board loops index company arrays through their own counter: it is set to the
# loop start minus one before the loop and advanced first in the body. The
# for_loop_effect value variable is never read, including in focuses and events.
NAM_board_recount = {
	NAM_board_count_industries = yes
	clear_temp_array = NAM_board_holdings
	resize_temp_array = {
		array = NAM_board_holdings
		size = 7
		value = 0
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_federal_districts
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_board_current_concession = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_corp_district_owner value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# Island concessions count with the districts once the island is the
	# Directory's (status 2 or 3); the operator is copied first because the
	# engine resolves only one index name. After the southern promise Sharden's
	# concession is worth half a holding, one vote.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 1 compare = greater_than }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^1 value = 0 compare = greater_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner_input value = NAM_board_isl_owner^1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_board_isl_owner_input value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 1 compare = greater_than }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^2 value = 0 compare = greater_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner_input value = NAM_board_isl_owner^2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_board_isl_owner_input value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^3 value = 1 compare = greater_than }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^3 value = 0 compare = greater_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner_input value = NAM_board_isl_owner^3 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_sharden_promise_done }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_board_isl_owner_input value = 0.5 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_board_isl_owner_input value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# The partition holders administer the belt land NAM holds for the
	# Directory: half a holding, one vote, to each share's holder.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_efl > 0 }
			NAM_board_belt_held_efl = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_belt_owner_input value = NAM_board_partition_efl }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_board_belt_owner_input value = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_azh > 0 }
			NAM_board_belt_held_azh = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_belt_owner_input value = NAM_board_partition_azh }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_board_belt_owner_input value = 0.5 }
	}
	NAM_mdr_count_holdings = yes
	NAM_ptn_count_holdings = yes
	clear_temp_array = NAM_board_ballots
	clear_temp_array = NAM_board_order
	clear_temp_array = NAM_board_seats
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^1 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_loren_premier }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^1 value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_loren_economy }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^1 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_loren_foreign }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^1 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^2 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_ferrant_defense }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^2 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_ferrant_economy }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^2 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_ferrant_education }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^2 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^3 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_navis_defense }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^3 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_navis_intelligence }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^3 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_navis_foreign }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^3 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^4 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_arktur_defense }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^4 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_arktur_education }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^4 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_arktur_intelligence }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^4 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^5 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_smenkom_health }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^5 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_labor_nominee }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^5 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_smenkom_foreign }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^5 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^6 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_reidbank_premier }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^6 value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_bank_nominee }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^6 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_min_reidbank_health }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_seat_count^6 value = 1 }
	}
	add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_board_seats value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 1
		end = 7
		value = NAM_board_loop_step
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes value = NAM_board_industries^NAM_board_company }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes value = 2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes value = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_territorial_votes value = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_board_company }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_territorial_votes value = 2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes value = NAM_board_territorial_votes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes value = NAM_board_seat_count^NAM_board_company }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_chair compare = equals }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes value = NAM_board_chair_vote }
		}
		# Story votes (events 58 and 73) last until partition night; bought proxies
		# until the next annual meeting. Their sum is kept for the company card.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_extra_count value = NAM_board_proxy_votes^NAM_board_company }
		# The dominion's heirs keep their seats for good; under "Одно правление" the
		# holding votes two proxies for each of the five while it trusts the council.
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_hgm_started }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_extra_count value = NAM_hgm_heir_votes^NAM_board_company }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NAM_hgm_holding_commands = yes
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = NAM_hgm_holding compare = equals }
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_extra_count value = 10 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_guarantor_vote compare = equals }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_extra_count value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_keeper_vote compare = equals }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_extra_count value = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_extra_votes^NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_extra_count }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes value = NAM_board_extra_count }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_votes }
		add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_board_seats value = NAM_board_votes }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes value = 10 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes value = 7 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes value = NAM_board_company }
		add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_board_ballots value = NAM_board_votes }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		end = 6
		value = NAM_board_round
		find_highest_in_array = {
			array = NAM_board_ballots
			index = NAM_board_index
			value = NAM_board_winning_score
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_ballots^NAM_board_index value = -1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_index value = 1 }
		add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_board_order value = NAM_board_index }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rank_1 value = NAM_board_order^0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_sectors_1 value = NAM_board_industries^1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_districts_1 value = NAM_board_holdings^1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_1 value = NAM_board_seats^1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rank_2 value = NAM_board_order^1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_sectors_2 value = NAM_board_industries^2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_districts_2 value = NAM_board_holdings^2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_2 value = NAM_board_seats^2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rank_3 value = NAM_board_order^2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_sectors_3 value = NAM_board_industries^3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_districts_3 value = NAM_board_holdings^3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_3 value = NAM_board_seats^3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rank_4 value = NAM_board_order^3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_sectors_4 value = NAM_board_industries^4 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_districts_4 value = NAM_board_holdings^4 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_4 value = NAM_board_seats^4 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rank_5 value = NAM_board_order^4 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_sectors_5 value = NAM_board_industries^5 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_districts_5 value = NAM_board_holdings^5 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_5 value = NAM_board_seats^5 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rank_6 value = NAM_board_order^5 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_sectors_6 value = NAM_board_industries^6 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_districts_6 value = NAM_board_holdings^6 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_6 value = NAM_board_seats^6 }
	# "Одно правление" compares the first company's ballot with one and a half
	# times the second's; the copies keep one index name per expression.
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_hgm_started }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_rank_company value = NAM_board_rank_1 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rank_1_ballot value = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_hgm_rank_company }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_rank_company value = NAM_board_rank_2 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rank_2_quota value = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_hgm_rank_company }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_board_rank_2_quota value = 1.5 }
	}
	NAM_board_update_industrial_policy = yes
	NAM_judas_refresh_targets = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_board_company_input (1-6). Opens the company's next
# product line; a company with both lines open is paid 40 capital instead.
# Trust is moved by the caller. Callers: the tender award and nine focus rewards.
NAM_board_grant_charter = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter_company value = NAM_board_company_input }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter^NAM_board_charter_company value = 2 compare = less_than }
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter^NAM_board_charter_company value = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter_lines value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 40 }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	}
	NAM_board_recount = yes
}

# Recounts preserve the first deadline throughout an uninterrupted low-trust period.
# Focus rewards call this directly after changing a profile level, so it reads
# votes from the stored ballot and rebuilds the industry count it needs.
NAM_board_update_industrial_policy = {
	NAM_board_count_industries = yes
	clear_temp_array = NAM_board_weights
	add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_board_weights value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_new_objection value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_active value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_board_operable = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_active value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_for value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_against value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_total value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_majority_stab value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_majority_pp value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_challenger value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_best_opposition value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_envy value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 1
		end = 7
		value = NAM_board_loop_step
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^NAM_board_company value = 1 compare = greater_than } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_envy value = -5 }
		}
	}
	clear_temp_array = NAM_board_frames
	add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_board_frames value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 1
		end = 7
		value = NAM_board_loop_step
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_rest_value value = NAM_board_seat_count^NAM_board_company }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_rest_value value = 10 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_rest_value value = 30 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_sector_points value = NAM_board_industries^NAM_board_company }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_sector_points value = 5 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_rest_value value = NAM_board_sector_points }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_envy_points^NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_envy }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_industries^NAM_board_company value = 1 compare = greater_than } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_envy_points^NAM_board_company value = 5 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_points^NAM_board_company value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_chair compare = equals } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_points^NAM_board_company value = 10 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_rest_value value = NAM_board_envy_points^NAM_board_company }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_rest_value value = NAM_board_chair_points^NAM_board_company }
		# "Устав шести" holds up the resting trust of the two last companies by votes.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_covenant_of_six
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_rank_5 compare = equals }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_rank_6 compare = equals }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_rest_value value = 10 }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_rest_value min = 20 max = 70 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rest^NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_rest_value }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust value = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_company }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_forecast^NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_trust }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust value = NAM_board_rest_value compare = less_than } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_forecast^NAM_board_company value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust value = NAM_board_rest_value compare = greater_than } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_forecast^NAM_board_company value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_board_company value = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_total value = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_company }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_weight value = NAM_board_industries^NAM_board_company }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_board_weight > 0 }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_chair compare = equals }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_weight value = 1 }
		}
		# Under "Одно правление" the five vote with the council while the holding
		# trusts it; the holding itself votes by its own trust.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_hgm_holding_commands = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = NAM_hgm_holding compare = equals } }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_board_company value = 0 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_board_company value = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_frame value = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_for value = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_company }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_trust < 35 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_deadline value = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_board_company }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_deadline = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_deadline value = global.num_days }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_deadline value = 30 }
				# "Вечный совет шести": a boycott needs 60 days of distrust.
				if = {
					limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_perpetual_council }
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_deadline value = 30 }
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_deadline }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_new_objection value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = NAM_board_deadline compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_board_company value = -1 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_frame value = 4 }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_against value = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_company }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_majority_stab value = -0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_weight value = -0.5 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_chair compare = equals } }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_company value = NAM_board_best_opposition compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_variable = { var = NAM_board_challenger value = NAM_board_company }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_best_opposition value = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_company }
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_weight value = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_frame value = 3 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_board_company value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_trust > 59 } }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_board_company value = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_frame value = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_for value = NAM_board_ballot^NAM_board_company }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_weight value = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_frame value = 2 }
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_board_frames value = NAM_board_frame }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = NAM_judas_dock_walkout
				check_variable = { var = NAM_judas_walkout_target value = NAM_board_company compare = equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_weight value = 0 }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_weight value = NAM_board_active }
		add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_board_weights value = NAM_board_weight }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance_frame_1 value = NAM_board_frames^NAM_board_rank_1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance_frame_2 value = NAM_board_frames^NAM_board_rank_2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance_frame_3 value = NAM_board_frames^NAM_board_rank_3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance_frame_4 value = NAM_board_frames^NAM_board_rank_4 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance_frame_5 value = NAM_board_frames^NAM_board_rank_5 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance_frame_6 value = NAM_board_frames^NAM_board_rank_6 }
	# The golden share of "Материковые акции": four votes on the council's side
	# while the chair's company stands for the council.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_mainland_shares
			check_variable = { NAM_board_chair > 0 }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_board_chair value = 1 compare = equals }
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_for value = 4 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_total value = 4 }
	}
	# The people's share of "Акции девяноста девяти": four votes on the council's side.
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_shares_of_the_ninety_nine }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_for value = 4 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_total value = 4 }
	}
	# On "Материковые акции" every two lots of the South kept by the council add a
	# vote on its side (NAM_ptn_kept_votes, written by NAM_ptn_count_holdings).
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_hgm_started
			has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_mainland_shares
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_kept_votes > 0 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_for value = NAM_ptn_kept_votes }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_votes_total value = NAM_ptn_kept_votes }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_double_for value = NAM_board_votes_for }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_double_for value = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_board_active = 1 }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_double_for value = NAM_board_votes_total compare = greater_than }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_majority_since < 0 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_board_majority_since value = global.num_days }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_majority_pp value = 0.20 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_majority_stab value = 0.05 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { var = NAM_board_majority_since value = -1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_active = 0 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_majority_stab value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_new_objection > 0 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.111 days = 30 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_output value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_construction value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_growth value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_naval value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_dockyards value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_ceiling value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_goods value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter_working value = 0 }
	# A closed charter line applies minus its factor whatever the stance; an open
	# one applies the live potential. The potentials are kept for the tooltips.
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_a_1 value = NAM_board_weights^1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_b_1 value = NAM_board_weights^1 }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_b_1 value = 2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_a_1 value = -1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_b_1 value = -2 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter^1 value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_a_1 value = NAM_board_potential_a_1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter^1 value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_b_1 value = NAM_board_potential_b_1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_rate_a_1 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter_working value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_rate_b_1 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter_working value = 1 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_output value = NAM_board_rate_a_1 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_construction value = NAM_board_rate_b_1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_a_2 value = NAM_board_weights^2 }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_a_2 value = 2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_b_2 value = NAM_board_weights^2 }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_b_2 value = 3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_a_2 value = -2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_b_2 value = -3 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter^2 value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_a_2 value = NAM_board_potential_a_2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter^2 value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_b_2 value = NAM_board_potential_b_2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_rate_a_2 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter_working value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_rate_b_2 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter_working value = 1 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_output value = NAM_board_rate_a_2 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_growth value = NAM_board_rate_b_2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_a_3 value = NAM_board_weights^3 }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_a_3 value = 3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_b_3 value = NAM_board_weights^3 }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_b_3 value = 3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_a_3 value = -3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_b_3 value = -3 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter^3 value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_a_3 value = NAM_board_potential_a_3 }
	}
	if = {
