		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_b_3 value = NAM_board_potential_b_3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_rate_a_3 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter_working value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_rate_b_3 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter_working value = 1 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_naval value = NAM_board_rate_a_3 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_mod_dockyards value = NAM_board_rate_b_3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_a_4 value = NAM_board_weights^4 }
	multiply_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_a_4 value = 3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_potential_b_4 value = NAM_board_weights^4 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_a_4 value = -3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_rate_b_4 value = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_charter^4 value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }

# COUNTRY district. An undisputed operator delivers its own product under the federal charter.
NAM_board_ship_district_order = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_board_trading_concession = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = 1 compare = equals }
				NAM = { NAM_board_product_blocked_1 = no }
			}
			NAM = {
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_open_fuel_reserve value = 12000 }
				NAM_open_fuel_release = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = 2 compare = equals }
				NAM = { NAM_board_product_blocked_2 = no }
			}
			NAM = {
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = motorized_equipment_1
					amount = 100
					producer = NAM
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = 3 compare = equals }
				NAM = { NAM_board_product_blocked_3 = no }
			}
			NAM = {
				NAM_judas_report_convoys = yes
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = convoy_1
					amount = 4
					producer = NAM
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = 4 compare = equals }
				NAM = { NAM_board_product_blocked_4 = no }
			}
			NAM = {
				NAM_judas_report_arms = yes
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = artillery_equipment_1
					amount = 30
					producer = NAM
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = 5 compare = equals }
				NAM = { NAM_board_product_blocked_5 = no }
			}
			NAM = { add_manpower = 250 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = 6 compare = equals }
				NAM = { NAM_board_product_blocked_6 = no }
			}
			NAM = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 15 }
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The owner of the next district handed out.
NAM_corp_init_owner_turn = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_corp_next_owner } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_next_owner value = 1 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY federal district. A district without an owner receives the next
# corporation in turn.
NAM_corp_assign_district = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_corp_district_owner } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = EFL
				NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_partition_fixed }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = NAM.NAM_board_partition_efl }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				tag = AZH
				NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_partition_fixed }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = NAM.NAM_board_partition_azh }
		}
		else = {
			NAM = { NAM_corp_init_owner_turn = yes }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = NAM.NAM_corp_next_owner }
			NAM = {
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_corp_next_owner value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_next_owner > 6 } }
					set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_next_owner value = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	NAM_corp_district_apply = yes
}

# COUNTRY federal district. The concession passes to the next corporation.
NAM_corp_district_rotate = {
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner > 6 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = 1 }
	}
	NAM_corp_district_apply = yes
}

# COUNTRY federal district. The owner's profile modifier and name.
NAM_corp_district_apply = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_disputed }
		NAM_corp_dispute_clear = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_1_district } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_1_district }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_2_district } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_2_district }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_3_district } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_3_district }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_4_district } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_4_district }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_5_district } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_5_district }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_6_district } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_6_district }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner = 1 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_1_district }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner = 2 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_2_district }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner = 3 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_3_district }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner = 4 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_4_district }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner = 5 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_5_district }
	}
	else = {
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_corp_owner_6_district }
	}
	NAM_corp_district_set_name = yes
	NAM = { NAM_board_recount = yes }
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY federal district. The caller settles the combined capital dividend;
# a contested concession can remit funds only under guard at its own capital.
NAM_corp_district_dividend = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = NAM_corp_district_owner
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_disputed }
				capital_scope = {
					has_state_flag = NAM_board_guard_post
					NAM_hum_union_market = yes
				}
			}
		}
		# Coupons 1-3 divert this district's earnings. Coupon 4 closes its issue.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = NAM_board_stock_coupon
				check_variable = { NAM_board_stock_coupon < 4 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_stock_coupon value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner = 1 } }
			NAM = { add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dividend value = 8 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner = 2 } }
			NAM = { add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dividend value = 10 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner = 3 } }
			NAM = { add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dividend value = 10 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner = 4 } }
			NAM = { add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dividend value = 6 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_owner = 5 } }
			NAM = { add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dividend value = 12 } }
		}
		else = {
			NAM = { add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dividend value = 15 } }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, inside NAM_corp_monthly after the takeover. Dividends of the
# districts and the rivalry roll over NAM's own array of districts.
NAM_corp_districts_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_corp_dispute_open
			NOT = { event_target:NAM_corp_dispute_district = { NAM_corp_live_disputed_district = yes } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = NAM_corp_dispute_district }
			event_target:NAM_corp_dispute_district = { NAM_corp_dispute_clear = yes }
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_corp_dispute_open
		clear_global_event_target = NAM_corp_dispute_district
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dividend value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_count value = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_federal_districts
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_board_operating_district = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_corp_district_owner } }
				NAM_corp_assign_district = yes
			}
			# On "Союз правлений" a boycotting owner's domain pays no dividend; the
			# charter of an Eflor or Azhar concession focus adds half of it again.
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_dividend_owner value = NAM_corp_district_owner }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						NAM = {
							has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_union_of_boards
							check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_mdr_dividend_owner value = -1 compare = equals }
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_dividend_before value = NAM_corp_dividend }
				NAM_corp_district_dividend = yes
				if = {
					limit = { NAM_mdr_chartered_district = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_dividend_bonus value = NAM_corp_dividend }
					subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_dividend_bonus value = NAM_mdr_dividend_before }
					multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_dividend_bonus value = 0.5 }
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dividend value = NAM_mdr_dividend_bonus }
				}
				# The finals of the dominion rescale the whole dividend of the district:
				# the league doubles it, the perpetual council's equal shares cut a quarter.
				if = {
					limit = {
						NAM = {
							OR = {
								has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_league_of_districts
								has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_perpetual_council
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_dividend_part value = NAM_corp_dividend }
					subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_dividend_part value = NAM_mdr_dividend_before }
					if = {
						limit = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_league_of_districts } }
						add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dividend value = NAM_hgm_dividend_part }
					}
					else = {
						multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_dividend_part value = -0.25 }
						add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dividend value = NAM_hgm_dividend_part }
					}
				}
			}
			NAM = { add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_count value = 1 } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_last_dividend value = NAM_corp_dividend }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_district_count value = NAM_corp_district_count }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_corp_dividend }
	NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_corp_district_count > 1 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_dispute_open }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_dispute_cooldown }
		}
		random_list = {
			85 = { }
			15 = {
				# "Хартия владычества" halves the weight: about 8% a month.
				modifier = {
					factor = 0.5
					has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_charter_of_dominion
				}
				NAM_corp_open_dispute = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. A rival corporation, the next one in turn, claims a district.
NAM_corp_open_dispute = {
	clear_global_event_target = NAM_corp_dispute_district
	random_scope_in_array = {
		array = NAM_federal_districts
		limit = {
			NAM_board_trading_concession = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_hgm_owner_fixed }
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_corp_disputed
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dispute_claimant value = NAM_corp_district_owner }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dispute_claimant value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_corp_dispute_claimant > 6 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_dispute_claimant value = 1 }
		}
		save_global_event_target_as = NAM_corp_dispute_district
		save_event_target_as = NAM_corp_case_district
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = NAM_corp_dispute_district }
		NAM_board_recount = yes
		set_country_flag = NAM_corp_dispute_open
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = NAM_corp_dispute_cooldown
			value = 1
			days = 120
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.108 hours = 6 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY disputed district. The claimant takes the concession.
NAM_corp_dispute_award_claimant = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = NAM_corp_dispute_claimant }
	NAM_corp_dispute_clear = yes
	NAM_corp_district_apply = yes
}

# COUNTRY disputed district. The dispute ends; the board may face another.
NAM_corp_dispute_clear = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_corp_disputed
	clear_variable = NAM_corp_dispute_claimant
	NAM = {
		clr_country_flag = NAM_corp_dispute_open
		clear_global_event_target = NAM_corp_dispute_district
		NAM_board_recount = yes
	}
}

# Both claimants have equal standing at the concession hearing.
NAM_corp_arbitrate_dispute = {
	event_target:NAM_corp_dispute_district = {
		random_list = {
			50 = { NAM_corp_dispute_award_claimant = yes }
			50 = { NAM_corp_dispute_clear = yes }
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: mainland cells -----
# Cells are the state variable NAM_cells (0-100) on the six mainland districts:
# 67 and 688 for Eflor's holder, 689, 690, 700 and 719 for Azhar's. Only
# NAM_board_cells_add writes it. A paid run "Ячейка" holds the state flag
# NAM_board_cells_work on its district: value 1 for the 750-rifle price of the
# holders' underwriting, 2 for 1500. NAM_board_cells_running counts the runs.
# The cells rise and are spent when the war of return starts; a won return or
# the end of the council closes them, an armistice keeps them.

# STATE district. Input: temp NAM_board_cells_change, signed.
NAM_board_cells_add = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_value value = NAM_cells }
	add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_value value = NAM_board_cells_change }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_value min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_cells value = NAM_board_cells_value }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. NAM_board_mainland_inventory: ten cells in every district.
NAM_board_cells_seed = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_change value = 10 }
	67 = { NAM_board_cells_add = yes }
	688 = { NAM_board_cells_add = yes }
	689 = { NAM_board_cells_add = yes }
	690 = { NAM_board_cells_add = yes }
	700 = { NAM_board_cells_add = yes }
	719 = { NAM_board_cells_add = yes }
}

# COUNTRY NAM, complete_effect of NAM_board_inv_cells after its price
# recheck; FROM is the district. Debits the run once and opens its escrow.
NAM_board_cells_pay_run = {
	add_political_power = -25
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -40 }
	NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_inv_backing = 1 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = infantry_equipment
			amount = -750
		}
		FROM = {
			set_state_flag = {
				flag = NAM_board_cells_work
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = infantry_equipment
			amount = -1500
		}
		FROM = {
			set_state_flag = {
				flag = NAM_board_cells_work
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_running value = 1 }
}

# STATE district. Returns a paid run: 40 capital and its rifles.
NAM_board_cells_refund_run = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_board_cells_work }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = {
					flag = NAM_board_cells_work
					value = 1
				}
			}
			NAM = {
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment
					amount = 750
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			NAM = {
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment
					amount = 1500
				}
			}
		}
		clr_state_flag = NAM_board_cells_work
		NAM = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 40 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_running value = -1 }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = NAM_board_cells_running
				min = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# STATE district, remove_effect of NAM_board_inv_cells. The run settles only
# while Eflor or Azhar still holds the district and the war has not started;
# otherwise the price returns.
NAM_board_cells_settle_run = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = NAM_board_cells_work
			OR = {
				is_owned_by = EFL
				is_owned_by = AZH
			}
			NAM = { NAM_board_cells_open = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_change value = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_board_cells_safehouse_cover = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_change value = 25 }
		}
		NAM_board_cells_add = yes
		clr_state_flag = NAM_board_cells_work
		NAM = {
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_running value = -1 }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = NAM_board_cells_running
				min = 0
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		NAM_board_cells_refund_run = yes
	}
}

# STATE district. Opens the exposure event 130 for this district. Callers check
# that no exposure event is pending.
NAM_board_cells_expose = {
	save_global_event_target_as = NAM_board_cells_district
	NAM = {
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = NAM_board_cells_event_pending
			value = 1
			days = 30
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.130 }
	}
}

# STATE district, remove_effect of the enemy's NAM_cells_raid.
NAM_board_cells_raid_settle = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_change value = -25 }
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_board_cells_safehouse_cover = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_change value = -15 }
	}
	# The council's leaflets protect ten cells from the raid.
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { has_idea = NAM_sub_leaflets } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_change value = 10 }
	}
	NAM_board_cells_add = yes
	set_state_flag = {
		flag = NAM_cells_raided
		value = 1
		days = 120
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM = {
				NAM_board_cells_open = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_cells_event_pending }
			}
		}
		NAM_board_cells_expose = yes
	}
}

# STATE district. A network of ten or more recruits itself up to 60; higher
# values need paid runs.
NAM_board_cells_grow = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				is_owned_by = EFL
				is_owned_by = AZH
			}
			check_variable = { NAM_cells > 9 }
			check_variable = { NAM_cells < 60 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_change value = 1 }
		# The council's leaflets on the owner recruit three a month.
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_idea = NAM_sub_leaflets } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_change value = 3 }
		}
		NAM_board_cells_add = yes
	}
}

# STATE district. One 8% exposure roll for a network of 40 or more without a
# raid cooldown, while no exposure event is pending.
NAM_board_cells_expose_roll = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_cells > 39 }
			NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_cells_raided }
			NAM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_cells_event_pending } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 8
			NAM_board_cells_expose = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from NAM_corp_monthly after its main NAM_corp_capital_add. Six
# explicit rows each, no scope scan; the first exposure hit sets the pending
# flag, so the later rows wait for the next month.
NAM_board_cells_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_board_cells_open = yes }
		67 = { NAM_board_cells_grow = yes }
		688 = { NAM_board_cells_grow = yes }
		689 = { NAM_board_cells_grow = yes }
		690 = { NAM_board_cells_grow = yes }
		700 = { NAM_board_cells_grow = yes }
		719 = { NAM_board_cells_grow = yes }
		67 = { NAM_board_cells_expose_roll = yes }
		688 = { NAM_board_cells_expose_roll = yes }
		689 = { NAM_board_cells_expose_roll = yes }
		690 = { NAM_board_cells_expose_roll = yes }
		700 = { NAM_board_cells_expose_roll = yes }
		719 = { NAM_board_cells_expose_roll = yes }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The locked militia template of the risings; never recruitable.
NAM_board_partisan_template = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Mainland Partisans" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Mainland Partisans"
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			is_locked = yes
			template_counter = 3
			regiments = {
				ADISCORD_militia = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				ADISCORD_militia = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				ADISCORD_militia = { x = 0 y = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# STATE district. NAM takes the rising province: a non-VP land province, in
# the South Harbour the smallest of its four VP provinces.
NAM_board_cells_take_rising_province = {
	if = {
		limit = { state = 67 }
		NAM = { set_province_controller = 4287 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 688 }
		NAM = { set_province_controller = 3127 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 689 }
		NAM = { set_province_controller = 176 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 690 }
		NAM = { set_province_controller = 2935 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 700 }
		NAM = { set_province_controller = 16881 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 719 }
		NAM = { set_province_controller = 461 }
	}
}

# STATE district. One partisan division on the rising province, counted
# against the cap of eight in the temp NAM_board_partisans_raised.
NAM_board_cells_raise_partisan = {
	add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_partisans_raised value = 1 }

			division = "division_template = \"Mainland Partisans\" start_experience_factor = 0.10 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
			owner = NAM
			prioritize_location = 4287
			allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 688 }
		create_unit = {
			division = "division_template = \"Mainland Partisans\" start_experience_factor = 0.10 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
			owner = NAM
			prioritize_location = 3127
			allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 689 }
		create_unit = {
			division = "division_template = \"Mainland Partisans\" start_experience_factor = 0.10 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
			owner = NAM
			prioritize_location = 176
			allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 690 }
		create_unit = {
			division = "division_template = \"Mainland Partisans\" start_experience_factor = 0.10 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
			owner = NAM
			prioritize_location = 2935
			allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 700 }
		create_unit = {
			division = "division_template = \"Mainland Partisans\" start_experience_factor = 0.10 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
			owner = NAM
			prioritize_location = 16881
			allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 719 }
		create_unit = {
			division = "division_template = \"Mainland Partisans\" start_experience_factor = 0.10 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
			owner = NAM
			prioritize_location = 461
			allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
		}
	}
}

# STATE district. Rising by the district's cells: sabotage from 30; from 50
# the hostile armies there fall back to their capitals, NAM takes the rising
# province and one partisan division forms on it; from 70 a second division,
# and Svetlogorsk also gives up its port province 689 once the partition night
# has set up the holders' safehouses. The cap of eight divisions holds across the six districts. Only
# a district held by the enemy, or already by NAM, rises.
NAM_board_cells_rise_state = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_cells > 29 }
			OR = {
				is_controlled_by = NAM
				controller = {
					OR = {
						has_war_with = NAM
						has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = {
			modifier = NAM_board_rising_sabotage
			days = 120
		}
		damage_building = {
			type = infrastructure
			damage = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_cells > 49 }
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partisans_raised < 8 }
			}
			teleport_armies = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_war_with = NAM
						has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
					}
				}
			}
			NAM_board_cells_take_rising_province = yes
			NAM_board_cells_raise_partisan = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_cells > 69 }
					check_variable = { NAM_board_partisans_raised < 8 }
				}
				NAM_board_cells_raise_partisan = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { state = 700 }
				NAM = { set_country_flag = NAM_board_harbour_rose }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					state = 688
					check_variable = { NAM_cells > 69 }
					NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_partition_fixed }
				}
				NAM = { set_province_controller = 689 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# STATE district. Spends the network: a paid run returns its price first.
NAM_board_cells_spend = {
	NAM_board_cells_refund_run = yes
	clear_variable = NAM_cells
}

# COUNTRY NAM, after a successful NAM_war_of_return_start (operation Poseidon
# or the renewal decision). Every district rises by its cells, then the cells
# are spent. The harbour landing rule has already read district 700.
NAM_board_cells_rise = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_board_harbour_rose
	NAM_board_partisan_template = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_partisans_raised value = 0 }
	67 = { NAM_board_cells_rise_state = yes }
	688 = { NAM_board_cells_rise_state = yes }
	689 = { NAM_board_cells_rise_state = yes }
	690 = { NAM_board_cells_rise_state = yes }
	700 = { NAM_board_cells_rise_state = yes }
	719 = { NAM_board_cells_rise_state = yes }
	67 = { NAM_board_cells_spend = yes }
	688 = { NAM_board_cells_spend = yes }
	689 = { NAM_board_cells_spend = yes }
	690 = { NAM_board_cells_spend = yes }
	700 = { NAM_board_cells_spend = yes }
	719 = { NAM_board_cells_spend = yes }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_cells_running value = 0 }
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][CELLS] Mainland rising: [?NAM_board_partisans_raised] partisan divisions."
}

# STATE district, from NAM_war_of_return_close. The rising's sabotage ends with
# the war; after an armistice or defeat it must not burden the peacetime controller.
NAM_board_rising_sabotage_clear = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_board_rising_sabotage } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_board_rising_sabotage }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Route end (NAM_board_end_operations) or a won return: every

# ----- Council of boards: operation Poseidon -----
# The final focus NAM_board_operation_poseidon starts the existing war of
# return; no second war exists. The landing-hour grants follow only when the
# exile war really began. A start refused in the same tick pays nothing more:
# the renewal decision NAM_exile_renew_war_of_return becomes visible through
# the completed focus and reopens it.

# COUNTRY NAM. Reward of NAM_board_operation_poseidon, in landing order:
# the war and its harbour landing, the risings, the island brigades, the
# flagship division, the spirit, the council's trust and the beachhead mission.
NAM_board_poseidon_launch = {
	NAM_war_of_return_start = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
			has_global_flag = NAM_wor_exile_war
		}
		NAM_board_cells_rise = yes
		NAM_board_poseidon_island_brigades = yes
		NAM_marine_ensure_template = yes
		if = {
			limit = { controls_province = 16716 }
			700 = {
				create_unit = {
					division = "name = \"Флагманский десант\" division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.35 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
					owner = NAM
					prioritize_location = 16716
					allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			capital_scope = {
				create_unit = {
					division = "name = \"Флагманский десант\" division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.35 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
					owner = NAM
					allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
				}
			}
		}
		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = NAM_board_poseidon_spirit
			days = 120
		}
		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = NAM_board_invasion_fleet_spirit
			days = 365
		}
		NAM_sub_apply_landing_charges = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_gain value = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_others_gain value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_gain value = 5 }
		NAM_board_holders_package = yes
		NAM_rtw_begin = yes
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.168 days = 1 }
		activate_mission = NAM_board_poseidon_beachhead
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][POSEIDON] Operation Poseidon began the war of return."
	}
	else = {
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][POSEIDON] Operation Poseidon found no war of return to start; the renewal decision reopens it."
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from event 131 a (temp NAM_board_armistice_offer 1) and c (2). The offer
# goes to the principal that can still decide, in the order of NAM_rtw_pick_decider
# (the primary, Eflor, Azhar), without saving NAM_rtw_decider, so a line or dictate
# offer keeps its own decider. With no principal left the war is won and no offer
# goes out; the paid answers of event 131 share the limit, so no price is charged
# for an offer that cannot go out or would cross another pending one. An offer whose event 133 never fires lapses in NAM_rtw_expire_offers.
NAM_board_send_armistice_offer = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_board_armistice_offer_possible = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_armistice_terms value = NAM_board_armistice_offer }
		set_country_flag = NAM_board_armistice_sent
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved
				event_target:NAM_wor_primary = { NAM_rtw_can_decide = yes }
			}
			event_target:NAM_wor_primary = {
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.133 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { EFL = { NAM_rtw_can_decide = yes } }
			EFL = {
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.133 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			AZH = {
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.133 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from event 133 a: the coalition's leader accepted the council's
# armistice. Terms from event 131: 1 - the "Отлив" spirit and the holders -5,
# 2 - the holders -12. NAM_war_of_return_close sets the resolved flag first,
# white-peaces and releases every participant and keeps NAM_wor_exile_war,
# so the renewal decision reopens the war after the truce. The external close
# is not used: it would clear NAM_board_loren_debt, and Loren's advances are
# charged at the victory of a renewed war. The cells stay for the renewal.
NAM_board_poseidon_armistice = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
			check_variable = { NAM_board_armistice_terms > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_gain value = -12 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_armistice_terms < 2 } }
			add_timed_idea = {
				idea = NAM_board_poseidon_ebb
				days = 180
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_gain value = -5 }
			# The council's terms give up the partition belt.
			NAM_board_partition_drop_claims = yes
		}
		# The holders' terms keep the claimed belt land NAM controls; the white
		# peace of NAM_war_of_return_close follows the transfer.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_armistice_terms > 1 } }
			NAM_board_partition_keep_belt = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_others_gain value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_gain value = 0 }
		NAM_board_holders_package = yes
		# The price passes to the principal that accepted (saved by event 133 a);
		# send_equipment moves only rifles NAM actually holds.
		send_equipment = {
			equipment = infantry_equipment
			amount = 3000
			target = event_target:NAM_board_armistice_acceptor
		}
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = NAM_board_poseidon_truce
			value = 1
			days = 180
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_board_poseidon_beachhead }
			remove_mission = NAM_board_poseidon_beachhead
		}
		clear_variable = NAM_board_armistice_terms
		clr_country_flag = NAM_board_armistice_sent
		NAM_war_of_return_close = yes
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][POSEIDON] Armistice: the war of return closed, renewal after 180 days."
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: subversive operations -----
# The partition night opens eight operations against Eflor and Azhar (category
# NAM_board_subversion) and claims the border belt. Residency operations 1-6
# keep one receipt per target country: NAM_sub_op_kind (the operation) and
# NAM_sub_op_capital (the capital paid). The council operations keep theirs
# on NAM: the leaflets NAM_sub_leaflets_receipt with NAM_sub_leaflets_target
# (1 Eflor, 2 Azhar), the quarrel NAM_sub_quarrel_receipt. Settlement, refund
# and exposure clear a receipt exactly once; political power and trust are
# never refunded. No operation writes the mainland cells or moves a resource
# to NAM. Temp inputs: NAM_sub_k (1-6 residency, 7 leaflets, 8 quarrel) and
# NAM_sub_target_index (1 Eflor, 2 Azhar).

# COUNTRY NAM, partition night. Claims on the belt beyond the old border:
# Eflor's share 720, 721, 723 and Azhar's share 722, 727.

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH, from a residency decision of NAM. Writes the receipt
# and lets the target's political police smell the operation.
NAM_sub_launch_residency = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_sub_op_kind value = NAM_sub_k }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_sub_op_capital value = 80 }
	random = {
		chance = 50
		set_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_residency
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH. Capital back to NAM, receipt and police flags cleared.
NAM_sub_residency_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_sub_op_kind }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_refund value = NAM_sub_op_capital }
		NAM = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_sub_refund }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
		clear_variable = NAM_sub_op_kind
		clear_variable = NAM_sub_op_capital
		clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_residency
		clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunted
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The leaflets' capital and chancery slot back.

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH. The exposure roll of operation NAM_sub_k against this
# country: temp NAM_sub_failed = 1 when the operation is exposed. The failure
# weight is the risk of NAM_sub_risk_compute in literal steps of 5.
NAM_sub_roll = {

			100 = {
				modifier = {
					add = -5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 4 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 9 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 14 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 19 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 24 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 29 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 34 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 39 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 44 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 49 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_failed value = 0 }
			}
			0 = {
				modifier = {
					add = 5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 4 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 9 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 14 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 19 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 24 }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 5
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_risk > 29 }
				}

		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = NAM_sub_dock_fire
			days = 90
		}
	}
}

# Operation 4 leaves a landing-hour charge: its days are applied by
# NAM_sub_apply_landing_charges at the start of the war of return.
NAM_sub_apply_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_sub_profile_is_4 = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_sub_sights_days value = 90 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { var = NAM_sub_sights_days value = 60 }
	}
}

NAM_sub_apply_5 = {

	if = {

			idea = NAM_sub_labour_strike
			days = 120
		}
	}
	else = {

			days = 90
		}

NAM_sub_apply_6 = {

	if = {

			days = 120
		}

			idea = NAM_sub_bond_crash
			days = 90
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH. One network level per success, at most two.
NAM_sub_network_grow = {
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_sub_network value = 1 }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_sub_network
		min = 0
		max = 2
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH. Writes temp NAM_sub_target_index from the tag.
NAM_sub_set_target_index = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_target_index value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { tag = AZH }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_target_index value = 2 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Temp NAM_sub_holder: the holder of the share of target
# NAM_sub_target_index, 0 before the partition.
NAM_sub_find_holder = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_holder value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_target_index = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_holder value = NAM_board_partition_efl }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_target_index = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_holder value = NAM_board_partition_azh }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Trust after a success: a residency operation gives its company
# +2 and the holder of the share +1 (both land on one company when it is the
# holder); the leaflets give the chairing company +2. The quarrel pays its
# trust through NAM_board_holders_package in NAM_sub_settle_quarrel.
NAM_sub_trust_success = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_sub_k > 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_sub_k < 7 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_sub_k }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 2 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		NAM_sub_find_holder = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_holder > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_sub_holder }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 1 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_chair > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_chair }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 2 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Trust after an exposure: the company -4 and the holder -2 for
# a residency operation, the chairing company -4 for the leaflets or quarrel.
NAM_sub_trust_failure = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_sub_k > 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_sub_k < 7 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_sub_k }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -4 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		NAM_sub_find_holder = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_holder > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_sub_holder }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -2 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_chair > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_chair }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -4 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
	}
	NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH, remove_effect of a residency decision (temp NAM_sub_k,
# ROOT NAM). A receipt cleared by an exposure settles nothing; a target lost
# meanwhile, a full strike cap or a result already in place refunds the
# capital; otherwise the roll decides between the strike and the exposure.
NAM_sub_settle_residency = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_sub_op_kind value = NAM_sub_k compare = equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_cap_self value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NAM_sub_target_valid = no
					NAM_sub_has_profile_spirit = yes
					AND = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 4 } }
						NAM_sub_below_cap = no
					}
				}
			}
			NAM_sub_residency_refund = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM_sub_roll = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_failed = 1 } }
				NAM_sub_expose_from_target = yes
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 1 } }
					NAM_sub_apply_1 = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 2 } }
					NAM_sub_apply_2 = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 3 } }
					NAM_sub_apply_3 = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 4 } }
					NAM_sub_apply_4 = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 5 } }
					NAM_sub_apply_5 = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 6 } }
					NAM_sub_apply_6 = yes
				}
				NAM_sub_network_grow = yes
				clear_variable = NAM_sub_op_kind
				clear_variable = NAM_sub_op_capital
				clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_residency
				clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunted
				NAM_sub_set_target_index = yes
				NAM = {
					NAM_sub_trust_success = yes
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_variable = NAM_sub_files }
							NAM_sub_both_networks = yes
						}
						country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.137 days = 3 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_cap_self value = 0 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, remove_effect of the leaflets (temp NAM_sub_k = 7 is set here).
NAM_sub_settle_leaflets = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_sub_leaflets_receipt }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_k value = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_leaflets_target = 1 } }
			EFL = { NAM_sub_settle_leaflets_target = yes }
		}
		else = {
			AZH = { NAM_sub_settle_leaflets_target = yes }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH, the leaflets' target.
NAM_sub_settle_leaflets_target = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_cap_self value = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NAM_sub_target_valid = no
				has_idea = NAM_sub_leaflets
				NAM_sub_below_cap = no
			}
		}
		NAM = { NAM_sub_leaflets_refund = yes }
	}
	else = {
		NAM_sub_roll = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_failed = 1 } }
			NAM_sub_expose_from_target = yes
		}
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = {
				idea = NAM_sub_leaflets
				days = 120
			}
			NAM_sub_network_grow = yes
			clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_leaflets
			clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunted
			NAM = {
				clear_variable = NAM_sub_leaflets_receipt
				clear_variable = NAM_sub_leaflets_target
				NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
				NAM_sub_trust_success = yes
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_cap_self value = 0 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM, remove_effect of the quarrel. Both members must still be
# targets; Eflor then leads the coalition and carries the roll.
NAM_sub_settle_quarrel = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_sub_quarrel_receipt }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_sub_quarrel_targets = no }
			NAM_sub_quarrel_refund = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_k value = 8 }
			EFL = {
				NAM_sub_roll = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_failed = 1 } }
					NAM_sub_expose_from_target = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_failed = 0 } }
				set_country_flag = NAM_sub_quarrel_ready
				clear_variable = NAM_sub_quarrel_receipt
				NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
				EFL = {
					clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_quarrel
					clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunted
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_gain value = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_others_gain value = -2 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_gain value = 2 }
				NAM_board_holders_package = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH. Exposure of operation NAM_sub_k against this country.
NAM_sub_expose_from_target = {
	NAM_sub_set_target_index = yes
	NAM = { NAM_sub_expose = yes }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Temps NAM_sub_target_index and NAM_sub_k, set by every caller
# (residency settlement, leaflets, quarrel, the enemy's counter-intelligence).
# No strike or charge, the price is lost; trust and readiness fall; the target
# goes on alert, loses a network level and hears of it (event 136); the
# council hears of it in event 135. Each receipt is cleared exactly once.
NAM_sub_expose = {
	NAM_sub_trust_failure = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = -3 }
	NAM_revenge_readiness_clamp = yes
	# One council hearing at a time: event 135 reads and its answers clear the
	# exposed_* record, so a second exposure before the answer pays every cost
	# below but does not overwrite the pending record or queue another hearing.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = NAM_sub_exposed_target }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_sub_exposed_target value = NAM_sub_target_index }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_sub_exposed_runner value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k < 7 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_sub_exposed_runner value = NAM_sub_k }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_chair > 0 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_sub_exposed_runner value = NAM_board_chair }
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.135 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_target_index = 1 } }
		EFL = { NAM_sub_expose_target_side = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_target_index = 2 } }
		AZH = { NAM_sub_expose_target_side = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 7 }
			has_variable = NAM_sub_leaflets_receipt
		}
		clear_variable = NAM_sub_leaflets_receipt
		clear_variable = NAM_sub_leaflets_target
		NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 8 }
			has_variable = NAM_sub_quarrel_receipt
		}
		clear_variable = NAM_sub_quarrel_receipt
		NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH, the exposed target (temp NAM_sub_k).
NAM_sub_expose_target_side = {
	set_country_flag = {
		flag = NAM_sub_vigilant
		value = 1
		days = 120
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_network > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_sub_network value = -1 }
	}
	clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunted
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k < 7 } }
		clear_variable = NAM_sub_op_kind
		clear_variable = NAM_sub_op_capital
		clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_residency
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 7 } }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_leaflets
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_quarrel
	}
	country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.136 days = 1 }
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH, remove_effect of NAM_sub_counter. The operation is chosen
# among those the police smelled and that still run (NAM_sub_counter_lead), in
# the order residency, leaflets, quarrel; the catch chance is 30% +10 against a
# landing preparation (4 or the quarrel), -10 under cell cover, -10 when the
# holder runs its own trade. A miss sets the shared NAM_sub_hunted, which adds
# its risk to whichever operation against the country settles next; the alert
# follows either way.
NAM_sub_counter_settle = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_k value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_residency
			has_variable = NAM_sub_op_kind
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_k value = NAM_sub_op_kind }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_leaflets
			NAM_sub_leaflets_against_this = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_k value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_quarrel
			NAM_sub_quarrel_against_this = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_k value = 8 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_k > 0 } }
		random_list = {
			70 = {
				modifier = {
					add = -10
					OR = {
						check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 4 }
						check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 8 }
					}
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 10
					NAM_sub_cells_cover = yes
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 10
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_k < 7 }
					NAM_sub_holder_runs = yes
				}
				set_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunted
			}
			30 = {
				modifier = {
					add = 10
					OR = {
						check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 4 }
						check_variable = { NAM_sub_k = 8 }
					}
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -10
					NAM_sub_cells_cover = yes
				}
				modifier = {
					add = -10
					check_variable = { NAM_sub_k < 7 }
					NAM_sub_holder_runs = yes
				}
				NAM_sub_counter_catch = yes
			}
		}
	}
	set_country_flag = {
		flag = NAM_sub_vigilant
		value = 1
		days = 120
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH (ROOT of NAM_sub_counter), temp NAM_sub_k. The exposure
# clears the receipt before NAM's decision is removed, so a settlement that
# the removal may still run finds nothing to settle.
NAM_sub_counter_catch = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_sub_caught value = NAM_sub_k }
	NAM_sub_set_target_index = yes
	NAM = { NAM_sub_expose = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_caught = 1 } }
		NAM = {
			remove_targeted_decision = {
				target = ROOT
				decision = NAM_sub_sand_in_tanks_op
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_caught = 2 } }
		NAM = {
			remove_targeted_decision = {
				target = ROOT
				decision = NAM_sub_bad_castings_op
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_caught = 3 } }
		NAM = {
			remove_targeted_decision = {
				target = ROOT
				decision = NAM_sub_dock_fire_op
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_caught = 4 } }
		NAM = {
			remove_targeted_decision = {
				target = ROOT
				decision = NAM_sub_bad_sights_op
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_caught = 5 } }
		NAM = {
			remove_targeted_decision = {
				target = ROOT
				decision = NAM_sub_labour_strike_op
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_caught = 6 } }
		NAM = {
			remove_targeted_decision = {
				target = ROOT
				decision = NAM_sub_bond_crash_op
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_caught = 7 } }
		NAM = {
			remove_targeted_decision = {
				target = ROOT
				decision = NAM_sub_leaflets_op
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_caught = 8 } }
		NAM = { remove_decision = NAM_sub_trophy_quarrel_op }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Landing-hour charges at the actual start of the war of return:
# operation 4 on each country that carries it, the quarrel on both members.
NAM_sub_apply_landing_charges = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = EFL }
		EFL = { NAM_sub_apply_sights_charge = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = AZH }
		AZH = { NAM_sub_apply_sights_charge = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_sub_quarrel_ready }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_quarrel_ready
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = EFL }
			EFL = {
				add_timed_idea = {
					idea = NAM_sub_trophy_quarrel
					days = 120
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = AZH }
			AZH = {
				add_timed_idea = {
					idea = NAM_sub_trophy_quarrel
					days = 120
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH. Applies and clears the charge of operation 4.
NAM_sub_apply_sights_charge = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_sub_sights_days = 90 } }
		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = NAM_sub_bad_sights
			days = 90
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_sub_sights_days }
		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = NAM_sub_bad_sights
			days = 60
		}
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_sub_sights_days
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH. Victory or defeat in the war of return: every subversion
# spirit, charge, receipt and police state of the operations ends.
NAM_sub_clear_target = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_sub_dry_tanks }
		remove_ideas = NAM_sub_dry_tanks
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_sub_bad_castings }
		remove_ideas = NAM_sub_bad_castings
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_sub_dock_fire }
		remove_ideas = NAM_sub_dock_fire
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_sub_bad_sights }
		remove_ideas = NAM_sub_bad_sights
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_sub_labour_strike }
		remove_ideas = NAM_sub_labour_strike
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_sub_bond_crash }
		remove_ideas = NAM_sub_bond_crash
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_sub_leaflets }
		remove_ideas = NAM_sub_leaflets
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_sub_trophy_quarrel }
		remove_ideas = NAM_sub_trophy_quarrel
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_sub_op_kind
	clear_variable = NAM_sub_op_capital
	clear_variable = NAM_sub_sights_days
	clear_variable = NAM_sub_network
	clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_vigilant
	clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_residency
	clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_leaflets
	clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunch_quarrel
	clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_hunted
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Route end or a won return: every running operation returns its
# capital and slot; the landing-hour charges lapse.
NAM_sub_close = {
	EFL = {
		NAM_sub_residency_refund = yes
		clear_variable = NAM_sub_sights_days
	}
	AZH = {
		NAM_sub_residency_refund = yes
		clear_variable = NAM_sub_sights_days
	}
	NAM_sub_leaflets_refund = yes
	NAM_sub_quarrel_refund = yes
	clr_country_flag = NAM_sub_quarrel_ready
	clear_variable = NAM_sub_exposed_target
	clear_variable = NAM_sub_exposed_runner
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every answer of event 135 clears the exposure record.
NAM_sub_exposed_clear = {
	clear_variable = NAM_sub_exposed_target
	clear_variable = NAM_sub_exposed_runner
}

# ----- Council of boards: war of return -----
# The tree NAM_return_war_focus replaces the corporate tree for the war of
# return. NAM_board_poseidon_launch and the renewal start it with NAM_rtw_begin;
# NAM_war_of_return_close runs NAM_rtw_close on every terminal path, and the
# route end runs it when the council falls during the war.

# COUNTRY NAM. Called after the rising of the landing or of the renewal in the
# same effect. The age of NAM_rtw_at_war is the war's day count; the temp
# NAM_board_partisans_raised left by NAM_board_cells_rise counts the landing's
# partisans against the cap of eight per war.
NAM_rtw_begin = {
	set_country_flag = NAM_rtw_at_war
	set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_partisans value = NAM_board_partisans_raised }
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_renewed
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Event 168 loads the war tree one day after operation Poseidon,
# so Poseidon's own completion does not depend on the engine order inside its
# reward. The renewal loads it directly.
NAM_rtw_load_tree = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
			has_focus_tree = NAM_exile_corporate_focus
		}
		load_focus_tree = {
			tree = NAM_return_war_focus
			keep_completed = yes
		}
	}
	mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The reload is skipped only when the annexation is certain:
# NAM_war_of_return_resolve_defeat runs NAM_wor_pick_annexer before the close,
# and its temp NAM_wor_annexer_found reads 1 only when an annexer exists. A
# capitulated Directory without an annexer survives the white peace and gets
# the corporate tree back. A won return keeps the war tree for NAM_mdr_begin,
# which loads the mainland tree after the settlement.
NAM_rtw_restore_tree = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_focus_tree = NAM_return_war_focus
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_capitulated = yes
					check_variable = { NAM_wor_annexer_found = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = NAM_war_of_return_won } }
			load_focus_tree = {
				tree = NAM_exile_corporate_focus
				keep_completed = yes
			}
		}
	}
	mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The single exit of the war tree, behind NAM_rtw_at_war. Receipts
# are refunded by their holders before the markers are cleared; the tree swap
# comes last.
NAM_rtw_close = {
	NAM_rtw_fronts_close = yes
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_at_war
	clear_variable = NAM_rtw_partisans
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_renewed
	clear_variable = NAM_rtw_requisitions
	NAM_rtw_restore_tree = yes
}

# War of return: fronts, operations and the peace. The decisions of the
# category NAM_rtw_war keep each paid run's receipt in the scope it belongs to:
# a district's state flag (administration, rising, militia) or a NAM variable
# (landing, raid, colonel, levy, the surrender escrow). cancel_effect, the
# remove-time recheck and NAM_rtw_fronts_close refund only while the receipt
# exists and clear it in the same block, so a run is returned at most once.

# COUNTRY NAM, first row of NAM_rtw_close: every running receipt is refunded,
# the orders and offers are withdrawn and the war spirits leave both sides.
# The administered and militia flags of the districts end here too; the line
# armistice has already transferred the administered districts.
NAM_rtw_fronts_close = {
	67 = { NAM_rtw_district_close = yes }
	688 = { NAM_rtw_district_close = yes }
	689 = { NAM_rtw_district_close = yes }
	690 = { NAM_rtw_district_close = yes }
	700 = { NAM_rtw_district_close = yes }
	719 = { NAM_rtw_district_close = yes }
	692 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_raided }
	NAM_rtw_landing_refund = yes
	NAM_rtw_raid_refund = yes
	NAM_rtw_colonel_refund = yes
	NAM_rtw_levy_refund = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_rtw_surrender_escrow }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_rtw_surrender_escrow }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		clear_variable = NAM_rtw_surrender_escrow
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_rtw_order_mission }
		remove_mission = NAM_rtw_order_mission
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_rtw_capital_order_mission }
		remove_mission = NAM_rtw_capital_order_mission
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_rtw_order_target
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_order_extra_days
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_order_cooldown
	set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_admin_running value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_rising_running value = 0 }
	clear_variable = NAM_rtw_bought_efl
	clear_variable = NAM_rtw_lured_azh
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_renewed_landed
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_pending
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_cooldown_efl
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_bonus_efl
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_malus_efl
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_line_pending
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_armistice_cooldown
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_dictate_pending
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_dictate_cooldown
	clear_variable = NAM_rtw_dictate_refusals
	clear_variable = NAM_board_armistice_terms
	clr_country_flag = NAM_board_armistice_sent
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_off_mainland
	clr_global_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_settling
	NAM_rtw_clear_decider = yes
	NAM_rtw_clear_war_spirits = yes
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = EFL }
		EFL = { NAM_rtw_clear_enemy_ideas = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = AZH }
		AZH = { NAM_rtw_clear_enemy_ideas = yes }
	}
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# STATE homeland district, from NAM_rtw_fronts_close.
NAM_rtw_district_close = {
	NAM_rtw_admin_refund = yes
	NAM_rtw_rising_refund = yes
	NAM_rtw_militia_refund = yes
	clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_administered
	clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_militia_raised
	clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_rose
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Temps NAM_rtw_holder_share (1 Eflor's share, 2 Azhar's) and
# NAM_rtw_holder_delta: the trust of that share's holder, frozen at the
# partition night.
NAM_rtw_holder_trust = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_rtw_holder_share = 1 }
			check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_efl > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_partition_efl }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_rtw_holder_delta }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_rtw_holder_share = 2 }
			check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_azh > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_partition_azh }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_rtw_holder_delta }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_holder_share value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_holder_delta value = 0 }
}

# while NAM controls it, else the South Harbour (16716), else the capital.

		}

		limit = { controls_province = 16716 }

# COUNTRY NAM. One "Line Infantry Brigade"; temp NAM_rtw_unit_name: 1 the
# northern volunteers (preferred Svetlogorsk, 16721), 2 Eflor's bought
# regiment (preferred the harbour). Without the template its men join the pool.
NAM_rtw_place_brigade = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_template = "Line Infantry Brigade" }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_unit_name = 2 } }
			NAM_rtw_place_defectors_brigade = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM_rtw_place_north_brigade = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_manpower = 6300
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_unit_name value = 0 }
}

# ----- War of return: risings, orders and administration -----

# STATE homeland district held by the enemy; temp NAM_rtw_rise_count (1 or 2).
# The rising of the landing without the cell threshold: hostile armies leave
# the district, NAM takes the rising province and raises partisans against
# the war's cap of eight in NAM_rtw_partisans.
NAM_rtw_rise_state = {
	NAM = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_partisans_raised value = NAM_rtw_partisans }
		NAM_board_partisan_template = yes
	}
	add_dynamic_modifier = {
		modifier = NAM_board_rising_sabotage
		days = 120
	}
	teleport_armies = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_war_with = NAM
				has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
			}
		}
	}
	NAM_board_cells_take_rising_province = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_partisans_raised < 8 } }
		NAM_board_cells_raise_partisan = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_rtw_rise_count > 1 }
			check_variable = { NAM_board_partisans_raised < 8 }
		}
		NAM_board_cells_raise_partisan = yes
	}
	NAM = { set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_partisans value = NAM_board_partisans_raised } }
	set_state_flag = NAM_rtw_rose
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_rise_count value = 0 }
}

# STATE district, receipt of NAM_rtw_raise_district: 60 capital and 3000 rifles.
NAM_rtw_rising_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_rtw_rising_work }
		clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_rising_work
		NAM = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 60 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 3000 producer = NAM }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_rising_running value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# STATE district (NAM_rtw_raise_district remove_effect). The rising happens while the district is
# still held by a country at war with the Directory, otherwise the price returns.
NAM_rtw_rising_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_rtw_rising_work }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM }
				controller = { has_war_with = NAM }
				NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_partisans < 8 } }
			}
			clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_rising_work
			NAM = { set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_rising_running value = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_rise_count value = 1 }
			NAM_rtw_rise_state = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM_rtw_rising_refund = yes
		}
	}
}

# STATE district, receipt of NAM_rtw_provisional_admin: the capital paid
# is kept in NAM_rtw_admin_paid; political power is never refunded.
NAM_rtw_admin_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_rtw_admin_work }
		clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_admin_work
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_rtw_admin_paid }
		clear_variable = NAM_rtw_admin_paid
		NAM = {
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_admin_running value = 1 }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = NAM_rtw_admin_running
				min = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# STATE district (NAM_rtw_provisional_admin remove_effect): still held by the Directory and still
# owned by a principal at war, the district accepts the council's administration.
NAM_rtw_admin_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_rtw_admin_work }
		if = {
			limit = {

# COUNTRY NAM, from NAM_rtw_order (FROM = the target state). One order at a
# time: the district orders run 75 days, the capital orders 120 with the
# assault spirit. The Middle Loren order (701) runs 30 more after the bridge
# stormed from the march (event 147 b); the Black Basin order (69) never takes
# that bonus, which stays reserved for 701.
NAM_rtw_order_activate = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_order_target value = FROM }
	if = {
		limit = {
			FROM = {
				OR = {
					state = 701
					state = 69
				}
			}
		}
		activate_mission = NAM_rtw_capital_order_mission
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_order_extra_days
				FROM = { state = 701 }
			}
			clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_order_extra_days
			add_days_mission_timeout = {
				mission = NAM_rtw_capital_order_mission
				days = 30
			}
			add_timed_idea = {
				idea = NAM_rtw_capital_assault
				days = 150
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = {
				idea = NAM_rtw_capital_assault
				days = 120
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		activate_mission = NAM_rtw_order_mission
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Temp NAM_rtw_holder_share from the order's target: 688, 67 and
# 701 are Eflor's share, 700, 690 and 69 Azhar's.
NAM_rtw_order_share = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_holder_share value = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_rtw_order_target = 688 }
				check_variable = { NAM_rtw_order_target = 67 }
				check_variable = { NAM_rtw_order_target = 701 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_holder_share value = 1 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, the order missions' complete_effect: the district or capital is taken.

	add_political_power = 40
	add_war_support = 0.03
	NAM_rtw_order_share = yes

		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_open_fuel_reserve value = 8000 }
		NAM_open_fuel_release = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = 3 }
		NAM_board_trust_package = yes
	}
	else_if = {

		add_manpower = 4000
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = 3 }
		NAM_board_trust_package = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_order_target = 690 } }

					exists = yes

					days = 120
				}
			}
		}
	}

			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_order_last value = NAM_rtw_order_target }
	clear_variable = NAM_rtw_order_target
	set_country_flag = {
		flag = NAM_rtw_order_cooldown
		value = 1
		days = 30
	}

}

# STATE homeland district owned by Eflor at its surrender: returned to the

# so the Directory's recruitment stays as it was for the rest of the war.
NAM_rtw_return_share_state = {

	remove_core_of = EFL

	clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_administered

# COUNTRY NAM, from event 157 a. Eflor leaves the coalition before anything
# ends its war, so the peace callbacks this effect causes find no Eflor in the
# campaign; the guard flag keeps NAM_war_of_return_close_external away until
# the routing at the end. Azhar stays in the participant list in every case,
# so the victory's field, belt and settlement rows still reach it.
NAM_rtw_accept_surrender_efl = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
			has_variable = NAM_rtw_surrender_escrow
			EFL = { NAM_rtw_can_decide = yes }
		}
		set_global_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_settling
		# Whether Azhar is already beaten is read before anything changes the war.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_azh_down value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { country_exists = AZH }
					AZH = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant } }
					AZH = { has_capitulated = yes }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_azh_down value = 1 }
		}
		EFL = {
			remove_from_array = {
				array = global.NAM_wor_participants
				value = THIS
			}
			clr_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_wor_coalition_founder }
				clr_country_flag = NAM_wor_coalition_founder
				if = {
					limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
					dismantle_faction = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved
				event_target:NAM_wor_primary = { tag = EFL }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AZH = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
					}
				}
				AZH = { save_global_event_target_as = NAM_wor_primary }
			}
			else = {
				clear_global_event_target = NAM_wor_primary
				clr_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved
			}
		}
		# The bankers' fee goes to the cabinet that signs.
		clear_variable = NAM_rtw_surrender_escrow
		clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_pending
		clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_bonus_efl
		clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_malus_efl
		# Eflor's homeland districts, its belt and any island ceded to it.
		67 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_rtw_return_share_state = yes
			}
		}
		688 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_rtw_return_share_state = yes
			}
		}
		689 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_rtw_return_share_state = yes
			}
		}
		690 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_rtw_return_share_state = yes
			}
		}
		700 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_rtw_return_share_state = yes
			}
		}
		719 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_rtw_return_share_state = yes
			}
		}
		720 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_board_partition_transfer_state = yes
			}
		}
		721 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_board_partition_transfer_state = yes
			}
		}
		722 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_board_partition_transfer_state = yes
			}
		}
		723 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_board_partition_transfer_state = yes
			}
		}
		727 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = EFL }
				NAM_board_partition_transfer_state = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_cede_from value = 1 }
		NAM_rtw_return_ceded_states = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		# The field army is dissolved without refund before the peace.
		EFL = { delete_unit = { } }
		EFL = {
			white_peace = NAM
			NAM_rtw_clear_enemy_ideas = yes
			NAM_sub_clear_target = yes
		}
		# The form of rule: the holder's district, or under direct rule a
		# provisional subject annexed at the victory.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_settling_return value = 2 }
		EFL = { NAM_rtw_settle_country = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_settling_return value = 0 }
		# A white peace may have ended Azhar's war with its leader; a beaten
		# Azhar is never attacked again.
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_rtw_azh_down = 0 }
				AZH = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = NAM }
				}
			}
			declare_war_on = {
				target = AZH
				type = annex_everything
			}
		}
		clr_global_flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_settling
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
				OR = {
					check_variable = { NAM_rtw_azh_down = 1 }
					NAM_wor_all_defeated = yes
				}
			}
			NAM_war_of_return_resolve_victory = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM_war_of_return_close_external = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = 3 }
		NAM_board_trust_package = yes
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.159 hours = 1 }
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][RTW] Eflor surrendered to the Directory."
	}
	else = {
		NAM_rtw_surrender_refused = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY principal defeated at the victory (temp NAM_rtw_settling_return 1)
# or Eflor at its surrender (temp 2). Its subjects become the Directory's
# puppets first; then exactly one form of rule.
NAM_rtw_settle_country = {
	NAM_rtw_take_subjects = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM = { NAM_rtw_direct_rule = yes }
			check_variable = { NAM_rtw_settling_return = 1 }
		}
		NAM_wor_radical_annex = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM = { NAM_rtw_direct_rule = yes } }
		NAM_rtw_hold_surrendered = yes
	}
	else = {
		NAM_wor_federal_district_join = yes
		NAM_rtw_restore_district_control = yes
	}
	NAM = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
}

# COUNTRY defeated principal. A native iterator inside the principal; its
# subjects keep their tags and land as ordinary puppets of the Directory.
NAM_rtw_take_subjects = {
	every_subject_country = {
		NAM = { puppet = PREV }
	}
}

# COUNTRY district. A subject made in the tick of its defeat keeps the
# overlord's occupation; the district controls all of its own land.
NAM_rtw_restore_district_control = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = PREV } }
		set_state_controller_to = PREV
	}
}

# COUNTRY Eflor surrendered under direct rule. A provisional subject until the
# victory: no federal-district flag, no entry in NAM_federal_districts and no
# concession, so it pays no dividend, gives no votes and keeps its land out
# of the Directory's own surrender base, as the holders' district does.
NAM_rtw_hold_surrendered = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject = no
			is_in_faction = yes
		}
		leave_faction = yes
	}
	NAM_rw_clear_punishment = yes
	NAM = { puppet = PREV }
	NAM = {
		set_autonomy = {
			target = PREV
			autonomy_state = autonomy_NAM_federal_district
			end_wars = no
			end_civil_wars = no
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_rtw_annex_pending
	}
	NAM_rtw_restore_district_control = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM, first row of NAM_rtw_settle_victory: the provisional subject is

NAM_rtw_annex_surrendered = {

	}
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_annex_pending
}

# COUNTRY NAM, after the settlement list of a won return on the corporate

NAM_rtw_settle_victory = {
