# ----- War of return: ceded islands -----
# NAM_rtw_ceded_states lists every state the dictated peace ceded;
# NAM_rtw_ceded_status^k and NAM_rtw_ceded_owner^k keep the island's status and
# concession owner (k 1 Ulven, 2 Luren, 3 Sharden). Island cores are never
# removed, so a nationalised island is national again when it returns.

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_rtw_cede_from: 0 returns the states Eflor or Azhar
# owns (victory), 1 only Eflor's (its surrender). Each entry is cleared when
# returned; the temp is reset to 0.
NAM_rtw_return_ceded_states = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
			check_variable = { NAM_rtw_ceded_states^num > 0 }
		}
		clear_temp_array = NAM_rtw_cede_list
		for_each_loop = {
			array = NAM_rtw_ceded_states
			value = v
			add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_rtw_cede_list value = v }
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_rtw_cede_list
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_owned_by = EFL
						AND = {
							is_owned_by = AZH
							check_variable = { NAM_rtw_cede_from = 0 }
						}
					}
				}
				NAM = { transfer_state = PREV }
				set_state_controller_to = NAM
				NAM = {
					remove_from_array = {
						array = NAM_rtw_ceded_states
						value = PREV
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 1 }
		NAM_rtw_restore_island_status = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 2 }
		NAM_rtw_restore_island_status = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 3 }
		NAM_rtw_restore_island_status = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_cede_from value = 0 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_rtw_isl_k. A ceded island whose capital is the
# Directory's again regains its status and concession owner.
NAM_rtw_restore_island_status = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_ceded_status^NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { NAM_rtw_isl_k = 1 }
					648 = { is_owned_by = NAM }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { NAM_rtw_isl_k = 2 }
					651 = { is_owned_by = NAM }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { NAM_rtw_isl_k = 3 }
					680 = { is_owned_by = NAM }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^NAM_rtw_isl_k value = NAM_rtw_ceded_status^NAM_rtw_isl_k }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^NAM_rtw_isl_k value = NAM_rtw_ceded_owner^NAM_rtw_isl_k }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_ceded_status^NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_ceded_owner^NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 0 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, dictated peace on terms 1. The most recently nationalised
# island (Sharden, Luren, Ulven), else an annexed one, else state 230 unless it
# is the capital, passes to the decider. Leaves the temp NAM_rtw_ceded_ok at 1
# when land passed; at 0 the caller applies terms 2.
NAM_rtw_cede_island = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_ceded_ok value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rtw_island_cedable_3 = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^3 value = 3 compare = equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rtw_island_cedable_2 = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 3 compare = equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rtw_island_cedable_1 = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 3 compare = equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rtw_island_cedable_3 = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^3 value = 2 compare = equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rtw_island_cedable_2 = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 2 compare = equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_rtw_island_cedable_1 = yes
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 2 compare = equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_isl_k > 0 } }
		# The island-indexed cells exist only in a sized array.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_ceded_status^num < 4 } }
			resize_array = {
				array = NAM_rtw_ceded_status
				size = 4
				value = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_ceded_owner^num < 4 } }
			resize_array = {
				array = NAM_rtw_ceded_owner
				size = 4
				value = 0
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_ceded_status^NAM_rtw_isl_k value = NAM_isl_status^NAM_rtw_isl_k }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_ceded_owner^NAM_rtw_isl_k value = NAM_board_isl_owner^NAM_rtw_isl_k }
		NAM_rtw_cede_island_rows = yes
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^NAM_rtw_isl_k value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_ceded_ok value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			230 = { is_owned_by = NAM }
			NOT = { capital_scope = { state = 230 } }
		}
		230 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_ceded_ok value = 1 }
	}
	NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_rtw_isl_k. Every state of the island's explicit list.
NAM_rtw_cede_island_rows = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_isl_k = 1 } }
		643 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		644 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		645 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		646 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		647 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		648 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_isl_k = 2 } }
		649 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		650 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		651 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		652 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
	}
	else = {
		672 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		673 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		674 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		675 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		676 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		677 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		678 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		679 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
		680 = { NAM_rtw_cede_state = yes }
	}
}

# STATE owned by NAM: recorded, then passed to the decider of the dictated peace.
NAM_rtw_cede_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
		NAM = { add_to_array = { array = NAM_rtw_ceded_states value = PREV } }
		event_target:NAM_rtw_decider = { transfer_state = PREV }
		set_state_controller_to = event_target:NAM_rtw_decider
	}
}

# ----- War of return: the coalition's decider, armistice and dictated peace -----

# GLOBAL. Who answers for the coalition, in explicit order: the primary, then
# Eflor, then Azhar, each only while at war with the Directory and not
# capitulated. A capitulated principal never chooses a peace.
NAM_rtw_pick_decider = {
	NAM_rtw_clear_decider = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = NAM_wor_primary_saved
			event_target:NAM_wor_primary = { NAM_rtw_can_decide = yes }
		}
		event_target:NAM_wor_primary = { save_global_event_target_as = NAM_rtw_decider }
		set_global_flag = NAM_rtw_decider_saved
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { EFL = { NAM_rtw_can_decide = yes } }
		EFL = { save_global_event_target_as = NAM_rtw_decider }
		set_global_flag = NAM_rtw_decider_saved
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AZH = { NAM_rtw_can_decide = yes } }
		AZH = { save_global_event_target_as = NAM_rtw_decider }
		set_global_flag = NAM_rtw_decider_saved
	}
}

# GLOBAL. Clears the decider with its marker flag.
NAM_rtw_clear_decider = {
	clear_global_event_target = NAM_rtw_decider
	clr_global_flag = NAM_rtw_decider_saved
}

# STATE homeland district at the line armistice: an administered district
# still owned by a principal passes to the Directory with its core.
NAM_rtw_keep_administered = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = NAM_rtw_administered
			owner = { has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant }
		}
		owner = { save_event_target_as = NAM_rtw_old_owner }
		NAM = { transfer_state = PREV }
		remove_core_of = event_target:NAM_rtw_old_owner
		add_core_of = NAM
		set_state_controller_to = NAM
	}
	clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_administered
	clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_militia_raised
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from event 161 a: the coalition accepted the line of contact.
# A pause: the claims stay, the truce lasts 180 days and the renewal resumes
# the war against every principal still standing.
NAM_rtw_line_armistice = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_line_pending
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
			has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_at_war
		}
		67 = { NAM_rtw_keep_administered = yes }
		688 = { NAM_rtw_keep_administered = yes }
		689 = { NAM_rtw_keep_administered = yes }
		690 = { NAM_rtw_keep_administered = yes }
		700 = { NAM_rtw_keep_administered = yes }
		719 = { NAM_rtw_keep_administered = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_gain value = -5 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_others_gain value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_gain value = 3 }
		NAM_board_holders_package = yes
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = NAM_board_poseidon_truce
			value = 1
			days = 180
		}
		NAM_rtw_clear_decider = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		NAM_war_of_return_close = yes
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][RTW] Armistice on the line of contact; renewal after 180 days."
	}
	else = {
		NAM_rtw_clear_decider = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. An offer whose event never fired (its trigger failed in the
# meantime) lapses after 30 days, so it cannot block every later offer; the
# surrender escrow returns as on a refusal.
NAM_rtw_expire_offers = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = {
				flag = NAM_rtw_surrender_pending
				days > 30
			}
		}
		NAM_rtw_surrender_refused = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = {
				flag = NAM_rtw_line_pending
				days > 30
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_line_pending
		NAM_rtw_clear_decider = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = {
				flag = NAM_rtw_dictate_pending
				days > 30
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_dictate_pending
		NAM_rtw_clear_decider = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = {
				flag = NAM_board_armistice_sent
				days > 30
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_board_armistice_sent
		clear_variable = NAM_board_armistice_terms
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, monthly from NAM_corp_monthly. Keeps the off-mainland timer and
# lets the coalition decide whether to dictate terms: surrender progress above
# the threshold, or the Directory off the mainland for 60 days after day 90.
NAM_rtw_dictate_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_at_war
			NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_board_poseidon_no_homeland_held = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_off_mainland } }
				set_country_flag = NAM_rtw_off_mainland
			}
		}
		else = {
			clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_off_mainland
		}
		NAM_rtw_expire_offers = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_rtw_offer_pending = no
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_dictate_cooldown }
				check_variable = { NAM_rtw_dictate_refusals < 2 }
				NAM_rtw_decider_available = yes
				OR = {
					NAM_rtw_dictate_threshold_met = yes
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = {
							flag = NAM_rtw_at_war
							days > 90
						}
						has_country_flag = {
							flag = NAM_rtw_off_mainland
							days > 59
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = NAM_rtw_dictate_pending
			NAM_rtw_pick_decider = yes
			event_target:NAM_rtw_decider = {
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.158 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from event 164 a (temp NAM_rtw_terms 1) or b (2). A lost pause:
# the Directory pays, the war closes and the renewal waits 360 days. Rifles
# and convoys go to the decider by send_equipment, so only stock NAM holds
# moves; the bankers' indemnity is a debit of the Directory only.
NAM_rtw_dictated_peace = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_rtw_dictate_pending
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
			has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_at_war
			has_global_flag = NAM_rtw_decider_saved
			event_target:NAM_rtw_decider = {
				exists = yes
				has_war_with = NAM
			}
		}
		67 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_administered }
		688 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_administered }
		689 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_administered }
		690 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_administered }
		700 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_administered }
		719 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_rtw_administered }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_ceded_ok value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_terms = 1 } }
			NAM_rtw_cede_island = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_ceded_ok = 1 } }
			send_equipment = {
				equipment = infantry_equipment
				amount = 10000
				target = event_target:NAM_rtw_decider
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_indemnity value = 300 }
			add_timed_idea = {
				idea = NAM_rtw_reparations
				days = 365
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_gain value = -15 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_others_gain value = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_gain value = 0 }
			NAM_board_holders_package = yes
		}
		else = {
			send_equipment = {
				equipment = infantry_equipment
				amount = 20000
				target = event_target:NAM_rtw_decider
			}
			send_equipment = {
				equipment = convoy_1
				amount = 10
				target = event_target:NAM_rtw_decider
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_indemnity value = 500 }
			add_timed_idea = {
				idea = NAM_rtw_reparations
				days = 540
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_gain value = -10 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_others_gain value = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_gain value = 0 }
			NAM_board_holders_package = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = 5 }
			NAM_board_trust_package = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_corp_capital }
		clamp_temp_variable = {
			var = NAM_corp_capital_change
			min = 0
			max = NAM_rtw_indemnity
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -1 }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		NAM_rtw_bonds_default = yes
		NAM_board_cells_close = yes
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = NAM_rtw_dictated_truce
			value = 1
			days = 360
		}
		NAM_rtw_clear_decider = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		NAM_war_of_return_close = yes
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][RTW] Dictated peace on terms [?NAM_rtw_terms]; renewal after 360 days."
	}
	else = {
		NAM_rtw_clear_decider = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_terms value = 0 }
}

# War of return: the council's own accounts (bonds, the boycott measure, the
# restitution of the harbour list and the victory shares of the companies).

# COUNTRY NAM. Victory: every issue of NAM_rtw_bonds costs 150 capital. A treasury
# that cannot pay the whole sum pays nothing; the default spirit and Reidbank's
# loss of trust follow instead. The counter is cleared either way.
NAM_rtw_bonds_repay = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_bonds > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_bonds_due value = NAM_rtw_bonds }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_bonds_due value = 150 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = NAM_rtw_bonds_due compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_rtw_bonds_due }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -1 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_rtw_bond_default days = 180 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = -5 }
			NAM_board_trust_package = yes
		}
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_rtw_bonds
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Dictated peace and route end: the bonds are not repaid. Every
# company loses 3 trust per issue while the council still sits.
NAM_rtw_bonds_default = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_rtw_bonds > 0 }
			NAM_board_operable = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_bonds_cut value = NAM_rtw_bonds }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_bonds_cut value = -3 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = NAM_rtw_bonds_cut }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_2 value = NAM_rtw_bonds_cut }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = NAM_rtw_bonds_cut }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = NAM_rtw_bonds_cut }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = NAM_rtw_bonds_cut }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = NAM_rtw_bonds_cut }
		NAM_board_trust_package = yes
		add_stability = -0.05
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_rtw_bonds
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Victory with NAM_rtw_left_behind_registry: the evacuated return to
# the harbour and the society track gains the 100 progress the focus promised;
# the monthly development tick raises the level when the progress allows.
NAM_rtw_settle_restitution = {
	add_manpower = 10000
	ADISCORD_initialize_society_development_variables = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_society_development_progress value = 100 }
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Victory: the companies' trust follows the form of rule chosen by
# the centre pair (NAM_rtw_direct_rule). Holders' districts reward both partition
# holders; the council's direct rule rewards the chair and costs the holders
# their concessions.
NAM_rtw_victory_trust = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_rtw_direct_rule = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_gain value = -12 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_others_gain value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_gain value = 10 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_gain value = 10 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_others_gain value = -3 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_gain value = 0 }
	}
	NAM_board_holders_package = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Leaves the lowest-numbered boycotting company (stance -1) in
# NAM_rtw_boycott_target, or 0. The measure and event 165 read it; every answer
# of 165 clears it.
NAM_rtw_find_boycott = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_boycott_target value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^1 value = -1 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_boycott_target value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^2 value = -1 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_boycott_target value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^3 value = -1 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_boycott_target value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^4 value = -1 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_boycott_target value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^5 value = -1 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_boycott_target value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^6 value = -1 compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_boycott_target value = 6 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_rtw_boycott_delta. Changes the trust of the company
# in NAM_rtw_boycott_target and recounts once.
NAM_rtw_boycott_trust = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_boycott_target > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_rtw_boycott_target }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_rtw_boycott_delta }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		NAM_board_recount = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The measure of NAM_rtw_boycott_measure after its price is paid.
# Under emergency powers the council requisitions the company's depots (twice per
# war at most); otherwise it buys the company back. Event 165 is its answer.
NAM_rtw_boycott_apply = {
	NAM_rtw_find_boycott = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_boycott_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_rtw_direct_rule = yes }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 6000
				producer = NAM
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = -2 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_2 value = -2 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = -2 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = -2 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = -2 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = -2 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_boycott_target = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = -15 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_boycott_target = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_2 value = -15 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_boycott_target = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = -15 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_boycott_target = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = -15 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_boycott_target = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = -15 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = -15 }
			}
			NAM_board_trust_package = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_requisitions value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_boycott_delta value = 15 }
			NAM_rtw_boycott_trust = yes
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.165 }
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: invasion preparation -----
# Programmes 1-9 of the category NAM_board_invasion keep their runs, paid receipts
# and caps in NAM_board_inv_runs, NAM_board_inv_running and NAM_board_inv_cap
# (index = programme). Caps only grow through NAM_board_inv_cap_add, so the order of
# rewards never overwrites a bonus. The targeted programmes 1 and 4 share one receipt
# per programme; the receipt blocks a second target until the first run settles.

# COUNTRY NAM. Inputs: temp NAM_board_inv_k (programme 1-9) and
# NAM_board_inv_cap_change (signed). Keeps the cap within 0-6 (arsenal 0-7, marines 0-4)
# and never below the runs already made. The arsenal ceiling leaves room for event 100 c
# on top of the open-tenders route (base 4, tenders +2).
NAM_board_inv_cap_add = {
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_cap^NAM_board_inv_k value = NAM_board_inv_cap_change }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_cap_max value = 6 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_inv_k = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_cap_max value = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_inv_k = 7 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_cap_max value = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_cap^NAM_board_inv_k value = NAM_board_inv_cap_max compare = greater_than } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_cap^NAM_board_inv_k value = NAM_board_inv_cap_max }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_cap^NAM_board_inv_k value = NAM_board_inv_runs^NAM_board_inv_k compare = less_than } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_cap^NAM_board_inv_k value = NAM_board_inv_runs^NAM_board_inv_k }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_cap_change value = 0 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Inputs: temp NAM_board_holders_gain (both partition holders),
# NAM_board_others_gain (the four other companies) and the optional
# NAM_board_chair_gain (added once to the chairing company; unset reads 0). The
# holders are the companies frozen by partition_night, not the current ranks.
# Writes the six trust inputs itself, so a caller must not set them beforehand, and
# applies them as one package with one recount.
NAM_board_holders_package = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_value value = NAM_board_holders_gain }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_others_value value = NAM_board_others_gain }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_value value = NAM_board_chair_gain }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holders_gain value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_others_gain value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair_gain value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = NAM_board_others_value }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_2 value = NAM_board_others_value }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = NAM_board_others_value }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = NAM_board_others_value }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = NAM_board_others_value }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = NAM_board_others_value }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_efl = 1 }
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_azh = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = NAM_board_holders_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_efl = 2 }
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_azh = 2 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_2 value = NAM_board_holders_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_efl = 3 }
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_azh = 3 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = NAM_board_holders_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_efl = 4 }
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_azh = 4 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = NAM_board_holders_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_efl = 5 }
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_azh = 5 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = NAM_board_holders_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_efl = 6 }
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_azh = 6 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = NAM_board_holders_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_chair = 1 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = NAM_board_chair_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_chair = 2 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_2 value = NAM_board_chair_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_chair = 3 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = NAM_board_chair_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_chair = 4 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = NAM_board_chair_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_chair = 5 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = NAM_board_chair_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_chair = 6 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = NAM_board_chair_value }
	}
	NAM_board_trust_package = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Inputs: temp NAM_board_build_kind (1 war plant, 2 synthetic refinery,
# 3 dockyard, 4 civilian factory converted to a war plant) and NAM_board_build_pref
# (state id). Builds in the preferred island state, else in the first held island of
# the fixed order 228, 227, 225, 231, 226, 229, 230 that can take the building.
# Output: temp NAM_board_site_built (1 built, 0 not); the caller then pays its
# fallback through NAM_board_pay_site_fallback.
NAM_board_build_on_island = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_site_built value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_build_try value = NAM_board_build_pref }
	NAM_board_build_try_state = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_site_built = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_build_try value = 228 }
		NAM_board_build_try_state = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_site_built = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_build_try value = 227 }
		NAM_board_build_try_state = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_site_built = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_build_try value = 225 }
		NAM_board_build_try_state = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_site_built = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_build_try value = 231 }
		NAM_board_build_try_state = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_site_built = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_build_try value = 226 }
		NAM_board_build_try_state = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_site_built = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_build_try value = 229 }
		NAM_board_build_try_state = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_site_built = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_build_try value = 230 }
		NAM_board_build_try_state = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. One attempt of NAM_board_build_on_island on the island state named by
# temp NAM_board_build_try.
NAM_board_build_try_state = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_board_build_try = 225 }
			225 = { NAM_board_inv_build_site = yes }
		}
		225 = { NAM_board_build_kind_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_site_built value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_board_build_try = 226 }
			226 = { NAM_board_inv_build_site = yes }
		}
		226 = { NAM_board_build_kind_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_site_built value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_board_build_try = 227 }
			227 = { NAM_board_inv_build_site = yes }
		}
		227 = { NAM_board_build_kind_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_site_built value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_board_build_try = 228 }
			228 = { NAM_board_inv_build_site = yes }
		}
		228 = { NAM_board_build_kind_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_site_built value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_board_build_try = 229 }
			229 = { NAM_board_inv_build_site = yes }
		}
		229 = { NAM_board_build_kind_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_site_built value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_board_build_try = 230 }
			230 = { NAM_board_inv_build_site = yes }
		}
		230 = { NAM_board_build_kind_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_site_built value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_board_build_try = 231 }
			231 = { NAM_board_inv_build_site = yes }
		}
		231 = { NAM_board_build_kind_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_site_built value = 1 }
	}
}

# STATE. Builds the kind named by temp NAM_board_build_kind.
NAM_board_build_kind_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_build_kind = 1 } }
		NAM_board_build_war_plant = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_build_kind = 2 } }
		NAM_board_build_refinery = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_build_kind = 3 } }
		NAM_board_build_company_docks = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_build_kind = 4 } }
		NAM_board_convert_plant = yes
	}
}

# STATE. A war plant brings its own shared slot when the state has no free one.
NAM_board_build_war_plant = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 include_locked = yes } }
		}
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
	}
	add_building_construction = {
		type = arms_factory
		level = 1
		instant_build = yes
	}
}

# STATE. The site trigger NAM_board_inv_refinery_site keeps at most three refineries.
NAM_board_build_refinery = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { free_building_slots = { building = synthetic_refinery size > 0 include_locked = yes } }
		}
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
	}
	add_building_construction = {
		type = synthetic_refinery
		level = 1
		instant_build = yes
	}
}

# STATE. Converts one civilian factory into a war plant in the slot it frees.
NAM_board_convert_plant = {
	remove_building = {
		type = industrial_complex
		level = 1
	}
	add_building_construction = {
		type = arms_factory
		level = 1
		instant_build = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. A supply hub in the main port of the capital's island state, if the
# council holds it and the port has none. Output: temp NAM_board_site_built.
NAM_board_build_supply_hub = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_site_built value = 0 }

# COUNTRY NAM. One "Island Marines" division at the capital, at 35% experience once
# storm_companies is completed, otherwise 20%. Used by the marine programme and by
# the focus rewards that grant a division.
NAM_board_raise_marine_division = {
	NAM_marine_ensure_template = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_storm_companies }
		capital_scope = {
			create_unit = {
				division = "division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.35 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
				owner = NAM
				allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		capital_scope = {
			create_unit = {
				division = "division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.20 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
				owner = NAM
				allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
			}
		}
	}
}

}

# The share pays in the stored company's own product and returns its trust with
# interest; the product block of NAM_board_product_blocked_<k> ends with the receipt.
NAM_board_inv_settle_9 = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_inv_expedition_share_result_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_inv_share_target = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_open_fuel_reserve value = 6000 }
			NAM_open_fuel_release = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_inv_share_target = 2 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 4500
				producer = NAM
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_inv_share_target = 3 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = convoy_1
				amount = 5
				producer = NAM
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_inv_share_target = 4 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = artillery_equipment_1
				amount = 36
				producer = NAM
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment
				amount = 96
				producer = NAM
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_inv_share_target = 5 } }
			add_manpower = 2500
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_inv_share_target = 6 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 80 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_inv_share_target > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_inv_share_target }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 6 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			NAM_board_recount = yes
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_share_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_running^9 value = 0 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Called by NAM_board_end_operations before NAM_dir_campaigns_close:
# refunds every paid run. The running decisions then cancel through
# NAM_board_operable = no and find no receipt. No target is known here, so the work
# flags of the targeted programmes are cleared on all seven islands.
NAM_board_inv_close = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_running^1 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		NAM_board_inv_refund_1 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_running^2 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		NAM_board_inv_refund_2 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_running^3 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		NAM_board_inv_refund_3 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_running^4 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		NAM_board_inv_refund_4 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_running^5 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		NAM_board_inv_refund_5 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_running^6 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		NAM_board_inv_refund_6 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_running^7 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		NAM_board_inv_refund_7 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_running^8 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		NAM_board_inv_refund_8 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_inv_running^9 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		NAM_board_inv_refund_9 = yes
	}
	225 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_board_inv_work }
	226 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_board_inv_work }
	227 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_board_inv_work }
	228 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_board_inv_work }
	229 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_board_inv_work }
	230 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_board_inv_work }
	231 = { clr_state_flag = NAM_board_inv_work }
}

# ----- Council of boards: island operations -----
# Island index k: 1 Ulven (ULV, capital state 648, landing province 3094,
# states 643-648), 2 Luren (LUR, 651, 3313, states 649-652), 3 Sharden (CHD,
# 680, 3224, states 672-680). NAM_isl_status^k: 0 independent, 1 registered in
# the running island war, 2 annexed, 3 national. One island war runs at a time:
# NAM_isl_op_target names its main target and NAM_isl_pact_member a warned
# strait partner drawn into the same war. Readiness lives on the capital state
# (NAM_isl_readiness) and is kept through the war: the stalled settlement
# halves it, the failed one empties it.
# Commit rule: every terminal path copies both into the temps NAM_isl_settle_k
# and NAM_isl_settle_member, writes the statuses and clears NAM_isl_op_target
# before the first white_peace or annex_country, so the peace, annexation and
# subjugation callbacks these raise find no open war. NAM_isl_release runs last.

# COUNTRY NAM; FROM is an island capital state.
NAM_isl_k_from_target = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { FROM = { state = 648 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { FROM = { state = 651 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { FROM = { state = 680 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 3 }
	}
}

# STATE island capital; temp NAM_isl_gain.
NAM_isl_add_readiness = {
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_isl_readiness value = NAM_isl_gain }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_isl_readiness
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temps NAM_isl_k and NAM_isl_gain.
NAM_isl_add_readiness_k = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
		648 = { NAM_isl_add_readiness = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
		651 = { NAM_isl_add_readiness = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 3 compare = equals } }
		680 = { NAM_isl_add_readiness = yes }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temps NAM_isl_k and NAM_isl_gain (the focus's readiness).
# Called by the three operation focuses: the island keeps status 0 and its
# readiness starts 10 higher once the companies' fleet is formed.
NAM_isl_open_target = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_private_navy }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_gain value = 10 }
	}
	NAM_isl_add_readiness_k = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temps NAM_isl_rows_k (1-3) and NAM_isl_rows_mode. Runs

NAM_isl_island_rows = {

		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
		643 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		644 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }

		647 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		648 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
		649 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		650 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		651 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		652 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 3 compare = equals } }
		672 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		673 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		674 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		675 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		676 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		677 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		678 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		679 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
		680 = { NAM_isl_state_row = yes }
	}
}

# STATE of an island list; temps NAM_isl_rows_k and NAM_isl_rows_mode:
# 1 pacification, 2-4 answers a-c of event 129, 5 transfer of remnants after
# the annexation, 6 nationalisation. After the southern promise Sharden's four
# southern states keep CHD's core and receive none from Svetlogorye.
NAM_isl_state_row = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 5 compare = equals }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM }
				owner = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_participant }
			}
			NAM = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
			set_state_controller_to = NAM
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 1 compare = equals } }
			add_resistance = -15
			add_compliance = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 2 compare = equals } }
			add_resistance = -15
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 3 compare = equals } }
			add_resistance = -20
			add_compliance = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 4 compare = equals } }
			add_resistance = -10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 6 compare = equals } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 3 compare = equals } }
						NOT = { NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_sharden_promise_done } }
						NOT = {
							OR = {
								state = 672
								state = 677
								state = 678
								state = 679
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add_core_of = NAM
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
					remove_core_of = ULV
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
					remove_core_of = LUR
				}
				else = {
					remove_core_of = CHD
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_controlled_by = NAM
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				cancel_resistance = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_isl_k. Pacification of every state of the island.

	NAM_isl_island_rows = yes

# COUNTRY island government. Woken from minor suppression and freed from any
# faction before the declaration, so no outside ally is drawn into the war.
NAM_isl_register_target = {
	ADISCORD_release_non_participating_minor_optimization = yes
	set_country_flag = NAM_isl_participant
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
		leave_faction = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY island government, once per war: spec D5's reserves. ULV and LUR
# receive 6000 men, 4000 rifles and two territorial brigades (three above
# normal difficulty); CHD 15000 men, 10000 rifles, 120 support equipment, four
# brigades (six) and coastal forts at its two harbours. A bribed garrison
# brings one brigade fewer, the southern promise two; a warned strait island
# fortifies its capital beach unless the fire squadron shells it, a warned
# Sharden musters one more brigade. Units given in an earlier war stay.
NAM_isl_reinforce_defender = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_defence_mobilised } }
		set_country_flag = NAM_isl_defence_mobilised
		if = {
			limit = { tag = CHD }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_brigades value = 4 }
			add_manpower = 15000
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 10000
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = support_equipment
				amount = 120
			}
			680 = {
				add_building_construction = {
					type = coastal_bunker
					level = 2
					instant_build = yes
					province = 1610
				}
			}
			672 = {
				add_building_construction = {
					type = coastal_bunker
					level = 2
					instant_build = yes
					province = 1858
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { difficulty > 2 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_brigades value = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NAM = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_sharden_promise_done } }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_brigades value = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_alerted }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_brigades value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { 680 = { has_state_flag = NAM_isl_bribed } }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_brigades value = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_brigades value = 2 }
			add_manpower = 6000
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 4000
			}
			if = {
				limit = { difficulty > 2 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_brigades value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							tag = ULV
							648 = { has_state_flag = NAM_isl_bribed }
						}
						AND = {
							tag = LUR
							651 = { has_state_flag = NAM_isl_bribed }
						}
					}
				}
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_brigades value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = NAM_isl_alerted
					NOT = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_fire_squadron } }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { tag = ULV }
					648 = {
						add_building_construction = {
							type = coastal_bunker
							level = 1
							instant_build = yes
							province = 6452
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					651 = {
						add_building_construction = {
							type = coastal_bunker
							level = 1
							instant_build = yes
							province = 1894
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_raised value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_template = "Territorial Brigade" }
			while_loop_effect = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_raised value = NAM_isl_brigades compare = less_than } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_raised value = 1 }
				capital_scope = {
					create_unit = {
						division = "division_template = \"Territorial Brigade\" start_experience_factor = 0.10 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
						owner = PREV
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temps NAM_isl_k and NAM_isl_wave. Marine divisions on island k's
# landing province (30% experience, 35% after the storm companies).
NAM_isl_land_wave = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_landed value = 0 }

		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_landed value = NAM_isl_wave compare = less_than } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_landed value = 1 }

			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 1 compare = equals } }

						owner = NAM

						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
				}
				else = {
					create_unit = {
						division = "division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.30 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
						owner = NAM
						prioritize_location = 3094
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
			651 = {
				if = {
					limit = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_storm_companies } }
					create_unit = {
						division = "division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.35 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
						owner = NAM
						prioritize_location = 3313
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
				}
				else = {
					create_unit = {
						division = "division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.30 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
						owner = NAM
						prioritize_location = 3313
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 3 compare = equals } }
			680 = {
				if = {
					limit = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_storm_companies } }
					create_unit = {
						division = "division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.35 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
						owner = NAM
						prioritize_location = 3224
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
				}
				else = {
					create_unit = {
						division = "division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.30 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
						owner = NAM
						prioritize_location = 3224
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_isl_k. create_unit refuses a province held by the

				limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_participant }
			}
		}

# COUNTRY NAM. The pending second echelon returns its men and rifles: one
# division for Ulven or Luren, two for Sharden.
NAM_isl_echelon_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_echelon_k value = 3 compare = equals } }
		add_manpower = 8600
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = infantry_equipment
			amount = 7740
			producer = NAM
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_echelon_k value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		add_manpower = 4300
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = infantry_equipment
			amount = 3870
			producer = NAM
		}
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_echelon_k value = 0 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM, hidden event 132 ten days after a landing. The echelon lands
# only on the beachhead of the war it was paid for; a newer landing's echelon
# waits for its own day.
NAM_isl_second_echelon = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_echelon_k value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_echelon_day value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = NAM_isl_echelon_k }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = NAM_isl_echelon_k compare = equals }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 1 compare = equals }
						controls_province = 3094
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 2 compare = equals }
						controls_province = 3313
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 3 compare = equals }
						controls_province = 3224
					}
				}
			}
			NAM_marine_ensure_template = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_wave value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 3 compare = equals } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_wave value = 2 }
			}
			NAM_isl_land_wave = yes
			set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_echelon_k value = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			NAM_isl_echelon_refund = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_isl_launch_k. Landing spirit for 60 days: tier 1, 2 or
# 3 at readiness 50, 75 or 100, one tier higher after the fire squadron.
NAM_isl_launch_spirit = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 1 compare = equals }
					648 = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_readiness value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 2 compare = equals }
					651 = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_readiness value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 3 compare = equals }
					680 = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_readiness value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tier value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 1 compare = equals }
					648 = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_readiness value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 2 compare = equals }
					651 = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_readiness value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 3 compare = equals }
					680 = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_readiness value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tier value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_fire_squadron }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tier value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_isl_landing_spirit_1 }
		remove_ideas = NAM_isl_landing_spirit_1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_isl_landing_spirit_2 }
		remove_ideas = NAM_isl_landing_spirit_2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_isl_landing_spirit_3 }
		remove_ideas = NAM_isl_landing_spirit_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tier value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_isl_landing_spirit_3 days = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tier value = 2 compare = equals } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_isl_landing_spirit_2 days = 60 }
	}
	else = {
		add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_isl_landing_spirit_1 days = 60 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; FROM is the target's capital state, temp NAM_isl_k. Called by
# NAM_isl_launch after its price was paid. A warned, peaceful second strait island
# joins as a pact member on the target's side, and then every member must fall
# (campaign major status on both sides). A declaration that does not create
# the war undoes the registration and returns the whole price.
NAM_isl_op_launch = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = NAM_isl_k }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = NAM_isl_launch_k }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^NAM_isl_launch_k value = 1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_capital_hold
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 1 compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 0 compare = equals }
			LUR = { NAM_isl_pact_partner_ready = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 2 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 2 compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 0 compare = equals }
			ULV = { NAM_isl_pact_partner_ready = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 1 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		ULV = { NAM_isl_register_target = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		LUR = { NAM_isl_register_target = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^3 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		CHD = { NAM_isl_register_target = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_reserve_major = yes
		ULV = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_reserve_major = yes }
		LUR = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_reserve_major = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
			ULV = {
				create_faction_from_template = {
					template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
					name = NAM_isl_pact_faction
				}
				set_country_flag = NAM_isl_pact_founder
				add_to_faction = LUR
			}
		}
		else = {
			LUR = {
				create_faction_from_template = {
					template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
					name = NAM_isl_pact_faction
				}
				set_country_flag = NAM_isl_pact_founder
				add_to_faction = ULV
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		ULV = { NAM_isl_reinforce_defender = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		LUR = { NAM_isl_reinforce_defender = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^3 value = 1 compare = equals } }
		CHD = { NAM_isl_reinforce_defender = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
		declare_war_on = {
			target = ULV
			type = annex_everything
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 2 compare = equals }
				NOT = { has_war_with = LUR }
			}
			LUR = {
				add_to_war = {
					targeted_alliance = ULV
					enemy = NAM
					hostility_reason = asked_to_join
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
		declare_war_on = {
			target = LUR
			type = annex_everything
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 1 compare = equals }
				NOT = { has_war_with = ULV }
			}
			ULV = {
				add_to_war = {
					targeted_alliance = LUR
					enemy = NAM
					hostility_reason = asked_to_join
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		declare_war_on = {
			target = CHD
			type = annex_everything
		}
	}
	# A partner that did not enter the war is not a member of it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 2 compare = equals }
			NOT = { has_war_with = LUR }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 0 }
		LUR = {
			clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_participant
			clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_defence_mobilised
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 1 compare = equals }
			NOT = { has_war_with = ULV }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 0 }
		ULV = {
			clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_participant
			clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_defence_mobilised
			ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 1 compare = equals }
					NOT = { has_war_with = ULV }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 2 compare = equals }
					NOT = { has_war_with = LUR }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 3 compare = equals }
					NOT = { has_war_with = CHD }
				}
			}
		}
		NAM_isl_launch_abort = yes
	}
	else = {
		NAM_isl_launch_spirit = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = NAM_isl_launch_k }
		NAM_isl_land_first_wave = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_launch_k value = 3 compare = equals } }
			activate_mission = NAM_isl_beachhead_sharden
		}
		else = {
			activate_mission = NAM_isl_beachhead_strait
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_echelon_k value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
			NAM_isl_echelon_refund = yes
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_echelon_k value = NAM_isl_launch_k }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_echelon_day value = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_isl_echelon_day value = 10 }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.132 days = 10 }
		# The flagship's flag (fire_only_once) is chosen at the first launch,
		# before any island concession tender reads it.
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.101 days = 1 }
		FROM = { clr_state_flag = NAM_isl_bribed }
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][ISLANDS] Landing on island [?NAM_isl_launch_k], pact member [?NAM_isl_pact_member], spirit tier [?NAM_isl_tier]."
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The declaration did not create the war: the registration is
# undone without a settlement and the launch price comes back in full.
NAM_isl_launch_abort = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = NAM_isl_op_target }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_member value = NAM_isl_pact_member }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^NAM_isl_settle_k value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_member value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^NAM_isl_settle_member value = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = 3 compare = equals } }
		add_political_power = 40
		add_manpower = 21500
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = infantry_equipment
			amount = 19350
			producer = NAM
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_political_power = 25
		add_manpower = 12900
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = infantry_equipment
			amount = 11610
			producer = NAM
		}
	}
	NAM_isl_release = yes
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][ISLANDS] Landing on island [?NAM_isl_settle_k] found no war; price returned."
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_isl_rows_k. White peace with island k's government.
NAM_isl_peace_k = {

			has_war_with = LUR
		}
		white_peace = LUR
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 3 compare = equals }
			country_exists = CHD
			has_war_with = CHD
		}
		white_peace = CHD
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_isl_rows_k. Peace and annexation of island k; states of
# its explicit list still held by its government follow, and every owned one
# returns to Svetlogorye's control. Sharden's hunger ends with its government.
NAM_isl_annex_island = {
	NAM_isl_peace_k = yes

		limit = {

			country_exists = ULV
		}
		annex_country = {
			target = ULV
			transfer_troops = no
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 2 compare = equals }
			country_exists = LUR
		}
		annex_country = {
			target = LUR
			transfer_troops = no
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 3 compare = equals }
			country_exists = CHD
		}
		CHD = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = NAM_isl_sharden_hunger }
				remove_ideas = NAM_isl_sharden_hunger
			}
		}
		annex_country = {
			target = CHD
			transfer_troops = no
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 5 }
	NAM_isl_island_rows = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_isl_rows_k. A stalled landing on island k: half the
# readiness stays, a new landing waits 90 days and the island is warned.
NAM_isl_stall_island = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
		648 = {
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_isl_readiness value = 0.5 }
			round_variable = NAM_isl_readiness
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_reopen_1 days = 90 value = 1 }
		ULV = { set_country_flag = NAM_isl_alerted }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
		651 = {
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_isl_readiness value = 0.5 }
			round_variable = NAM_isl_readiness
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_reopen_2 days = 90 value = 1 }
		LUR = { set_country_flag = NAM_isl_alerted }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 3 compare = equals } }
		680 = {
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_isl_readiness value = 0.5 }
			round_variable = NAM_isl_readiness
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_reopen_3 days = 90 value = 1 }
		CHD = { set_country_flag = NAM_isl_alerted }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temps NAM_isl_settle_k and NAM_isl_bidder_loss (negative).
# Navis, whose pilots led the crossing, and the island's two tender bidders
# carry the loss; Navis counts once when it is a bidder.
NAM_isl_blame_bidders = {

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = 1 compare = equals } }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = NAM_isl_bidder_loss }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = NAM_isl_bidder_loss }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = NAM_isl_bidder_loss }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = NAM_isl_bidder_loss }
	}
	NAM_board_trust_package = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Victory: every annexed island becomes the Directory's, its tender
# follows the next day. Temp NAM_isl_member_stalled = 1 when a pact partner's
# capital held out: the partner is settled as stalled inside the victory.
NAM_isl_settle_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = NAM_isl_op_target }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_member value = NAM_isl_pact_member }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^NAM_isl_settle_k value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_member value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_member_stalled value = 1 compare = equals } }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^NAM_isl_settle_member value = 0 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^NAM_isl_settle_member value = 2 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_last_target value = NAM_isl_settle_k }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_member value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_member_stalled value = 1 compare = equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = NAM_isl_settle_member }
			NAM_isl_peace_k = yes
			NAM_isl_stall_island = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = NAM_isl_settle_k }
		NAM_isl_annex_island = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_member value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_member_stalled value = 1 compare = equals } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = NAM_isl_settle_member }
			NAM_isl_annex_island = yes
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_insured
		add_stability = 0.03
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = 1 compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 0 compare = equals }
				country_exists = LUR
			}
			LUR = { set_country_flag = NAM_isl_alerted }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = 2 compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 0 compare = equals }
				country_exists = ULV
			}
			ULV = { set_country_flag = NAM_isl_alerted }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 2 compare = equals } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = 1 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_member value = 1 compare = equals }
					}
				}
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.125 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 2 compare = equals } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = 2 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_member value = 2 compare = equals }
					}
				}
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.126 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = 3 compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^3 value = 2 compare = equals }
			}
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.127 days = 1 }
		}
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][ISLANDS] Victory on island [?NAM_isl_settle_k], pact member [?NAM_isl_settle_member], member stalled [?NAM_isl_member_stalled]."
		NAM_isl_release = yes
	}
}

NAM_isl_settle_stalled = {
	if = {

		}

	}
