# COUNTRY island government; from NAM_isl_release.
NAM_isl_release_target = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_participant }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_participant
		clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_defence_mobilised
		ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_pact_founder }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_pact_founder
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				is_faction_leader = yes
			}
			dismantle_faction = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Last step of every terminal path: island missions, the
# campaign's major status, the strait pact and the war flags of every
# registered island.
NAM_isl_release = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_isl_beachhead_strait }
		remove_mission = NAM_isl_beachhead_strait
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_isl_beachhead_sharden }
		remove_mission = NAM_isl_beachhead_sharden
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_isl_campaign_strait }
		remove_mission = NAM_isl_campaign_strait
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_isl_campaign_sharden }
		remove_mission = NAM_isl_campaign_sharden
	}
	clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_capital_hold
	ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes
	ULV = { NAM_isl_release_target = yes }
	LUR = { NAM_isl_release_target = yes }
	CHD = { NAM_isl_release_target = yes }
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_isl_rows_k. An island left by a war that ended outside
# the settlements is the Directory's when it owns the capital state.
NAM_isl_status_by_capital = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
		if = {
			limit = { owns_state = 648 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
		if = {
			limit = { owns_state = 651 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 3 compare = equals } }
		if = {
			limit = { owns_state = 680 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^3 value = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^3 value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope; from on_peace, on_annex and on_puppet. An island war that another
# hand ended closes without awards or penalties. A strait partner that left
# the war alone is released while the main target fights on.
NAM_isl_close_external = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_isl_op_running = yes
			NAM_isl_war_interrupted = yes
		}
		NAM = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_k value = NAM_isl_op_target }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_member value = NAM_isl_pact_member }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = NAM_isl_settle_k }
			NAM_isl_status_by_capital = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_settle_member value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = NAM_isl_settle_member }
				NAM_isl_status_by_capital = yes
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = 0 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 0 }
			log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][ISLANDS] Island war [?NAM_isl_settle_k] closed outside the settlements."
			NAM_isl_release = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_isl_op_running = yes
			NAM_isl_member_interrupted = yes
		}
		NAM = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = NAM_isl_pact_member }
			NAM_isl_status_by_capital = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
				ULV = {
					clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_participant
					clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_defence_mobilised
					ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				LUR = {
					clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_participant
					clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_defence_mobilised
					ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_release_major = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_pact_member value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Native ROOT of a capitulation, FROM the credited victor; called inside both
# nam: capitulation hooks after the Veyran call. A registered island beaten by
# Svetlogorye or its subject keeps a two-day receipt and settles once every
# registered island has fallen; Svetlogorye falling to an island government
# is a failed landing. The receipt of either direction reserves the late
# callback from the generic annexation fallback (the nam: block sets
# skip_default_capitulation from it), so the ZZ handler never annexes the
# Directory or a target; the immediate callback leaves the global flag alone,
# because white peace can omit the late callback that would clear it.
NAM_isl_record_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { NAM_isl_target_beaten = yes } }
		ROOT = { set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_capitulation_reserved value = 1 days = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_isl_all_defeated = yes }
			NAM = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_member_stalled value = 0 }
				NAM_isl_settle_victory = yes
			}
			ROOT = { set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_capitulation_reserved value = 1 days = 2 } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { NAM_isl_directory_beaten = yes } }
		ROOT = { set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_capitulation_reserved value = 1 days = 2 } }
		NAM = { NAM_isl_settle_failed = yes }
		# The settlement can consume the receipt through a synchronous callback.
		ROOT = { set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_capitulation_reserved value = 1 days = 2 } }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; timeout of the beachhead mission. A foothold opens the campaign
# mission; none is a failed landing.
NAM_isl_beachhead_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_isl_any_foothold = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = 3 compare = equals } }
				activate_mission = NAM_isl_campaign_sharden
			}
			else = {
				activate_mission = NAM_isl_campaign_strait
			}
		}
		else = {
			NAM_isl_settle_failed = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; timeout of the campaign mission. Every registered capital state
# held is a victory; the main target's capital alone annexes it and settles
# the pact partner as stalled; a foothold alone is a stalled landing; nothing
# is a failed one.
NAM_isl_campaign_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_isl_capitals_held = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_member_stalled value = 0 }
			NAM_isl_settle_victory = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NAM_isl_main_capital_held = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_member_stalled value = 1 }
			NAM_isl_settle_victory = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NAM_isl_any_foothold = yes }
			NAM_isl_settle_stalled = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM_isl_settle_failed = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; from NAM_corp_monthly after its main NAM_corp_capital_add.
# Concession dividends join the council's income report; an annexed island
# whose capital resists above 50% raises event 129 at most once per 90 days and
# never while another is open; an island war is won by holding every
# registered capital state through two consecutive pulses.
NAM_isl_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_board_operable = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_dividend value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 1 compare = greater_than } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^1 value = 3 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^1 value = 2 compare = equals }
					}
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_dividend value = 10 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 1 compare = greater_than } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^2 value = 1 compare = equals } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_dividend value = 8 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^2 value = 5 compare = equals } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_dividend value = 12 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^3 value = 1 compare = greater_than } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^3 value = 4 compare = equals } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_sharden_promise_done }
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_dividend value = 3 }
				}
				else = {
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_dividend value = 6 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^3 value = 6 compare = equals } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_sharden_promise_done }
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_dividend value = 8 }
				}
				else = {
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_dividend value = 15 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_dividend value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_isl_dividend }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_corp_last_income value = NAM_isl_dividend }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_flare_target value = 0 compare = equals } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^1 value = 2 compare = equals }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_flare_1 }
					648 = { resistance > 50 }
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_flare_target value = 1 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_flare_1 days = 90 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.129 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^2 value = 2 compare = equals }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_flare_2 }
					651 = { resistance > 50 }
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_flare_target value = 2 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_flare_2 days = 90 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.129 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^3 value = 2 compare = equals }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_flare_3 }
					680 = { resistance > 50 }
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_flare_target value = 3 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_flare_3 days = 90 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.129 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_isl_capitals_held = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_capital_hold }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_member_stalled value = 0 }
					NAM_isl_settle_victory = yes
				}
				else = {
					set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_isl_capital_hold days = 40 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_capital_hold
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_isl_flare_answer 1-3, from the answers of event 129.
# The island named by NAM_isl_flare_target: martial law, money for the elders
# or the operator's guards; every answer closes the event's island record.
NAM_isl_flare_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_flare_target value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = NAM_isl_flare_target }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_flare_answer value = 2 compare = equals } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_flare_answer value = 3 compare = equals } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^NAM_isl_flare_target value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_isl_owner^NAM_isl_flare_target }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 4 }
				NAM_board_support_change = yes
				NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -30 }
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			}
		}
		NAM_isl_island_rows = yes
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_flare_target value = 0 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temps NAM_isl_k and NAM_board_company_input (the winner), from
# answers b and c of events 125-127. The concession, its votes and dividend go
# to the winner; with the chair's flag on the flagship the chair's company
# gains 20 instead of 15.
NAM_isl_tender_award = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tender_winner value = NAM_board_company_input }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^NAM_isl_k value = NAM_isl_tender_winner }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tender_loser value = 5 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
		set_country_flag = NAM_isl_tender_done_1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tender_loser value = 6 }
		set_country_flag = NAM_isl_tender_done_2
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tender_loser value = 10 }
		set_country_flag = NAM_isl_tender_done_3
	}
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_tender_loser value = NAM_isl_tender_winner }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 15 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_expedition_flag value = 2 compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair value = NAM_isl_tender_winner compare = equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 20 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_isl_tender_winner }
	NAM_board_support_change = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_isl_tender_loser }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -15 }
	NAM_board_support_change = yes
	NAM_board_recount = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM; temp NAM_isl_k, from answer a of events 125-127. Both bidders
# lose 5 unless the council's flag flies on the flagship; the tender returns
# in 90 days while the island is held and has no operator.
NAM_isl_tender_postpone = {

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = -5 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_2 value = -5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = -5 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = -5 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = -5 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = -5 }
		}
		NAM_board_trust_package = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.125 days = 90 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.126 days = 90 }
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.127 days = 90 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM; FROM is the island capital, temp NAM_isl_k. The caller consumed
# the receipt. The island must still be held and its capital calm (resistance
# at most 40), else the paid capital returns. The explicit list becomes
# national territory: national recruitment and the scripted economy's core
# population count it from now on.
NAM_isl_nationalise_finish = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_isl_island_held = yes
			FROM = { NOT = { resistance > 40 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_k value = NAM_isl_k }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_rows_mode value = 6 }
		NAM_isl_island_rows = yes
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_status^NAM_isl_k value = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_isl_owner^NAM_isl_k value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_isl_owner^NAM_isl_k }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 5 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_supply_overseas }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
				648 = {
					add_building_construction = {
						type = naval_base
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
						province = 6452
					}
					add_building_construction = {
						type = supply_node
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
						province = 6452
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
				651 = {
					add_building_construction = {
						type = naval_base
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
						province = 1894
					}
					add_building_construction = {
						type = supply_node
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
						province = 1894
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				680 = {
					add_building_construction = {
						type = naval_base
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
						province = 1610
					}
					add_building_construction = {
						type = supply_node
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
						province = 1610
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# An island cored during the war of return sends its brigade at once.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
				has_completed_focus = NAM_board_operation_poseidon
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 1 compare = equals } }
				NAM_board_poseidon_island_brigade_1 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_k value = 2 compare = equals } }
				NAM_board_poseidon_island_brigade_2 = yes
			}
			else = {
				NAM_board_poseidon_island_brigade_3 = yes
			}
		}
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	}
	else = {
		FROM = { set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_isl_nationalise_paid } }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	}
	FROM = { clear_variable = NAM_isl_nationalise_paid }
}

# COUNTRY NAM; FROM is the island capital. Debits the nationalisation price of
# NAM_isl_from_nationalise_affordable once and keeps the paid capital on the
# capital state for a refund.
NAM_isl_nationalise_pay = {
	if = {
		limit = { FROM = { state = 648 } }
		add_political_power = -70
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_price value = 180 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_isl_operator_discount_1 = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_price value = 120 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { FROM = { state = 651 } }
		add_political_power = -50
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_price value = 120 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_isl_operator_discount_2 = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_price value = 80 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_political_power = -90
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_price value = 250 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_isl_operator_discount_3 = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_price value = 170 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_isl_price }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -1 }
	NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	FROM = {
		set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_nationalise_paid value = NAM_isl_price }
		set_state_flag = NAM_isl_nationalising
	}
}

		NAM_isl_depots_refund = yes
		NAM_isl_bribe_refund = yes

	}
	680 = {
		NAM_isl_soundings_refund = yes
		NAM_isl_depots_refund = yes
		NAM_isl_bribe_refund = yes
		NAM_isl_pacify_refund = yes
		NAM_isl_nationalise_refund = yes
	}
	clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_promise_running
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_blockade_running }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_blockade_running
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 40 }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		add_fuel = 2000
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_isl_insurance_running }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_isl_insurance_running
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 60 }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_isl_op_target value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_quiet value = 1 }
		NAM_isl_settle_stalled = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_isl_quiet value = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_last_target value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_isl_flare_target value = 0 }
}

# ----- Council of boards: the continent -----
# NAM_mainland_directory_focus follows a won war of return on the corporate
# route, in both forms of rule (NAM_rtw_direct_rule). NAM_mdr_begin loads it
# once; NAM_mdr_close is its single exit and runs from NAM_board_end_operations.
# Paid decisions keep their receipt where it belongs: a state flag with its paid
# variables (restitution, nationalisation, rail brigades), a NAM variable of that
# decision, or a desert escrow NAM_mdr_desert_escrow^index. Every refund clears
# its receipt in the same block, so a run is returned at most once.

# COUNTRY NAM. Called from the corporate branch of the won war of return after
# NAM_rtw_settle_victory. The garrison charter kept the prewar disarmed law;
# with the exile over the native mobilisation laws are free until a course
# locks the slot. The form of rule is not copied: readers use NAM_rtw_direct_rule.
NAM_mdr_begin = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = NAM
			has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
			has_global_flag = NAM_wor_exile_war
			has_global_flag = NAM_war_of_return_won
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_mdr_started }
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_mdr_started
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_return_chair value = NAM_board_chair }
		# Display only: the lapse itself reads the age of NAM_mdr_started.
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lapse_day value = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lapse_day value = 540 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lapse_left value = 540 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_metropolitan_garrison_charter }
			remove_ideas = NAM_metropolitan_garrison_charter
		}
		resize_array = {
			array = NAM_mdr_regiments
			size = 7
			value = 0
		}
		resize_array = {
			array = NAM_mdr_leases
			size = 7
			value = 0
		}
		# Lots 4-6 are the mainland lots: wells, smelters, yards.
		resize_array = {
			array = NAM_board_lot_awarded
			size = 7
			value = 0
		}
		resize_array = {
			array = NAM_mdr_desert_escrow
			size = 4
			value = 0
		}
		resize_array = {
			array = NAM_mdr_offer_target
			size = 4
			value = 0
		}
		resize_array = {
			array = NAM_mdr_offer_dispatched
			size = 4
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lot_wells value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lot_smelters value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lot_yards value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_estates_owner value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_restitution_running value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_restitution_runs value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_nat_running value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_rail_running value = 0 }
		load_focus_tree = {
			tree = NAM_mainland_directory_focus
			keep_completed = yes
		}
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][MAINLAND] The council of boards loads the mainland tree."
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from NAM_board_end_operations before NAM_dir_campaigns_close.
# Refunds every running receipt, ends the leases, removes the state modifiers
# and the NAM spirits of the tree and clears its markers. Laws stay: only
# NAM_board_repeal_laws (nam:on_annex) repeals them.
NAM_mdr_close = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_mdr_started }
		67 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		688 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		689 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		690 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		700 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		719 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		240 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		68 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		70 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		692 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		724 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		725 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		726 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		729 = { NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_conquered_states
			NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes
			NAM_mdr_lease_end = yes
			NAM_mdr_remove_state_modifiers = yes
		}
		# NAM receipts of the paid decisions, returned as their cancel_effect does;
		# the decisions' own cancellation then finds no receipt. Political power
		# is never refunded.
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_efl }
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_efl
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 30 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			add_manpower = 6300
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_azh }
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_azh
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 30 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			add_manpower = 6300
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_regiment_company }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 40 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			add_manpower = NAM_mdr_regiment_men
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 4410
				producer = NAM
			}
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_regiment_company
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_regiment_men
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_battalions_paid }
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_battalions_paid
			add_manpower = 7650
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 6885
				producer = NAM
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_veterans_paid }
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_veterans_paid
			add_manpower = 4000
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 3600
				producer = NAM
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_war_shares_paid }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_war_shares_paid }
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_war_shares_paid
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_columns_paid }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_columns_paid }
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_columns_paid
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			add_manpower = 4150
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = motorized_equipment
				amount = 400
				producer = NAM
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_fuel_convoy_paid }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_fuel_convoy_paid }
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_fuel_convoy_paid
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_south_op_paid }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_south_op_paid }
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_south_op_paid
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_south_op_kind
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 1 }
		NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 2 }
		NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 3 }
		NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes
		NAM_mdr_remove_spirits = yes
		clear_array = NAM_mdr_tender_queue
		clr_country_flag = NAM_mdr_council_seat_promised
		clr_country_flag = NAM_mdr_mazar_offer_cooldown
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_estates_owner value = 0 }
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# STATE. The state modifiers of the tree end when the state is lost, cored or
# the route closes.
NAM_mdr_remove_state_modifiers = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_basin_levy } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_basin_levy }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_estate_guards } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_estate_guards }
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the continent - laws -----
# COUNTRY NAM. "Первое собрание на материке": the war's emergency powers end with
# the war; nothing changes under the holders' form.
NAM_mdr_end_martial_rule = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_law_martial_rule }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = NAM_board_law_martial_rule
			add_idea = ADISCORD_internal_security_local_garrisons
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Акт о забвении": the held council or war court gives way to the
# regular tribunals; nothing changes when the default already holds.

		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = NAM_board_law_concession_courts
			add_idea = ADISCORD_justice_regular_tribunals
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the continent - buildings and formations -----
# COUNTRY NAM. One building row of a focus, called inside the caller's
# hidden_effect (the reward tooltip names the building and its fallback).
# Inputs (temp): NAM_mdr_build_kind (1 military factory, 2 civilian factory,
# 3 dockyard, 4 synthetic refinery, 5 fuel silo, 6 infrastructure, 7 supply
# node), NAM_mdr_build_levels (1 or 2), NAM_mdr_build_state_1..3 (state ids in
# order of preference, 0 unused) and NAM_mdr_build_fallback (capital paid when no
# listed state qualifies). The first qualifying state takes every level; the
# shared-slot kinds bring their own slots. The temps are reset afterwards.
NAM_mdr_build = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_done value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_state_1 > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:NAM_mdr_build_state_1 = { NAM_mdr_build_site = yes } }
			var:NAM_mdr_build_state_1 = { NAM_mdr_build_here = yes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_done = 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_state_2 > 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:NAM_mdr_build_state_2 = { NAM_mdr_build_site = yes } }
			var:NAM_mdr_build_state_2 = { NAM_mdr_build_here = yes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_done = 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_state_3 > 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:NAM_mdr_build_state_3 = { NAM_mdr_build_site = yes } }
			var:NAM_mdr_build_state_3 = { NAM_mdr_build_here = yes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_done = 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_fallback > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_build_fallback }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_1 value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_2 value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_3 value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_fallback value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_levels value = 1 }
}

# STATE qualified by NAM_mdr_build_site. Writes temp NAM_mdr_build_done = 1.
NAM_mdr_build_here = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_done value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_kind = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_levels > 1 } }
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
			add_building_construction = {
				type = arms_factory
				level = 2
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			add_building_construction = {
				type = arms_factory
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_kind = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_levels > 1 } }
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
			add_building_construction = {
				type = industrial_complex
				level = 2
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			add_building_construction = {
				type = industrial_complex
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_kind = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_levels > 1 } }
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
			add_building_construction = {
				type = dockyard
				level = 2
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			add_building_construction = {
				type = dockyard
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_kind = 4 } }
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = {
			type = synthetic_refinery
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_kind = 5 } }
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = {
			type = fuel_silo
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_kind = 6 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_levels > 1 } }
			add_building_construction = {
				type = infrastructure
				level = 2
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_building_construction = {
				type = infrastructure
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_build_kind = 7 } }
		NAM_mdr_build_supply_node = yes
	}
}

# STATE. The supply node of kind 7 stands on a railway victory point of the
# state that has no node in map/supply_nodes.txt (supply_node is capped at one
# level per province). The state flag lets NAM_mdr_build_site skip the state
# on a later call, so that call moves on to its next state or fallback.
NAM_mdr_build_supply_node = {
	set_state_flag = NAM_mdr_supply_node_built
	if = {
		limit = { state = 240 }
		add_building_construction = {
			type = supply_node
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
			province = 16722
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 700 }
		add_building_construction = {
			type = supply_node
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
			province = 16881
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state = 729 }

# COUNTRY NAM. "Линия Дамира": bunkers level 2 on two provinces each of Damir
# (240) and the Eastern Uplands (729), where NAM or a company district owns and

	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_kind value = 8 }

			}
		}
	}

			limit = { NAM_mdr_build_site = yes }

# COUNTRY NAM. Fixed templates of the tree, locked while their programmes run.
# Men and rifles from the unit files: field division 7650 men, 6885 rifles;
# company regiment 4900 men, 4410 rifles; armoured column 4150 men, 3735 rifles.
# Each name has one composition, so prices and fallbacks stay exact. A template
# brings the technology of its support company when it is first created.
NAM_mdr_field_division_template = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Directory Field Division" } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_tech = ADISCORD_tech_desert_water_columns } }
			set_technology = {
				ADISCORD_tech_desert_water_columns = 1
				popup = no
			}
		}
		division_template = {
			name = "Directory Field Division"
			template_counter = 3
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			is_locked = yes
			force_allow_recruiting = yes
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 }
				ADISCORD_line_artillery = { x = 2 y = 0 }
				ADISCORD_line_artillery = { x = 2 y = 1 }
			}
			support = {
				engineer = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				recon = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				ADISCORD_desert_support_company = { x = 0 y = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Formation rows of focuses and decisions. Inputs (temp):
# NAM_mdr_unit_kind (1 field division, 2 company regiment, 3 armoured column,
# 4 line brigade, 5 marines, 6 militia of the coast veterans), NAM_mdr_unit_count,
# NAM_mdr_unit_state (state id, 0 for the harbour), NAM_mdr_unit_company (kind 2:
# the company's colours 1-6, 0 none) and NAM_mdr_unit_district (kind 4: 1 Eflor,
# 2 Azhar, 0 none). The unit forms in the state while NAM controls it, else at the
# harbour (16716), else at the capital. Without its template a unit pays its
# template's men instead. The temps are reset afterwards.
NAM_mdr_place_division = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_unit_kind = 1 } }
		NAM_mdr_field_division_template = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_men value = 7650 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_unit_kind = 2 } }
		NAM_mdr_company_regiment_template = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_men value = 4900 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_unit_kind = 3 } }
		NAM_mdr_armoured_column_template = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_men value = 4150 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_unit_kind = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_men value = 6300 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_unit_kind = 5 } }
		NAM_marine_ensure_template = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_men value = 4300 }
	}
	else = {
		NAM_board_militia_ensure_template = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_men value = 4000 }
	}
	clear_global_event_target = NAM_mdr_unit_site
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_sited value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_unit_state > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:NAM_mdr_unit_state = { is_controlled_by = NAM } }
			var:NAM_mdr_unit_state = { save_global_event_target_as = NAM_mdr_unit_site }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_sited value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_unit_sited = 0 }
			controls_province = 16716
		}
		700 = { save_global_event_target_as = NAM_mdr_unit_site }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_sited value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_unit_sited = 0 } }
		capital_scope = { save_global_event_target_as = NAM_mdr_unit_site }
	}
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_unit_count > 0 } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_count value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_mdr_unit_template_ready = yes }
			event_target:NAM_mdr_unit_site = { NAM_mdr_create_unit = yes }
		}
		else = {
			add_manpower = NAM_mdr_unit_men
		}
	}
	clear_global_event_target = NAM_mdr_unit_site
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_state value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_company value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_district value = 0 }
}
