# COUNTRY NAM. Ship rows: temp NAM_mdr_ship_cruiser (0 none, 1 ADISCORD_cruiser_2155,
# 2 ADISCORD_cruiser_2163) and NAM_mdr_ship_escorts (0-3). The ships are launched
# while NAM owns and controls the South Harbour; otherwise each ship pays five
# convoys. The temps are reset afterwards.
NAM_mdr_launch_ships = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			700 = {
				is_owned_by = NAM
				is_controlled_by = NAM
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_ship_cruiser = 1 } }
			create_equipment_variant = {
				name = "ADISCORD_cruiser_2155"
				type = ADISCORD_cruiser_2155
				allow_without_tech = yes
			}
			create_ship = {
				type = ADISCORD_cruiser_2155
				equipment_variant = "ADISCORD_cruiser_2155"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_ship_cruiser = 2 } }
			create_equipment_variant = {
				name = "ADISCORD_cruiser_2163"
				type = ADISCORD_cruiser_2163
				allow_without_tech = yes
			}
			create_ship = {
				type = ADISCORD_cruiser_2163
				equipment_variant = "ADISCORD_cruiser_2163"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_ship_escorts > 0 } }
			create_equipment_variant = {
				name = "ADISCORD_escort_ship_2155"
				type = ADISCORD_escort_ship_2155
				allow_without_tech = yes
			}
			while_loop_effect = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_ship_escorts > 0 } }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_ship_escorts value = 1 }
				create_ship = {
					type = ADISCORD_escort_ship_2155
					equipment_variant = "ADISCORD_escort_ship_2155"
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_ship_convoys value = NAM_mdr_ship_escorts }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_ship_cruiser > 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_ship_convoys value = 1 }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_ship_convoys value = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_ship_convoys > 0 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = convoy_1
				amount = NAM_mdr_ship_convoys
				producer = NAM
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_ship_cruiser value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_ship_escorts value = 0 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Партизаны в жандармы": the partisan divisions disband, their men
# and equipment return to the pools.
NAM_mdr_partisans_disband = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_template = "Mainland Partisans" }
		delete_unit = {
			division_template = "Mainland Partisans"
			disband = yes
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the continent - land, districts and leases -----
# COUNTRY EFL or AZH under the holders' form ("Эфлорская губерния", "Национализация
# скважин"). The district is annexed with its army; its concession ends, so its
# recruits and dividend stop; its land becomes conquered land and its capital
# state is cored at once. The holder's trust is moved by the focus.
NAM_mdr_absorb_district = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			is_subject_of = NAM
			has_country_flag = NAM_federal_district
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_disputed }
			NAM_corp_dispute_clear = yes
		}
		NAM = { remove_from_array = { array = NAM_federal_districts value = PREV } }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_federal_district
		clear_variable = NAM_corp_district_owner
		clear_temp_array = NAM_mdr_absorbed_states
		every_owned_state = {
			add_to_temp_array = { NAM_mdr_absorbed_states = THIS }
		}
		clear_global_event_target = NAM_mdr_absorbed_capital
		capital_scope = { save_global_event_target_as = NAM_mdr_absorbed_capital }
		NAM = {
			annex_country = {
				target = PREV
				transfer_troops = yes
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_mdr_absorbed_states
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
				NAM_wor_take_state = yes
			}
		}
		event_target:NAM_mdr_absorbed_capital = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_owned_by = NAM
					NOT = { is_core_of = NAM }
				}
				add_core_of = NAM
			}
		}
		clear_global_event_target = NAM_mdr_absorbed_capital
		NAM = {
			NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
			ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY EFL or AZH under the holders' form ("Концессия Эфлор", "Нефтяная
# концессия Бассейна"). The charter's dividend x1.5 is read in
# NAM_corp_districts_monthly from the completed focus; this call refreshes the
# accounts at once.
NAM_mdr_charter_district = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_board_federal_subject = yes }
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		NAM = {
			NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
			ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Compliance on the conquered states NAM owns and controls.
# Inputs (temp): NAM_mdr_compliance_add (5 or 10) and NAM_mdr_core_filter (0 all,
# 1 Eflor's land, 2 Azhar's land, 3 the South, 4 Shahrabad's land).
NAM_mdr_conquered_compliance = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_conquered_states
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_mdr_filtered_conquered_state = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_compliance_add > 5 } }
				add_compliance = 10
			}
			else = {
				add_compliance = 5
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_core_filter value = 0 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Resistance on the same states. Inputs (temp): NAM_mdr_resistance_add
# (5 or 10; a negative input lowers resistance by 5) and NAM_mdr_core_filter.
NAM_mdr_conquered_resistance = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_conquered_states
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_mdr_filtered_conquered_state = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_resistance_add > 5 } }
				add_resistance = 10
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_resistance_add < 0 } }
				add_resistance = -5
			}
			else = {
				add_resistance = 5
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_core_filter value = 0 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Бассейновый набор": the levy on Azhar's conquered land.
NAM_mdr_apply_basin_levy = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_conquered_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = NAM
				is_controlled_by = NAM
				is_core_of = AZH
				NOT = { is_core_of = NAM }
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_basin_levy } }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_basin_levy }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Стража поместий": the estate guards on every conquered state.
NAM_mdr_apply_estate_guards = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_conquered_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = NAM
				is_controlled_by = NAM
				NOT = { is_core_of = NAM }
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_estate_guards } }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_estate_guards }
		}
	}
}

# STATE conquered (event 213). Input: temp NAM_mdr_lease_company (1-6). The lease
# pays its rent in NAM_mdr_conquered_monthly and counts in the recount.
NAM_mdr_lease_state = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_lease_owner }
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lease_company > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_owner value = NAM_mdr_lease_company }
		NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_leases^NAM_mdr_lease_company value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_company_guards } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_company_guards }
		}
		NAM = { NAM_board_queue_recount = yes }
	}
}

# STATE. A lost, cored or closed lease returns the land to the council.
NAM_mdr_lease_end = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_lease_owner }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_k value = NAM_mdr_lease_owner }
		NAM = {
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_leases^NAM_mdr_lease_k value = 1 }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = NAM_mdr_leases^NAM_mdr_lease_k
				min = 0
			}
			NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		}
		clear_variable = NAM_mdr_lease_owner
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_company_guards } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_mdr_company_guards }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from NAM_corp_monthly while the council is operable. One bounded
# pass over NAM's own conquered states, no world scan: leases on lost or cored
# land end, the others pay rent (8 capital, 12 on "Материковые акции"; nothing
# while the tenant company boycotts on "Союз правлений"); the state modifiers of
# the tree leave land that is lost or cored.
NAM_mdr_conquered_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_mdr_started }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_rent value = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_conquered_states
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM }
						NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM }
						is_core_of = NAM
					}
				}
				NAM_mdr_lease_end = yes
				NAM_mdr_remove_state_modifiers = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_lease_owner }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_k value = NAM_mdr_lease_owner }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							NAM = {
								has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_union_of_boards
								check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_mdr_lease_k value = -1 compare = equals }
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_mainland_shares } }
						add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_rent value = 12 }
					}
					else = {
						add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_rent value = 8 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lease_rent > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_lease_rent }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, inside NAM_board_recount after the belt rows (temp array
# NAM_board_holdings, one holding = two votes). On "Союз правлений" every
# mainland holding is worth one more vote: a district concession, an awarded
# mainland lot, an estate. Leases give one vote per two leases, one per lease on
# the union. The two estates of "Выморочное наследство" are a holding each.
NAM_mdr_count_holdings = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_mdr_started }
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_union_of_boards }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = NAM_federal_districts
				if = {
					limit = { NAM_board_current_concession = yes }
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_corp_district_owner value = 0.5 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lot_wells > 0 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_mdr_lot_wells value = 0.5 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lot_smelters > 0 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_mdr_lot_smelters value = 0.5 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_lot_yards > 0 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_mdr_lot_yards value = 0.5 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_k value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 7
			value = NAM_mdr_loop_step
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_k value = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_votes value = NAM_mdr_leases^NAM_mdr_lease_k }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_union_of_boards } }
				# Whole votes only: 1 lease 0, 2-3 leases 1, 4-5 leases 2.
				multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_votes value = 0.5 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_votes value = 0.25 }
				round_temp_variable = NAM_mdr_lease_votes
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_votes min = 0 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lease_votes value = 0.5 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_mdr_lease_k value = NAM_mdr_lease_votes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_estates_owner > 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_mdr_estates_owner value = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_union_of_boards }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_mdr_estates_owner value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Выморочное наследство": the two estates go to the company that
# chairs today; event 201 c sells them to the first company by votes instead
# (temp NAM_mdr_estates_to_rank_1 = 1).
NAM_mdr_grant_estates = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_estates_to_rank_1 = 1 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_estates_owner value = NAM_board_rank_1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_estates_owner value = NAM_board_chair }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_estates_to_rank_1 value = 0 }
	NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
}

# ----- Council of boards: the continent - tenders -----
# COUNTRY district (KDR, SDR, RHM, MZR or any other). Queues the district for the
# owner's tender (event 212). Called by NAM_wor_federal_district_join on the
# corporate route once the mainland tree has started; a treaty district has its
# own tender (event 210) and sets temp NAM_mdr_skip_tender_queue = 1 first.
NAM_mdr_queue_district_tender = {
	NAM = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_queue_size value = NAM_mdr_tender_queue^num }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = NAM_mdr_tender_queue value = PREV } } }
			add_to_array = { array = NAM_mdr_tender_queue value = PREV }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_queue_size = 0 } }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.212 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, first row of event 212. Drops entries that are no longer the
# Directory's districts and saves the first one as event target
# NAM_mdr_tender_district (none when the queue is empty).
NAM_mdr_tender_queue_front = {
	clear_global_event_target = NAM_mdr_tender_district
	clear_temp_array = NAM_mdr_tender_keep
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_mdr_tender_queue
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_board_federal_subject = yes }
			add_to_temp_array = { NAM_mdr_tender_keep = THIS }
		}
	}
	clear_array = NAM_mdr_tender_queue
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_tender_found value = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_mdr_tender_keep
		NAM = { add_to_array = { array = NAM_mdr_tender_queue value = PREV } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_tender_found = 0 } }
			save_global_event_target_as = NAM_mdr_tender_district
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_tender_found value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, last row of every answer of event 212: the first entry leaves the
# queue and the event fires again one day later while entries remain.
NAM_mdr_tender_queue_pop = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_tender_queue^num > 0 } }
		remove_from_array = {
			array = NAM_mdr_tender_queue
			index = 0
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_tender_queue^num > 0 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.212 days = 1 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY district, answers of events 210 and 212. Inputs (temp):
# NAM_mdr_tender_winner and NAM_mdr_tender_loser (companies 1-6; loser 0 when
# the answer keeps the rotation owner). Winner +8, loser -5.
NAM_mdr_tender_set_owner = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_board_federal_subject = yes
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_tender_winner > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = NAM_mdr_tender_winner }
		NAM_corp_district_apply = yes
		NAM = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_mdr_tender_winner }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 8 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_tender_loser > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_mdr_tender_loser }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -5 }
				NAM_board_support_change = yes
			}
			NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_tender_winner value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_tender_loser value = 0 }
}

# ----- Council of boards: the continent - the desert stage -----
# "Пустынные концессии" offers treaties to at most two of Kadir, Sardan and Rahma
# (NAM_mdr_desert_treaty_room); "Последний довод" or "Поход в пустыню" fights the
# rest in the existing great war. Escrow index: 1 KDR, 2 SDR, 3 RHM.

# COUNTRY emirate. Output: temp NAM_mdr_offer_index (0 for any other tag).
NAM_mdr_desert_index_of = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { tag = KDR }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = SDR }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = RHM }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 3 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, body of event 214. Every escrow not yet dispatched goes to its
# emirate as event 209 while the emirate can still answer; otherwise it is
# refunded.
NAM_mdr_desert_dispatch = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_desert_escrow^1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_offer_dispatched^1 = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { KDR = { NAM_mdr_desert_offer_live = yes } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_dispatched^1 value = 1 }
			KDR = { country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.209 } }
		}
		else = {
			NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_desert_escrow^2 > 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_offer_dispatched^2 = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { SDR = { NAM_mdr_desert_offer_live = yes } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_dispatched^2 value = 1 }
			SDR = { country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.209 } }
		}
		else = {
			NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_desert_escrow^3 > 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_offer_dispatched^3 = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { RHM = { NAM_mdr_desert_offer_live = yes } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_dispatched^3 value = 1 }
			RHM = { country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.209 } }
		}
		else = {
			NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY emirate, answer a of event 209. The escrow is spent; the emirate
# becomes a company district with its own tender (event 210, fired by the answer).
NAM_mdr_desert_sign = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_mdr_offer_pending
			NOT = { NAM_great_war_active = yes }
		}
		NAM_mdr_desert_index_of = yes
		clr_country_flag = NAM_mdr_offer_pending
		NAM = {
			set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_desert_escrow^NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 0 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_target^NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 0 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_dispatched^NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_skip_tender_queue value = 1 }
		NAM_wor_federal_district_join = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_skip_tender_queue value = 0 }
		NAM = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
	}
}

# COUNTRY emirate, answer b of event 209: the escrow returns, the emirate stays a
# target and may be offered again once its 90-day refusal ends.
NAM_mdr_desert_refuse = {
	NAM_mdr_desert_index_of = yes
	NAM = { NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes }
	set_country_flag = {
		flag = NAM_mdr_offer_refused
		value = 1
		days = 90
	}
}

# COUNTRY emirate, fallback answer c of event 209: an offer that lapsed or met
# the great war returns its escrow and makes no district.
NAM_mdr_desert_void = {
	NAM_mdr_desert_index_of = yes
	NAM = { NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_mdr_offer_index (1-3). Returns the escrow once and
# clears the offer on the emirate that still exists.
NAM_mdr_desert_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_desert_escrow^NAM_mdr_offer_index > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_desert_escrow^NAM_mdr_offer_index }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_desert_escrow^NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_target^NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_dispatched^NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_offer_index = 1 }
			KDR = { exists = yes }
		}
		KDR = { clr_country_flag = NAM_mdr_offer_pending }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_offer_index = 2 }
			SDR = { exists = yes }
		}
		SDR = { clr_country_flag = NAM_mdr_offer_pending }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_mdr_offer_index = 3 }
			RHM = { exists = yes }
		}
		RHM = { clr_country_flag = NAM_mdr_offer_pending }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, at the end of NAM_consolidation_monthly. The failure path of the
# desert question: 540 days after the tree loaded, with no great war in progress
# and the desert still open, the freeze of the South ends (NAM_south_story_pending
# reads the global flag), every open escrow returns, event 216 carries the
# council's price and the South clock may start. No date row: the South deadline
# counts from contact.
NAM_mdr_desert_lapse_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_mdr_started
			NOT = { has_global_flag = NAM_mdr_desert_lapsed }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lapse_left value = NAM_mdr_lapse_day }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_lapse_left value = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_mdr_lapse_left
			min = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { NAM_great_war_active = yes }
				NOT = { NAM_mdr_desert_closed = yes }
				has_country_flag = {
					flag = NAM_mdr_started
					days > 539
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = NAM_mdr_desert_lapsed
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 1 }
			NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 2 }
			NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_offer_index value = 3 }
			NAM_mdr_desert_refund = yes
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.216 days = 1 }
			mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
			log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][MAINLAND] The desert question lapsed; the South clock is released."
			ADISCORD_south_begin_preparation = yes
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the continent - state receipts -----
# STATE target of "Реституция округа", "Национализация земли" or "Путевые бригады".
# Opens the state receipt and debits its price.
# Inputs (temp): NAM_mdr_work_kind (1 restitution, 2 nationalisation, 3 rail
# brigade), NAM_mdr_work_cap and NAM_mdr_work_men (rail brigades only).
NAM_mdr_state_work_open = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_work_kind = 1 } }
		set_state_flag = NAM_mdr_restitution_work
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_restitution_paid value = NAM_mdr_work_cap }
		NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_restitution_running value = 1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_work_kind = 2 } }
		set_state_flag = NAM_mdr_nationalising
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_nat_paid value = NAM_mdr_work_cap }
		NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_nat_running value = 1 } }
	}
	else = {
		set_state_flag = NAM_mdr_rail_work
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_rail_paid value = NAM_mdr_work_cap }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_rail_paid_men value = NAM_mdr_work_men }
		NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_rail_running value = 1 } }
	}
	NAM = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_work_cap > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_work_cap }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -1 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_work_men > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_rcpt_debit value = NAM_mdr_work_men }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_rcpt_debit value = -1 }
			add_manpower = NAM_mdr_rcpt_debit
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_work_cap value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_work_men value = 0 }
}

# STATE. Returns whatever state receipt is held, once, and frees its slot.
NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_mdr_restitution_work }
		clr_state_flag = NAM_mdr_restitution_work
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_work_refund value = NAM_mdr_restitution_paid }
		clear_variable = NAM_mdr_restitution_paid
		NAM = {
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_restitution_running value = 1 }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = NAM_mdr_restitution_running
				min = 0
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_work_refund }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_mdr_nationalising }
		clr_state_flag = NAM_mdr_nationalising
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_work_refund value = NAM_mdr_nat_paid }
		clear_variable = NAM_mdr_nat_paid
		NAM = {
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_nat_running value = 1 }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = NAM_mdr_nat_running
				min = 0
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_work_refund }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_mdr_rail_work }
		clr_state_flag = NAM_mdr_rail_work
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_work_refund value = NAM_mdr_rail_paid }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_work_refund_men value = NAM_mdr_rail_paid_men }
		clear_variable = NAM_mdr_rail_paid
		clear_variable = NAM_mdr_rail_paid_men
		NAM = {
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_rail_running value = 1 }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = NAM_mdr_rail_running
				min = 0
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_work_refund }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_work_refund_men > 0 } }
				add_manpower = NAM_mdr_work_refund_men
			}
		}
	}
}

# STATE target of "Реституция округа" at completion. Delivery needs the district still owned and
# controlled by NAM; otherwise the price returns. The first three runs also
# advance the society programme.
NAM_mdr_restitution_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_mdr_restitution_work }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = NAM
				is_controlled_by = NAM
				NAM = { NAM_board_operable = yes }
			}
			clr_state_flag = NAM_mdr_restitution_work
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_restitution_paid
			set_state_flag = NAM_mdr_restituted
			NAM = {
				subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_restitution_running value = 1 }
				clamp_variable = {
					var = NAM_mdr_restitution_running
					min = 0
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_act_of_oblivion }
					add_manpower = 5000
				}
				else = {
					add_manpower = 4000
				}
				add_stability = 0.01
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 5 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 2 }
				NAM_board_support_change = yes
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_restitution_runs value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_restitution_runs < 4 } }
					ADISCORD_programme_society_development = yes
				}
				NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes
		}
	}
}

# STATE target of "Национализация земли" at completion: the state becomes national land with a
# Directory core. Delivery rechecks ownership and control.
NAM_mdr_nationalise_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_mdr_nationalising }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = NAM
				is_controlled_by = NAM
				NAM = { NAM_board_operable = yes }
			}
			clr_state_flag = NAM_mdr_nationalising
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_nat_paid
			set_state_flag = NAM_mdr_nationalised
			add_core_of = NAM
			NAM_mdr_lease_end = yes
			NAM_mdr_remove_state_modifiers = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = NAM_ptn_lot }
				NAM_ptn_lot_state_cored = yes
			}
			NAM = {
				subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_nat_running value = 1 }
				clamp_variable = {
					var = NAM_mdr_nat_running
					min = 0
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_cons_change value = 2 }
				NAM_consolidation_add = yes
				ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes
		}
	}
}

# STATE target of "Путевые бригады" at completion: one level of infrastructure while NAM or a
# company district still owns and controls the state.
NAM_mdr_rail_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_mdr_rail_work }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_mdr_owned_by_directory = yes
				NAM = { NAM_board_operable = yes }
			}
			clr_state_flag = NAM_mdr_rail_work
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_rail_paid
			clear_variable = NAM_mdr_rail_paid_men
			set_state_flag = NAM_mdr_rail_done
			NAM = {
				subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_rail_running value = 1 }
				clamp_variable = {
					var = NAM_mdr_rail_running
					min = 0
				}
			}
			add_building_construction = {
				type = infrastructure
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			NAM_mdr_state_work_refund = yes
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war -----
# NAM_southern_dominion_focus follows a council of boards that wins the War for the
# South. NAM_hgm_begin loads it at the victory; on the next day the settlement of the
# war sequesters every loser (NAM_ptn_sequester) and lays the lots of the partition
# (NAM_ptn_open_table). NAM_hgm_close is the single exit, from NAM_board_end_operations.
# Lots 1-4 are Shahrabad's: 1 the Zarkhan belt, 2 the Safir coast, 3 Khazar, 4 the
# Bayrat mines. Lots 5-11 are the other losers: 5 KYZ, 6 GLP, 7 MZR, 8 WEF, 9 KDR,
# 10 SDR, 11 RHM. NAM arrays by lot (size 12): NAM_ptn_lot_state (0 off the table,
# 1 open, 2 awarded, 3 kept, 4 closed), NAM_ptn_lot_owner (company, 0 the council),
# NAM_ptn_lot_kind (1 Shahrabad, 2 country lot, 3 state lot of a country that no
# longer exists, 4 Fenn merged into the Eflor district), NAM_ptn_lot_mode (mode of the
# lot's pending event: 1 tender, 2 night, 3 re-tender), NAM_ptn_kept_form (1 rotation
# district, 2 council land, 3 furnaces to the treasury, 4 free port, 5 Mazar's share),
# NAM_ptn_bidder_a, NAM_ptn_bidder_b, NAM_ptn_tender_running, NAM_ptn_retendered.
# NAM arrays by company (size 7): NAM_ptn_lots_won, NAM_ptn_grievance,
# NAM_ptn_lot_bonus, NAM_hgm_heir_votes, NAM_hgm_lot_regiments. A lot's states carry
# the state variable NAM_ptn_lot and are listed once in NAM_ptn_states, so no loop of
# this section scans the world. NAM_ptn_shl_form (1 furnace trust, 2 inventory) is
# written once, by the pair focus, the deadline or a table without Shahrabad.

# COUNTRY NAM, at the northern victory of the council of boards, before the South
# war's campaign state closes; the restore of the prior tree then finds no war tree.
NAM_hgm_begin = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = NAM
			has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
			has_global_flag = ADISCORD_south_hegemon_NAM
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_hgm_started }
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_hgm_started
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_lot_state size = 12 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_lot_owner size = 12 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_lot_kind size = 12 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_lot_mode size = 12 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_kept_form size = 12 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_bidder_a size = 12 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_bidder_b size = 12 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_tender_running size = 12 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_retendered size = 12 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_lots_won size = 7 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_grievance size = 7 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_ptn_lot_bonus size = 7 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_hgm_heir_votes size = 7 value = 0 }
		resize_array = { array = NAM_hgm_lot_regiments size = 7 value = 0 }
		load_focus_tree = {
			tree = NAM_southern_dominion_focus
			keep_completed = yes
		}
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][DOMINION] The council of boards loads the dominion tree."
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from NAM_board_end_operations before NAM_mdr_close. Refunds every
# running receipt, removes the state modifiers and the timed spirits of the tree and
# clears the partition's markers. Laws, final spirits, traits, party names and the
# owners of districts stay.
NAM_hgm_close = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_hgm_started }
		NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_refund = yes
		NAM_hgm_rations_refund = yes
		NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_refund = yes
		NAM_hgm_export_refund = yes
		NAM_hgm_supply_refund = yes
		clear_variable = NAM_hgm_buyout_company
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_conquered_states
			NAM_hgm_town_refund = yes
			NAM_hgm_artel_refund = yes
			NAM_hgm_clear_state_marks = yes
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_ptn_states
			clear_variable = NAM_ptn_lot
			NAM_hgm_clear_state_marks = yes
		}
		288 = { NAM_hgm_clear_state_marks = yes }
		730 = { NAM_hgm_clear_state_marks = yes }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_ptn_sequestered_tags
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				clr_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_partition_charter }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_partition_charter
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_southern_dominion }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_southern_dominion
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_chairs_seal }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_chairs_seal
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_directory_charter }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_directory_charter
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_cities }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_cities
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_garrison_spirit }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_garrison_spirit
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_army_of_dominion }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_army_of_dominion
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_cartel_prices }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_cartel_prices
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_open_lanes }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_open_lanes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_world_bank }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_world_bank
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_crusade_spirit }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_crusade_spirit
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = NAM_hgm_hegemons_price }
			remove_ideas = NAM_hgm_hegemons_price
		}
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_states
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_sequestered_tags
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_walkout_queue
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_lot_state
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_lot_owner
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_lot_kind
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_lot_mode
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_kept_form
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_bidder_a
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_bidder_b
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_tender_running
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_lots_won
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_grievance
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_lot_bonus
		clear_array = NAM_hgm_loans
		clear_array = NAM_hgm_loan_due
		clear_array = NAM_hgm_credits
		clear_array = NAM_hgm_credit_due
		clr_country_flag = NAM_ptn_night_running
		clear_variable = NAM_ptn_deadline_day
		clear_variable = NAM_ptn_deadline_left
		clear_variable = NAM_ptn_walkout_company
		clear_variable = NAM_hgm_bonds_until
		clear_variable = NAM_hgm_tribute_until
		clear_variable = NAM_hgm_price_debtor
		clear_variable = NAM_hgm_price_demand
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# STATE. Markers of the tree on a South state, cleared by NAM_hgm_close.
NAM_hgm_clear_state_marks = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_ptn_free_port } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_ptn_free_port }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_hgm_southern_watch } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_hgm_southern_watch }
	}
	clr_state_flag = NAM_ptn_free_port
	clr_state_flag = NAM_hgm_quota_worked
}

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war - sequestration and the table -----
# COUNTRY loser of the War for the South, ROOT NAM, at the settlement on the day after
# the victory. The loser is already NAM's subject; the namestnik office keeps it under
# the council's seal until its lot is settled.
NAM_ptn_sequester = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { tag = NAM }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_subject_of = NAM } }
			NAM = { puppet = PREV }
		}
		NAM = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = PREV
				autonomy_state = autonomy_NAM_namestnik_office
				freedom_level = 0.05
				end_wars = no
				end_civil_wars = no
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = PREV } }
			set_state_controller_to = PREV
		}
		NAM = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = NAM_ptn_sequestered_tags value = PREV } } }
				add_to_array = { array = NAM_ptn_sequestered_tags value = PREV }
			}
		}
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, after the settlement has sequestered the losers. Lays the lots: every
# sequestered loser is a country lot; Shahrabad gives lots 1-4; land with the core of
# a country that no longer exists is a state lot. The furnace administrations' land
# without a lot goes to NAM's homeland, to a friendly country or to council land.
NAM_ptn_open_table = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_hgm_started
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_table_open }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				KYZ = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^5 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^5 value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				GLP = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^6 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^6 value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				MZR = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^7 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^7 value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				WEF = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^8 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^8 value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				KDR = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^9 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^9 value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				SDR = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^10 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^10 value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				RHM = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^11 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^11 value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				SHL = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^1 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^1 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^2 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^2 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^3 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^3 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^4 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^4 value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_shl_form value = 2 }
		}
		# The states are collected first: the sort moves owners.
		clear_temp_array = NAM_ptn_sort_states
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_ptn_sequestered_tags
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				every_owned_state = {
					add_to_temp_array = { NAM_ptn_sort_states = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_ptn_sort_states
			NAM_ptn_sort_state = yes
		}
		NAM_ptn_annex_empty_administrations = yes
		688 = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_core_of = SLF }
				remove_core_of = SLF
			}
		}
		NAM_ptn_assign_bidders = yes
		set_country_flag = NAM_ptn_table_open
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_deadline_day value = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_deadline_day value = 179 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_deadline_left value = 179 }
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][DOMINION] The table of the partition is laid."
	}
}

# STATE owned by a sequestered loser, from NAM_ptn_open_table.
NAM_ptn_sort_state = {
	NAM_ptn_state_lot_index = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_state_lot > 0 } }
		NAM_ptn_mark_state = yes
		# A country lot holds all its land in its own country.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_input value = NAM_ptn_state_lot }
		NAM = { NAM_ptn_save_lot_country = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_ptn_state_lot = 2 } }
				NOT = { is_owned_by = event_target:NAM_ptn_lot_country }
			}
			event_target:NAM_ptn_lot_country = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_core_of = NAM }
		NAM = { transfer_state = PREV }
		NAM_wor_take_state = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_ptn_friendly_core_state = yes }
		NAM_ptn_return_to_friend = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_ptn_country_lot_owner = yes }
		NAM_ptn_owner_lot_index = yes
		NAM_ptn_mark_state = yes
	}
	else = {
		NAM = { transfer_state = PREV }
		NAM_wor_take_state = yes
	}
}

# STATE. Output: temp NAM_ptn_state_lot, the lot on the table this state belongs to
# (0 none). Shahrabad's sixteen states belong to lots 1-4 by the map; other land by
# the core of a lot's country. A core of a country that no longer exists opens its
# lot as a state lot.
NAM_ptn_state_lot_index = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^1 = 1 } }
			OR = {
				state = 707
				state = 289
				state = 731
				state = 294
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^2 = 1 } }
			OR = {
				state = 288
				state = 730
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^3 = 1 } }
			OR = {
				state = 699
				state = 287
				state = 290
				state = 291
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^4 = 1 } }
			OR = {
				state = 732
				state = 292
				state = 293
				state = 296
				state = 733
				state = 295
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = KYZ
			OR = {
				NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^5 = 1 } }
				NOT = { country_exists = KYZ }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = GLP
			OR = {
				NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^6 = 1 } }
				NOT = { country_exists = GLP }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = MZR
			OR = {
				NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^7 = 1 } }
				NOT = { country_exists = MZR }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = WEF
			OR = {
				NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^8 = 1 } }
				NOT = { country_exists = WEF }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = KDR
			OR = {
				NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^9 = 1 } }
				NOT = { country_exists = KDR }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 9 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = SDR
			OR = {
				NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^10 = 1 } }
				NOT = { country_exists = SDR }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = RHM
			OR = {
				NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^11 = 1 } }
				NOT = { country_exists = RHM }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 11 }
	}
	# A lot opened by its core alone is a state lot.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_state_lot > 4 }
			NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_state_lot = 0 } }
		}
		NAM = {
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 3 }
		}
	}
}

# STATE owned by a country lot's country without another lot's core. Output: temp
# NAM_ptn_state_lot, the owner's lot.
NAM_ptn_owner_lot_index = {

		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = GLP }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = MZR }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = WEF }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = KDR }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 9 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = SDR }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = RHM }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_state_lot value = 11 }
	}
}

# STATE. Input: temp NAM_ptn_state_lot. The state joins its lot.
NAM_ptn_mark_state = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot value = NAM_ptn_state_lot }
	NAM = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = NAM_ptn_states value = PREV } } }
			add_to_array = { array = NAM_ptn_states value = PREV }
		}
	}
}

# STATE without a lot core whose core country is NAM's subject or in its faction.
NAM_ptn_return_to_friend = {

			is_core_of = EFL
