		}
		EFL = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = AZH
			AZH = { NAM_ptn_friendly_country = yes }
		}
		AZH = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = MZR
			MZR = { NAM_ptn_friendly_country = yes }
		}
		MZR = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = WEF
			WEF = { NAM_ptn_friendly_country = yes }
		}
		WEF = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = KYZ
			KYZ = { NAM_ptn_friendly_country = yes }
		}
		KYZ = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = GLP
			GLP = { NAM_ptn_friendly_country = yes }
		}
		GLP = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. A sequestered furnace administration without lot land is annexed;
# one with lot land is annexed when its last lot is settled.
NAM_ptn_annex_empty_administrations = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_ptn_sequestered_tags
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				NAM_ptn_furnace_administration = yes
				NOT = { any_owned_state = { has_variable = NAM_ptn_lot } }
			}
			clr_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
			NAM = {
				annex_country = {
					target = PREV
					transfer_troops = no
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Event target NAM_ptn_lot_country for the lot in temp NAM_ptn_lot_input:
# Shahrabad for lots 1-4, the loser for lots 5-11.
NAM_ptn_save_lot_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input < 5 } }
		SHL = { save_event_target_as = NAM_ptn_lot_country }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 5 } }
		KYZ = { save_event_target_as = NAM_ptn_lot_country }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 6 } }
		GLP = { save_event_target_as = NAM_ptn_lot_country }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 7 } }
		MZR = { save_event_target_as = NAM_ptn_lot_country }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 8 } }
		WEF = { save_event_target_as = NAM_ptn_lot_country }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 9 } }
		KDR = { save_event_target_as = NAM_ptn_lot_country }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 10 } }
		SDR = { save_event_target_as = NAM_ptn_lot_country }
	}
	else = {
		RHM = { save_event_target_as = NAM_ptn_lot_country }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Each lot has two bidding companies by appetite; Fenn's are read
# from the holders of the island partition (NAM_ptn_fenn_bidders).
NAM_ptn_assign_bidders = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^1 value = 2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^1 value = 4 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^2 value = 3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^2 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^3 value = 5 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^3 value = 6 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^4 value = 4 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^4 value = 5 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^5 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^5 value = 6 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^6 value = 3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^6 value = 4 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^7 value = 2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^7 value = 5 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^9 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^9 value = 6 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^10 value = 2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^10 value = 5 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^11 value = 3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^11 value = 4 }
	NAM_ptn_fenn_bidders = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Fenn: Eflor's holder against Reidbank; when Eflor's holder is
# Reidbank, against Azhar's holder, and Smenkom when that is Reidbank too. The
# second bidder is never Eflor's holder.
NAM_ptn_fenn_bidders = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^8 value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_efl > 0 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^8 value = NAM_board_partition_efl }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^8 value = 6 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_bidder_a^8 = 6 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^8 value = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_azh > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_azh = 6 } }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^8 value = NAM_board_partition_azh }
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war - Shahrabad -----
# COUNTRY NAM. "Печной трест": Shahrabad stays NAM's subject under the namestnik
# office and opens its seal chapter; lots 1-4 become furnace leases.
NAM_ptn_furnace_trust = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_ptn_shl_form } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_shl_form value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = SHL }
			SHL = {
				clr_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				SHL_seal_open_chapter = yes
				ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
			}
		}
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Хазар по описи": Shahrabad is annexed as conquered land, its army
# disbanded and its furnace chapter ended; lots 1-4 become land lots.
NAM_ptn_khazar_inventory = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_ptn_shl_form } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_shl_form value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = SHL }
			SHL = {
				clr_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				NAM_wor_radical_annex = yes
			}
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = NAM_conquered_states
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_core_of = SHL
						is_owned_by = NAM
						NOT = { is_core_of = NAM }
					}
					add_resistance = 15
				}
			}
		}
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, at the deadline. Shahrabad's form by the mainland course: the
# inventory on "Материковые акции", otherwise the trust.
NAM_ptn_settle_shl_default = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_ptn_shl_form } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				SHL = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_ptn_union_rules = no }
				NAM_ptn_khazar_inventory = yes
			}
			else = {
				NAM_ptn_furnace_trust = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_shl_form value = 2 }
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war - bids and awards -----
# COUNTRY NAM. Inputs (temp): NAM_ptn_lot_input, NAM_ptn_bid_company (0 for the base
# bid) and NAM_ptn_bid_mode (1 tender, 2 night, 3 re-tender, 4 deadline). Output:
# temp NAM_ptn_bid_value. Tender x0.75, night x1.25; a company's second lot at half;
# a furnace lease of the trust at three quarters.
NAM_ptn_compute_bid = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 50 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 120 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 80 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 140 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 90 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 80 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 7 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 110 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 8 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 40 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_bid_mode = 1 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 0.75 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_bid_mode = 2 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 1.25 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_bid_company > 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^NAM_ptn_bid_company > 0 }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input < 5 }
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_shl_form = 1 }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_value value = 0.75 }
	}
	round_temp_variable = NAM_ptn_bid_value
}

# COUNTRY NAM, in the immediate block of a lot event. Input: temp NAM_ptn_lot_input.
# The mode is the one stored for the lot's event, else the one the answers read: a
# kept lot is re-tendered, a running tender is a tender, otherwise the night when
# it runs. Writes the displayed values: NAM_ptn_bid_a, NAM_ptn_bid_b,
# NAM_ptn_win_trust, NAM_ptn_lose_trust, NAM_ptn_keep_cost, the bidders
# NAM_ptn_current_a / _b, the veto markers NAM_ptn_veto_a / _b (that bidder would
# take its third lot) and the forms NAM_ptn_award_form / NAM_ptn_kept_form_now.
# The award recomputes every value.
NAM_ptn_prepare_bids = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_prep_lot value = NAM_ptn_lot_input }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 8 } }
		NAM_ptn_fenn_bidders = yes
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_current_mode value = NAM_ptn_lot_mode^NAM_ptn_prep_lot }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_current_mode = 0 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_current_mode value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 3 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_current_mode value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_tender_running^NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 0 }
				has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_night_running
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_current_mode value = 2 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_current_a value = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^NAM_ptn_prep_lot }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_current_b value = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^NAM_ptn_prep_lot }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_mode value = NAM_ptn_current_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_company value = NAM_ptn_current_a }
	NAM_ptn_compute_bid = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_a value = NAM_ptn_bid_value }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_input value = NAM_ptn_prep_lot }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_company value = NAM_ptn_current_b }
	NAM_ptn_compute_bid = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_b value = NAM_ptn_bid_value }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_win_trust value = 6 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lose_trust value = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_current_mode = 2 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_win_trust value = 8 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lose_trust value = 5 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_keep_cost value = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_ptn_union_rules = no }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_keep_cost value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_veto_a value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_veto_b value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^NAM_ptn_current_a > 1 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_veto_a value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^NAM_ptn_current_b > 1 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_veto_b value = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_input value = NAM_ptn_prep_lot }
	NAM_ptn_focus_lot = yes
	NAM_ptn_set_forms = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_ptn_lot_input. The lot shown by the open event:
# NAM_ptn_current_lot, its owner NAM_ptn_current_owner and NAM_ptn_current_district
# (1 a company district, 0 land). Lot events and the events of the peoples call it.
NAM_ptn_focus_lot = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_current_lot value = NAM_ptn_lot_input }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_current_owner value = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^NAM_ptn_lot_input }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_current_district value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_ptn_lot_input = 4 }
				AND = {
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_ptn_lot_input = 2 }
					NAM_ptn_union_rules = yes
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_current_district value = 1 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_ptn_prep_lot. The forms an award and a kept lot take
# (scripted localisation NAMPtnAwardForm, NAMPtnFennAwardForm and NAMPtnKeptForm).
# Fenn's first bidder holds Eflor's lot, so its award merges Fenn into the Eflor
# district while Eflor is NAM's district (NAM_ptn_fenn_to_eflor).
NAM_ptn_set_forms = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_form value = 2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form_now value = 2 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_fenn_to_eflor_now value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 8 }
			EFL = { NAM_board_federal_subject = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_fenn_to_eflor_now value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 3 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form_now value = NAM_ptn_kept_form^NAM_ptn_prep_lot }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_shl_form = 1 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_form value = 3 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form_now value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 2 }
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form_now value = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 1 }
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 1 }
				NAM_hgm_mazar_ally = yes
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form_now value = 5 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 2 }
			NAM_ptn_union_rules = yes
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_form value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_prep_lot = 1 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form_now value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The award of a lot. Inputs (temp): NAM_ptn_lot_input,
# NAM_ptn_company_input (1-6, 0 the council keeps it) and NAM_ptn_mode (1 tender,
# 2 night, 3 re-tender, 4 deadline; 0 reads the mode stored for the lot's event).
# Settles only an open lot, or a kept lot not yet re-tendered in mode 3, so a stale
# or repeated answer changes nothing. The winner pays its bid into the council's
# capital; at night the loser bears a grudge; a third lot of one company overrules
# the veto of the five (its political power is the answer's own native row).
NAM_ptn_award = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_lot value = NAM_ptn_lot_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_company value = NAM_ptn_company_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_mode value = NAM_ptn_mode }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_mode = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_mode value = NAM_ptn_lot_mode^NAM_ptn_award_lot }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_mode = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_mode value = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_mode value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_open value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_award_lot = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_mode = 3 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_open value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_mode = 3 }
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_award_lot = 3 }
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_retendered^NAM_ptn_award_lot = 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_open value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_open = 1 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_tender_running^NAM_ptn_award_lot value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_mode^NAM_ptn_award_lot value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_mode = 3 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_retendered^NAM_ptn_award_lot value = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_loser value = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^NAM_ptn_award_lot }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_company value = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^NAM_ptn_award_lot compare = equals } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_loser value = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^NAM_ptn_award_lot }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_company > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_input value = NAM_ptn_award_lot }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_company value = NAM_ptn_award_company }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_bid_mode value = NAM_ptn_award_mode }
			NAM_ptn_compute_bid = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_ptn_bid_value }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_win value = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_lose value = -3 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_mode = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_win value = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_lose value = -5 }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_grievance^NAM_ptn_award_loser value = 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_award_company }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_ptn_award_win }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_award_loser }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_ptn_award_lose }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^NAM_ptn_award_company > 1 } }
				NAM_ptn_veto_package = yes
			}
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lots_won^NAM_ptn_award_company value = 1 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^NAM_ptn_award_lot value = NAM_ptn_award_company }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_mode < 3 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_lose value = -3 }
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_ptn_union_rules = no }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_award_lose value = -1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^NAM_ptn_award_lot }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_ptn_award_lose }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_bidder_b^NAM_ptn_award_lot }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = NAM_ptn_award_lose }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_input value = NAM_ptn_award_lot }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_company_input value = NAM_ptn_award_company }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_mode value = NAM_ptn_award_mode }
		NAM_ptn_apply_lot = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	}
	# Every answer of the night calls the dispatcher again, a stale one included.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_mode = 2 }
			has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_night_running
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.246 hours = 1 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, inside NAM_ptn_award. The four companies that neither win nor lose
# the lot pay the overruled veto with 3 trust each.
NAM_ptn_veto_package = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_company = 1 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_loser = 1 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_company = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_loser = 2 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_2 value = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_company = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_loser = 3 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_company = 4 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_loser = 4 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_company = 5 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_loser = 5 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = -3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_company = 6 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_award_loser = 6 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = -3 }
	}
	NAM_board_trust_package = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from NAM_ptn_award. Inputs (temp): NAM_ptn_lot_input,
# NAM_ptn_company_input, NAM_ptn_mode. The lot takes its form by kind, course and
# Shahrabad's form; a kept lot becomes a rotation district or council land. A kept
# lot sold at a re-tender passes to its winner.
NAM_ptn_apply_lot = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_apply_lot value = NAM_ptn_lot_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_apply_company value = NAM_ptn_company_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_apply_mode value = NAM_ptn_mode }
	NAM_ptn_save_lot_country = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_company > 0 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_apply_lot value = 2 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^NAM_ptn_apply_lot value = NAM_ptn_apply_company }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form^NAM_ptn_apply_lot value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 2 }
					NAM_ptn_union_rules = yes
					event_target:NAM_ptn_lot_country = { NAM_board_federal_subject = yes }
				}
				event_target:NAM_ptn_lot_country = {
					set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = NAM_ptn_apply_company }
					set_country_flag = NAM_hgm_owner_fixed
					NAM_corp_district_apply = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 1 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_apply_lot value = 3 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form^NAM_ptn_apply_lot value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_company > 0 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_apply_lot value = 2 }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form^NAM_ptn_apply_lot value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_shl_form = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_company = 0 } }
					set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form^NAM_ptn_apply_lot value = 3 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_company = 0 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 2 } }
					NAM_ptn_open_free_port = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 1 }
						check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_mode < 4 }
						NAM_hgm_mazar_ally = yes
					}
					NAM_ptn_give_mazar_share = yes
				}
				NAM_ptn_kept_compliance = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 8 }
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_company > 0 }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_apply_company value = NAM_ptn_bidder_a^8 compare = equals }
					EFL = { NAM_board_federal_subject = yes }
				}
				NAM_ptn_fenn_to_eflor = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NAM_ptn_union_rules = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_company = 0 } }
					set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form^NAM_ptn_apply_lot value = 1 }
				}
				event_target:NAM_ptn_lot_country = { NAM_ptn_make_district = yes }
			}
			else = {
				event_target:NAM_ptn_lot_country = { NAM_ptn_annex_lot = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_company = 0 } }
					NAM_ptn_kept_compliance = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			NAM_ptn_take_state_lot = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_company = 0 } }
				NAM_ptn_kept_compliance = yes
			}
		}
		NAM_ptn_queue_people_event = yes
		if = {
			limit = { event_target:NAM_ptn_lot_country = { exists = yes } }
			event_target:NAM_ptn_lot_country = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
		}
	}
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY sequestered loser of a country lot on the union course (or with neither
# course). Input: temp NAM_ptn_apply_company. The join only changes the autonomy of
# a subject; a sold lot's owner is set before it, a kept lot gets the rotation owner,
# and the tender queue of the mainland is skipped because the lot was auctioned.
NAM_ptn_make_district = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_company > 0 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = NAM_ptn_apply_company }
		set_country_flag = NAM_hgm_owner_fixed
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_skip_tender_queue value = 1 }
	NAM_wor_federal_district_join = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_skip_tender_queue value = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY sequestered loser of a country lot on "Материковые акции". Its states
# become conquered council land and keep their lot index.
NAM_ptn_annex_lot = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
	NAM_wor_radical_annex = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_ptn_apply_lot. A state lot: NAM takes the lot's states
# from their sequestered holders; an administration left without lot land is annexed.
NAM_ptn_take_state_lot = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_ptn_states
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot value = NAM_ptn_apply_lot compare = equals } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM } }
				NAM = { transfer_state = PREV }
			}
			NAM_wor_take_state = yes
		}
	}
	NAM_ptn_annex_empty_administrations = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Fenn to Eflor's holder while Eflor is NAM's district: Fenn's states go
# to the district and WEF ends with its last state; the holding counts through
# Eflor's district row.
NAM_ptn_fenn_to_eflor = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_ptn_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot = 8 }
				is_owned_by = WEF
			}
			EFL = { transfer_state = PREV }
			set_state_controller_to = EFL
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = WEF }
		WEF = { clr_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_kind^8 value = 4 }
	EFL = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Lot 2 kept under the inventory becomes the free port of the South.
NAM_ptn_open_free_port = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form^2 value = 4 }
	288 = { NAM_ptn_free_port_state = yes }
	730 = { NAM_ptn_free_port_state = yes }
}

NAM_ptn_free_port_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
		set_state_flag = NAM_ptn_free_port
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_ptn_free_port } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_ptn_free_port }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Lot 1 kept while Mazar is the Directory's sovereign ally: the Zarkhan
# district goes to Mazar, the rest of the lot stays with the council.
NAM_ptn_give_mazar_share = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_form^1 value = 5 }
	707 = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_owned_by = NAM }
			NAM_ptn_lot_state_cored = yes
			MZR = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
	}
	MZR = {
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = NAM
			modifier = NAM_hgm_mazar_share
		}
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_ptn_apply_lot. Under the council's direct rule the
# governors of a kept land lot are already in place.
NAM_ptn_kept_compliance = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_rtw_direct_rule = yes }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_ptn_states
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot value = NAM_ptn_apply_lot compare = equals }
					is_owned_by = NAM
				}
				add_compliance = 10
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_ptn_apply_lot. The people of a country lot answer the
# settlement once; the event rechecks its lot and land.
NAM_ptn_queue_people_event = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 5 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.281 days = 60 random_days = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 6 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.282 days = 60 random_days = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 7 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.283 days = 60 random_days = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 8 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.284 days = 60 random_days = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 9 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.285 days = 60 random_days = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 10 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.286 days = 60 random_days = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_apply_lot = 11 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.287 days = 60 random_days = 60 }
	}
}

# STATE of a lot that NAM cored, nationalised or lost. The state leaves its lot; a
# lot left without a state is closed: no holding, no rent, no re-tender.
NAM_ptn_lot_state_cored = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_ptn_lot }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cored_lot value = NAM_ptn_lot }
		clear_variable = NAM_ptn_lot
		NAM = {
			remove_from_array = { array = NAM_ptn_states value = PREV }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_cored_lot = 2 }
						check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_cored_lot = 3 }
					}
					NOT = {
						any_of_scopes = {
							array = NAM_ptn_states
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot value = NAM_ptn_cored_lot compare = equals }
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_cored_lot value = 4 }
				NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war - tenders and the night -----
# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_ptn_lot_input. The lot's event, one hour later.
NAM_ptn_fire_lot_event = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.233 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 2 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.234 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 3 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.235 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 4 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.236 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 5 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.237 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 6 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.238 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 7 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.239 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 8 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.240 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 9 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.241 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 10 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.242 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_input = 11 } }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.243 hours = 1 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. A private tender (NAM_ptn_tender_1..11) runs for the lot in temp NAM_ptn_lot_input:
# taken in complete_effect; settled in remove_effect by NAM_ptn_finish_tender;
# cancel_effect calls NAM_ptn_cancel_tender. The night skips a lot under tender.
NAM_ptn_start_tender = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_tender_running^NAM_ptn_lot_input value = 1 }
}

NAM_ptn_finish_tender = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_tender_running^NAM_ptn_lot_input = 1 }
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_lot_input = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_mode^NAM_ptn_lot_input value = 1 }
		NAM_ptn_fire_lot_event = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_tender_running^NAM_ptn_lot_input value = 0 }
	}
}

NAM_ptn_cancel_tender = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_tender_running^NAM_ptn_lot_input value = 0 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Повторные торги" (NAM_ptn_retender): the lowest kept lot that may be re-tendered
# (not the free port, not Mazar's share, not yet re-tendered). Output: temp
# NAM_ptn_retender_lot (0 none).
NAM_ptn_pick_retender_lot = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_retender_lot value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 1
		end = 12
		value = NAM_ptn_loop_step
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_retender_lot = 0 }
				NAM_ptn_retender_candidate = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_retender_lot value = NAM_ptn_loop_lot }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The re-tender taken: the lot is fixed at once, so the decision settles the lot
# it was paid for. Output: NAM_ptn_retender_open (0 none).
NAM_ptn_start_retender = {
	NAM_ptn_pick_retender_lot = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_retender_open value = NAM_ptn_retender_lot }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The re-tender completed: the lot's event in re-tender mode.
NAM_ptn_finish_retender = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_retender_open > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_input value = NAM_ptn_retender_open }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_lot_input = 3 }
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_retendered^NAM_ptn_lot_input = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_mode^NAM_ptn_lot_input value = 3 }
			NAM_ptn_fire_lot_event = yes
		}
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_retender_open value = 0 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Ночь раздела юга": every open lot goes under the hammer, one an hour.
NAM_ptn_run_night = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_table_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_protocol_signed }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_night_running }
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_ptn_night_running
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_night_day value = global.num_days }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.246 hours = 1 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from the dispatcher event 246. The open lot with the lowest index and
# no running tender gets its event; while only tenders remain the dispatcher waits a
# day; with no lot open the walk-outs follow, then the protocol.
NAM_ptn_night_next = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_night_running }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_night_day value = global.num_days }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_night_lot value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_night_waiting value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 12
			value = NAM_ptn_loop_step
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_night_lot = 0 }
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_loop_lot = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_tender_running^NAM_ptn_loop_lot = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_night_waiting value = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_night_lot value = NAM_ptn_loop_lot }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_night_lot > 0 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_mode^NAM_ptn_night_lot value = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_input value = NAM_ptn_night_lot }
			NAM_ptn_fire_lot_event = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_night_waiting = 1 } }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.246 days = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			NAM_ptn_queue_walkouts = yes
			NAM_ptn_walkout_next = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every company with two grudges or more may walk out after the night.
NAM_ptn_queue_walkouts = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_walkouts_queued } }
		set_country_flag = NAM_ptn_walkouts_queued
		clear_array = NAM_ptn_walkout_queue
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_grievance^1 > 1 } }
			add_to_array = { array = NAM_ptn_walkout_queue value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_grievance^2 > 1 } }
			add_to_array = { array = NAM_ptn_walkout_queue value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_grievance^3 > 1 } }
			add_to_array = { array = NAM_ptn_walkout_queue value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_grievance^4 > 1 } }
			add_to_array = { array = NAM_ptn_walkout_queue value = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_grievance^5 > 1 } }
			add_to_array = { array = NAM_ptn_walkout_queue value = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_grievance^6 > 1 } }
			add_to_array = { array = NAM_ptn_walkout_queue value = 6 }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The next walk-out (event 244, NAM_ptn_walkout_company), or the
# protocol at dawn when the queue is empty.
NAM_ptn_walkout_next = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_walkout_queue^num > 0 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_night_day value = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_walkout_company value = NAM_ptn_walkout_queue^0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = NAM_ptn_walkout_queue index = 0 }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.244 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_night_running }
		NAM_ptn_sign_protocol = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, answers of event 244 for NAM_ptn_walkout_company. "Отпустить": its
# trust falls to 20 and its objection deadline is today, so it boycotts from the
# next recount. "Отступные": 60 capital, trust +10, grudges forgotten. "Грамота": a
# charter line and trust +6 (the political power is the answer's native row).
NAM_ptn_walkout_leave = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_walkout_company }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_set_input value = 20 }
	NAM_board_support_change = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_ptn_walkout_company value = global.num_days }
	NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	NAM_ptn_walkout_next = yes
}

NAM_ptn_walkout_pay = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -60 }
	NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_grievance^NAM_ptn_walkout_company value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_walkout_company }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 10 }
	NAM_board_support_change = yes
	NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	NAM_ptn_walkout_next = yes
}

NAM_ptn_walkout_charter = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_walkout_company }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 6 }
	NAM_board_support_change = yes
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_walkout_company }
	NAM_board_grant_charter = yes
	NAM_ptn_walkout_next = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The protocol of the partition, once: after the night or at the
# deadline. Every company that took a lot gains trust; superevent request 79.
NAM_ptn_sign_protocol = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_table_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_protocol_signed }
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_ptn_protocol_signed
		clr_country_flag = NAM_ptn_night_running
		clear_variable = NAM_ptn_deadline_day
		clear_variable = NAM_ptn_deadline_left
		add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_hgm_partition_charter days = 365 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^1 > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^2 > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_2 value = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^3 > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^4 > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^5 > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^6 > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_6 value = 4 }
		}
		NAM_board_trust_package = yes
		set_temp_variable = { ADISCORD_superevent_request = 79 }
		ADISCORD_superevent_enqueue = yes
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.245 hours = 2 }
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][DOMINION] The protocol of the partition is signed."
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, monthly from NAM_corp_monthly. The countdown of the table; a night
# that has had no answer for 30 days resumes; at the deadline every open lot stays
# with the council.
NAM_ptn_deadline_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_table_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_protocol_signed }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_deadline_left value = NAM_ptn_deadline_day }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_deadline_left value = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_ptn_deadline_left
			min = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_night_running }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_night_stall value = NAM_ptn_night_day }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_night_stall value = 30 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = NAM_ptn_night_stall compare = greater_than } }
				NAM_ptn_night_next = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = NAM_ptn_deadline_day compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			NAM_ptn_deadline_settle = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The deadline: Shahrabad's form by course, running tenders closed,
# every open lot kept without bid, trust change, grudge or walk-out, the remaining
# administrations annexed, notice 247 and the protocol.
NAM_ptn_deadline_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_table_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_protocol_signed }
		}
		NAM_ptn_settle_shl_default = yes
		# A private counter: a district join inside the award recounts the council,
		# and the holdings count runs its own lot loop.
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_deadline_lot value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 12
			value = NAM_ptn_deadline_step
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_deadline_lot value = 1 }
			NAM_ptn_deadline_keep_lot = yes
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_ptn_sequestered_tags
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					NAM_ptn_furnace_administration = yes
				}
				clr_country_flag = NAM_ptn_sequestered
				NAM = {
					annex_country = {
						target = PREV
						transfer_troops = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.247 hours = 1 }
		NAM_ptn_sign_protocol = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_ptn_deadline_lot. A running tender is closed and its
# native price returned; an open lot stays with the council (mode 4).
NAM_ptn_deadline_keep_lot = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_tender_running^NAM_ptn_deadline_lot = 1 } }
		add_political_power = 25
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_tender_running^NAM_ptn_deadline_lot value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_deadline_lot = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_input value = NAM_ptn_deadline_lot }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_company_input value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_mode value = 4 }
		NAM_ptn_award = yes
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war - holdings and rents -----
# COUNTRY NAM, inside NAM_board_recount after the mainland holdings. An awarded lot
# is one holding (two votes) on the union course and with neither course, half a
# holding on "Материковые акции"; a district lot counts only through its district,
# a furnace lot while one of its furnaces stays leased. "Южный холдинг" adds half a
# holding per lot of its company. On "Материковые акции" two kept lots give the
# council a vote (NAM_ptn_kept_votes).
NAM_ptn_count_holdings = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_hgm_started
			has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_table_open
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_votes value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 12
			value = NAM_ptn_loop_step
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 1 }
			NAM_ptn_count_lot = yes
		}
		# Whole votes only: 1 kept lot 0, 2-3 kept lots 1, 4-5 kept lots 2.
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_votes value = 0.5 }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_votes value = 0.25 }
		round_variable = NAM_ptn_kept_votes
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_ptn_kept_votes
			min = 0
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_ptn_loop_lot.
NAM_ptn_count_lot = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_loop_lot = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_kept_votes value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_loop_lot = 2 }
			NAM_ptn_lot_counts_as_holding = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_count_owner value = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^NAM_ptn_loop_lot }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_ptn_union_rules = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_ptn_count_owner value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_ptn_count_owner value = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_southern_holding
				check_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_southern_holder value = NAM_ptn_count_owner compare = equals }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_holdings^NAM_ptn_count_owner value = 0.5 }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, monthly from NAM_corp_monthly. Lots lose states NAM no longer owns or
# has cored; district lots close when their country is no longer NAM's district; the
# awarded land and furnace lots pay the council.
NAM_ptn_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_ptn_table_open }
		clear_temp_array = NAM_ptn_drop_states
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_ptn_states
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_check_lot value = NAM_ptn_lot }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NAM = { NAM_ptn_land_lot = yes }
					OR = {
						NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM }
						is_core_of = NAM
					}
				}
				add_to_temp_array = { NAM_ptn_drop_states = THIS }
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_ptn_drop_states
			NAM_ptn_lot_state_cored = yes
		}
		288 = { NAM_ptn_free_port_check = yes }
		730 = { NAM_ptn_free_port_check = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_rent value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 12
			value = NAM_ptn_loop_step
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 1 }
			NAM_ptn_lot_month = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_southern_extraction }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_rent value = 1.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_share_for_the_ninety_nine }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_rent value = 0.9 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					288 = {
						has_state_flag = NAM_ptn_free_port
						is_owned_by = NAM
					}
					730 = {
						has_state_flag = NAM_ptn_free_port
						is_owned_by = NAM
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_rent value = 10 }
		}
		round_temp_variable = NAM_ptn_rent
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_last_rent value = NAM_ptn_rent }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_rent > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_ptn_rent }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
	}
}

# STATE 288 or 730. The free port ends where NAM no longer owns the state.
NAM_ptn_free_port_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = NAM_ptn_free_port
			NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM }
		}
		clr_state_flag = NAM_ptn_free_port
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_ptn_free_port } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_ptn_free_port }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, inside NAM_ptn_monthly. Input: temp NAM_ptn_loop_lot. A district lot
# that is no longer NAM's district closes; an awarded lot adds its rent to temp
# NAM_ptn_rent: 6 a month on the union course, 8 on shares, the cadastre's bonus of
# its company and 4 for a Shahrabad lot after "Хазарская аренда"; a furnace lot 4 per
# leased furnace after "Печные дивиденды". Nothing while the owner boycotts on the
# union course.
NAM_ptn_lot_month = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_check_lot value = NAM_ptn_loop_lot }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_loop_lot = 2 }
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_loop_lot = 3 }
			}
			NAM_ptn_district_lot_lost = yes
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 4 }
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_loop_lot = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_rent_owner value = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^NAM_ptn_loop_lot }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						NAM_ptn_union_rules = yes
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_ptn_rent_owner value = -1 compare = equals }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_ptn_land_lot = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { NAM_ptn_union_rules = yes }
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_rent value = 6 }
				}
				else = {
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_rent value = 8 }
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_rent value = NAM_ptn_lot_bonus^NAM_ptn_rent_owner }
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { NAM_ptn_loop_lot < 5 }
						has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_khazar_leases
					}
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_rent value = 4 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_ptn_loop_lot = 1 }
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_shl_form = 1 }
					has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_furnace_dividends
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_furnace_lot value = NAM_ptn_loop_lot }
				NAM_ptn_count_leased_furnaces = yes
				multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_leased_count value = 4 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_rent value = NAM_ptn_leased_count }
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_ptn_furnace_lot (1-4). Output: temp
# NAM_ptn_leased_count, the furnaces of the lot still leased by Shahrabad's seal.
NAM_ptn_count_leased_furnaces = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_leased_count value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			SHL = {
				exists = yes
				is_subject_of = NAM
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_furnace_lot = 1 } }
			289 = { NAM_ptn_count_leased_site = yes }
			294 = { NAM_ptn_count_leased_site = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_furnace_lot = 2 } }
			288 = { NAM_ptn_count_leased_site = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_furnace_lot = 3 } }
			287 = { NAM_ptn_count_leased_site = yes }
			290 = { NAM_ptn_count_leased_site = yes }
			291 = { NAM_ptn_count_leased_site = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_furnace_lot = 4 } }
			292 = { NAM_ptn_count_leased_site = yes }
			293 = { NAM_ptn_count_leased_site = yes }
			295 = { NAM_ptn_count_leased_site = yes }
		}
	}
}

NAM_ptn_count_leased_site = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_owned_by = SHL
			SHL_seal_site_leased = yes
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_leased_count value = 1 }
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war - council effects -----
# COUNTRY NAM. Event 280 "Межевые камни": the two companies with the most awarded
# lots (ties to the lower number); with fewer than two lot holders the first two
# companies by votes. Output: NAM_ptn_cadastre_first, NAM_ptn_cadastre_second.
NAM_ptn_cadastre_pick = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cadastre_first value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cadastre_second value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_exclude value = 0 }
	NAM_ptn_pick_most_lots = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cadastre_first value = NAM_ptn_pick_result }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_exclude value = NAM_ptn_cadastre_first }
	NAM_ptn_pick_most_lots = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cadastre_second value = NAM_ptn_pick_result }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_cadastre_first = 0 }
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_cadastre_second = 0 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cadastre_first value = NAM_board_rank_1 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cadastre_second value = NAM_board_rank_2 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_ptn_pick_exclude. Output: temp NAM_ptn_pick_result,
# the company with most lots won (strictly more, so ties go to the lower number),
# 0 when no other company holds a lot.
NAM_ptn_pick_most_lots = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_result value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_lots value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_pick_exclude = 1 } }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lots_won^1 value = NAM_ptn_pick_lots compare = greater_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_result value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_lots value = NAM_ptn_lots_won^1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_pick_exclude = 2 } }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lots_won^2 value = NAM_ptn_pick_lots compare = greater_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_result value = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_lots value = NAM_ptn_lots_won^2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_pick_exclude = 3 } }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lots_won^3 value = NAM_ptn_pick_lots compare = greater_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_result value = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_lots value = NAM_ptn_lots_won^3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_pick_exclude = 4 } }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lots_won^4 value = NAM_ptn_pick_lots compare = greater_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_result value = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_lots value = NAM_ptn_lots_won^4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_pick_exclude = 5 } }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lots_won^5 value = NAM_ptn_pick_lots compare = greater_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_result value = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_lots value = NAM_ptn_lots_won^5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_pick_exclude = 6 } }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lots_won^6 value = NAM_ptn_pick_lots compare = greater_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_result value = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_pick_lots value = NAM_ptn_lots_won^6 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Answers b and c of event 280. Input: temp NAM_ptn_cadastre_winner
# (1 the first company, 2 the second). The winner's lots pay 3 capital a month more
# each for good, it gains 5 trust; the other loses 5 and bears a grudge.
NAM_ptn_cadastre_award = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cadastre_won value = NAM_ptn_cadastre_first }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cadastre_lost value = NAM_ptn_cadastre_second }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_cadastre_winner = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cadastre_won value = NAM_ptn_cadastre_second }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_cadastre_lost value = NAM_ptn_cadastre_first }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_cadastre_won > 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_cadastre_lost > 0 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_bonus^NAM_ptn_cadastre_won value = 3 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_grievance^NAM_ptn_cadastre_lost value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_cadastre_won }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 5 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_cadastre_lost }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -5 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Отступные" (NAM_ptn_compensate). Input: temp NAM_board_company_input. Debits 60
# capital; trust +10 and one grudge forgotten.
NAM_ptn_compensate_deliver = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_comp_company value = NAM_board_company_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -60 }
	NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_grievance^NAM_ptn_comp_company > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_grievance^NAM_ptn_comp_company value = -1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_ptn_comp_company }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 10 }
	NAM_board_support_change = yes
	NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Event 278 a: one proxy vote to every company until the next annual

NAM_hgm_heirs_spread = {

	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^2 value = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^3 value = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^4 value = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^5 value = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^6 value = 1 }
	NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Выкуп доли" (NAM_hgm_buyout) at completion. Input: temp NAM_board_company_input,
# the seller. Its lowest awarded lot passes to the first company by votes (a district
# lot with its district), else its first district; capital +80, the buyer +6, the
# seller -15. Political power is the decision's native price.
NAM_hgm_buyout_deliver = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_seller value = NAM_board_company_input }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_buyer value = NAM_board_rank_1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_seller value = NAM_hgm_buyer compare = equals } }
			check_variable = { NAM_hgm_seller > 0 }
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_perpetual_council }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_sold_lot value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 12
			value = NAM_ptn_loop_step
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = 1 }
			NAM_hgm_buyout_find_lot = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_sold_lot > 0 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^NAM_hgm_sold_lot value = NAM_hgm_buyer }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lots_won^NAM_hgm_buyer value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lots_won^NAM_hgm_seller > 0 } }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lots_won^NAM_hgm_seller value = -1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_hgm_sold_lot = 2 }
					NAM_ptn_union_rules = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_input value = NAM_hgm_sold_lot }
				NAM_ptn_save_lot_country = yes
				event_target:NAM_ptn_lot_country = { NAM_hgm_set_district_owner = yes }
			}
			# Fenn merged into the Eflor district counts only through Eflor's row, so
			# Eflor's district changes hands with the lot.
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_kind^NAM_hgm_sold_lot = 4 }
					EFL = {
						NAM_board_federal_subject = yes
						check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = NAM_hgm_seller compare = equals }
					}
				}
				EFL = { NAM_hgm_set_district_owner = yes }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_district_moved value = 0 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = NAM_federal_districts
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { NAM_hgm_district_moved = 0 }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = NAM_hgm_seller compare = equals }
						NAM_board_federal_subject = yes
					}
					NAM_hgm_set_district_owner = yes
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_district_moved value = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_buyouts_done value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 80 }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_hgm_buyer }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 6 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_hgm_seller }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -15 }
		NAM_board_support_change = yes
		NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Inputs (temp): NAM_ptn_loop_lot, NAM_hgm_seller. Output: temp
# NAM_hgm_sold_lot, the seller's lowest awarded lot.
NAM_hgm_buyout_find_lot = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_hgm_sold_lot = 0 }
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_ptn_loop_lot = 2 }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^NAM_ptn_loop_lot value = NAM_hgm_seller compare = equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_sold_lot value = NAM_ptn_loop_lot }
	}
}

# COUNTRY district. Input: temp NAM_hgm_buyer. The bought district keeps its new
# owner for good.
NAM_hgm_set_district_owner = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_corp_district_owner value = NAM_hgm_buyer }
	set_country_flag = NAM_hgm_owner_fixed
	NAM_corp_district_apply = yes
}

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war - paid decisions -----
# Each paid decision debits its price once in its pay effect and keeps the receipt
# named there; delivery rechecks the target and refunds on failure; cancellation and
# NAM_hgm_close call the refund. Political power is never refunded.

# COUNTRY NAM. "Подряды печных домов": 40 capital.
NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_pay = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -40 }
	NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_paid value = 40 }
}

NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_deliver = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_paid }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_board_operable = yes
				SHL = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject_of = NAM
					has_country_flag = SHL_seal_chapter_open
				}
			}
			clear_variable = NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_paid
			SHL = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = SHL_cold_heat_delta value = -10 }
				SHL_cold_add_heat = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 2 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_refund = yes
		}
	}
}

NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_paid }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_paid }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		clear_variable = NAM_hgm_furnace_contracts_paid
	}
}

# Completion: the regiment forms at the first state of the company's lots that NAM
# controls, else at the harbour, in the company's colours.
NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_deliver = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_regiment_company }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_board_operable = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick value = NAM_hgm_regiment_company }
			clear_variable = NAM_hgm_regiment_company
			NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_site = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_kind value = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_count value = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_company value = NAM_hgm_pick }
			NAM_mdr_place_division = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_lot_regiments^NAM_hgm_pick value = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_hgm_pick }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 3 }
			NAM_board_support_change = yes
			NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
		}
		else = {
			NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_refund = yes
		}
	}
}

NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_regiment_company }
		clear_variable = NAM_hgm_regiment_company
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 40 }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		add_manpower = 4900
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = infantry_equipment
			amount = 4410
			producer = NAM
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_hgm_pick (company). Output: temp NAM_mdr_unit_state,
# the first conquered state of an awarded lot of that company NAM controls (0 the
# harbour).
NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_site = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_state value = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_ptn_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_mdr_unit_state = 0 }
				is_owned_by = NAM
				is_controlled_by = NAM
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_site_lot value = NAM_ptn_lot }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NAM = {
						check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^NAM_hgm_site_lot = 2 }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^NAM_hgm_site_lot value = NAM_hgm_pick compare = equals }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_state value = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY target of "Заём за морем", ROOT NAM: 80 capital now, 100 back after
# 365 days (125 after "Хазарский банк") while the debtor exists and is not at war
# with NAM (NAM_hgm_loans_monthly).
NAM_hgm_open_loan = {
	NAM = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -80 }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		add_to_array = { array = NAM_hgm_loans value = PREV }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_due value = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_due value = 365 }
		add_to_array = { array = NAM_hgm_loan_due value = NAM_hgm_due }
	}
	add_opinion_modifier = {
		target = NAM
		modifier = NAM_hgm_loan_goodwill
	}
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

	set_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_export_paid value = 15000 }
}

# COUNTRY target of NAM_hgm_arms_credit_sale, ROOT NAM: 6000 rifles and 48 guns sent
# now, 120 capital back after 180 days while the buyer exists (NAM_hgm_loans_monthly).
NAM_hgm_open_credit = {
	NAM = {
		send_equipment = {
			equipment = infantry_equipment
			amount = 6000
			target = PREV
		}
		send_equipment = {
			equipment = artillery_equipment
			amount = 48
			target = PREV
		}
		add_to_array = { array = NAM_hgm_credits value = PREV }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_due value = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_due value = 180 }
		add_to_array = { array = NAM_hgm_credit_due value = NAM_hgm_due }
	}
	add_opinion_modifier = {
		target = NAM
		modifier = NAM_hgm_credit_goodwill
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Поставки коалиции". Input: temp NAM_hgm_supply_kind (1 10000
# fuel, 2 5000 rifles). The goods are held until delivery.
NAM_hgm_supply_pay = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_supply_paid value = NAM_hgm_supply_kind }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_supply_kind = 1 } }
		add_fuel = -10000
	}
	else = {
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = infantry_equipment
			amount = -5000
			producer = NAM
		}
	}
}

# Completion, in the target's scope (ROOT NAM): the goods reach a coalition member
# still at war with the Khan and not with NAM; capital +90, opinion +20, and Loren
# (fuel) or Arktur (rifles) +2.
NAM_hgm_supply_deliver = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_supply_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_war_with = RUS
				NOT = { has_war_with = NAM }
				NAM = { NAM_board_operable = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NAM = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_supply_paid = 1 } } }
				add_fuel = 10000
				NAM = { set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_1 value = 2 } }
			}
			else = {
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment
					amount = 5000
					producer = NAM
				}
				NAM = { set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = 2 } }
			}
			add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = NAM
				modifier = NAM_hgm_supply_goodwill
			}
			NAM = {
				clear_variable = NAM_hgm_supply_paid
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 90 }
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
				NAM_board_trust_package = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			NAM = { NAM_hgm_supply_refund = yes }
		}
	}
}

NAM_hgm_supply_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_supply_paid }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_supply_paid = 1 } }
			add_fuel = 10000
		}
		else = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 5000
				producer = NAM
			}
		}
		clear_variable = NAM_hgm_supply_paid
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, monthly from NAM_corp_monthly. Loans and arms credits come due (one of
# each a month, oldest first), Shahrabad's bonds of "Гроссбух гегемона" pay 12 a
# month and the hegemon's tribute 10 (15 for Loren's concession) until their end day.
NAM_hgm_loans_monthly = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_due_break value = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = NAM_hgm_loans
		index = NAM_hgm_loan_index
		value = NAM_hgm_loan_debtor
		break = NAM_hgm_due_break
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_loan_due^NAM_hgm_loan_index value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:NAM_hgm_loan_debtor = {
						exists = yes
						NOT = { has_war_with = NAM }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 100 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_bank_of_the_south }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 125 }
				}
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			}
			remove_from_array = { array = NAM_hgm_loans index = NAM_hgm_loan_index }
			remove_from_array = { array = NAM_hgm_loan_due index = NAM_hgm_loan_index }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_due_break value = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_due_break value = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = NAM_hgm_credits
		index = NAM_hgm_credit_index
		value = NAM_hgm_credit_buyer
		break = NAM_hgm_due_break
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_credit_due^NAM_hgm_credit_index value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:NAM_hgm_credit_buyer = { exists = yes } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 120 }
				NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
			}
			remove_from_array = { array = NAM_hgm_credits index = NAM_hgm_credit_index }
			remove_from_array = { array = NAM_hgm_credit_due index = NAM_hgm_credit_index }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_due_break value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_bonds_until }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = NAM_hgm_bonds_until compare = less_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 12 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			clear_variable = NAM_hgm_bonds_until
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_tribute_until }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = NAM_hgm_tribute_until compare = less_than }
				has_variable = NAM_hgm_price_debtor
				var:NAM_hgm_price_debtor = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { has_war_with = NAM }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 10 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_price_demand = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 15 }
			}
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			clear_variable = NAM_hgm_tribute_until
			clear_variable = NAM_hgm_price_debtor
			clear_variable = NAM_hgm_price_demand
		}
	}
}

# NAM, from hegemons_price. The debtor is the buyer of the oldest open arms credit
# that can still answer, else a sovereign member of the coalition against the Khan
# at war with RUS. Both arrays are short; no world scan. Leaves NAM_hgm_price_debtor
# unset when nobody qualifies.
NAM_hgm_pick_debtor = {
	clear_variable = NAM_hgm_price_debtor
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_debtor_found value = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_hgm_credits
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_hgm_debtor_found = 0 }
				NAM_hgm_debtor_eligible = yes
			}
			NAM = { set_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_price_debtor value = PREV } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_debtor_found value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_debtor_found = 0 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.RUS_crisis_defenders
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_hgm_debtor_found = 0 }
					NAM_hgm_debtor_eligible = yes
					is_subject = no
					has_war_with = RUS
				}
				NAM = { set_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_price_debtor value = PREV } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_debtor_found value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# NAM, from each answer of event 276 after NAM_hgm_price_demand is set. The letter
# goes to the debtor while it can answer; a debtor gone or at war in the meantime
# leaves the focus's fallback sum instead.
NAM_hgm_send_price = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = NAM_hgm_price_debtor
			var:NAM_hgm_price_debtor = { NAM_hgm_debtor_eligible = yes }
		}
		var:NAM_hgm_price_debtor = { country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.277 days = 3 } }
	}
	else = {
		clear_variable = NAM_hgm_price_debtor
		clear_variable = NAM_hgm_price_demand
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 150 }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	}
}

# NAM, from the refusal of event 277. The debtor's open arms credit, if it has one,
# is struck from the books with its due day, so the settlement never pays it.
NAM_hgm_forfeit_credit = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_credit_break value = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = NAM_hgm_credits
		index = NAM_hgm_credit_index
		value = NAM_hgm_credit_buyer
		break = NAM_hgm_credit_break
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_credit_buyer = NAM_hgm_price_debtor } }
			remove_from_array = { array = NAM_hgm_credits index = NAM_hgm_credit_index }
			remove_from_array = { array = NAM_hgm_credit_due index = NAM_hgm_credit_index }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_credit_break value = 1 }
		}
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_hgm_price_debtor
	clear_variable = NAM_hgm_price_demand
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Полки правлений на юге": one Company Guard Regiment for each of the
# three companies with the most awarded South lots (NAM_ptn_lots_won, ties to the
# lower company number), in the company's colours, at the first state of its lots
# that NAM controls; district and furnace lots have no such state, so their
# regiment forms at the harbour (NAM_mdr_place_division's fallback). Each regiment
# counts in NAM_hgm_lot_regiments^<company> for "Полк лота".
NAM_hgm_raise_lot_regiments = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_1 value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_2 value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_round value = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 1
		end = 4
		value = NAM_hgm_loop_step
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_round value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_lots value = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_company value = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 1
			end = 7
			value = NAM_hgm_loop_inner
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_company value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lots_won^NAM_hgm_pick_company value = NAM_hgm_pick_lots compare = greater_than }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_company value = NAM_hgm_pick_1 compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_company value = NAM_hgm_pick_2 compare = equals } }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick value = NAM_hgm_pick_company }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_lots value = NAM_ptn_lots_won^NAM_hgm_pick_company }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_pick > 0 } }
			NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_site = yes
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_kind value = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_count value = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_company value = NAM_hgm_pick }
			NAM_mdr_place_division = yes
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_lot_regiments^NAM_hgm_pick value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_pick_round = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_1 value = NAM_hgm_pick }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_pick_round = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_pick_2 value = NAM_hgm_pick }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war - the finals -----
# COUNTRY NAM. "Лига округов": every operating district keeps its owner for good and
# moves to the oil charter (its recruits stay home); the ruling party becomes "Лига
# правлений" and the chair the league's arbiter.
NAM_hgm_apply_league = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = NAM_federal_districts
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_board_operating_district = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = NAM_corp_district_owner }
				set_country_flag = NAM_hgm_owner_fixed
			}
			NAM = {
				set_autonomy = {
					target = PREV
					autonomy_state = autonomy_NAM_oil_charter
					freedom_level = 0.40
					end_wars = no
					end_civil_wars = no
				}
			}
			ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		}
	}
	set_party_name = {
		ideology = technocracy
		name = NAM_hgm_party_league
		long_name = NAM_hgm_party_league_long
	}
	# The final's own completion is not yet set inside its reward, so the sync
	# below cannot see it here.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_leader_with_trait = NAM_trait_arbiter_of_the_league } }
		add_country_leader_trait = NAM_trait_arbiter_of_the_league
	}
	NAM_hgm_sync_chair_traits = yes
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Акции девяноста девяти": the ruling party becomes "Народный реестр";
# the people's four votes are read through the completion.
NAM_hgm_apply_people = {

		add_country_leader_trait = NAM_trait_trustee_of_the_register
	}
	NAM_hgm_sync_chair_traits = yes
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. "Вечный совет шести": every district keeps its owner for good; the
