# COUNTRY NAM. "Одно правление": the first company by votes becomes the holding of
# the five (NAM_hgm_holding); the ruling party takes its name. The council stays the
# player: the holding commands the five only while it trusts the council.
NAM_hgm_apply_one_board = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_holding value = NAM_board_rank_1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_holding = 1 } }
		set_party_name = {
			ideology = technocracy
			name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_1
			long_name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_1_long
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_holding = 2 } }
		set_party_name = {
			ideology = technocracy
			name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_2
			long_name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_2_long
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_holding = 3 } }
		set_party_name = {
			ideology = technocracy
			name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_3
			long_name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_3_long
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_holding = 4 } }
		set_party_name = {
			ideology = technocracy
			name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_4
			long_name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_4_long
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_holding = 5 } }
		set_party_name = {
			ideology = technocracy
			name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_5
			long_name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_5_long
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_party_name = {
			ideology = technocracy
			name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_6
			long_name = NAM_hgm_party_one_board_6_long
		}
	}
	NAM_hgm_sync_chair_traits = yes
	NAM_board_queue_recount = yes
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM, from the finals and NAM_board_install_chairman after a promotion. The
# chair carries the trait of the final taken; the owner's trait stays only while the
# holding's head chairs.
NAM_hgm_sync_chair_traits = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_league_of_districts
			NOT = { has_country_leader_with_trait = NAM_trait_arbiter_of_the_league }
		}
		add_country_leader_trait = NAM_trait_arbiter_of_the_league
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_shares_of_the_ninety_nine
			NOT = { has_country_leader_with_trait = NAM_trait_trustee_of_the_register }
		}
		add_country_leader_trait = NAM_trait_trustee_of_the_register
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_perpetual_council
			NOT = { has_country_leader_with_trait = NAM_trait_chair_of_the_perpetual_council }
		}
		add_country_leader_trait = NAM_trait_chair_of_the_perpetual_council
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = NAM_hgm_holding
			check_variable = { var = NAM_board_chair value = NAM_hgm_holding compare = equals }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_leader_with_trait = NAM_trait_owner_of_the_directory } }
			add_country_leader_trait = NAM_trait_owner_of_the_directory
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_leader_with_trait = NAM_trait_owner_of_the_directory }
		remove_country_leader_trait = NAM_trait_owner_of_the_directory
	}
}

# an empty slot.

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war - development trade -----
# COUNTRY NAM. "Акции девяноста девяти": the economy pays a level for the society;
# at the society's cap the society takes one run of its programme instead. At
# economic level 1 the drop costs its progress, as the council's other trades do.
NAM_hgm_trade_economic_for_society = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_society_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_trade_economic_for_society_capped_tt
		hidden_effect = { ADISCORD_programme_society_development = yes }
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_trade_economic_for_society_tt
		hidden_effect = { NAM_hgm_dev_raise_society = yes }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		NAM_hgm_dev_lower_economic = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

NAM_hgm_dev_raise_society = {
	ADISCORD_initialize_society_development_variables = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_society_development_progress value = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_society_development_progress value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { ADISCORD_society_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_development_remainder value = ADISCORD_society_development_progress }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_development_remainder value = -100 }
		ADISCORD_increase_society_development = yes
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_society_development_progress value = ADISCORD_development_remainder }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_society_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_society_development_progress value = 0 }
	}
}

# The level setter clears progress, so the kept progress is restored after the drop.
NAM_hgm_dev_lower_economic = {
	ADISCORD_initialize_society_development_variables = yes
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_economic_development_at_least_2 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_dev_kept value = ADISCORD_economic_development_progress }
		ADISCORD_decrease_economic_development = yes
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economic_development_progress value = NAM_board_dev_kept }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economic_development_progress value = 0 }
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the South after the war (end) -----

# ----- Radical exploitation of the conquered south -----
# STATE. The council's guarantees survive the district changing hands again.
NAM_rad_devolve_district = {
	set_state_flag = NAM_rad_local_council
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_rad_command_post } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_rad_command_post }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_conquered_state_modifier } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_conquered_state_modifier }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_labour_camp_state } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_labour_camp_state }
	}
	NAM = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
}

# STATE conquered, the end of NAM_radical_labour_camp: forced labour extracts
# the state's resources for Svetlogorye and nothing is built there.
NAM_radical_open_labour_camp = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = NAM_labour_camp_building
			NAM = { NAM_country_operable = yes }
			NAM_rad_held_direct_district = yes
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_labour_camp_state } }
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_labour_camp_state }
	}
	clr_state_flag = NAM_labour_camp_building
}

# STATE conquered, NAM_radical_strip_state. One civilian and one military
# factory are dismantled when present and their worth goes to Svetlogorye;
# the stores are requisitioned and the state yields less for a year.
NAM_radical_strip = {
	set_state_flag = NAM_state_stripped
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_strip_treasury value = 80 }
	if = {
		limit = { industrial_complex > 0 }
		remove_building = {
			type = industrial_complex
			level = 1
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_strip_treasury value = 120 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { arms_factory > 0 }
		remove_building = {
			type = arms_factory
			level = 1
		}
		NAM = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 1500 producer = NAM }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment amount = 100 producer = NAM }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = artillery_equipment amount = 40 producer = NAM }
		}
	}
	add_dynamic_modifier = {
		modifier = NAM_stripped_state
		days = 365
	}
	NAM = {
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = NAM_strip_treasury }
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
		add_fuel = 1000
	}
}

# ----- Notes of Egor Rom -----
# COUNTRY NAM. Hidden dispatcher .99: one chapter every 90 days for a human
# player; an AI-held Svetlogorye skips the chapter. Five chapters at most.
# The notes are Rom's own voice: the chain runs while he lives as a character of
# Svetlogorye, whoever rules. Stepping down keeps him; death or retirement ends it.
NAM_memoir_dispatch = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_character = NAM_Egor_Rom }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				NAM_country_operable = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_memoir_next = 1 } }
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_memoir.1 hours = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_memoir_next = 2 } }
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_memoir.2 hours = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_memoir_next = 3 } }
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_memoir.3 hours = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_memoir_next = 4 } }
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_memoir.4 hours = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_memoir_next = 5 } }
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_memoir.5 hours = 1 }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_memoir_next value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_memoir_next < 6 } }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_memoir.99 days = 90 }
		}
	}
}

# ----- Island exile: piracy -----
# NAM_pirate_loot is the exile's plunder: it buys arms, drill and marines or is
# fenced for treasury. NAM_pirate_notoriety (0-100) is the
# coalition's attention: raids raise it, each month lowers it by 3, and from 50
# the coalition answers with a blockade or, from 75, a punitive raid on the
# islands. NAM_revenge_readiness (0-100) is the preparation for the return; at
# 70 the landing at the South Harbour takes a third division.

# COUNTRY NAM. Preserve any landing readiness earned during the evacuation.
NAM_exile_prepare_landing = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_revenge_readiness } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_marine_order_cap } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_marine_order_cap value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_marine_orders_paid } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_marine_orders_paid value = 0 }
	}
	NAM_revenge_readiness_clamp = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every writer of notoriety calls this clamp.
NAM_pirate_notoriety_clamp = {
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_pirate_notoriety
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every writer of revenge readiness calls this clamp.
NAM_revenge_readiness_clamp = {
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_revenge_readiness
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_board_expedition_planning value = NAM_revenge_readiness }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_board_expedition_planning value = 100 }
		divide_variable = { var = NAM_board_expedition_planning value = 1000 }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_pirate_loot_change (negative spends).
NAM_pirate_loot_add = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_pirate_loot_change }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_loot value = NAM_pirate_loot_change }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = NAM_pirate_loot
			min = 0
			max = 100000
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_pirate_notoriety_change; raids on lanes of
# Eflor and Azhar count more through the callers.
NAM_pirate_notoriety_add = {
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_notoriety value = NAM_pirate_notoriety_change }
	NAM_pirate_notoriety_clamp = yes
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Input: temp NAM_pirate_lane_input, the lane of the settling
# raid (1 oil run, 2 northern coast, 3 Luren strait, 4 Charden crossing).
# Saves the lane's owners that may still be raided as NAM_pirate_victim_a and
# NAM_pirate_victim_b and sets the temps NAM_pirate_victims (their number),
# NAM_pirate_coalition_hit (Eflor or Azhar among them) and
# NAM_pirate_lane_alerted (an owner still on guard). The owners match the
# NAM_pirate_lane_<id>_open triggers.
NAM_pirate_save_lane_victims = {
	set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_coalition_hit = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_alerted = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_input = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { EFL = { NAM_pirate_victim_valid = yes } }
			EFL = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_a }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_coalition_hit = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { AZH = { NAM_pirate_victim_valid = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 0 } }
				AZH = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_a }
			}
			else = {
				AZH = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_b }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_coalition_hit = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_pirate_lane_oil_alert = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_alerted = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_input = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { RIV = { NAM_pirate_victim_valid = yes } }
			RIV = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_a }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { EFL = { NAM_pirate_victim_valid = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 0 } }
				EFL = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_a }
			}
			else = {
				EFL = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_b }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_coalition_hit = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_pirate_lane_coast_alert = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_alerted = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_input = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { ULV = { NAM_pirate_victim_valid = yes } }
			ULV = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_a }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { LUR = { NAM_pirate_victim_valid = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 0 } }
				LUR = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_a }
			}
			else = {
				LUR = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_b }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_pirate_lane_strait_alert = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_alerted = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_input = 4 } }
		if = {
			limit = { CHD = { NAM_pirate_victim_valid = yes } }
			CHD = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_a }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
				RIV = { NAM_pirate_victim_valid = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 0 } }
				RIV = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_a }
			}
			else = {
				RIV = { save_event_target_as = NAM_pirate_victim_b }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_pirate_lane_crossing_alert = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_alerted = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, the end of a paid lane raid; the decision has cleared its
# receipt. Input: temp NAM_pirate_lane_input. The outcome is rolled once: a
# haul (50), a rich prize (15) or a failure (35). More ships, owners off guard
# and low notoriety favour the flotilla; the oil run's tankers make the richest
# prizes. A lane whose owners have all gone or become friends returns the fuel.
# The settlement only changes the owners' fuel, flags and opinion and sends an
# event to human owners alone, so a suppressed minor needs no waking.
NAM_pirate_raid_settle = {
	subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_raids_active value = 1 }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_pirate_raids_active
		min = 0
		max = 3
	}
	NAM_pirate_save_lane_victims = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims = 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_open_fuel_reserve value = 1000 }
		NAM_open_fuel_release = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_lane value = NAM_pirate_lane_input }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_victims value = NAM_pirate_victims }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_loot value = 0 }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_loss value = 0 }
		random_list = {
			50 = {
				modifier = {
					factor = 1.2
					check_variable = { var = num_ships value = 2 compare = greater_than }
				}
				modifier = {
					factor = 1.2
					check_variable = { var = num_ships value = 5 compare = greater_than }
				}
				modifier = {
					factor = 0.6
					check_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_alerted = 1 }
				}
				modifier = {
					factor = 0.7
					has_idea = NAM_pirate_blockade
				}
				modifier = {
					factor = 0.8
					check_variable = { NAM_pirate_notoriety > 59 }
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_result value = 1 }
				NAM_pirate_raid_success = yes
			}
			15 = {
				modifier = {
					factor = 1.5
					check_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_input = 1 }
				}
				modifier = {
					factor = 0.6
					check_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_alerted = 1 }
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_result value = 2 }
				NAM_pirate_raid_prize = yes
			}
			35 = {
				modifier = {
					factor = 0.7
					check_variable = { var = num_ships value = 5 compare = greater_than }
				}
				modifier = {
					factor = 1.3
					has_idea = NAM_pirate_blockade
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_result value = 0 }
				NAM_pirate_raid_failure = yes
			}
		}
		event_target:NAM_pirate_victim_a = { NAM_pirate_mark_victim = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims > 1 } }
			event_target:NAM_pirate_victim_b = { NAM_pirate_mark_victim = yes }
		}
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][PIRACY] Raid on lane [?NAM_pirate_last_lane] against [NAM_pirate_victim_a.GetTag] and [?NAM_pirate_last_victims|0] owner(s): result [?NAM_pirate_last_result], loot [?NAM_pirate_last_loot], notoriety [?NAM_pirate_notoriety]."
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.90 hours = 1 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY owner of a raided lane: on guard for 90 days, protests to
# Svetlogorye and, when human, learns who took its convoy.
NAM_pirate_mark_victim = {
	set_country_flag = {
		flag = NAM_pirate_alert
		value = 1
		days = 90
	}
	add_opinion_modifier = {
		target = NAM
		modifier = protest_action
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.91 hours = 1 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. An interrupted paid raid returns its fuel and frees the
# flotilla; political power stays spent. The decision clears its receipt.
NAM_pirate_raid_release = {
	subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_raids_active value = 1 }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = NAM_pirate_raids_active
		min = 0
		max = 3
	}
	add_to_variable = { var = NAM_open_fuel_reserve value = 1000 }
	NAM_open_fuel_release = yes
}

# A haul from the convoys: 50 loot (60 when Eflor's or Azhar's convoys sail the
# lane) and 1000 fuel; the owners lose 2000 fuel between them.
NAM_pirate_raid_success = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_loot_change value = 50 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_notoriety_change value = 6 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_coalition_hit = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_loot_change value = 60 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_notoriety_change value = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_loot value = NAM_pirate_loot_change }
	NAM_pirate_loot_add = yes
	NAM_pirate_notoriety_add = yes
	add_fuel = 1000
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims > 1 } }
		event_target:NAM_pirate_victim_a = { add_fuel = -1000 }
		event_target:NAM_pirate_victim_b = { add_fuel = -1000 }
	}
	else = {
		event_target:NAM_pirate_victim_a = { add_fuel = -2000 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Captured cargo goes to the raider; the fuel loss is shared
# between the route owners recorded when the flotilla sailed.
NAM_pirate_raid_prize = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_loot_change value = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_notoriety_change value = 8 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_coalition_hit = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_notoriety_change value = 12 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_loot value = NAM_pirate_loot_change }
	NAM_pirate_loot_add = yes
	NAM_pirate_notoriety_add = yes
	add_fuel = 2000
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 9000 producer = NAM }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = convoy_1 amount = 3 producer = NAM }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_victims > 1 } }
		event_target:NAM_pirate_victim_a = { add_fuel = -1500 }
		event_target:NAM_pirate_victim_b = { add_fuel = -1500 }
	}
	else = {
		event_target:NAM_pirate_victim_a = { add_fuel = -3000 }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The convoy was escorted: a patrol ship is sunk or, without
# one, 1000 sailors are taken prisoner.
NAM_pirate_raid_failure = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_notoriety_change value = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_coalition_hit = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_notoriety_change value = 5 }
	}
	NAM_pirate_notoriety_add = yes
	random_list = {
		50 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NOT = {
					has_navy_size = {
						size > 0
						unit = ADISCORD_coastal_patrol_vessel
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_loss value = 1 }
			destroy_ships = {
				type = ADISCORD_coastal_patrol_ship
				count = 1
			}
		}
		50 = {
			set_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_last_loss value = 2 }
			add_manpower = -1000
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The coalition's blockade lasts 90 days; a new one restarts it.
NAM_pirate_apply_blockade = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_pirate_blockade }
		remove_ideas = NAM_pirate_blockade
	}
	add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_pirate_blockade days = 90 }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every option of a retaliation event ends with this call.
NAM_pirate_close_event = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_pirate_event_pending
}

# COUNTRY NAM. on_monthly_NAM in exile: notoriety fades by 3; from 50 the
# coalition may answer once in 120 days, with a blockade (event .92) or, from
# 75, a punitive raid on the islands (event .93). Fixed tags only.
NAM_pirate_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NAM_piracy_open = yes
				NAM_pirate_commissioned = yes
			}
			NAM_country_operable = yes
			has_variable = NAM_pirate_notoriety
		}
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_notoriety value = -3 }
		NAM_pirate_notoriety_clamp = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_piracy_open = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
				check_variable = { NAM_pirate_notoriety > 49 }
				has_war = no
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_pirate_retaliation_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_pirate_event_pending }
				OR = {
					EFL = { exists = yes }
					AZH = { exists = yes }
				}
			}
			random_list = {
				60 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0.5
						check_variable = { NAM_pirate_notoriety > 74 }
					}
				}
				40 = {
					set_country_flag = {
						flag = NAM_pirate_retaliation_cooldown
						value = 1
						days = 120
					}
					set_country_flag = {
						flag = NAM_pirate_event_pending
						value = 1
						days = 30
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pirate_notoriety > 74 } }
						country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.93 hours = 6 }
					}
					else = {
						country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.92 hours = 6 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. NAM_exile_drill was interrupted: the deposit returns in the
# currency the course paid with.
NAM_exile_drill_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_exile_drill_deposit value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_exile_drill_deposit }
		NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_exile_drill_deposit
}

# ----- Island exile: marines and the revenge landing -----
# A marine order debits 50 loot and 4300 recruits once; NAM_marine_orders_paid
# is the escrow. Before the war of return an order may be released with both
# returned. The landing at the South Harbour delivers every paid order.

# COUNTRY NAM. The marine programme and its fixed template. The template is
# locked while orders can be placed and unlocked by the landing or a release.
NAM_marine_ensure_template = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_tech = ADISCORD_tech_svetlogorsk_marine_corps } }
		set_technology = {
			ADISCORD_tech_svetlogorsk_marine_corps = 1
			popup = no
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Island Marines" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Island Marines"
			override_model = ADISCORD_NAM_marine_entity
			template_counter = 34
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			is_locked = yes
			regiments = {
				ADISCORD_marine_infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				ADISCORD_marine_infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				ADISCORD_marine_infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				ADISCORD_marine_infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
			}
			support = {
				engineer = { x = 0 y = 0 }
			}
		}
		set_division_force_allow_recruiting = {
			division_template = "Island Marines"
			force_allow_recruiting = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The template stays fixed while another paid order is possible.
NAM_marine_unlock_template = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_template = "Island Marines"
			NAM_marine_orders_open = no
		}
		set_division_template_lock = {
			division_template = "Island Marines"
			is_locked = no
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Release before the war of return: the recruits and the price
# return in the currency the course paid with - 50 loot under the junta, 60
# corporate capital under the humanists.
NAM_marine_orders_refund = {
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][MARINES] Refund of [?NAM_marine_orders_paid] marine orders."
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_marine_orders_paid > 0 } }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_marine_orders_paid value = 1 }
		add_manpower = 4300
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_marine_loot_orders > 0 } }
			subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_marine_loot_orders value = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_loot_change value = 50 }
			NAM_pirate_loot_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 50 }
			NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
		}
	}
	set_variable = { var = NAM_marine_orders_paid value = 0 }
	NAM_marine_unlock_template = yes
}

# COUNTRY coalition leader. The quartermasters can divert only equipment still in reserve.
NAM_hum_divert_return_supplies = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hum_diverted_rifles value = num_equipment@infantry_equipment }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hum_diverted_rifles value = 0.25 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hum_diverted_rifles min = 0 max = 1000 }
	round_temp_variable = NAM_hum_diverted_rifles
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hum_diverted_rifles > 0 } }
		send_equipment = {
			equipment = infantry_equipment
			amount = NAM_hum_diverted_rifles
			target = NAM
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hum_diverted_trucks value = num_equipment@motorized_equipment }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hum_diverted_trucks value = 0.25 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hum_diverted_trucks min = 0 max = 100 }
	round_temp_variable = NAM_hum_diverted_trucks
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_hum_diverted_trucks > 0 } }
		send_equipment = {
			equipment = motorized_equipment
			amount = NAM_hum_diverted_trucks
			target = NAM
		}
	}
	log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][RETURN] [This.GetTag] depot crews diverted [?NAM_hum_diverted_rifles] rifles and [?NAM_hum_diverted_trucks] trucks to Svetlogorye."
}

# COUNTRY NAM, NAM_war_of_return_start after the declaration, from the island
# exile only. create_unit refuses a province held by the enemy, so the landing
# first takes a beachhead: hostile armies in the South Harbour (province 16716
# is the harbour province of state 700) fall back to their capitals and
# Svetlogorye becomes its controller. Two marine divisions land there, a third
# with a trained order or a revenge readiness of 70. Further trained orders
# form on the island capital, and so does the whole landing when the harbour's
# controller is not at war with Svetlogorye. Only the council's southern rising
# (NAM_board_harbour_rising_ready, read before NAM_board_cells_rise spends the
# cells) lands those orders at the harbour instead. The beachhead is ordinary control and awards nothing by itself:
# the harbour returns only with the capitulation of its owner. Every trained
# order is delivered here. The delivery receipt prevents a renewed war from
# creating the expedition again, including when the first landing used no orders.
NAM_wor_revenge_landing = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_island_exile
			NOT = { has_variable = NAM_marines_orders_delivered }
		}
		NAM_marine_ensure_template = yes
		set_variable = { var = NAM_marines_orders_delivered value = NAM_marine_orders_paid }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_hum_government_operable = yes
				has_completed_focus = NAM_hum_split_coalition
				has_event_target = NAM_wor_primary
			}
			event_target:NAM_wor_primary = { NAM_hum_divert_return_supplies = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_marines_landed value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_landing_third_division = yes }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_marines_landed value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_marine_orders_paid > 0 }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = 70 compare = less_than }
				}
				subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_marine_orders_paid value = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_marines_island value = NAM_marine_orders_paid }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_landing_at_harbour value = 0 }
		# A participant invited by add_to_war in the same effect may not show the
		# war relation yet; its membership flag marks it as the enemy already.
		if = {
			limit = {
				700 = {
					controller = {
						OR = {
							has_war_with = NAM
							has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
						}
					}
				}
			}
			700 = {
				teleport_armies = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_war_with = NAM
							has_country_flag = NAM_wor_participant
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_province_controller = 16716
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_landing_at_harbour value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { 700 = { is_controlled_by = NAM } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_landing_at_harbour value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_landing_at_harbour = 0 } }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_marines_island value = NAM_marines_landed }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_marines_landed value = 0 }
		}
		# The council's southern rising holds the harbour: every trained order
		# lands there as well.
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { NAM_landing_at_harbour > 0 }
				NAM_board_harbour_rising_ready = yes
			}
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_marines_landed value = NAM_marines_island }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_marines_island value = 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_landing_index value = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_landing_index value = NAM_marines_landed compare = less_than } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_landing_index value = 1 }
			700 = {
				create_unit = {
					division = "division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.30 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
					owner = NAM
					prioritize_location = 16716
					allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_landing_index value = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_landing_index value = NAM_marines_island compare = less_than } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_landing_index value = 1 }
			capital_scope = {
				create_unit = {
					division = "division_template = \"Island Marines\" start_experience_factor = 0.30 start_equipment_factor = 1.0 start_manpower_factor = 1.0"
					owner = NAM
					allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_marine_orders_paid value = 0 }
		clear_variable = NAM_marine_loot_orders
		NAM_marine_unlock_template = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_landing_harbour_held value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { controls_state = 700 }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_landing_harbour_held value = 1 }
		}
		log = "[ADISCORD][NAM][MARINES] Revenge landing: beachhead [?NAM_landing_at_harbour], harbour held [?NAM_landing_harbour_held]; [?NAM_marines_landed] divisions at the South Harbour, [?NAM_marines_island] on the island capital, [?NAM_marines_orders_delivered] trained orders delivered."
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_landing_at_harbour = 1 } }
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.94 hours = 2 }
		}
	}
}

# ----- Post-war republic: laws -----
# COUNTRY NAM. One enactment per post-war law, called once by its focus as the first native row
# of the reward. The law the slot holds is swapped out visibly, whichever law the campaign left
# there (the history law, another post-war law of the slot or a council law), so the native line
# shows what the republic gives up; the else branch covers an empty slot.
# The economic-system laws also set ADISCORD_economy_model: the economy reads only the listed
# system laws and keeps the last model otherwise (3 state-coordinated, 2 mixed).
NAM_pw_enact_rail_echelons = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ADISCORD_logistics_centralized_depots }
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = ADISCORD_logistics_centralized_depots add_idea = NAM_pw_law_rail_echelons }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ADISCORD_logistics_local_foraging }
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = ADISCORD_logistics_local_foraging add_idea = NAM_pw_law_rail_echelons }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ADISCORD_logistics_civilian_contracts }
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = ADISCORD_logistics_civilian_contracts add_idea = NAM_pw_law_rail_echelons }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = ADISCORD_logistics_motorized_supply }

	else_if = {

		limit = { has_idea = NAM_pw_law_cabinet_decrees }
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = NAM_pw_law_cabinet_decrees add_idea = NAM_pw_law_public_accounts }
	}
	else = {
		add_ideas = NAM_pw_law_public_accounts
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_pw_law_lock_tt
}

# ----- Post-war republic: southern war hand-over -----
# COUNTRY NAM. Called once at the start of the war for the South, before the war tree replaces
# the post-war tree, so the completed lane ends are still readable. The staff plan comes from
# the answer of ADISCORD_nam_story.312 (1 furnaces, 2 coast, 3 line; an unanswered event
# counts as 1). The variable is kept, so a war restarted after a repelled one installs the same
# plan again. The has_idea guards make a repeated call add nothing while a spirit runs.
# ADISCORD_south_close_member_state removes all four spirits when the war ends.
NAM_pw_south_war_handover = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_pw_southern_operations
			NOT = { has_idea = NAM_pw_south_plan_furnaces }
			NOT = { has_idea = NAM_pw_south_plan_coast }
			NOT = { has_idea = NAM_pw_south_plan_line }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pw_operations_plan = 2 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_pw_south_plan_coast days = 120 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pw_operations_plan = 3 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_pw_south_plan_line days = 120 }
		}
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_pw_south_plan_furnaces days = 120 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_pw_industrial_sites
			NOT = { has_idea = NAM_pw_war_conversion }
		}
		add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_pw_war_conversion days = 180 }
	}
}
# ----- Post-war republic: southern war hand-over (end) -----

# ----- Post-war republic: development trades -----
# COUNTRY NAM. A trade of the post-war tree moves 100 progress from one development track to
# another; each key is called by one focus of a course. The raised track checks its level at once
# (economic through the shared economy upgrade gate); at level 5 the republic takes 250
# treasury instead. The lowered track drops one level and keeps its progress; at level 1 it
# loses its progress and, once per campaign and track, one point of monthly growth.
# Society and social system reuse the council's lowering primitives and their cut flags: the
# corporate council and the post-war republic never share a campaign.
NAM_pw_trade_social_system_for_army = {
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_army_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_pw_trade_social_system_for_army_capped_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 250 }
			NAM_add_treasury = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_pw_trade_social_system_for_army_tt
		hidden_effect = { NAM_board_dev_raise_army = yes }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		NAM_board_dev_lower_social_system = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

NAM_pw_dev_raise_social_system = {
	ADISCORD_initialize_society_development_variables = yes
	add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_social_system_development_progress value = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_social_system_development_progress value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { ADISCORD_social_system_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_development_remainder value = ADISCORD_social_system_development_progress }
		add_to_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_development_remainder value = -100 }
		ADISCORD_increase_social_system_development = yes
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_social_system_development_progress value = ADISCORD_development_remainder }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_social_system_development_at_least_5 = yes }
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_social_system_development_progress value = 0 }
	}
}

# The level setter clears progress, so the kept progress is restored after the drop.
NAM_pw_dev_lower_state = {
	ADISCORD_initialize_society_development_variables = yes
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_state_development_at_least_2 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_dev_kept value = ADISCORD_state_development_progress }
		ADISCORD_decrease_state_development = yes
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_state_development_progress value = NAM_board_dev_kept }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_state_development_progress value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_pw_dev_cut_state }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_state_development_monthly_growth value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_state_development_monthly_growth value = -1 }
			set_country_flag = NAM_pw_dev_cut_state
		}
	}
}

NAM_pw_dev_lower_economic = {

# ----- Postwar paid orders -----
# Receipts own each payment and channel; callbacks clear them before delivery or refund.
NAM_veteran_housing_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_veteran_housing_paid }
		clr_country_flag = NAM_veteran_housing_paid
		clr_country_flag = NAM_pw_civil_busy
		add_political_power = 35
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 500 }
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
	}
}

NAM_veteran_housing_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_veteran_housing_paid
			NAM_veteran_housing_ready = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = { flag = NAM_veteran_housing_paid value > 1 } }
			688 = {
				add_building_construction = {
					type = industrial_complex
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = NAM_veteran_housing_blueprint
		clr_country_flag = NAM_veteran_housing_paid
		clr_country_flag = NAM_pw_civil_busy
		700 = {
			add_building_construction = {
				type = industrial_complex
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = NAM_housing_programme
			days = 60
		}
	}
	else = { NAM_veteran_housing_refund = yes }
}

# STATE. The receipt records which office reserved the slot when the order was signed.
NAM_pw_district_allotment_close = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_pw_allotment_authority = 1 } }
		NAM = { clr_country_flag = NAM_pw_civil_busy }
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_pw_allotment_authority
}

NAM_pw_district_allotment_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = NAM_pw_allotment_authority } }
		hidden_effect = { NAM_pw_district_allotment_close = yes }
		NAM = { add_political_power = 25 }
	}
}

NAM_pw_district_allotment_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_variable = NAM_pw_allotment_authority } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				hidden_trigger = {
					NAM_pw_district_allotment_site = yes
					NAM = { NAM_district_audit_ready = yes }
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = { NAM_pw_district_allotment_close = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { hidden_trigger = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_ladder_ending_service } } }
				if = {
					limit = {
						hidden_trigger = {
							NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_pw_allotment_site_opened }
							OR = {
								infrastructure > 4
								NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_pw_cadastre }
							}
						}
					}
					add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
					hidden_effect = { set_state_flag = NAM_pw_allotment_site_opened }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { hidden_trigger = { infrastructure < 5 } }
					add_building_construction = {
						type = infrastructure
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { hidden_trigger = { infrastructure > 3 } }
					NAM = {
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = motorized_equipment
							amount = 120
							producer = NAM
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					NAM = {
						add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
							type = motorized_equipment
							amount = 80
							producer = NAM
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { hidden_trigger = { NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_namestnik_garrisons } } }
					add_dynamic_modifier = {
						modifier = NAM_pw_district_fleet_called
						days = 90
					}
				}
				else = {
					add_dynamic_modifier = {
						modifier = NAM_pw_district_fleet_called
						days = 180
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = { NAM_pw_district_allotment_refund = yes }

			has_country_flag = NAM_pw_forward_base_paid

		}

					add_building_construction = {
						type = anti_air_building
						level = 1

					}

			}
		}

				add_building_construction = {
					type = bunker
					level = 1
					province = 16721
					instant_build = yes
				}

					limit = { anti_air_building < 5 }
					add_building_construction = {
						type = anti_air_building
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			67 = {
				add_building_construction = {
					type = bunker
					level = 1
					province = 6099
					instant_build = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { anti_air_building < 5 }

						type = anti_air_building

						instant_build = yes
					}

# STATE. The local receipt owns the workers until this plant opens or releases them.
NAM_plant_conversion_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_plant_conversion_underway }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM = { NAM_plant_conversion_authorised = yes }
				has_state_flag = NAM_project_in_progress
				NAM_plant_conversion_site = yes
			}
			remove_building = { type = arms_factory level = 1 }
			add_building_construction = {
				type = industrial_complex
				level = 2
				instant_build = yes
			}
			set_state_flag = NAM_demobilised_plant
			clr_state_flag = NAM_plant_conversion_underway
			NAM_project_close = yes
			NAM = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
		}
		else = { NAM_plant_conversion_cancel = yes }
	}
}

	}
}

NAM_pw_district_congress_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_pw_district_congress_paid
			NAM_pw_district_congress_ready = yes
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_pw_district_congress_paid
		clr_country_flag = NAM_pw_civil_busy
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 10 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = -3 }
		NAM_groups_refresh = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = NAM_tenant_petition_site }
			event_target:NAM_tenant_petition_site = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_owned_by = NAM
						is_controlled_by = NAM
					}
					if = {
						limit = { infrastructure < 5 }
						add_building_construction = {
							type = infrastructure
							level = 1
							instant_build = yes
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_tenant_supply_depot } }
						remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_tenant_supply_depot }
					}
					add_dynamic_modifier = {
						modifier = NAM_tenant_supply_depot
						days = 90
					}
				}
			}
			clear_global_event_target = NAM_tenant_petition_site
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_public_utilities }
			NAM_workers_inspection_dispatch = yes
		}
	}
	else = { NAM_pw_district_congress_refund = yes }
}

}

# COUNTRY desert tag (WEF, KDR, RHM, SDR), from NAM_well_partnerships. The tie is
# read before the push, so a country leaning toward Shahrabad gains the push only.
NAM_well_partnerships_desert_rows = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ADISCORD_south_in_contest = yes
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_coalition_influence value = 0 compare = less_than } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_tie_value value = 2 }
		ADISCORD_south_set_north_tie = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = SHL_embassy }
		set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_push_delta value = 8 }
		ADISCORD_south_push_influence_north = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM, answer b of ADISCORD_nam_story.377. Pushes the desert country that
# leans furthest toward Shahrabad. The four fixed candidates record the pick in
# NAM variables, which are cleared at the end.
NAM_well_land_buyout_push = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_index value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_lean value = 101 }
	WEF = {
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_south_desert_pick_candidate = yes }
			NAM = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_lean value = PREV.ADISCORD_south_coalition_influence }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_index value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	KDR = {
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_south_desert_pick_candidate = yes }
			NAM = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_lean value = PREV.ADISCORD_south_coalition_influence }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_index value = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	RHM = {
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_south_desert_pick_candidate = yes }
			NAM = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_lean value = PREV.ADISCORD_south_coalition_influence }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_index value = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	SDR = {
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_south_desert_pick_candidate = yes }
			NAM = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_lean value = PREV.ADISCORD_south_coalition_influence }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_index value = 4 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_index value = 1 compare = equals } }
		WEF = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_push_delta value = 5 }
			ADISCORD_south_push_influence_north = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_index value = 2 compare = equals } }
		KDR = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_push_delta value = 5 }
			ADISCORD_south_push_influence_north = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_index value = 3 compare = equals } }
		RHM = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_push_delta value = 5 }
			ADISCORD_south_push_influence_north = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_pick_desert_index value = 4 compare = equals } }
		SDR = {
			set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_push_delta value = 5 }
			ADISCORD_south_push_influence_north = yes
		}
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_pick_desert_index
	clear_variable = NAM_pick_desert_lean
}

# ----- Post-war district course: southern rows (end) -----

# ----- National naval procurement -----
# The fixed-price template stays locked while the permanent programme is open;
# ordinary recruitment remains available independently of paid orders.
NAM_naval_ensure_marine_template = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Naval Landing Detachment" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Naval Landing Detachment"
			override_model = ADISCORD_NAM_marine_entity
			template_counter = 34
			division_names_group = ADISCORD_INF_01
			is_locked = yes
			regiments = {
				ADISCORD_marine_infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				ADISCORD_marine_infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				ADISCORD_marine_infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
			}
		}
		set_division_force_allow_recruiting = {
			division_template = "Naval Landing Detachment"
			force_allow_recruiting = yes
		}
	}
}

		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_coast_observation_paid }

		add_political_power = 50
	}
}

			has_country_flag = NAM_coast_observation_paid

				type = radar_station
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else = { NAM_coast_observation_order_refund = yes }
}

# STATE. Only this project's receipt may complete or cancel the hydroelectric works.
NAM_project_complete_hydroelectric = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = NAM_project_in_progress
			check_variable = { var = NAM_project_deposit value = 1200 compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_project_pp_deposit value = 50 compare = equals }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_hydroelectric_site = yes }
			NAM_project_close = yes
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
			add_building_construction = {
				type = industrial_complex
				level = 2
				instant_build = yes
			}
			add_building_construction = {
				type = dam
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
				province = 3127
			}
			add_building_construction = {
				type = hidden_dam
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
			67 = {
				add_building_construction = {
					type = dam
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
					province = 12668
				}
				add_building_construction = {
					type = hidden_dam
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
			NAM = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_crisis_dam_commissioned } }
					set_country_flag = NAM_crisis_dam_commissioned
					NAM_crisis_apply_interval_bonus = yes
				}
				NAM_grid_refresh_connections = yes
				ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
			}
		}
		else = { NAM_project_release = yes }
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Consume the case before removing its mission; the cancellation
# callback cannot settle it twice. A new clock starts after each resolution.
NAM_crisis_close = {
	clr_country_flag = NAM_crisis_open
	if = {
		limit = { has_active_mission = NAM_incident_response }
		remove_mission = NAM_incident_response
	}
	NAM_crisis_draw = yes
}

NAM_crisis_response_timeout = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_crisis_case_1 = yes
			has_completed_focus = NAM_field_firefighters
		}
		NAM_crisis_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_industrial_claim_payable = yes }
		NAM_settle_industrial_claim = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_garrison_families_entitled = yes }
		NAM_pay_garrison_families = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_crisis_fund
			OR = {
				NAM_crisis_case_1 = yes
				NAM_crisis_case_2 = yes
				NAM_crisis_case_3 = yes
				NAM_crisis_case_4 = yes
				NAM_crisis_case_5 = yes
				NAM_crisis_case_6 = yes
				NAM_crisis_case_7 = yes
				NAM_crisis_case_8 = yes
				NAM_crisis_case_9 = yes
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_crisis_fund
		NAM_crisis_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_crisis_case_1 = yes }
		NAM_crisis_default_1 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_crisis_case_2 = yes }
		NAM_crisis_default_2 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_crisis_case_3 = yes }
		NAM_crisis_default_3 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_crisis_case_4 = yes }
		add_stability = -0.02
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_chancellery_purge }
			NAM_receive_250 = yes
		}
		else = { ADISCORD_economy_receive_100 = yes }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 5 }
		NAM_groups_refresh = yes
		NAM_crisis_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_crisis_case_5 = yes }
		NAM_crisis_default_5 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_crisis_case_6 = yes }
		NAM_crisis_default_6 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_crisis_case_7 = yes }
		NAM_crisis_default_7 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_crisis_case_8 = yes }
		NAM_crisis_default_8 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_crisis_case_9 = yes }
		NAM_crisis_default_9 = yes
	}
	else = { NAM_crisis_close = yes }
}

# STATE. A recorded settlement receives a grant once, under the funded city programme.
NAM_returnee_deliver_grant = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_returnee_settlement value = 1 compare = equals }
			is_owned_by = NAM
			is_controlled_by = NAM
			NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_project_in_progress }
			NAM = { NAM_pw_operable = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NAM = { has_idea = NAM_pw_public_utilities_idea } }
			if = {
				limit = { infrastructure < 5 }
				add_building_construction = {
					type = infrastructure
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				NAM = {
					add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = motorized_equipment amount = 30 producer = NAM }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_returnee_settlement value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NAM = { has_idea = NAM_pw_municipal_services_idea } }
			if = {
				limit = { free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no } }
				add_building_construction = {
					type = industrial_complex
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				NAM = {
					add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment amount = 60 producer = NAM }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_returnee_settlement value = 2 }
		}
	}
}

	}
}

	else = { NAM_war_refugee_registration_refund = yes }
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Every resource-war settlement closes the prewar network.

		NAM_agreement_cancel = yes
		NAM_weber_talks_refund = yes
		NAM_underground_close_event = yes

		688 = { NAM_sweep_release = yes }
		689 = { NAM_sweep_release = yes }
		690 = { NAM_sweep_release = yes }
		719 = { NAM_sweep_release = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_campaign_answer_leaflets_slot_held }
			clr_country_flag = NAM_campaign_answer_leaflets_slot_held
			ADISCORD_campaign_slot_release = yes
		}
		remove_decision = NAM_campaign_answer_leaflets
		remove_decision = NAM_colonial_pipeline_guard
		remove_decision = NAM_disrupt_print_supply
		remove_decision = NAM_weber_talks_1
		remove_decision = NAM_weber_talks_2
		remove_decision = NAM_weber_talks_3
		clear_variable = NAM_underground
		clear_variable = NAM_underground_growth
		clr_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_40
		clr_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_60
		clr_country_flag = NAM_ug_alarm_80
		clr_country_flag = NAM_ug_sabotage_cooldown
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
}

# ----- Political agreements -----
# The contract number is also the pillar number: namestniks, oil, districts,
# garrisons, trade. Progress is written only after delivery of real assets.
NAM_agreement_add_support = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_support_pillar value = NAM_agreement_current }
	NAM_agreement_adjust_pillar_support = yes
}

NAM_agreement_adjust_pillar_support = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_support_pillar = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = NAM_agreement_support_delta }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_support_pillar = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = NAM_agreement_support_delta }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_support_pillar = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = NAM_agreement_support_delta }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_support_pillar = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = NAM_agreement_support_delta }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_support_pillar = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = NAM_agreement_support_delta }
	}
	NAM_groups_refresh = yes
}

NAM_agreement_close_objection = {
	clear_variable = NAM_agreement_objector
	clr_country_flag = NAM_agreement_part_performed
}

NAM_agreement_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_agreement_cash_deposit }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = NAM_agreement_cash_deposit }
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
		add_political_power = 75
		clear_variable = NAM_agreement_cash_deposit
		clr_country_flag = NAM_pw_civil_busy
	}
	67 = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building }
			clr_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building
			NAM_project_release = yes
		}
	}
	688 = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building }
			clr_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building
			NAM_project_release = yes
		}
	}
	689 = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building }
			clr_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building
			NAM_project_release = yes
		}
	}
	690 = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building }
			clr_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building
			NAM_project_release = yes
		}
	}
	719 = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building }
			clr_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building
			NAM_project_release = yes
		}
	}
	700 = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building }
			clr_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building
			NAM_project_release = yes
		}
	}
}

NAM_agreement_finish = {
	NAM_agreement_close_objection = yes
	NAM_agreement_refund = yes
	clear_variable = NAM_agreement_current
	clr_country_flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending
	remove_mission = NAM_agreement_deadline
	remove_mission = NAM_agreement_crisis
	remove_decision = NAM_agreement_audit
	remove_decision = NAM_agreement_training
	clr_country_flag = NAM_agreement_audit_done
	clr_country_flag = NAM_agreement_training_done
	clear_variable = NAM_agreement_progress
	clear_variable = NAM_agreement_target
	clear_variable = NAM_agreement_offer_a
	clear_variable = NAM_agreement_offer_b
	set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_agreement_cooldown value = 1 days = 300 }
}

NAM_agreement_cancel = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = NAM_agreement_current
				has_country_flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = NAM_council_petition }
				has_country_flag = { flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending value > 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_council_petition value = NAM_agreement_offer_a }
		}
		NAM_agreement_finish = yes
	}
}

NAM_council_preview_rejection = {
	if = {
		limit = { hidden_trigger = { NAM_council_hearing_lapsed = yes } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_council_lapsed_tt
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { hidden_trigger = { NAM_council_nam_hearing = yes } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_council_audit_dissent_tt
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { hidden_trigger = { NAM_council_garr_hearing = yes } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_council_garr_recall_tt
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { hidden_trigger = { NAM_council_dist_hearing = yes } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_council_workshops_withdraw_tt
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { hidden_trigger = { NAM_council_oil_hearing = yes } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_council_oil_withdraw_tt
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { hidden_trigger = { NAM_council_trade_hearing = yes } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_council_trade_rebook_tt
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The selected delegation must still own one of the two live proposals.
NAM_agreement_sign_offer = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_agreement_offer_open = yes
			OR = {
				check_variable = { var = NAM_council_choice value = NAM_agreement_offer_a compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = NAM_council_choice value = NAM_agreement_offer_b compare = equals }
			}
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_council_choice = 1 }
				check_variable = { NAM_council_choice = 4 }
				AND = {
					check_variable = { NAM_council_choice = 2 }
					NAM_agreement_oil_possible = yes
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { NAM_council_choice = 3 }
					NAM_agreement_dist_possible = yes
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { NAM_council_choice = 5 }
					NAM_agreement_trade_possible = yes
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_current value = NAM_council_choice }
		NAM_agreement_start = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_agreement_offer_open = yes }
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.20 hours = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending }
		NAM_agreement_cancel = yes
	}
}

NAM_agreement_start = {
	NAM_agreement_set_goal = yes
	# Keep the unsigned proposal on file until the council uses it or the agreement ends.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_current value = NAM_agreement_offer_b compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_b value = NAM_agreement_offer_a }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_council_hearing_lapsed = yes }
			clear_variable = NAM_agreement_offer_b
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NAM_council_nam_hearing = yes }
			add_political_power = -15
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.26 hours = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NAM_council_garr_hearing = yes }
			# Standby instructors keep the ordinary reserve bid open for the first fourteen days.
			set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_b value = 6 }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = -3 }
			NAM_groups_refresh = yes
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.28 hours = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NAM_council_dist_hearing = yes }
			clear_variable = NAM_agreement_offer_b
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = -3 }
			NAM_groups_refresh = yes
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.27 hours = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NAM_council_oil_hearing = yes }
			clear_variable = NAM_agreement_offer_b
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = -3 }
			NAM_groups_refresh = yes
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.24 hours = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NAM_council_trade_hearing = yes }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = -3 }
			NAM_groups_refresh = yes
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.25 hours = 1 }
		}
	}
	clear_variable = NAM_agreement_offer_a
	clr_country_flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending
	activate_mission = NAM_agreement_deadline
}

NAM_agreement_set_goal = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_progress value = 0 }
	clear_variable = NAM_agreement_target
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 4 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_target value = 200 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_council_garr_hearing = yes }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_target value = 100 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 1 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_target value = 300 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_council_nam_hearing = yes }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_target value = 150 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 3 }
			NAM_council_dist_hearing = yes
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_target value = 30 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 2 }
			NAM_council_oil_hearing = yes
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_target value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 2 } }
		# The last available expansion remains a valid contract at a developed field.
		set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_target value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_room value = 0 }
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = {
				NAM_field_state = yes
				is_controlled_by = NAM
				NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_wells_scorched }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_field_room value = NAM_field_max_capacity }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_field_room value = NAM_field_capacity }
			NAM = { add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_room value = PREV.NAM_agreement_field_room } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_room > 2 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_target value = 2 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 5 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_target value = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_council_trade_hearing = yes }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_target value = 2 }
		}
	}
}

NAM_agreement_success = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_agreement_peace = yes
			NAM_agreement_goal_met = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_support_delta value = 15 }
		NAM_agreement_add_support = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 1 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_agreement_nam_reward days = 365 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 2 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_agreement_oil_reward days = 365 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 3 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_agreement_dist_reward days = 365 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 4 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_agreement_garr_reward days = 365 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 5 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_agreement_trade_reward days = 365 }
		}
		NAM_agreement_finish = yes
	}
	else = { NAM_agreement_cancel = yes }
}

NAM_agreement_failure = {
	NAM_agreement_close_objection = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_agreement_peace = yes
			has_variable = NAM_agreement_current
			NOT = { has_active_mission = NAM_agreement_crisis }
		}
		NAM_agreement_refund = yes
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_support_delta value = -20 }
		NAM_agreement_add_support = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 1 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_agreement_nam_failure days = 180 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 2 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_agreement_oil_failure days = 180 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 3 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_agreement_dist_failure days = 180 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 4 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_agreement_garr_failure days = 180 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 5 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = NAM_agreement_trade_failure days = 180 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { NAM_agreement_support_broken = yes }
			activate_mission = NAM_agreement_crisis
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.22 hours = 1 }
		}
		else = { NAM_agreement_finish = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_agreement_peace = no }
		NAM_agreement_cancel = yes
	}
}

NAM_agreement_crisis_escalate = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_agreement_peace = yes
			has_variable = NAM_agreement_current
		}
		add_stability = -0.10
		add_political_power = -50
		set_variable = { var = NAM_rival_current value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 1 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_rival_current value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 2 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_rival_current value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 4 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_rival_current value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 5 } }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_rival_current value = 4 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_rival_current_pillar_broken = yes
				NAM_rival_current_heard = no
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_ladder_settled }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_coup_succeeded }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_rival_event_pending }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 1 }
						NAM_rival_pechat_free = yes
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 2 }
						NAM_rival_klyuch_free = yes
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 3 }
						NAM_rival_shtyk_free = yes
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { NAM_rival_current = 4 }
						NAM_rival_gavanov_free = yes
					}
				}
			}
			NAM_rival_open_coup = yes
		}
	}
	NAM_agreement_finish = yes
}

NAM_agreements_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_agreement_peace = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_agreement_cooldown }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_rival_event_pending }
			NOT = { has_variable = NAM_agreement_current }
		}
		NAM_agreement_check_crisis = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = NAM_agreement_current } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_council_petition = 1 } }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_a value = 1 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending value = 6 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_council_petition = 4 } }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_a value = 4 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending value = 4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_council_petition = 3 }
					NAM_agreement_dist_possible = yes
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_a value = 3 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending value = 3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_council_petition = 2 }
					NAM_agreement_oil_possible = yes
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_a value = 2 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending value = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { NAM_council_petition = 5 }
					NAM_agreement_trade_possible = yes
				}
				set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_a value = 5 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending value = 5 }
			}
			else = {
				random_list = {
					20 = {
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							NAM_agreement_nam_possible = no
						}
						modifier = {
							factor = 3
							check_variable = { NAM_grp_nam_support < 35 }
						}
						set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_a value = 1 }
					}
					20 = {
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							NAM_agreement_oil_possible = no
						}
						modifier = {
							factor = 3
							check_variable = { NAM_grp_oil_support < 35 }
						}
						set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_a value = 2 }
					}
					20 = {
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							NAM_agreement_dist_possible = no
						}
						modifier = {
							factor = 3
							check_variable = { NAM_grp_dist_support < 35 }
						}
						set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_a value = 3 }
					}
					20 = {
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							NAM_agreement_garr_possible = no
						}
						modifier = {
							factor = 3
							check_variable = { NAM_grp_garr_support < 35 }
						}
						set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_a value = 4 }
					}
					20 = {
						modifier = {
							factor = 0
							NAM_agreement_trade_possible = no
						}
						modifier = {
							factor = 3
							check_variable = { NAM_grp_trade_support < 35 }
						}
						set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_a value = 5 }
					}
				}
			}
			clear_variable = NAM_council_petition
			random_list = {
				20 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0
						OR = {
							NAM_agreement_nam_possible = no
							check_variable = { NAM_agreement_offer_a = 1 }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_b value = 1 }
				}
				20 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0
						OR = {
							NAM_agreement_oil_possible = no
							check_variable = { NAM_agreement_offer_a = 2 }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_b value = 2 }
				}
				20 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0
						OR = {
							NAM_agreement_dist_possible = no
							check_variable = { NAM_agreement_offer_a = 3 }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_b value = 3 }
				}
				20 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0
						OR = {
							NAM_agreement_garr_possible = no
							check_variable = { NAM_agreement_offer_a = 4 }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_b value = 4 }
				}
				20 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0
						OR = {
							NAM_agreement_trade_possible = no
							check_variable = { NAM_agreement_offer_a = 5 }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_offer_b value = 5 }
				}

			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_agreement_offer_pending value = 1 }
			}
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.20 hours = 6 }
		}
	}
}

NAM_agreement_district_deliver = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building
			has_state_flag = NAM_project_in_progress
			NAM = { NAM_agreement_dist_active = yes }
			NAM_agreement_district_buildable = yes
		}
		clr_state_flag = NAM_agreement_building
		NAM_project_close = yes
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = {
			type = industrial_complex
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
		add_building_construction = {
			type = infrastructure
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
		NAM = {
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_progress value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_target > 0 } }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = motorized_equipment
					amount = NAM_agreement_target
					producer = NAM
				}
			}
			ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		}
	}
	else = { NAM_agreement_district_refund = yes }
}

NAM_agreement_check_crisis = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_crisis_group value = 0 }
	random_list = {
		40 = { }
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { NAM_grp_nam_support < 25 }
						check_variable = { ADISCORD_economy_treasury < 0 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_crisis_group value = 1 }
		}
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { NAM_grp_oil_support < 25 }
						any_owned_state = {
							NAM_field_state = yes
							OR = {
								check_variable = { NAM_field_condition < 50 }
								NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_crisis_group value = 2 }
		}
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { NAM_grp_dist_support < 25 }
						has_stability < 0.35
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_crisis_group value = 3 }
		}
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { NAM_grp_garr_support < 25 }
						has_war_support < 0.30
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_crisis_group value = 4 }
		}
		20 = {
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { NAM_grp_trade_support < 25 }
						700 = {
							is_owned_by = NAM
							NOT = { is_controlled_by = NAM }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_crisis_group value = 5 }
		}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_crisis_group > 0 } }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_agreement_current value = NAM_agreement_crisis_group }
		activate_mission = NAM_agreement_crisis
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.22 hours = 1 }
	}
}
