# ----- Rom's Veyran expedition -----

# The array belongs to the campaign and survives save/load. Occupied foreign
# states and the lands of southern subjects never enter the governorate.
NAM_veyran_start_invasion = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_veyran_can_invade = yes }
		every_owned_state = {
			add_to_array = { array = global.NAM_veyran_homeland value = THIS }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_veyran_campaign value = 1 }
		declare_war_on = {
			target = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation
			type = annex_everything
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation } }
			NAM_veyran_settle_defeat = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Commit the result before native peace, annex and puppet effects
# can re-enter the campaign through their own callbacks.
NAM_veyran_settle_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_veyran_invasion_active = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_veyran_campaign value = 2 }
		clear_temp_array = NAM_veyran_annexed_states
		event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation = {
			every_owned_state = {
				add_to_temp_array = { array = NAM_veyran_annexed_states value = THIS }
			}
		}
		white_peace = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation
		annex_country = { target = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation transfer_troops = no }
		# Impassable states can survive the native annexation.
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = NAM_veyran_annexed_states
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_owned_by = NAM } }
				NAM = { transfer_state = PREV }
			}
			set_state_controller_to = NAM
		}
		clear_temp_array = NAM_veyran_annexed_states
		32 = {
			add_core_of = NAM
			set_state_controller_to = NAM
		}
		set_capital = { state = 32 }
		set_cosmetic_tag = NAM_veyran_union
		NAM_refresh_subject_identities = yes
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.NAM_veyran_homeland
			add_core_of = SNG
			SNG = { transfer_state = PREV }
			set_state_controller_to = SNG
		}
		clear_array = global.NAM_veyran_homeland
		puppet = {
			target = SNG
			end_wars = no
			end_civil_wars = no
		}
		set_autonomy = {
			target = SNG
			autonomy_state = autonomy_NAM_imperial_governorate
			freedom_level = 0.10
			end_wars = no
			end_civil_wars = no
		}
		SNG = {
			if = {
				limit = { owns_state = 700 }
				set_capital = { state = 700 }
			}
			inherit_technology = NAM
			ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		}
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.408 hours = 1 }
	}
}

NAM_veyran_settle_defeat = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_veyran_invasion_active = yes }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_veyran_campaign value = 2 }
		clear_array = global.NAM_veyran_homeland
		if = {
			limit = { has_war_with = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation }
			white_peace = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_cosmetic_tag = NAM_svetlogorye_derzhava
			NAM_refresh_subject_identities = yes
			country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.409 hours = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Native ROOT is the loser. White peace can omit the late callback, so its
# short-lived receipt belongs to this country rather than the next defeat.
NAM_veyran_handle_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_veyran_capitulation_managed = yes }
		ROOT = { set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_veyran_capitulation_reserved days = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = { tag = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation }
				32 = {
					OR = {
						is_owned_by = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation
						is_owned_by = NAM
					}
				}
			}
			NAM = { NAM_veyran_settle_victory = yes }
		}
		else = { NAM = { NAM_veyran_settle_defeat = yes } }
		# Annexation and a synchronous late callback can consume the first receipt.
		ROOT = { set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_veyran_capitulation_reserved days = 2 } }
	}
}

NAM_veyran_close_external = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_veyran_invasion_active = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { country_exists = NAM }
				NOT = { event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation = { exists = yes } }
				NAM = { is_subject = yes }
				event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation = { is_subject = yes }
				NAM = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation } }
			}
		}
		NAM = { NAM_veyran_settle_defeat = yes }
	}
}

			type = synthetic_refinery
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
		NAM_combine_sync_visual = yes
		NAM = {
			NAM_combine_support_refund = yes
			ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
		}
	}
	else = { NAM_combine_refund = yes }
}

# COUNTRY. Only one support order can hold a receipt; settlement is tied to its phase.
NAM_combine_support_refund = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_combine_support_cash }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = NAM_combine_support_cash }
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
		add_political_power = NAM_combine_support_pp
		NAM_combine_support_close = yes
	}
}

NAM_combine_support_close = {
	clear_variable = NAM_combine_support_cash
	clear_variable = NAM_combine_support_pp
	clear_variable = NAM_combine_support_phase
	clear_variable = NAM_combine_support_days
}

NAM_combine_support_deliver = {
	if = {
		limit = { NAM_combine_support_current = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_combine_support_phase value = 1 compare = equals } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_combine_support_days > 45 } }
				add_days_mission_timeout = {
					mission = NAM_combine_frame_process
					days = -60
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_days_mission_timeout = {
					mission = NAM_combine_frame_process
					days = -30
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_combine_support_phase value = 2 compare = equals } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { NAM_combine_support_days > 45 } }
				add_days_mission_timeout = {
					mission = NAM_combine_plant_process
					days = -60
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_days_mission_timeout = {
					mission = NAM_combine_plant_process
					days = -30
				}
			}
		}
		NAM_combine_support_close = yes
	}
	else = { NAM_combine_support_refund = yes }
}

# ----- Regional export offices -----
# STATE. Called only by the new-campaign field initializer.
NAM_export_office_initialize = {
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_quota value = 100 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_full_load value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_half_load value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_rate value = 0.3 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_level value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_cost value = 200 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_capacity value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_month_estimate value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_oil value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_oil_delta value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_last_day value = global.num_days }
}

# STATE. Integrate the previous quota before any change. Repeated refreshes on
# the same date add nothing; pausing and recapture cannot create a full month's sale.
NAM_export_office_accrue = {
	set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_elapsed value = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_elapsed value = NAM_export_office_last_day }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_elapsed value = NAM_export_office_oil }
	multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_elapsed value = NAM_export_office_rate }
	NAM = { add_to_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_unpaid value = PREV.NAM_export_office_elapsed } }
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_last_day value = global.num_days }
}

# STATE. Withhold a quota through a modifier, never through add_resource: the
# field ledger remains gross extraction and unrelated oil rewards stay intact.
NAM_export_office_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_export_office_level > 0 } }
		NAM_export_office_accrue = yes
		set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_rate value = 0.3 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_rate value = NAM.NAM_export_office_price_bonus }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_previous_capacity value = NAM_export_office_capacity }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_previous_estimate value = NAM_export_office_month_estimate }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_capacity value = 4 }
		add_to_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_capacity value = NAM.NAM_export_office_capacity_bonus }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_capacity value = NAM_export_office_level }
		set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_full_load value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_export_office_operating_site = yes }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_full_load value = NAM_export_office_capacity }
			clamp_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_full_load min = 0 max = NAM_field_oil }
		}
		# The domestic market keeps the odd unit when the dispatch is split.
		set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_half_load value = NAM_export_office_full_load }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_half_load value = 0.5 }
		subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_half_load value = 0.25 }
		round_variable = NAM_export_office_half_load
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_next value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_quota value = 100 compare = equals } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_next value = NAM_export_office_full_load }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_quota value = 50 compare = equals } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_next value = NAM_export_office_half_load }
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_month_estimate value = NAM_export_office_next }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_month_estimate value = NAM_export_office_rate }
		multiply_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_month_estimate value = 30 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_oil value = NAM_export_office_next compare = equals } }
			}
			set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_oil value = NAM_export_office_next }
			set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_oil_delta value = NAM_export_office_oil }
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_oil_delta value = -1 }
			force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
			NAM = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
			owner = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_capacity value = NAM_export_office_previous_capacity compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_month_estimate value = NAM_export_office_previous_estimate compare = equals } }
				}
			}
			force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. Only the five established mainland fields are visited.
NAM_export_office_refresh_all = {
	67 = { NAM_export_office_refresh = yes }
	688 = { NAM_export_office_refresh = yes }
	689 = { NAM_export_office_refresh = yes }
	690 = { NAM_export_office_refresh = yes }
	719 = { NAM_export_office_refresh = yes }
}

NAM_export_office_monthly = {
	NAM_export_office_refresh_all = yes
	set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_last_income value = NAM_export_office_unpaid }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NAM_export_office_unpaid > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = NAM_export_office_unpaid }
		NAM_add_treasury = yes
		# A substantial paid statement can back one exchange receipt and a bond
		# certificate. Bond repayment itself remains in the existing monthly hook.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_unpaid value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			if = {
				limit = { NAM_exchange_can_write_receipt = yes }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_exchange_receipts value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_completed_focus = NAM_municipal_bonds
						has_completed_focus = NAM_prag_ending_directorate
					}
				}
				NAM_certify_shipping_manifest = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_unpaid value = 0 }
	}
}

# STATE. A paid order owns the existing project escrow until delivery or refund.
NAM_export_office_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = NAM_export_office_order }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NAM_export_office_build_site = yes
				has_state_flag = NAM_project_in_progress
				NAM = { NAM_independent_programmes_operable = yes }
			}
			NAM_export_office_accrue = yes
			set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_level value = NAM_export_office_order }
			NAM_project_close = yes
			set_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_cost value = NAM_export_office_level }
			multiply_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_cost value = 150 }
			add_to_variable = { var = NAM_export_office_cost value = 200 }
			NAM_export_office_install_modifier = yes
			NAM_export_office_refresh = yes
			NAM_export_office_sync_visual = yes
		}
		else = { NAM_project_release = yes }
	}
}

# COUNTRY signatory. These event targets remain local to each scripted transaction.
NAM_neighbour_bind_government = {
	save_event_target_as = NAM_neighbour_government
	if = {
		limit = { tag = EFL }
		EFR = { save_event_target_as = NAM_neighbour_resistance }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = AZH }
		AZR = { save_event_target_as = NAM_neighbour_resistance }
	}
}

NAM_neighbour_recognise_republics = {
	EFL = {
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_neighbour_partner = yes }
			NAM_neighbour_recognise_signatory = yes
		}
	}
	AZH = {
		if = {
			limit = { NAM_neighbour_partner = yes }
			NAM_neighbour_recognise_signatory = yes
		}
	}
}

NAM_neighbour_recognise_signatory = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_subject_of = NAM }
		NAM = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = PREV
				autonomy_state = autonomy_free
				end_wars = no
				end_civil_wars = no
			}
		}
	}
	NAM_rw_clear_punishment = yes
	NAM = { give_guarantee = PREV }
	add_opinion_modifier = {
		target = NAM
		modifier = improve_relation
	}
}

# COUNTRY NAM. The founding treaty follows the government in power when the first ally joins or war begins.
NAM_form_campaign_alliance = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = NAM_alliance_directory
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_exile_radical }
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = NAM_alliance_admiralty
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_exile_humanist }
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = NAM_alliance_havens
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_defeat_revenge }
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = NAM_alliance_return
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_compromise }
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = NAM_alliance_loren
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_prewar_service_mandate = yes }
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = NAM_alliance_governors
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_prewar_district_mandate = yes }
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = NAM_alliance_districts
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NAM_prewar_pragmatic_mandate = yes }
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = NAM_alliance_compact
		}
	}
	else = {
		create_faction_from_template = {
			template = faction_template_ADISCORD_standard
			name = ADISCORD_south_north_faction
		}
	}
}

# During the southern crisis the alliance is signed in the coalition invitation event.
NAM_neighbour_apply_allied_staff = {

				AND = {
					tag = EFL
					NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_eflor_accord }

					tag = AZH
					NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_eflor_accord }

	}
}

				add_to_faction = PREV
			}

		}
	}
}

# A one-day interval after leaving a faction lets the native membership cache update before puppet.
NAM_neighbour_accept_command = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_neighbour_military_answer_open = yes
			has_country_flag = NAM_neighbour_command_offer
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_in_faction = yes
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = NAM }
			}
			ADISCORD_south_leave_previous_alliance = yes
		}
		country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.412 days = 1 }
	}
}

NAM_neighbour_establish_command = {
	ADISCORD_release_non_participating_minor_optimization = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_subject_of = NAM } }
		NAM = {
			puppet = {
				target = PREV
				end_wars = no
				end_civil_wars = no
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject_of = NAM
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_neighbour_military_command }
		}
		NAM = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = PREV
				autonomy_state = autonomy_NAM_namestnik_office
				freedom_level = 0.05
				end_wars = no
				end_civil_wars = no
			}
		}
		NAM_rw_clear_punishment = yes
		set_country_flag = NAM_neighbour_military_command
		NAM_board_sync_district_status = yes
		NAM = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_completed_focus = NAM_border_citizenship }
					NOT = { has_idea = NAM_neighbour_nationalists }
				}
				add_ideas = NAM_neighbour_nationalists
			}
		}
		NAM_neighbour_bind_government = yes
		# Preserve all current claims to national territory, including disputed
		# districts outside the governorate, under its own opposition tag.
		every_core_state = {
			add_core_of = event_target:NAM_neighbour_resistance
			remove_core_of = event_target:NAM_neighbour_government
		}
		NAM_neighbour_apply_completed_charters = yes
	}
}

# STATE. Each landless opposition has a fixed tag so both can hold cores concurrently.
NAM_neighbour_start_resistance = {
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_neighbour_command_resistance }
	force_enable_resistance = {
		occupier = event_target:NAM_neighbour_government
		occupied = event_target:NAM_neighbour_resistance
	}
	start_resistance = event_target:NAM_neighbour_resistance
	set_resistance = 30
}

NAM_neighbour_restore_local_core = {
	force_enable_resistance = {
		clear = yes
		occupier = event_target:NAM_neighbour_government
		occupied = event_target:NAM_neighbour_resistance
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_controlled_by = event_target:NAM_neighbour_government
			has_resistance = yes
		}
		cancel_resistance = yes
	}
	add_core_of = event_target:NAM_neighbour_government
	remove_core_of = event_target:NAM_neighbour_resistance
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_neighbour_command_resistance } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_neighbour_command_resistance }
	}
}

NAM_neighbour_integrate_centres = {
	every_subject_country = {
		limit = { NAM_neighbour_is_command = yes }
		army_experience = 15
		NAM_neighbour_bind_government = yes
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = {
				is_controlled_by = event_target:NAM_neighbour_government
				is_core_of = event_target:NAM_neighbour_resistance
				is_capital = yes
			}
			NAM_neighbour_restore_local_core = yes
		}
	}
}

NAM_neighbour_integrate_provinces = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NAM_neighbour_nationalists }
		remove_ideas = NAM_neighbour_nationalists
	}
	every_subject_country = {
		limit = { NAM_neighbour_is_command = yes }
		add_war_support = 0.10
		NAM_neighbour_bind_government = yes
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = {
				is_controlled_by = event_target:NAM_neighbour_government
				is_core_of = event_target:NAM_neighbour_resistance
			}
			NAM_neighbour_restore_local_core = yes
		}
	}
}

# A government accepting after the charter vote also receives the enacted stage.
NAM_neighbour_apply_completed_charters = {
	NAM_neighbour_bind_government = yes
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			is_controlled_by = event_target:NAM_neighbour_government
			is_core_of = event_target:NAM_neighbour_resistance
		}
		NAM_neighbour_apply_district_charter = yes
	}
}

# STATE, held by its local government. Reapply the local penalty after an occupation
# if the district is still administered under the military mandate.
NAM_neighbour_apply_district_charter = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM = { has_completed_focus = NAM_border_citizenship }
		}
		NAM_neighbour_restore_local_core = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NAM_neighbour_command_resistance } } }
		NAM_neighbour_start_resistance = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY former subject. A third party's temporary occupation does not cancel the native claim.
NAM_neighbour_close_command = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_neighbour_military_command }
		NAM_neighbour_bind_government = yes
		event_target:NAM_neighbour_resistance = {
			every_core_state = { NAM_neighbour_restore_local_core = yes }
		}
		clr_country_flag = NAM_neighbour_military_command
		NAM = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = NAM_neighbour_nationalists
					NAM_neighbour_has_command = no
				}
				remove_ideas = NAM_neighbour_nationalists
			}
		}
	}
}

NAM_neighbour_check_command_status = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_neighbour_military_command
			NOT = { is_subject_of = NAM }
		}
		NAM_neighbour_close_command = yes
	}
}

NAM_open_postwar_future = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_power_balance = { id = NAM_ladder_bop } }
		remove_power_balance = { id = NAM_ladder_bop }
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NAM_prewar_service_mandate = yes
			NOT = { has_power_balance = { id = NAM_postwar_future_bop } }
		}
		set_power_balance = { id = NAM_postwar_future_bop set_value = 0 }
	}
	NAM_depot_board_seed = yes
}
